    $ Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'destruction-model-implementation-plan.md'
    # Destruction model implementation plan
    
    Build one small wall that behaves correctly, then expand its generation and presentation. Keep components as plain state and put the rules in a handful of functions. Use the existing language, entity system and physics engine; this plan does not require a new framework.
    
    This plan follows the uploaded handoff and the decisions agreed in this conversation: replacement children inherit surviving boundary attachments; load calculation is replaceable; and destruction advances at most one generation per explosion evaluation or physics tick. Sustained physical loads may cause further generations on later ticks.
    
    **Starting storage**
    
    | Data | Simple first implementation |
    | --- | --- |
    | Material | Shared records containing the two strengths, flexibility and the three generation settings. |
    | Subdivision | Stable ID, range into a global outline vertex pool, and owning piece ID. |
    | Connection | Stable ID and two subdivision IDs. |
    | Piece | Stable ID, material reference, byte seed, and retained lists of subdivision and connection IDs. |
    | Physics state | Existing components or engine storage for bodies, poses and velocities. |
    | Derived connection data | Local anchor/sample offsets and engine joint handles, rebuilt when their source geometry or endpoints change. |
    | Per-pass scratch | Loads, failed IDs, affected pieces, replacement mappings and graph traversal buffers. |
    
    Keep entity identity independent of array position. If the current entity system already solves this, use it. Otherwise, monotonically assigned IDs and an ID-to-row lookup are sufficient initially. Store stable IDs in connections and membership lists; update row lookups when dense arrays move. Keep outlines in a common undeformed reference frame for related geometry so shared boundaries remain identifiable after bodies move.
    
    **1. Build the graph and a debug view**
    
    Create one hand-authored wall with a few polygon subdivisions, one material and explicit connections. Draw subdivision outlines, connection lines and piece colors. Add debug controls to remove a chosen subdivision or connection.
    
    Implement one structural update function. It removes failed links and subdivisions, discovers connected components in each affected piece, assigns ownership and retains the resulting membership lists. Start with a straightforward graph traversal and temporary adjacency built from the affected piece's connections. Rebuild that piece's lists completely after changes.
    
    Each resulting piece inherits the material. Derive its future-generation seed from the old seed and stable group identity/order. Preserve zero when the old seed is zero; derived nonterminal seeds use 1..255. Geometry already present is independent of this seed.
    
    **Done when:** removing a bridge connection produces two pieces; removing a subdivision also removes its incident links; every live subdivision belongs to exactly one connected piece.
    
    **2. Add the first blast destruction loop**
    
    Use a blast containing only position and radius. Keep the agreed fixed distance falloff and outward impulses proportional to local load and mass. Start with a simple candidate scan of this small scene. Use the physics engine's existing spatial query when scene size makes selection necessary.
    
    For an initial subdivision sampling default, use its posed polygon centroid and keep that choice in one function. For a connection, use the length-weighted shared-boundary rest point, transformed through both endpoints and averaged, as specified in the handoff. Derive the two local offsets when creating the connection and transform them at query time.
    
    Evaluate all candidates that exist at the start of this explosion evaluation. Compare positive loads with their material's appropriate shared threshold and collect failed IDs. Finite loads leave infinite-strength entities intact. Discard the loads after the pass.
    
    Initially exercise this using terminal pieces with seed zero: failed subdivisions disappear and connections can fail independently. Zero-seed geometry remains live until a failure actually occurs. Apply the structural update between physics steps.
    
    **Done when:** the wall loses the expected geometry and links, surviving groups separate, and repeated subthreshold blasts do not weaken anything.
    
    **3. Add procedural replacement and inherited connections**
    
    Create one generation function taking a parent outline, material recipe and seed. It returns child outlines, internal connections and stable child ordering. Start with one reproducible rectangular example. Extend the same pipeline to the supported concave outlines and the chunk, splinter and shatter presets using subdivision count, aspect ratio and triangulation.
    
    Generate each shared displaced boundary once and reuse it in both neighboring outlines. Preserve the parent's outside boundary during replacement. Produce any convex collision decomposition as derived fixtures of the same logical subdivision.
    
    Extend the structural update to replace eligible failed subdivisions with children. Seed zero produces no children. Preserve the direct-removal path for results already selected for discard.
    
    Before removing old endpoints, retain their original neighbor relationships and which connections independently failed. Across an old connection that survived its own failure test, connect replacement descendants sharing a nonzero length of its original boundary. If both endpoints were replaced, compare descendants on both sides. Connections that failed remain broken. Consider only old neighbor relationships, so earlier breaks cannot be healed by geometric proximity.
    
    Stage all replacements before reconnecting and regrouping. Generated children are absent from the current pass's evaluation set. Derive their future piece seeds using stable ordering and identity, independently of physical array order.
    
    **Done when:** a failed subdivision can become smaller geometry while keeping surviving attachments; a simultaneously broken boundary stays disconnected; changing failure-processing order gives the same result.
    
    **4. Connect physics and the replaceable load calculation**
    
    Give each retained subdivision one rigid body, with as many derived convex fixtures as needed. Represent connections with one suitable joint type and map the shared flexibility value to its softness. Keep damping a global implementation setting initially. A piece remains a graph grouping; its subdivisions retain their own motion.
    
    After each fixed physics tick, read the reactions and collect failures through the same path used by blasts. Implement the initial policies as plain functions:
    
    ```text
    equivalent_force = impulse / interval_covered_by_that_impulse
    interaction_load = max(force_magnitude, abs(torque) / reference_length)
    subdivision_load = largest_individual_interaction_load
    connection_load = load_from_its_own_joint_reaction
    fails = load > 0 and load >= relevant_material_strength
    ```
    
    Choose one global reference length, initially one world unit, and calibrate the fixed blast falloff onto the same load scale. Combine contact points belonging to the same logical interaction before choosing the strongest interaction. Keep different opposing interactions separate so squeezing is not lost through cancellation. All load scratch is temporary.
    
    Keep force/torque conversion and interaction aggregation together in a small load-calculation function. Replacing that function can change the approximation later without changing the component relationships or threshold check.
    
    Preserve existing bodies and their motion when only piece ownership changes. For generated children, inherit the parent's angular velocity and its linear velocity evaluated at each child's center. Apply an explosion's impulse to the original motion before transferring motion to replacements; do not sample that explosion again on the children. Create and remove bodies and joints between engine steps.
    
    **Done when:** an impact or overloaded connection uses the same structural update as a blast, flexible and stiff materials behave differently, and fragments inherit the parent's motion without receiving the same blast twice.
    
    **5. Finish size filtering and presentation**
    
    After regrouping, measure each resulting connected group's orientation-independent geometric width. Put the width calculation in one function. A straightforward convex-hull and edge-normal projection calculation is a reasonable initial implementation of the agreed shortest overall dimension.
    
    Groups below the global minimum width become visual fading remnants. Apply this filter to resulting pieces; small subdivisions may still belong to a sufficiently large connected piece. Filter new results before creating their physics bodies. Existing bodies selected for fading are removed between steps.
    
    Render the stored polygons from their body poses. Add simple interpolation across flexible connections for the rubber-like cosmetic surface once the physical motion works. Keep that surface separate from collision and failure geometry.
    
    **Done when:** rotating a group does not change the width decision, narrow separated remnants fade, and collision triangles never appear as extra destruction entities.
    
    **6. Add transmission after the local loop works**
    
    Expose a simple state reader using stable IDs. Send geometry, connections, ownership and generation context on structural changes, plus the motion state needed for interpolation. Start with explicit snapshots using the project's existing transport.
    
    Transmit existing geometry or the information actually needed to reconstruct it. The current piece seed only governs future generation and cannot by itself reconstruct the current damaged shape. Cosmetic surface interpolation may differ between clients.
    
    **Done when:** a receiver can display a structure, apply a split and interpolate the surviving geometry using the transmitted state.
    
    **The shared structural update**
    
    Both explosion and physics passes use this order:
    
    ```text
    evaluate loads on the entities present at pass start
    collect failed subdivision and connection IDs
    stage deletions and one generation of replacements
    rebuild inherited links across old surviving boundaries
    find connected groups and retain their memberships
    filter groups by minimum width
    update physics representations and presentation state
    ```
    
    This is one implementation path with reusable helper functions. A temporary failure list is enough to keep children out of the current evaluation. A continuing physical overload may affect them on a later tick.
    
    **Verification to keep throughout implementation**
    
    Use the same small wall and a few focused behavior checks:
    
    - Removing a bridge link and removing a central subdivision produce the expected graph partitions and membership lists.
    - Replacements inherit intact boundaries and never restore independently failed connections, including simultaneous replacement of both endpoints.
    - One explosion produces at most one generation; sustained overload may progress on later physics ticks.
    - Seed zero stays live until failure and generates no children. The same outline, recipe, seed and stable ordering reproduce the same output after storage rows are shuffled.
    - Subthreshold events leave strengths unchanged; infinite strengths survive finite loads.
    - Child motion includes the parent's rotation, and an explosion is not applied twice to replacements.
    - Width filtering is unchanged by rotation and runs before new physics creation; multiple collision fixtures remain one logical subdivision.
    
    **Keep the first version small**
    
    Use ordinary arrays, per-piece member lists and complete rebuilds of affected pieces. Reuse the benchmark fixtures as examples and the benchmark results as evidence for membership retention and local sample caching. Measure the complete working scene before adding more specialized storage.
    
    Leave full-world repacking, incremental membership patching, eager world-space sample caches, parallel processing, custom allocators, network compression and rollback for demonstrated needs. Start implementation with phase 1's wall and debug removals.
    
    The plan is engine-agnostic. For Box2D integration, consult the installed version's [simulation documentation](https://box2d.org/documentation/md_simulation.html) for safe update timing, joint reactions and the time interval represented by contact impulses. Global normalization choices in this plan are gameplay rules.

    package main

    vadd :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {a.x+b.x, a.y+b.y} }
    vsub :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y} }
    vmul :: proc(a: Vec2, s: f32) -> Vec2 { return {a.x*s, a.y*s} }
    vdot :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> f32 { return a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y }
    vcross :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> f32 { return a.x*b.y-a.y*b.x }
    vlen :: proc(a: Vec2) -> f32 { return math.sqrt(vdot(a,a)) }
    vrotate :: proc(a: Vec2, angle: f32) -> Vec2 {
    	c, s := f32(math.cos(angle)), f32(math.sin(angle))
    	return {a.x*c-a.y*s,a.x*s+a.y*c}
    }
    centroid :: proc(p: Polygon) -> Vec2 {
    	area, x, y: f32
    	for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
    		a, b := p.points[i], p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
    		cross := vcross(a,b)
    		area += cross
    		x += (a.x+b.x)*cross
    		y += (a.y+b.y)*cross
    	}
    	if math.abs(area) < 0.00001 {
    		for point in p.points { x += point.x; y += point.y }
    		return {x/f32(len(p.points)),y/f32(len(p.points))}
    	}
    	return {x/(3*area),y/(3*area)}
    }
    posed_point :: proc(sub: Subdivision, rest: Vec2) -> Vec2 {
    	return vadd(sub.pose.position,vrotate(vsub(rest,sub.rest_center),sub.pose.angle))
    }
    posed_polygon :: proc(sub: Subdivision) -> Polygon {
    	result := Polygon{}
    	for point in sub.outline.points { append(&result.points,posed_point(sub,point)) }
    	return result
    }
    // Returns the common collinear edge length and its length-weighted midpoint.
    shared_boundary :: proc(a, b: Polygon) -> (f32, Vec2) {
    	total: f32
    	weighted := Vec2{}
    	for i in 0..<len(a.points) {
    		p, q := a.points[i], a.points[(i+1)%len(a.points)]
    		d := vsub(q,p)
    		length := vlen(d)
    		if length < 0.00001 { continue }
    		unit := vmul(d,1/length)
    		for j in 0..<len(b.points) {
    			r, s := b.points[j], b.points[(j+1)%len(b.points)]
    			if math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(r,p))) > 0.0001*length || math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(s,p))) > 0.0001*length { continue }
    			t0, t1 := vdot(vsub(r,p),unit), vdot(vsub(s,p),unit)
    			lo := max(f32(0),min(t0,t1))
    			hi := min(length,max(t0,t1))
    			if hi-lo > 0.0001 {
    				span := hi-lo
    				total += span
    				weighted = vadd(weighted,vmul(vadd(p,vmul(unit,(lo+hi)*0.5)),span))
    			}
    		}
    	}
    	if total == 0 { return 0, {} }
    	return total,vmul(weighted,1/total)
    }
    new_id :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> u64 { s.next_id += 1; return s.next_id }
    new_scene :: proc(minimum_width: f32) -> Scene {
    	return Scene{sub_rows=make(map[u64]int),conn_rows=make(map[u64]int),piece_rows=make(map[u64]int),minimum_width=minimum_width}
    }
    add_material :: proc(s: ^Scene, m: Material) -> int { append(&s.materials,m); return len(s.materials)-1 }
    add_piece :: proc(s: ^Scene, material: int, seed: u8) -> u64 {
    	id := new_id(s)
    	s.piece_rows[id] = len(s.pieces)
    	append(&s.pieces,Piece{id=id,material=material,seed=seed,live=true})
    	return id
    }
    add_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene, owner: u64, outline: Polygon, pose: Pose) -> u64 {
    	id := new_id(s)
    	center := centroid(outline)
    	s.sub_rows[id] = len(s.subdivisions)
    	append(&s.subdivisions,Subdivision{id=id,owner=owner,material=s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].material,outline=outline,rest_center=center,pose=pose,live=true})
    	return id
    }
    add_connection :: proc(s: ^Scene, a, b: u64) -> u64 {
    	if a == b { return 0 }
    	for c in s.connections { if c.live && ((c.a == a && c.b == b) || (c.a == b && c.b == a)) { return c.id } }
    	sa, sb := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[b]]
    	length, point := shared_boundary(sa.outline,sb.outline)
    	if length <= 0 { return 0 }
    	id := new_id(s)
    	s.conn_rows[id] = len(s.connections)
    	append(&s.connections,Connection{id=id,a=a,b=b,rest_point=point,local_a=vsub(point,sa.rest_center),local_b=vsub(point,sb.rest_center),live=true})
    	return id
    }
    connection_sample :: proc(s: ^Scene, c: Connection) -> Vec2 {
    	a,b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
    	return vmul(vadd(posed_point(a,c.rest_point),posed_point(b,c.rest_point)),0.5)
    }
    contains_id :: proc(ids: []u64,id: u64) -> bool { for x in ids { if x == id { return true } }; return false }
    derive_seed :: proc(seed: u8, identity: u64) -> u8 {
    	if seed == 0 { return 0 }
    	x := identity ^ (u64(seed)*0x9e3779b97f4a7c15)
    	x ^= x >> 30; x *= 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9
    	x ^= x >> 27; x *= 0x94d049bb133111eb
    	x ^= x >> 31
    	return u8(x%255+1)
    }
    // Projection across every polygon edge includes all hull edges, so its minimum
    // equals the convex hull's minimum caliper width without retaining a hull.
    piece_width :: proc(s: ^Scene, ids: []u64) -> f32 {
    	if len(ids) == 0 { return 0 }
    	width := f32(1e30)
    	for id in ids {
    		p := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].outline
    		for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
    			a,b := p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
    			edge := vsub(b,a); length := vlen(edge)
    			if length < 0.00001 { continue }
    			normal := Vec2{-edge.y/length,edge.x/length}
    			lo, hi := f32(1e30),f32(-1e30)
    			for member in ids {
    				for point in s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[member]].outline.points {
    					projection := vdot(point,normal)
    					lo = min(lo,projection); hi = max(hi,projection)
    				}
    			}
    			width = min(width,hi-lo)
    		}
    	}
    	return width
    }
    rebuild_piece :: proc(s: ^Scene, old_id: u64) {
    	old_row, ok := s.piece_rows[old_id]
    	if !ok || !s.pieces[old_row].live { return }
    	old_seed := s.pieces[old_row].seed
    	material := s.pieces[old_row].material
    	groups: [dynamic][dynamic]u64
    	visited := make(map[u64]bool)
    	// Find the lowest unvisited ID each time, independent of storage order.
    	for {
    		start := u64(0)
    		for sub in s.subdivisions {
    			if sub.live && sub.owner == old_id && !visited[sub.id] && (start == 0 || sub.id < start) { start = sub.id }
    		}
    		if start == 0 { break }
    		group: [dynamic]u64
    		queue := [dynamic]u64{start}
    		visited[start] = true
    		for head := 0; head < len(queue); head += 1 {
    			id := queue[head]
    			append(&group,id)
    			for c in s.connections {
    				if !c.live { continue }
    				other := u64(0)
    				if c.a == id { other = c.b } else if c.b == id { other = c.a }
    				if other != 0 && !visited[other] && s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[other]].live && s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[other]].owner == old_id {
    					visited[other] = true; append(&queue,other)
    				}
    			}
    		}
    		append(&groups,group)
    	}
    	s.pieces[old_row].live = false
    	for group in groups {
    		min_id := group[0]
    		for id in group { min_id = min(min_id,id) }
    		if piece_width(s,group[:]) < s.minimum_width {
    			for id in group {
    				row := s.sub_rows[id]
    				append(&s.remnants,Remnant{outline=s.subdivisions[row].outline,pose=s.subdivisions[row].pose})
    				s.subdivisions[row].live = false
    			}
    			continue
    		}
    		new_owner := add_piece(s,material,derive_seed(old_seed,min_id))
    		for id in group {
    			s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].owner = new_owner
    			append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[new_owner]].subdivisions,id)
    		}
    		for c in s.connections {
    			if c.live && contains_id(group[:],c.a) && contains_id(group[:],c.b) { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[new_owner]].connections,c.id) }
    		}
    	}
    	for i in 0..<len(s.connections) {
    		c := &s.connections[i]
    		if c.live && (!s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].live || !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].live) { c.live = false }
    	}
    }
    
    make_wall :: proc(seed: u8 = 0, minimum_width: f32 = 0) -> Scene {
    	s := new_scene(minimum_width)
    	m := add_material(&s,Material{name="brick",subdivision_strength=6,connection_strength=4,flexibility=0.25,generation_count=2,aspect_ratio=1.5})
    	p := add_piece(&s,m,seed)

    	for i in 0..<3 {

    		center := centroid(poly)

    	s.pieces[s.piece_rows[p]].subdivisions = append(s.pieces[s.piece_rows[p]].subdivisions,ids[:]...)
    	for c in s.connections { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[p]].connections,c.id) }
    	return s
    }

    package main
    
    import "core:math"
    
    polygon_area :: proc(p: Polygon) -> f32 {
    	a: f32
    	for i in 0..<len(p.points) { a += vcross(p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]) }
    	return math.abs(a)*0.5
    }
    clip_polygon :: proc(p: Polygon, axis: int, cut: f32, keep_low: bool) -> Polygon {
    	out := Polygon{}
    	for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
    		a,b := p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
    		av,bv := a.x-cut,b.x-cut
    		if axis == 1 { av = a.y-cut; bv = b.y-cut }
    		if !keep_low { av = -av; bv = -bv }
    		inside_a, inside_b := av <= 0.00001,bv <= 0.00001
    		if inside_a { append(&out.points,a) }
    		if inside_a != inside_b {
    			t := av/(av-bv)
    			append(&out.points,vadd(a,vmul(vsub(b,a),t)))
    		}
    	}
    	return out
    }
    is_convex :: proc(p: Polygon) -> bool {
    	if len(p.points) < 3 { return false }
    	sign: f32
    	for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
    		cross := vcross(vsub(p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)],p.points[i]),vsub(p.points[(i+2)%len(p.points)],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]))
    		if math.abs(cross) < 0.00001 { continue }
    		if sign == 0 { sign = cross } else if cross*sign < 0 { return false }
    	}
    	return true
    }
    point_in_triangle :: proc(p,a,b,c: Vec2, orientation: f32) -> bool {
    	return vcross(vsub(b,a),vsub(p,a))*orientation >= -0.00001 &&
    	       vcross(vsub(c,b),vsub(p,b))*orientation >= -0.00001 &&
    	       vcross(vsub(a,c),vsub(p,c))*orientation >= -0.00001
    }
    triangulate_polygon :: proc(p: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
    	result: [dynamic]Polygon
    	indices: [dynamic]int
    	for i in 0..<len(p.points) { append(&indices,i) }
    	signed: f32
    	for i in 0..<len(p.points) { signed += vcross(p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]) }
    	orientation := f32(1)
    	if signed < 0 { orientation = -1 }
    	for len(indices) > 3 {
    		found := false
    		for k in 0..<len(indices) {
    			i,j,l := indices[(k+len(indices)-1)%len(indices)],indices[k],indices[(k+1)%len(indices)]
    			a,b,c := p.points[i],p.points[j],p.points[l]
    			if vcross(vsub(b,a),vsub(c,b))*orientation <= 0.00001 { continue }
    			contains := false
    			for n in indices { if n != i && n != j && n != l && point_in_triangle(p.points[n],a,b,c,orientation) { contains = true; break } }
    			if contains { continue }
    			append(&result,Polygon{points=[]Vec2{a,b,c}})
    			ordered_remove(&indices,k)
    			found = true
    			break
    		}
    		if !found { break }
    	}
    	if len(indices) == 3 { append(&result,Polygon{points=[]Vec2{p.points[indices[0]],p.points[indices[1]],p.points[indices[2]]}}) }
    	return result
    }
    // Straight shared cuts are constructed by clipping both sides at one value.
    // Outside edges are never moved; no gap or overlap is introduced at the cut.
    generate_children :: proc(parent: Polygon, recipe: Material, seed: u8) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
    	result: [dynamic]Polygon
    	if seed == 0 { return result }
    	if !is_convex(parent) || recipe.triangulate { result = triangulate_polygon(parent) } else { append(&result,parent) }
    	target := max(recipe.generation_count,len(result))
    	for len(result) < target {
    		chosen := -1
    		largest: f32
    		for i,p in result { a := polygon_area(p); if a > largest { largest = a; chosen = i } }
    		if chosen < 0 || largest < 0.0001 { break }
    		p := result[chosen]
    		min_x,min_y := f32(1e30),f32(1e30)
    		max_x,max_y := f32(-1e30),f32(-1e30)
    		for point in p.points { min_x=min(min_x,point.x); max_x=max(max_x,point.x); min_y=min(min_y,point.y); max_y=max(max_y,point.y) }
    		axis := 0
    		if (max_x-min_x) < (max_y-min_y)*max(recipe.aspect_ratio,0.1) { axis = 1 }
    		cut := (min_x+max_x)*0.5
    		if axis == 1 { cut = (min_y+max_y)*0.5 }
    		low, high := clip_polygon(p,axis,cut,true),clip_polygon(p,axis,cut,false)
    		if polygon_area(low) < 0.0001 || polygon_area(high) < 0.0001 { break }
    		result[chosen] = low
    		append(&result,high)
    	}
    	return result
    }
    
    apply_failures :: proc(s: ^Scene, failures: Failures) {
    	if len(failures.subdivisions) == 0 && len(failures.connections) == 0 { return }
    	affected := make(map[u64]bool)
    	replacements := make(map[u64][dynamic]u64)
    	old_connection_count := len(s.connections)
    	for id in failures.subdivisions {
    		row, ok := s.sub_rows[id]
    		if !ok || !s.subdivisions[row].live { continue }
    		parent := s.subdivisions[row]
    		affected[parent.owner] = true
    		seed := s.pieces[s.piece_rows[parent.owner]].seed
    		children := generate_children(parent.outline,s.materials[parent.material],seed)
    		for outline in children {
    			center := centroid(outline)
    			world_center := posed_point(parent,center)
    			r := vsub(world_center,parent.pose.position)
    			pose := Pose{position=world_center,angle=parent.pose.angle,velocity=vadd(parent.pose.velocity,Vec2{-parent.pose.angular_velocity*r.y,parent.pose.angular_velocity*r.x}),angular_velocity=parent.pose.angular_velocity}
    			child := add_subdivision(s,parent.owner,outline,pose)
    			append(&replacements[id],child)
    		}
    		s.subdivisions[row].live = false
    	}
    	for id in failures.connections {
    		row, ok := s.conn_rows[id]
    		if ok && s.connections[row].live {
    			c := s.connections[row]
    			affected[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].owner] = true
    			affected[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].owner] = true
    			s.connections[row].live = false
    		}
    	}
    	for i in 0..<old_connection_count {
    		c := s.connections[i]
    		if !c.live { continue }
    		a_dead := !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].live
    		b_dead := !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].live
    		if !a_dead && !b_dead { continue }
    		s.connections[i].live = false
    		left: [dynamic]u64
    		right: [dynamic]u64
    		if a_dead { left = replacements[c.a] } else { append(&left,c.a) }
    		if b_dead { right = replacements[c.b] } else { append(&right,c.b) }
    		old_a,old_b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
    		old_length,old_mid := shared_boundary(old_a.outline,old_b.outline)
    		if old_length <= 0 { continue }
    		for a in left {
    			for b in right {
    				length,mid := shared_boundary(s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[a]].outline,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[b]].outline)
    				// The new edge must lie on the original relationship's boundary.
    				if length > 0.0001 && vlen(vsub(mid,old_mid)) <= old_length*0.5+0.0001 { add_connection(s,a,b) }
    			}
    		}
    	}
    	for _, children in replacements {
    		for i in 0..<len(children) { for j in i+1..<len(children) { add_connection(s,children[i],children[j]) } }
    	}
    	for owner in affected { rebuild_piece(s,owner) }
    }
    
    blast_load :: proc(distance,radius: f32) -> f32 {
    	if radius <= 0 || distance >= radius { return 0 }
    	return 10*(1-distance/radius)
    }
    fails :: proc(load,strength: f32) -> bool { return load > 0 && load >= strength }
    evaluate_blast :: proc(s: ^Scene, blast: Blast) -> Failures {
    	f := Failures{}
    	for i in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
    		sub := &s.subdivisions[i]
    		if !sub.live { continue }
    		offset := vsub(sub.pose.position,blast.position)
    		distance := vlen(offset)
    		load := blast_load(distance,blast.radius)
    		if load <= 0 { continue }
    		if distance > 0.00001 { sub.pose.velocity = vadd(sub.pose.velocity,vmul(offset,load*0.1/distance)) }
    		if fails(load,s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&f.subdivisions,sub.id) }
    	}
    	for c in s.connections {
    		if !c.live { continue }
    		a := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]]
    		load := blast_load(vlen(vsub(connection_sample(s,c),blast.position)),blast.radius)
    		if fails(load,s.materials[a.material].connection_strength) { append(&f.connections,c.id) }
    	}
    	return f
    }
    blast_pass :: proc(s: ^Scene, blast: Blast) { f := evaluate_blast(s,blast); apply_failures(s,f) }
    fade_step :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) {
    	for i := len(s.remnants)-1; i >= 0; i -= 1 {
    		s.remnants[i].age += dt
    		if s.remnants[i].age >= 1 { ordered_remove(&s.remnants,i) }
    	}
    }

    package main
    
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    Physics :: struct {
    	world: b2.WorldId,
    	bodies: map[u64]b2.BodyId,
    	joints: map[u64]b2.JointId,
    	fixture_counts: map[u64]int,
    	active: bool,
    }
    Interaction :: struct { force: Vec2, torque: f32 }
    REFERENCE_LENGTH :: f32(1)
    PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS :: 4
    GLOBAL_DAMPING :: f32(0.7)
    
    to_b2 :: proc(v: Vec2) -> b2.Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    from_b2 :: proc(v: b2.Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    interaction_load :: proc(i: Interaction) -> f32 {
    	return max(vlen(i.force),math.abs(i.torque)/REFERENCE_LENGTH)
    }
    equivalent_force :: proc(impulse: Vec2, interval: f32) -> Vec2 {
    	assert(interval > 0)
    	return vmul(impulse,1/interval)
    }
    physics_init :: proc(s: ^Scene, gravity: Vec2 = {}) {
    	assert(!s.physics.active)
    	def := b2.DefaultWorldDef()
    	def.gravity = to_b2(gravity)
    	s.physics = Physics{world=b2.CreateWorld(def),bodies=make(map[u64]b2.BodyId),joints=make(map[u64]b2.JointId),fixture_counts=make(map[u64]int),active=true}
    	physics_sync_structure(s)
    }
    physics_destroy :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
    	if !s.physics.active { return }
    	b2.DestroyWorld(s.physics.world)
    	delete(s.physics.bodies); delete(s.physics.joints); delete(s.physics.fixture_counts)
    	s.physics = {}
    }
    physics_read_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
    	if !s.physics.active { return }
    	for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
    		row := s.sub_rows[id]
    		rotation := b2.Body_GetRotation(body)
    		s.subdivisions[row].pose = Pose{
    			position=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(body)),angle=math.atan2(rotation.s,rotation.c),
    			velocity=from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body)),angular_velocity=b2.Body_GetAngularVelocity(body),
    		}
    	}
    }
    physics_create_fixture :: proc(s: ^Scene, body: b2.BodyId, sub: Subdivision, outline: Polygon) {
    	points: [dynamic]b2.Vec2
    	defer delete(points)
    	for point in outline.points { append(&points,to_b2(vsub(point,sub.rest_center))) }
    	hull := b2.ComputeHull(points[:])
    	assert(hull.count >= 3,"Collision polygon is too small for Box2D")
    	polygon := b2.MakePolygon(hull,0)
    	def := b2.DefaultShapeDef()
    	def.density = 1
    	_ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
    	s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id] += 1
    }
    // This runs only between World_Step calls. Existing handles survive ownership changes.
    physics_sync_structure :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
    	if !s.physics.active { return }
    	dead_joints: [dynamic]u64
    	dead_bodies: [dynamic]u64
    	defer delete(dead_joints); defer delete(dead_bodies)
    	for id,joint in s.physics.joints {
    		row,ok := s.conn_rows[id]
    		if !ok || !s.connections[row].live { b2.DestroyJoint(joint); append(&dead_joints,id) }
    	}
    	for id in dead_joints { delete_key(&s.physics.joints,id) }
    	for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
    		row,ok := s.sub_rows[id]
    		if !ok || !s.subdivisions[row].live { b2.DestroyBody(body); append(&dead_bodies,id) }
    	}
    	for id in dead_bodies { delete_key(&s.physics.bodies,id); delete_key(&s.physics.fixture_counts,id) }
    	for sub in s.subdivisions {
    		if !sub.live { continue }
    		if _,exists := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]; exists { continue }
    		def := b2.DefaultBodyDef()
    		def.type = .dynamicBody
    		def.position = to_b2(sub.pose.position)
    		def.rotation = b2.MakeRot(sub.pose.angle)
    		def.linearVelocity = to_b2(sub.pose.velocity)
    		def.angularVelocity = sub.pose.angular_velocity
    		body := b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
    		s.physics.bodies[sub.id] = body
    		if is_convex(sub.outline) && len(sub.outline.points) <= 8 {
    			physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,sub.outline)
    		} else {
    			triangles := triangulate_polygon(sub.outline)
    			for triangle in triangles { physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,triangle); delete(triangle.points) }
    			delete(triangles)
    		}
    	}
    	for c in s.connections {
    		if !c.live { continue }
    		if _,exists := s.physics.joints[c.id]; exists { continue }
    		a := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]]
    		b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
    		def := b2.DefaultWeldJointDef()
    		def.bodyIdA = s.physics.bodies[c.a]
    		def.bodyIdB = s.physics.bodies[c.b]
    		def.localAnchorA = to_b2(c.local_a)
    		def.localAnchorB = to_b2(c.local_b)
    		// All outlines share one undeformed frame. Its relative rest angle is zero.
    		def.referenceAngle = 0
    		flexibility := max(s.materials[a.material].flexibility,s.materials[b.material].flexibility)
    		if flexibility > 0 {
    			def.linearHertz = 1/max(flexibility,0.01)
    			def.angularHertz = def.linearHertz
    		}
    		def.linearDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
    		def.angularDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
    		s.physics.joints[c.id] = b2.CreateWeldJoint(s.physics.world,def)
    	}
    }
    apply_blast_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene, sub: ^Subdivision, direction: Vec2, load: f32) {
    	delta_v := vmul(direction,load*0.1)
    	if s.physics.active {
    		body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
    		impulse := vmul(delta_v,b2.Body_GetMass(body))
    		b2.Body_ApplyLinearImpulseToCenter(body,to_b2(impulse),true)
    		sub.pose.velocity = from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body))
    	} else {
    		sub.pose.velocity = vadd(sub.pose.velocity,delta_v)
    	}
    }
    // Contact points and fixtures against the same other body form one interaction.
    // Joint reactions are already forces; totalNormalImpulse covers the full tick.
    // Box2D's tangent/rolling impulses cover the final substep in this binding version.
    calculate_physics_loads :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) -> Failures {
    	assert(dt > 0)
    	failures := Failures{}
    	loads := make(map[u64]f32)
    	defer delete(loads)
    	for sub in s.subdivisions {
    		if !sub.live { continue }
    		body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
    		capacity := int(b2.Body_GetContactCapacity(body))
    		buffer := make([]b2.ContactData,capacity)
    		contacts := b2.Body_GetContactData(body,buffer)
    		interactions := make(map[b2.BodyId]Interaction)
    		for contact in contacts {
    			body_a,body_b := b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdA),b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdB)
    			other := body_b
    			sign := f32(-1)
    			if body_b == body { other=body_a; sign=1 }
    			normal := from_b2(contact.manifold.normal)
    			tangent := Vec2{normal.y,-normal.x}
    			interaction := interactions[other]
    			for k in 0..<int(contact.manifold.pointCount) {
    				point := contact.manifold.points[k]
    				force := vadd(equivalent_force(vmul(normal,point.totalNormalImpulse*sign),dt),equivalent_force(vmul(tangent,point.tangentImpulse*sign),dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)))
    				interaction.force = vadd(interaction.force,force)
    				interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(from_b2(point.point),sub.pose.position),force)
    			}
    			interaction.torque += contact.manifold.rollingImpulse*sign/(dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS))
    			interactions[other] = interaction
    		}
    		for _,interaction in interactions { loads[sub.id] = max(loads[sub.id],interaction_load(interaction)) }
    		delete(interactions); delete(buffer)
    	}
    	for c in s.connections {
    		if !c.live { continue }
    		joint := s.physics.joints[c.id]
    		interaction := Interaction{force=from_b2(b2.Joint_GetConstraintForce(joint)),torque=b2.Joint_GetConstraintTorque(joint)}
    		load := interaction_load(interaction)
    		loads[c.a] = max(loads[c.a],load)
    		loads[c.b] = max(loads[c.b],load)
    		material := s.materials[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].material]
    		if fails(load,material.connection_strength) { append(&failures.connections,c.id) }
    	}
    	for sub in s.subdivisions {
    		if sub.live && fails(loads[sub.id],s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&failures.subdivisions,sub.id) }
    	}
    	return failures
    }
    physics_tick :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) {
    	assert(s.physics.active && dt > 0)
    	physics_sync_structure(s)
    	b2.World_Step(s.physics.world,dt,PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)
    	physics_read_motion(s)
    	failures := calculate_physics_loads(s,dt)
    	apply_failures(s,failures)
    	delete(failures.subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
    	physics_sync_structure(s)
    	fade_step(s,dt)
    }

    package main
    
    import "core:math"
    
    Segment :: struct { a,b: Vec2 }
    Cut_Boundary :: struct { a,b: int, segment: Segment }
    segment_overlap :: proc(a,b: Segment) -> (Segment,bool) {
    	d := vsub(a.b,a.a)
    	length := vlen(d)
    	if length < 0.00001 { return {},false }
    	if math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(b.a,a.a))) > 0.0001*length || math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(b.b,a.a))) > 0.0001*length { return {},false }
    	unit := vmul(d,1/length)
    	t0,t1 := vdot(vsub(b.a,a.a),unit),vdot(vsub(b.b,a.a),unit)
    	lo,hi := max(f32(0),min(t0,t1)),min(length,max(t0,t1))
    	if hi-lo <= 0.0001 { return {},false }
    	return Segment{vadd(a.a,vmul(unit,lo)),vadd(a.a,vmul(unit,hi))},true
    }
    shared_segments :: proc(a,b: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Segment {
    	result: [dynamic]Segment
    	for i in 0..<len(a.points) {
    		for j in 0..<len(b.points) {
    			if segment,ok := segment_overlap(Segment{a.points[i],a.points[(i+1)%len(a.points)]},Segment{b.points[j],b.points[(j+1)%len(b.points)]}); ok { append(&result,segment) }
    		}
    	}
    	return result
    }
    inherits_old_boundary :: proc(a,b,old_a,old_b: Polygon) -> bool {
    	current := shared_segments(a,b)
    	original := shared_segments(old_a,old_b)
    	defer delete(current); defer delete(original)
    	for x in current { for y in original { if _,ok := segment_overlap(x,y); ok { return true } } }
    	return false
    }
    insert_polygon_vertex :: proc(p: ^Polygon,index: int,point: Vec2) {
    	append(&p.points,point)
    	for j := len(p.points)-1; j > index; j -= 1 { p.points[j] = p.points[j-1] }
    	p.points[index] = point
    }
    insert_boundary_endpoint :: proc(p: ^Polygon,point: Vec2) {
    	for existing in p.points { if vlen(vsub(existing,point)) < 0.00001 { return } }
    	for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
    		a,b := p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
    		edge := vsub(b,a)
    		length := vlen(edge)
    		if length < 0.00001 { continue }
    		t := vdot(vsub(point,a),edge)/(length*length)
    		if t > 0 && t < 1 && math.abs(vcross(edge,vsub(point,a))) < 0.00001*length { insert_polygon_vertex(p,i+1,point); return }
    	}
    }
    insert_shared_midpoint :: proc(p: ^Polygon,segment: Segment,point: Vec2) {
    	insert_boundary_endpoint(p,segment.a)
    	insert_boundary_endpoint(p,segment.b)
    	for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
    		a,b := p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
    		if (vlen(vsub(a,segment.a)) < 0.00001 && vlen(vsub(b,segment.b)) < 0.00001) || (vlen(vsub(b,segment.a)) < 0.00001 && vlen(vsub(a,segment.b)) < 0.00001) {
    			insert_polygon_vertex(p,i+1,point)
    			return
    		}
    	}
    }
    // Capture each common cut once, then install the exact same displaced midpoint
    // in both outlines. Parent boundary vertices are untouched, including T junctions.
    displace_shared_boundaries :: proc(children: []Polygon,seed: u8) {
    	boundaries: [dynamic]Cut_Boundary
    	defer delete(boundaries)
    	for i in 0..<len(children) {
    		for j in i+1..<len(children) {
    			segments := shared_segments(children[i],children[j])
    			for segment in segments { append(&boundaries,Cut_Boundary{i,j,segment}) }
    			delete(segments)
    		}
    	}
    	for boundary,index in boundaries {
    		edge := vsub(boundary.segment.b,boundary.segment.a)
    		length := vlen(edge)
    		normal := Vec2{-edge.y/length,edge.x/length}
    		amplitude := min(length*0.04,min(polygon_area(children[boundary.a]),polygon_area(children[boundary.b]))/length*0.08)
    		if derive_seed(seed,u64(index+1))%2 == 0 { amplitude = -amplitude }
    		mid := vadd(vmul(vadd(boundary.segment.a,boundary.segment.b),0.5),vmul(normal,amplitude))
    		insert_shared_midpoint(&children[boundary.a],boundary.segment,mid)
    		insert_shared_midpoint(&children[boundary.b],boundary.segment,mid)
    	}
    }

    package main
    
    import "core:encoding/json"
    import "core:math"
    import "core:os"
    import "core:strings"
    
    Wire_Material :: struct {
    	name: string,
    	subdivision_strength,connection_strength: f32,
    	subdivision_infinite,connection_infinite: bool,
    	flexibility: f32,
    	generation_count: int,
    	aspect_ratio: f32,
    	triangulate: bool,
    }
    Wire_Connection :: struct { id,a,b: u64 }
    Snapshot :: struct {
    	version: int,
    	next_id: u64,
    	minimum_width: f32,
    	materials: [dynamic]Wire_Material,
    	subdivisions: [dynamic]Subdivision,
    	connections: [dynamic]Wire_Connection,
    	pieces: [dynamic]Piece,
    }
    finite :: proc(value: f32) -> bool { return !math.is_nan(value) && !math.is_inf(value) }
    valid_vec :: proc(v: Vec2) -> bool { return finite(v.x) && finite(v.y) }
    validate_scene :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> (bool,string) {
    	membership := make(map[u64]int)
    	defer delete(membership)
    	for p in s.pieces {
    		if !p.live { continue }
    		if len(p.subdivisions) == 0 { return false,"empty live piece" }
    		if p.material < 0 || p.material >= len(s.materials) { return false,"invalid material" }
    		for id in p.subdivisions {
    			row,ok := s.sub_rows[id]
    			if !ok { return false,"missing subdivision" }
    			sub := s.subdivisions[row]
    			if !sub.live || sub.owner != p.id || sub.material != p.material { return false,"invalid subdivision ownership" }
    			membership[id] += 1
    		}
    		for id in p.connections {
    			row,ok := s.conn_rows[id]
    			if !ok || !s.connections[row].live { return false,"invalid connection membership" }
    			c := s.connections[row]
    			if !contains_id(p.subdivisions[:],c.a) || !contains_id(p.subdivisions[:],c.b) { return false,"connection crosses pieces" }
    		}
    		visited := make(map[u64]bool)
    		queue: [dynamic]u64
    		append(&queue,p.subdivisions[0]); visited[p.subdivisions[0]] = true
    		for head := 0; head < len(queue); head += 1 {
    			for id in p.connections {
    				c := s.connections[s.conn_rows[id]]
    				other := u64(0)
    				if c.a == queue[head] { other=c.b } else if c.b == queue[head] { other=c.a }
    				if other != 0 && !visited[other] { visited[other]=true; append(&queue,other) }
    			}
    		}
    		connected := len(queue) == len(p.subdivisions)
    		delete(queue); delete(visited)
    		if !connected { return false,"piece is disconnected" }
    	}
    	for sub in s.subdivisions {
    		if !sub.live { continue }
    		if membership[sub.id] != 1 { return false,"subdivision must belong to exactly one piece" }
    		if len(sub.outline.points) < 3 || polygon_area(sub.outline) <= 0 { return false,"invalid polygon" }
    		for point in sub.outline.points { if !valid_vec(point) { return false,"invalid polygon coordinate" } }
    		if !valid_vec(sub.pose.position) || !valid_vec(sub.pose.velocity) || !finite(sub.pose.angle) || !finite(sub.pose.angular_velocity) { return false,"invalid motion" }
    	}
    	for c in s.connections {
    		if !c.live { continue }
    		a_row,a_ok := s.sub_rows[c.a]; b_row,b_ok := s.sub_rows[c.b]
    		if !a_ok || !b_ok { return false,"missing endpoint" }
    		a,b := s.subdivisions[a_row],s.subdivisions[b_row]
    		if !a.live || !b.live || a.owner != b.owner { return false,"invalid live connection endpoints" }
    		p := s.pieces[s.piece_rows[a.owner]]
    		if !contains_id(p.connections[:],c.id) { return false,"connection absent from its piece" }
    	}
    	return true,""
    }
    
    // A shallow read view. Geometry and memberships remain owned by the scene.
    read_state :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> Snapshot {
    	out := Snapshot{version=1,next_id=s.next_id,minimum_width=s.minimum_width}
    	for m in s.materials {
    		wire := Wire_Material{name=m.name,subdivision_strength=m.subdivision_strength,connection_strength=m.connection_strength,flexibility=m.flexibility,generation_count=m.generation_count,aspect_ratio=m.aspect_ratio,triangulate=m.triangulate}
    		if math.is_inf(m.subdivision_strength) { wire.subdivision_infinite=true; wire.subdivision_strength=0 }
    		if math.is_inf(m.connection_strength) { wire.connection_infinite=true; wire.connection_strength=0 }
    		append(&out.materials,wire)
    	}
    	ids: [dynamic]u64
    	defer delete(ids)
    	for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live { append(&ids,sub.id) } }
    	sort_ids(ids[:])
    	for id in ids { append(&out.subdivisions,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]]) }
    	clear(&ids)
    	for c in s.connections { if c.live { append(&ids,c.id) } }
    	sort_ids(ids[:])
    	for id in ids { c:=s.connections[s.conn_rows[id]]; append(&out.connections,Wire_Connection{c.id,c.a,c.b}) }
    	clear(&ids)
    	for p in s.pieces { if p.live { append(&ids,p.id) } }
    	sort_ids(ids[:])
    	for id in ids { append(&out.pieces,s.pieces[s.piece_rows[id]]) }
    	return out
    }
    release_state_view :: proc(snapshot: ^Snapshot) {
    	delete(snapshot.materials); delete(snapshot.subdivisions); delete(snapshot.connections); delete(snapshot.pieces)
    	snapshot^ = {}
    }
    encode_snapshot :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> ([]byte,bool) {
    	view := read_state(s)
    	defer release_state_view(&view)
    	data,err := json.marshal(view,{pretty=true})
    	return data,err == nil
    }
    destroy_decoded_snapshot :: proc(snapshot: ^Snapshot) {
    	for m in snapshot.materials { delete(m.name) }
    	for sub in snapshot.subdivisions { delete(sub.outline.points) }
    	for p in snapshot.pieces { delete(p.subdivisions); delete(p.connections) }
    	release_state_view(snapshot)
    }
    decode_snapshot :: proc(data: []byte) -> (Scene,bool) {
    	wire := Snapshot{}
    	defer destroy_decoded_snapshot(&wire)
    	if err := json.unmarshal(data,&wire); err != nil { return {},false }
    	if wire.version != 1 || !finite(wire.minimum_width) || wire.minimum_width < 0 { return {},false }
    	s := new_scene(wire.minimum_width)
    	s.next_id = wire.next_id
    	seen := make(map[u64]bool)
    	defer delete(seen)
    	ok := false
    	defer { if !ok { scene_destroy(&s) } }
    	for m in wire.materials {
    		if !finite(m.subdivision_strength) || !finite(m.connection_strength) || m.subdivision_strength < 0 || m.connection_strength < 0 || !finite(m.flexibility) || m.flexibility < 0 || m.generation_count < 1 || !finite(m.aspect_ratio) || m.aspect_ratio <= 0 { return {},false }
    		material := Material{name=strings.clone(m.name),subdivision_strength=m.subdivision_strength,connection_strength=m.connection_strength,flexibility=m.flexibility,generation_count=m.generation_count,aspect_ratio=m.aspect_ratio,triangulate=m.triangulate}
    		append(&s.owned_names,material.name)
    		if m.subdivision_infinite { material.subdivision_strength = math.inf_f32(1) }
    		if m.connection_infinite { material.connection_strength = math.inf_f32(1) }
    		add_material(&s,material)
    	}
    	for p in wire.pieces {
    		if p.id == 0 || p.id > s.next_id || seen[p.id] || !p.live { return {},false }
    		seen[p.id] = true
    		copy := p
    		copy.subdivisions=nil; copy.connections=nil
    		for id in p.subdivisions { append(&copy.subdivisions,id) }
    		for id in p.connections { append(&copy.connections,id) }
    		s.piece_rows[p.id]=len(s.pieces); append(&s.pieces,copy)
    	}
    	for sub in wire.subdivisions {
    		if sub.id == 0 || sub.id > s.next_id || seen[sub.id] || !sub.live { return {},false }
    		seen[sub.id] = true
    		copy := sub; copy.outline.points=nil
    		for point in sub.outline.points { append(&copy.outline.points,point) }
    		if len(copy.outline.points) < 3 { delete(copy.outline.points); return {},false }
    		copy.rest_center=centroid(copy.outline)
    		s.sub_rows[sub.id]=len(s.subdivisions); append(&s.subdivisions,copy)
    	}
    	for c in wire.connections {
    		if c.id == 0 || c.id > s.next_id || seen[c.id] { return {},false }
    		seen[c.id] = true
    		a_row,a_ok := s.sub_rows[c.a]; b_row,b_ok := s.sub_rows[c.b]
    		if !a_ok || !b_ok || c.a == c.b { return {},false }
    		a,b := s.subdivisions[a_row],s.subdivisions[b_row]
    		length,point := shared_boundary(a.outline,b.outline)
    		if length <= 0 { return {},false }
    		s.conn_rows[c.id]=len(s.connections)
    		append(&s.connections,Connection{id=c.id,a=c.a,b=c.b,rest_point=point,local_a=vsub(point,a.rest_center),local_b=vsub(point,b.rest_center),live=true})
    	}
    	if valid,_ := validate_scene(&s); !valid { return {},false }
    	ok = true
    	return s,true
    }
    save_snapshot :: proc(s: ^Scene,path: string) -> bool {
    	data,ok := encode_snapshot(s)
    	defer delete(data)
    	return ok && os.write_entire_file(path,data) == nil
    }
    load_snapshot :: proc(path: string) -> (Scene,bool) {
    	data,err := os.read_entire_file(path)
    	defer delete(data)
    	if err != nil { return {},false }
    	return decode_snapshot(data)
    }
    interpolate_pose :: proc(previous,current: Pose,alpha: f32) -> Pose {
    	t := clamp(alpha,f32(0),f32(1))
    	angle := current.angle-previous.angle
    	for angle > math.PI { angle -= 2*math.PI }
    	for angle < -math.PI { angle += 2*math.PI }
    	result := current
    	result.position=vadd(previous.position,vmul(vsub(current.position,previous.position),t))
    	result.angle=previous.angle+angle*t
    	return result
    }

    counts :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> (int,int,int) {
    	a,b,c := 0,0,0
    	for x in s.subdivisions { if x.live { a+=1 } }
    	for x in s.connections { if x.live { b+=1 } }
    	for x in s.pieces { if x.live { c+=1 } }
    	return a,b,c
    }
    expect_valid :: proc(t: ^testing.T,s: ^Scene) { ok,message:=validate_scene(s); testing.expect(t,ok,message) }
    close :: proc(a,b: f32) -> bool { return math.abs(a-b) < 0.001 }
    close_vec :: proc(a,b: Vec2) -> bool { return vlen(vsub(a,b)) < 0.001 }
    failure_for :: proc(ids: ..u64) -> Failures {
    	f := Failures{}
    	for id in ids { append(&f.subdivisions,id) }
    	return f
    }
    free_failures :: proc(f: ^Failures) { delete(f.subdivisions); delete(f.connections); delete(f.discard_subdivisions); f^={} }

    snapshot_roundtrip_and_split :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
    	s:=make_wall(42); defer scene_destroy(&s)
    	s.materials[0].connection_strength=math.inf_f32(1)
    	f:=failure_for(s.subdivisions[1].id); defer free_failures(&f)
    	apply_failures(&s,f)
    	bytes,ok:=encode_snapshot(&s); defer delete(bytes)
    	testing.expect(t,ok)
    	receiver,decoded:=decode_snapshot(bytes); defer scene_destroy(&receiver)
    	testing.expect(t,decoded)
    	if !decoded { return }
    	expect_valid(t,&receiver)
    	roundtrip,encoded:=encode_snapshot(&receiver); defer delete(roundtrip)
    	testing.expect(t,encoded && string(bytes)==string(roundtrip))
    	g:=Failures{connections=[dynamic]u64{receiver.connections[0].id}}; defer free_failures(&g)
    	apply_failures(&receiver,g)
    	expect_valid(t,&receiver)
    	invalid,accepted:=decode_snapshot(transmute([]byte)`{"version":2}`)
    	testing.expect(t,!accepted)
    	if accepted { scene_destroy(&invalid) }
    }
    @(test)
    interpolation_wraps_angles :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
    	a:=Pose{position={0,0},angle=3.1}
    	b:=Pose{position={2,4},angle=-3.1}
    	mid:=interpolate_pose(a,b,0.5)
    	testing.expect(t,close_vec(mid.position,Vec2{1,2}) && math.abs(mid.angle-f32(math.PI))<0.001)
    }
    @(test)
    direct_debug_removal_discards_nonterminal_geometry :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
    	s:=make_wall(42); defer scene_destroy(&s)
    	f:=Failures{discard_subdivisions=[dynamic]u64{s.subdivisions[1].id}}; defer free_failures(&f)
    	apply_failures(&s,f)
    	a,_,c:=counts(&s)
    	testing.expect(t,a==2 && c==2 && len(s.subdivisions)==3)
    }

    // Text formatting with variables (sprintf style)
    TextFormat :: proc(text: cstring, args: ..any) -> cstring {
        @static buffers: [MAX_TEXTFORMAT_BUFFERS][MAX_TEXT_BUFFER_LENGTH]byte
        @static index: u32
    
        buffer := buffers[index][:]
        mem.zero_slice(buffer)
    
        index = (index+1)%MAX_TEXTFORMAT_BUFFERS
    
        str := fmt.bprintf(buffer[:len(buffer)-1], string(text), ..args)
        buffer[len(str)] = 0
    
        return cstring(raw_data(buffer))
    }

    import rl "vendor:raylib"

    View :: struct { offset: Vec2, scale: f32 }
    screen_point :: proc(view: View,point: Vec2) -> rl.Vector2 { return {view.offset.x+point.x*view.scale,view.offset.y-point.y*view.scale} }
    world_point :: proc(view: View,point: rl.Vector2) -> Vec2 { return {(point.x-view.offset.x)/view.scale,(view.offset.y-point.y)/view.scale} }
    piece_color :: proc(id: u64,alpha: u8 = 255) -> rl.Color {
    	colors := [6]rl.Color{{64,173,165,255},{97,142,206,255},{194,134,204,255},{212,161,88,255},{139,178,113,255},{211,116,125,255}}
    	c:=colors[id%6]; c.a=alpha; return c
    }
    render_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene,sub: Subdivision,poses: map[u64]Pose) -> Subdivision {
    	result:=sub
    	if pose,ok:=poses[sub.id]; ok { result.pose=pose }
    	return result
    }
    point_on_boundary :: proc(point: Vec2,a,b: Polygon) -> bool {
    	for i in 0..<len(a.points) {
    		for j in 0..<len(b.points) {
    			if segment,ok:=segment_overlap(Segment{a.points[i],a.points[(i+1)%len(a.points)]},Segment{b.points[j],b.points[(j+1)%len(b.points)]}); ok {
    				d:=vsub(segment.b,segment.a); length:=vlen(d)
    				projection:=vdot(vsub(point,segment.a),d)/(length*length)
    				if projection >= -0.0001 && projection <= 1.0001 && math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(point,segment.a))) < 0.0001*length { return true }
    			}
    		}
    	}
    	return false
    }
    // Only presentation vertices are blended. Stored outlines and fixtures stay exact.
    cosmetic_point :: proc(s: ^Scene,sub: Subdivision,rest: Vec2,poses: map[u64]Pose) -> Vec2 {
    	self:=render_subdivision(s,sub,poses)
    	point:=posed_point(self,rest)
    	flex:=clamp(s.materials[sub.material].flexibility,f32(0),f32(1))
    	if flex==0 { return point }
    	weighted:=point
    	count:=f32(1)
    	for c in s.connections {
    		if !c.live { continue }
    		other_id:=u64(0)
    		if c.a==sub.id { other_id=c.b } else if c.b==sub.id { other_id=c.a }
    		if other_id==0 { continue }
    		other:=render_subdivision(s,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[other_id]],poses)
    		if point_on_boundary(rest,sub.outline,other.outline) { weighted=vadd(weighted,posed_point(other,rest)); count+=1 }
    	}
    	return vadd(point,vmul(vsub(vmul(weighted,1/count),point),flex))
    }
    draw_polygon :: proc(view: View,outline: Polygon,color: rl.Color,stroke: rl.Color) {
    	triangles:=triangulate_polygon(outline)
    	for triangle in triangles {
    		a,b,c:=screen_point(view,triangle.points[0]),screen_point(view,triangle.points[1]),screen_point(view,triangle.points[2])
    		// World CCW becomes screen CW; raylib expects counterclockwise screen vertices.
    		cross:=vcross(vsub(triangle.points[1],triangle.points[0]),vsub(triangle.points[2],triangle.points[0]))
    		if cross > 0 { rl.DrawTriangle(c,b,a,color) } else { rl.DrawTriangle(a,b,c,color) }
    		delete(triangle.points)
    	}
    	delete(triangles)
    	for i in 0..<len(outline.points) { rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,outline.points[i]),screen_point(view,outline.points[(i+1)%len(outline.points)]),2,stroke) }
    }
    pick_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2) -> u64 {
    	for sub in s.subdivisions {
    		if !sub.live { continue }
    		points: [dynamic]rl.Vector2
    		for rest in sub.outline.points { p:=posed_point(sub,rest); append(&points,rl.Vector2{p.x,p.y}) }
    		hit:=rl.CheckCollisionPointPoly({point.x,point.y},raw_data(points),i32(len(points)))
    		delete(points)
    		if hit { return sub.id }
    	}
    	return 0
    }
    pick_connection :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2,max_distance: f32) -> u64 {
    	best:=u64(0); distance:=max_distance
    	for c in s.connections { if c.live { d:=vlen(vsub(point,connection_sample(s,c))); if d<distance { distance=d; best=c.id } } }
    	return best
    }
    material_preset :: proc(index: int) -> Material {
    	switch index {
    	case 1: return Material{name="splinter",subdivision_strength=14,connection_strength=9,flexibility=0.6,generation_count=5,aspect_ratio=0.2}
    	case 2: return Material{name="shatter",subdivision_strength=5,connection_strength=4,flexibility=0.05,generation_count=6,aspect_ratio=1,triangulate=true}
    	}
    	return Material{name="chunk",subdivision_strength=6,connection_strength=4,flexibility=0.25,generation_count=3,aspect_ratio=1}
    }
    reset_demo :: proc(s: ^Scene,preset: int,terminal: bool) {
    	scene_destroy(s)
    	seed:=u8(42); if terminal { seed=0 }
    	s^=make_wall(seed,0.08)
    	s.materials[0]=material_preset(preset)
    	physics_init(s)
    }
    add_projectile :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
    	material:=add_material(s,Material{name="projectile",subdivision_strength=math.inf_f32(1),connection_strength=math.inf_f32(1),generation_count=2,aspect_ratio=1})
    	owner:=add_piece(s,material,0)
    	outline:=Polygon{}
    	for point in []Vec2{{-1.2,0.3},{-0.8,0.3},{-0.8,0.7},{-1.2,0.7}} { append(&outline.points,point) }
    	id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline),velocity={8,0}})
    	append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
    	physics_sync_structure(s)
    	b2.Body_SetBullet(s.physics.bodies[id],true)
    }
    draw_scene :: proc(s: ^Scene,view: View,poses: map[u64]Pose,selected: u64,surface,joints: bool) {
    	for i in -20..=20 {
    		tint:=rl.Color{31,44,62,255}
    		if i==0 { tint={45,65,85,255} }
    		rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,Vec2{f32(i),-20}),screen_point(view,Vec2{f32(i),20}),1,tint)
    		rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,Vec2{-20,f32(i)}),screen_point(view,Vec2{20,f32(i)}),1,tint)
    	}
    	for remnant in s.remnants {
    		sub:=Subdivision{outline=remnant.outline,rest_center=centroid(remnant.outline),pose=remnant.pose}
    		outline:=posed_polygon(sub)
    		draw_polygon(view,outline,rl.Color{140,152,170,u8(160*(1-remnant.age))},rl.Color{140,152,170,u8(160*(1-remnant.age))})
    		delete(outline.points)
    	}
    	for sub in s.subdivisions {
    		if !sub.live { continue }
    		outline:=Polygon{}
    		posed:=render_subdivision(s,sub,poses)
    		for rest in sub.outline.points {
    			point:=posed_point(posed,rest)
    			if surface { point=cosmetic_point(s,sub,rest,poses) }
    			append(&outline.points,point)
    		}
    		stroke:=rl.Color{202,220,231,255}
    		if sub.id==selected { stroke={255,255,255,255} }
    		draw_polygon(view,outline,piece_color(sub.owner,210),stroke)
    		delete(outline.points)
    		center:=screen_point(view,posed.pose.position)
    		rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%d",sub.id),i32(center.x)-5,i32(center.y)-7,16,rl.Color{16,29,40,255})
    	}
    	if joints {
    		for c in s.connections {
    			if !c.live { continue }
    			a,b:=render_subdivision(s,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],poses),render_subdivision(s,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]],poses)
    			anchor:=vmul(vadd(posed_point(a,c.rest_point),posed_point(b,c.rest_point)),0.5)
    			color:=rl.Color{248,205,109,255}
    			rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,a.pose.position),screen_point(view,b.pose.position),2,color)
    			rl.DrawCircleV(screen_point(view,anchor),5,color)
    			p:=screen_point(view,anchor)
    			rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("c%d",c.id),i32(p.x)+7,i32(p.y)+7,14,color)
    		}
    	}
    }
    run_debug_view :: proc(smoke: bool) {
    	rl.SetTraceLogLevel(.WARNING)
    	flags:=rl.ConfigFlags{.MSAA_4X_HINT,.WINDOW_RESIZABLE}
    	if smoke { flags+={.WINDOW_HIDDEN} }
    	rl.SetConfigFlags(flags)
    	rl.InitWindow(1280,800,"Destruction lab | Odin + Box2D")
    	defer rl.CloseWindow()
    	rl.SetTargetFPS(60)
    	s:=new_scene(0)
    	defer scene_destroy(&s)
    	preset:=0; terminal:=false
    	reset_demo(&s,preset,terminal)
    	view:=View{offset={310,530},scale=210}
    	previous:=make(map[u64]Pose); poses:=make(map[u64]Pose)
    	defer delete(previous); defer delete(poses)
    	paused,surface,joints:=false,true,true
    	selected:=u64(0)
    	radius:=f32(0.8)
    	accumulator:=f32(0)
    	status:=string("Ready. Click the wall to apply a blast.")
    	frames:=0
    	for !rl.WindowShouldClose() {
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.SPACE) { paused=!paused }
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.V) { surface=!surface }
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.J) { joints=!joints }
    		reset:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.R)
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.T) { terminal=!terminal; reset=true }
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.ONE) { preset=0; reset=true }
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.TWO) { preset=1; reset=true }
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.THREE) { preset=2; reset=true }
    		if reset { reset_demo(&s,preset,terminal); clear(&previous); selected=0; accumulator=0; status="Wall reset." }
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.I) { add_projectile(&s); status="Projectile launched." }
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.Q) { radius=max(f32(0.1),radius-0.1) }
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.E) { radius=min(f32(5),radius+0.1) }
    		if rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.MIDDLE) { delta:=rl.GetMouseDelta(); view.offset=vadd(view.offset,Vec2{delta.x,delta.y}) }
    		view.scale=clamp(view.scale*(1+rl.GetMouseWheelMove()*0.1),f32(30),f32(600))
    		mouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()
    		point:=world_point(view,mouse)
    		hover:=pick_subdivision(&s,point)
    		if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.RIGHT) { selected=hover }
    		remove_sub:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.DELETE) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.D)
    		remove_connection:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.X)
    		if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) && mouse.y>190 && mouse.y<f32(rl.GetScreenHeight()-145) {
    			if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_CONTROL) { selected=hover; remove_sub=true } else if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_SHIFT) { remove_connection=true } else {
    				blast_pass(&s,Blast{position=point,radius=radius}); clear(&previous); status="Blast evaluated once on the original entities."
    			}
    		}
    		if remove_sub && selected!=0 {
    			f:=Failures{}; append(&f.discard_subdivisions,selected)
    			apply_failures(&s,f); delete(f.discard_subdivisions); physics_sync_structure(&s)
    			clear(&previous); selected=0; status="Selected subdivision removed."
    		}
    		if remove_connection {
    			id:=pick_connection(&s,point,24/view.scale)
    			if id!=0 {
    				f:=Failures{}; append(&f.connections,id)
    				apply_failures(&s,f); delete(f.connections); physics_sync_structure(&s); clear(&previous)
    				status="Connection removed. Surviving components regrouped."
    			}
    		}
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.S) { if save_snapshot(&s,"snapshot.json") { status="Saved snapshot.json." } else { status="Could not save snapshot.json." } }
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.L) {
    			loaded,ok:=load_snapshot("snapshot.json")
    			if ok { scene_destroy(&s); s=loaded; physics_init(&s); clear(&previous); selected=0; status="Received snapshot.json; geometry and motion restored." } else { status="Snapshot is missing or invalid." }
    		}
    		if !paused { accumulator+=min(rl.GetFrameTime(),f32(0.1)) }
    		if paused && rl.IsKeyPressed(.N) { accumulator=1.0/60.0 }
    		for accumulator>=1.0/60.0 {
    			clear(&previous)
    			for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live { previous[sub.id]=sub.pose } }
    			physics_tick(&s,1.0/60.0)
    			accumulator-=1.0/60.0
    		}
    		clear(&poses)
    		for sub in s.subdivisions {
    			if !sub.live { continue }
    			pose:=sub.pose
    			if old,ok:=previous[sub.id]; ok && !paused { pose=interpolate_pose(old,pose,accumulator*60) }
    			poses[sub.id]=pose
    		}
    		rl.BeginDrawing()
    		rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
    		draw_scene(&s,view,poses,selected,surface,joints)
    		if mouse.y>190 && mouse.y<f32(rl.GetScreenHeight()-145) { rl.DrawCircleLinesV(mouse,radius*view.scale,{245,197,105,170}) }
    		rl.DrawRectangle(0,0,rl.GetScreenWidth(),190,{19,28,42,250})
    		rl.DrawText("DESTRUCTION LAB",32,25,30,{229,239,246,255})
    		rl.DrawText("Stable graph / one generation per pass",33,64,18,{133,156,180,255})
    		live_subs,live_conns,live_pieces:=counts_runtime(&s)
    		rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%d subdivisions     %d connections     %d pieces",live_subs,live_conns,live_pieces),33,106,23,{96,201,184,255})
    		mode:=string("generative"); if terminal { mode="terminal (seed 0)" }
    		play:=string("running"); if paused { play="paused" }
    		rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%s  |  %s  |  %s  |  blast radius %.1f",s.materials[0].name,mode,play,radius),33,144,18,{230,197,137,255})
    		height:=rl.GetScreenHeight()
    		rl.DrawRectangle(0,height-145,rl.GetScreenWidth(),145,{24,36,52,255})
    		rl.DrawText("Click: blast   Right click: select   D/Delete: remove subdivision   Shift+click/X: remove connection",32,height-125,18,{217,230,240,255})
    		rl.DrawText("1/2/3: chunk/splinter/shatter   T: terminal   R: reset   I: impact   Q/E: radius   Wheel: zoom   Middle drag: pan",32,height-94,17,{151,174,195,255})
    		rl.DrawText("Space: pause   N: step   J: joints   V: cosmetic surface   S/L: send/receive snapshot.json",32,height-64,17,{151,174,195,255})
    		rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%s",status),32,height-32,16,{96,201,184,255})
    		rl.EndDrawing()
    		frames+=1
    		if smoke && frames==2 { rl.TakeScreenshot("debug-preview.png"); break }
    	}
    }
    counts_runtime :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> (int,int,int) {
    	a,b,c:=0,0,0
    	for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live { a+=1 } }
    	for conn in s.connections { if conn.live { b+=1 } }
    	for piece in s.pieces { if piece.live { c+=1 } }
    	return a,b,c
    }

    Add: C:\Users\jblic\Documents\BOM\transmission.odin
    package main
    
    import "core:net"
    import "core:fmt"
    import rl "vendor:raylib"
    
    SNAPSHOT_PORT :: 9901
    MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES :: 4*1024*1024
    Snapshot_Server :: struct {
    	listener,client: net.TCP_Socket,
    	active,connected: bool,
    	pending: []byte,
    	sent: int,
    	elapsed: f32,
    	last_revision: u64,
    }
    Snapshot_Stream :: struct { socket: net.TCP_Socket, buffer: [dynamic]byte, connected: bool }
    snapshot_server_start :: proc(port: int = SNAPSHOT_PORT) -> Snapshot_Server {
    	listener,err:=net.listen_tcp(net.Endpoint{address=net.IP4_Loopback,port=u16(port)})
    	if err!=nil { return {} }
    	if net.set_blocking(listener,false)!=.None { net.close(listener); return {} }
    	return Snapshot_Server{listener=listener,active=true}
    }
    snapshot_server_destroy :: proc(server: ^Snapshot_Server) {
    	if server.connected { net.close(server.client) }
    	if server.active { net.close(server.listener) }
    	delete(server.pending); server^={}
    }
    frame_snapshot :: proc(data: []byte) -> []byte {
    	assert(len(data)<=MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES)
    	frame:=make([]byte,len(data)+4)
    	length:=u32(len(data))
    	for i in 0..<4 { frame[i]=u8(length>>(8*i)) }
    	copy(frame[4:],data)
    	return frame
    }
    snapshot_server_update :: proc(server: ^Snapshot_Server,s: ^Scene,dt: f32) {
    	if !server.active { return }
    	server.elapsed+=dt
    	accepted:=false
    	if !server.connected {
    		client,_,err:=net.accept_tcp(server.listener,{no_delay=true})
    		if err!=.None { return }
    		if net.set_blocking(client,false)!=.None { net.close(client); return }
    		server.client=client; server.connected=true; accepted=true
    	}
    	// Send complete state on changes and at 10 Hz for motion interpolation.
    	// Finish an in-flight frame before taking a newer state; queues cannot grow.
    	if len(server.pending)==0 && (accepted || s.revision!=server.last_revision || server.elapsed>=0.1) {
    		data,ok:=encode_snapshot(s)
    		defer delete(data)
    		if !ok || len(data)>MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES { return }
    		server.pending=frame_snapshot(data)
    		server.sent=0; server.elapsed=0; server.last_revision=s.revision
    	}
    	if len(server.pending)==0 { return }
    	n,err:=net.send(server.client,server.pending[server.sent:])
    	server.sent+=n
    	if err!=.None && err!=.Would_Block {
    		net.close(server.client); server.connected=false
    		delete(server.pending); server.pending=nil; server.sent=0
    		return
    	}
    	if server.sent==len(server.pending) { delete(server.pending); server.pending=nil; server.sent=0 }
    }
    snapshot_stream_connect :: proc(port: int = SNAPSHOT_PORT) -> Snapshot_Stream {
    	socket,err:=net.dial_tcp(net.Endpoint{address=net.IP4_Loopback,port=u16(port)},{no_delay=true})
    	if err!=nil { return {} }
    	if net.set_blocking(socket,false)!=.None { net.close(socket); return {} }
    	return Snapshot_Stream{socket=socket,connected=true}
    }
    snapshot_stream_destroy :: proc(stream: ^Snapshot_Stream) {
    	if stream.connected { net.close(stream.socket) }
    	delete(stream.buffer); stream^={}
    }
    // TCP can split a header or payload anywhere, or join multiple frames in one read.
    // Retain the incomplete suffix and return the newest complete snapshot.
    take_latest_frame :: proc(buffer: ^[dynamic]byte) -> ([]byte,bool) {
    	consumed,latest_start,latest_length:=0,0,0
    	for len(buffer^)-consumed>=4 {
    		length:=u32(0)
    		for i in 0..<4 { length |= u32(buffer^[consumed+i])<<(8*i) }
    		if length==0 || length>MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES { return nil,false }
    		if len(buffer^)-consumed-4<int(length) { break }
    		latest_start=consumed+4; latest_length=int(length)
    		consumed+=4+int(length)
    	}
    	data: []byte
    	if latest_length>0 {
    		data=make([]byte,latest_length)
    		copy(data,buffer^[latest_start:latest_start+latest_length])
    		copy(buffer^[:],buffer^[consumed:])
    		resize(buffer,len(buffer^)-consumed)
    	}
    	return data,true
    }
    snapshot_stream_poll :: proc(stream: ^Snapshot_Stream) -> (Scene,bool) {
    	if !stream.connected { return {},false }
    	read_buffer: [16384]byte
    	for {
    		n,err:=net.recv(stream.socket,read_buffer[:])
    		for byte in read_buffer[:n] { append(&stream.buffer,byte) }
    		if err==.Would_Block { break }
    		if err!=.None || n==0 || len(stream.buffer)>MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES*2 {
    			net.close(stream.socket); stream.connected=false; break
    		}
    	}
    	data,valid:=take_latest_frame(&stream.buffer)
    	defer delete(data)
    	if !valid { if stream.connected { net.close(stream.socket); stream.connected=false }; return {},false }
    	if len(data)==0 { return {},false }
    	return decode_snapshot(data)
    }
    run_receiver :: proc() {
    	stream:=snapshot_stream_connect()
    	defer snapshot_stream_destroy(&stream)
    	if !stream.connected { fmt.println("No sender on 127.0.0.1:9901. Start BOM with --serve first."); return }
    	rl.SetTraceLogLevel(.WARNING)
    	rl.SetConfigFlags({.MSAA_4X_HINT,.WINDOW_RESIZABLE,.WINDOW_HIGHDPI})
    	rl.InitWindow(1280,800,"Destruction lab | Snapshot receiver")
    	defer rl.CloseWindow()
    	rl.SetTargetFPS(60)
    	s:=new_scene(0); defer scene_destroy(&s)
    	previous:=make(map[u64]Pose); poses:=make(map[u64]Pose)
    	defer delete(previous); defer delete(poses)
    	view:=View{offset={310,530},scale=210}
    	age:=f32(1)
    	for !rl.WindowShouldClose() {
    		if received,ok:=snapshot_stream_poll(&stream); ok {
    			clear(&previous)
    			for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live { previous[sub.id]=sub.pose } }
    			scene_destroy(&s); s=received; age=0
    		}
    		age+=rl.GetFrameTime()
    		clear(&poses)
    		for sub in s.subdivisions {
    			pose:=sub.pose
    			if old,ok:=previous[sub.id]; ok { pose=interpolate_pose(old,pose,age/0.1) }
    			poses[sub.id]=pose
    		}
    		if rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.MIDDLE) { delta:=rl.GetMouseDelta(); view.offset=vadd(view.offset,Vec2{delta.x,delta.y}) }
    		view.scale=clamp(view.scale*(1+rl.GetMouseWheelMove()*0.1),f32(30),f32(600))
    		if rl.IsKeyPressed(.S) { _=save_snapshot(&s,"received-snapshot.json") }
    		rl.BeginDrawing()
    		rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
    		draw_scene(&s,view,poses,0,true,true)
    		rl.DrawRectangle(0,0,rl.GetScreenWidth(),180,{19,28,42,250})
    		rl.DrawText("SNAPSHOT RECEIVER",32,25,30,{229,239,246,255})
    		rl.DrawText("127.0.0.1:9901  /  full geometry and stable IDs  /  interpolated motion",32,70,18,{133,156,180,255})
    		a,b,c:=counts_runtime(&s)
    		rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%d subdivisions     %d connections     %d pieces",a,b,c),32,112,23,{96,201,184,255})
    		status:=string("Receiving snapshots. Wheel: zoom   Middle drag: pan   S: save received state")
    		if !stream.connected { status="Sender disconnected. Last received state retained." }
    		rl.DrawRectangle(0,rl.GetScreenHeight()-65,rl.GetScreenWidth(),65,{24,36,52,255})
    		rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%s",status),32,rl.GetScreenHeight()-42,18,{217,230,240,255})
    		rl.EndDrawing()
    	}
    }

    /*
        Repeatedly sends data until the entire buffer is sent.
        If a send fails before all data is sent, returns the amount sent up to that point.
    */
    send_tcp :: proc(socket: TCP_Socket, buf: []byte) -> (bytes_written: int, err: TCP_Send_Error) {
        return _send_tcp(socket, buf)
    }
    
    /*

        UDP packets are not guarenteed to be received in order.
    */
    send_udp :: proc(socket: UDP_Socket, buf: []byte, to: Endpoint) -> (bytes_written: int, err: UDP_Send_Error) {

    +// Merge adjacent triangles whenever their union is convex. In particular this
    +// avoids feeding thin ears from a displaced boundary to Box2D as tiny fixtures.
    +convex_decomposition :: proc(outline: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
    +	parts:=triangulate_polygon(outline)
    +	for {
    +		merged:=false
    +		for i in 0..<len(parts) {
    +			for j in i+1..<len(parts) {
    +				if length,_:=shared_boundary(parts[i],parts[j]); length<=0 { continue }
    +				points: [dynamic]Vec2
    +				for point in parts[i].points { append(&points,point) }
    +				for point in parts[j].points { append(&points,point) }
    +				hull:=convex_hull(points[:]); delete(points)
    +				combined:=Polygon{points=hull}
    +				error:=math.abs(polygon_area(combined)-polygon_area(parts[i])-polygon_area(parts[j]))
    +				if len(hull)<=8 && error<0.000001 {
    +					delete(parts[i].points); delete(parts[j].points)
    +					parts[i]=combined; ordered_remove(&parts,j); merged=true; break
    +				}
    +				delete(hull)
    +			}
    +			if merged { break }
    +		}
    +		if !merged { break }
    +	}
    +	return parts
    +}
