            if piece_width(s,group[:]) < s.minimum_width {
                for id in group {
                    row := s.sub_rows[id]
                    append(&s.remnants,Remnant{subdivision=id,pose=s.subdivisions[row].pose})
                    s.subdivisions[row].live = false
                }
                continue
            }
            new_owner := add_piece(s,material,derive_seed(old_seed,min_id))
            for id in group {
                s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].owner = new_owner
                append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[new_owner]].subdivisions,id)
            }
            for c in s.connections {
                if c.live && contains_id(group[:],c.a) && contains_id(group[:],c.b) { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[new_owner]].connections,c.id) }
            }
            sort_ids(s.pieces[s.piece_rows[new_owner]].connections[:])
        }
        for i in 0..<len(s.connections) {
            c := &s.connections[i]
            if c.live && (!s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].live || !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].live) { c.live = false }
        }
    }
    
    make_wall :: proc(seed: u8 = 0, minimum_width: f32 = 0) -> Scene {
        s := new_scene(minimum_width)
        m := add_material(&s,Material{name="brick",subdivision_strength=6,connection_strength=4,flexibility=0.25,generation_count=2,aspect_ratio=1.5})
        p := add_piece(&s,m,seed)
        ids: [3]u64
        for i in 0..<3 {
            x := f32(i)
            poly := make_polygon([]Vec2{{x,0},{x+1,0},{x+1,1},{x,1}})
            center := centroid(poly)
            ids[i] = add_subdivision(&s,p,poly,Pose{position=center})
            delete(poly.points)
        }
        add_connection(&s,ids[0],ids[1]); add_connection(&s,ids[1],ids[2])
        for id in ids { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[p]].subdivisions,id) }
        for c in s.connections { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[p]].connections,c.id) }
        return s
    }
    
    scene_destroy :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        physics_destroy(s)
        delete(s.vertices)
        for p in s.pieces { delete(p.subdivisions); delete(p.connections) }
        delete(s.subdivisions); delete(s.connections); delete(s.pieces)
        delete(s.materials); delete(s.remnants)
        for name in s.owned_names { delete(name) }
        delete(s.owned_names)
        delete(s.sub_rows); delete(s.conn_rows); delete(s.piece_rows)
        s^ = {}
    }
    package main
    
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    Physics :: struct {
        world: b2.WorldId,
        bodies: map[u64]b2.BodyId,
        joints: map[u64]b2.JointId,
        fixture_counts: map[u64]int,
        active: bool,
    }
    Interaction :: struct { force: Vec2, torque: f32 }
    REFERENCE_LENGTH :: f32(1)
    PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS :: 4
    GLOBAL_DAMPING :: f32(0.7)
    
    to_b2 :: proc(v: Vec2) -> b2.Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    from_b2 :: proc(v: b2.Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    interaction_load :: proc(i: Interaction) -> f32 {
        return max(vlen(i.force),math.abs(i.torque)/REFERENCE_LENGTH)
    }
    equivalent_force :: proc(impulse: Vec2, interval: f32) -> Vec2 {
        assert(interval > 0)
        return vmul(impulse,1/interval)
    }
    physics_init :: proc(s: ^Scene, gravity: Vec2 = {}) {
        assert(!s.physics.active)
        def := b2.DefaultWorldDef()
        def.gravity = to_b2(gravity)
        s.physics = Physics{world=b2.CreateWorld(def),bodies=make(map[u64]b2.BodyId),joints=make(map[u64]b2.JointId),fixture_counts=make(map[u64]int),active=true}
        physics_sync_structure(s)
    }
    physics_destroy :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        b2.DestroyWorld(s.physics.world)
        delete(s.physics.bodies); delete(s.physics.joints); delete(s.physics.fixture_counts)
        s.physics = {}
    }
    physics_read_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row := s.sub_rows[id]
            rotation := b2.Body_GetRotation(body)
            s.subdivisions[row].pose = Pose{
                position=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(body)),angle=math.atan2(rotation.s,rotation.c),
                velocity=from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body)),angular_velocity=b2.Body_GetAngularVelocity(body),
            }
        }
    }
    physics_create_fixture :: proc(s: ^Scene, body: b2.BodyId, sub: Subdivision, outline: Polygon) -> bool {
        points: [dynamic]b2.Vec2
        defer delete(points)
        for point in outline.points { append(&points,to_b2(vsub(point,sub.rest_center))) }
        hull := b2.ComputeHull(points[:])
        // Hull welding can collapse a thin ear below Box2D's collision tolerance.
        if hull.count < 3 { return false }
        polygon := b2.MakePolygon(hull,0)
        def := b2.DefaultShapeDef()
        def.density = 1
        _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
        s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id] += 1
        return true
    }
    physics_finish_mass :: proc(s: ^Scene,body: b2.BodyId,sub: Subdivision) {
        if s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id]==0 {
            // A microscopic attached subdivision is still one live logical entity.
            // Use a bounding fixture when the engine cannot resolve any of its ears.
            lo,hi:=Vec2{1e30,1e30},Vec2{-1e30,-1e30}
            for rest in sub.outline.points { p:=vsub(rest,sub.rest_center); lo={min(lo.x,p.x),min(lo.y,p.y)}; hi={max(hi.x,p.x),max(hi.y,p.y)} }
            polygon:=b2.MakeOffsetBox(max(f32(0.0025),(hi.x-lo.x)*0.5),max(f32(0.0025),(hi.y-lo.y)*0.5),to_b2(vmul(vadd(lo,hi),0.5)),b2.MakeRot(0))
            def:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); def.density=1
            _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
            s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id]=1
        }
        // Keep mass and the body origin tied to the exact logical polygon, including
        // when Box2D simplifies a fixture. This also makes rotational inheritance exact.
        inertia: f32
        for i in 0..<len(sub.outline.points) {
            a,b:=vsub(sub.outline.points[i],sub.rest_center),vsub(sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)],sub.rest_center)
            inertia+=vcross(a,b)*(vdot(a,a)+vdot(a,b)+vdot(b,b))/12
        }
        b2.Body_SetMassData(body,b2.MassData{mass=polygon_area(sub.outline),center={},rotationalInertia=math.abs(inertia)})
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,to_b2(sub.pose.velocity))
        b2.Body_SetAngularVelocity(body,sub.pose.angular_velocity)
    }
    // This runs only between World_Step calls. Existing handles survive ownership changes.
    physics_sync_structure :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        dead_joints: [dynamic]u64
        dead_bodies: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(dead_joints); defer delete(dead_bodies)
        for id,joint in s.physics.joints {
            row,ok := s.conn_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.connections[row].live { b2.DestroyJoint(joint); append(&dead_joints,id) }
        }
        for id in dead_joints { delete_key(&s.physics.joints,id) }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row,ok := s.sub_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.subdivisions[row].live { b2.DestroyBody(body); append(&dead_bodies,id) }
        }
        for id in dead_bodies { delete_key(&s.physics.bodies,id); delete_key(&s.physics.fixture_counts,id) }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            if _,exists := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]; exists { continue }
            def := b2.DefaultBodyDef()
            def.type = .dynamicBody
            def.position = to_b2(sub.pose.position)
            def.rotation = b2.MakeRot(sub.pose.angle)
            def.linearVelocity = to_b2(sub.pose.velocity)
            def.angularVelocity = sub.pose.angular_velocity
            body := b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
            s.physics.bodies[sub.id] = body
            if is_convex(sub.outline) && len(sub.outline.points) <= 8 {
                physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,sub.outline)
            } else {
                triangles := convex_decomposition(sub.outline)
                for triangle in triangles { physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,triangle); delete(triangle.points) }
                delete(triangles)
            }
            physics_finish_mass(s,body,sub)
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            if _,exists := s.physics.joints[c.id]; exists { continue }
            a := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]]
            b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            def := b2.DefaultWeldJointDef()
            def.bodyIdA = s.physics.bodies[c.a]
            def.bodyIdB = s.physics.bodies[c.b]
            def.localAnchorA = to_b2(c.local_a)
            def.localAnchorB = to_b2(c.local_b)
            // All outlines share one undeformed frame. Its relative rest angle is zero.
            def.referenceAngle = 0
            flexibility := max(s.materials[a.material].flexibility,s.materials[b.material].flexibility)
            if flexibility > 0 {
                def.linearHertz = 1/max(flexibility,0.01)
                def.angularHertz = def.linearHertz
            }
            def.linearDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
            def.angularDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
            s.physics.joints[c.id] = b2.CreateWeldJoint(s.physics.world,def)
        }
    }
    apply_blast_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene, sub: ^Subdivision, direction: Vec2, load: f32) {
        delta_v := vmul(direction,load*BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE)
        if s.physics.active {
            body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
            impulse := vmul(delta_v,b2.Body_GetMass(body))
            b2.Body_ApplyLinearImpulseToCenter(body,to_b2(impulse),true)
            sub.pose.velocity = from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body))
        } else {
            sub.pose.velocity = vadd(sub.pose.velocity,delta_v)
        }
    }
    // Contact points and fixtures against the same other body form one interaction.
    // Joint reactions are already forces; totalNormalImpulse covers the full tick.
    // Box2D's tangent/rolling impulses cover the final substep in this binding version.
    calculate_physics_loads :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) -> Failures {
        assert(dt > 0)
        failures := Failures{}
        loads := make(map[u64]f32)
        defer delete(loads)
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
            capacity := int(b2.Body_GetContactCapacity(body))
            buffer := make([]b2.ContactData,capacity)
            contacts := b2.Body_GetContactData(body,buffer)
            interactions := make(map[b2.BodyId]Interaction)
            for contact in contacts {
                body_a,body_b := b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdA),b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdB)
                other := body_b
                sign := f32(-1)
                if body_b == body { other=body_a; sign=1 }
                normal := from_b2(contact.manifold.normal)
                tangent := Vec2{normal.y,-normal.x}
                interaction := interactions[other]
                for k in 0..<int(contact.manifold.pointCount) {
                    point := contact.manifold.points[k]
                    force := vadd(equivalent_force(vmul(normal,point.totalNormalImpulse*sign),dt),equivalent_force(vmul(tangent,point.tangentImpulse*sign),dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)))
                    interaction.force = vadd(interaction.force,force)
                    interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(from_b2(point.point),sub.pose.position),force)
                }
                interaction.torque += contact.manifold.rollingImpulse*sign/(dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS))
                interactions[other] = interaction
            }
            for _,interaction in interactions { loads[sub.id] = max(loads[sub.id],interaction_load(interaction)) }
            delete(interactions); delete(buffer)
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            joint := s.physics.joints[c.id]
            interaction := Interaction{force=from_b2(b2.Joint_GetConstraintForce(joint)),torque=b2.Joint_GetConstraintTorque(joint)}
            load := interaction_load(interaction)
            a,b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            a_interaction,b_interaction := interaction,interaction
            a_interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(posed_point(a,c.rest_point),a.pose.position),interaction.force)
            b_interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(posed_point(b,c.rest_point),b.pose.position),interaction.force)
            loads[c.a] = max(loads[c.a],interaction_load(a_interaction))
            loads[c.b] = max(loads[c.b],interaction_load(b_interaction))
            material := s.materials[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].material]
            if fails(load,material.connection_strength) { append(&failures.connections,c.id) }
        }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if sub.live && fails(loads[sub.id],s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&failures.subdivisions,sub.id) }
        }
        return failures
    }
    Load_Calculator :: #type proc(s: ^Scene,dt: f32) -> Failures
    physics_tick :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32,calculate_loads: Load_Calculator = calculate_physics_loads) {
        assert(s.physics.active && dt > 0)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        b2.World_Step(s.physics.world,dt,PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)
        physics_read_motion(s)
        failures := calculate_loads(s,dt)
        apply_failures(s,failures)
        delete(failures.subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
        delete(failures.discard_subdivisions)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        fade_step(s,dt)
    }

    counts_runtime :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> (int,int,int) {
        a,b,c:=0,0,0
        for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live { a+=1 } }
        for conn in s.connections { if conn.live { b+=1 } }
        for piece in s.pieces { if piece.live { c+=1 } }
        return a,b,c
    }

    # Odin destruction lab
    
    A standalone implementation of `destruction-model-implementation-plan.md`, using Odin's bundled Box2D and raylib libraries. The workspace did not contain an existing engine or transport, so this project includes a small native debug application and a localhost snapshot transport.
    
    ## Run
    
    Requires an Odin installation with compiled `vendor:box2d` and `vendor:raylib` libraries. Tested on Windows with Odin `dev-2026-05-nightly:ea5175d`.
    
    ```powershell
    odin run .
    odin test .
    odin build . -o:speed -out:BOM.exe
    ```
    
    The application starts with three connected wall subdivisions. Physics uses a fixed 60 Hz tick with four Box2D substeps and zero gravity. Press **I** to launch a projectile into the wall.
    
    | Control | Action |
    | --- | --- |
    | Left click | Blast at the cursor |
    | Right click, then D or Delete | Select and directly remove a subdivision |
    | Ctrl + left click | Directly remove the hovered subdivision |
    | Shift + left click, or X near a yellow anchor | Break a connection |
    | 1 / 2 / 3 | Reset with chunk / splinter / shatter material |
    | T | Reset with terminal seed zero or generative seed 42 |
    | Q / E | Decrease / increase blast radius and power |
    | Space / N | Pause / advance one physics tick |
    | R / I | Reset / launch a projectile |
    | Mouse wheel / middle drag | Zoom / pan |
    | J / V | Toggle joints / cosmetic flexible surface |
    | S / L | Save / receive `snapshot.json` |
    
    For automated execution:
    
    ```powershell
    odin run . -- --headless
    odin run . -- --smoke
    ```
    
    `--headless` evaluates a blast, runs 60 physics ticks, validates the graph, writes `snapshot.json`, and reconstructs a receiver. `--smoke` renders two frames in a hidden window, exports `debug-preview.png`, and exits.
    
    ## Live transmission
    
    Build once, then run these in separate terminals:
    
    ```powershell
    .\BOM.exe --serve
    .\BOM.exe --receive
    ```
    
    The sender listens on **127.0.0.1:9901** for one receiver. It sends explicit complete snapshots after structural changes and at 10 Hz for motion. The receiver renders polygons, connections, ownership and interpolated motion without simulating physics. Destroy or split the wall in the sender to see the receiver update.
    
    Frames contain a four byte little endian payload length followed by UTF-8 JSON, capped at 4 MiB. Partial reads, partial writes, coalesced frames and disconnects are handled. One in-flight send is retained; the sender does not accumulate a queue of old states. `read_state`, `encode_snapshot` and `decode_snapshot` can also be used with another transport.
    
    Snapshots carry current geometry, materials, stable IDs, piece memberships, future generation seeds, structural revision, and body motion. They reconstruct derived anchors from the transmitted outlines. Infinite strengths have explicit flags so snapshots remain valid JSON. A piece's current seed is never used to reconstruct its existing damaged geometry.
    
    ## Implementation
    
    | File | Responsibility |
    | --- | --- |
    | `model.odin` | Stable identity, shared reference vertex pool, retained memberships, component traversal and width filtering |
    | `geometry.odin` | Shared boundaries, displaced cuts, convex hull and collision decomposition |
    | `destruction.odin` | Seeded generation, blast evaluation and the shared structural update |
    | `physics.odin` | Box2D bodies, fixtures, weld joints, interaction aggregation and load policy |
    | `state.odin` | State reader, snapshot validation, serialization and pose interpolation |
    | `transmission.odin` | Framed localhost TCP snapshots and the receiver application |
    | `debug_view.odin` | Native controls, rendering and material presets |
    | `behavior_test.odin` | Focused behavior and integration checks |
    
    IDs are monotonic and mapped to storage rows. Removed rows and outline ranges remain retained until `scene_destroy`; no world repacking is performed. Subdivision outlines use ranges into one append-only vertex pool in a common undeformed reference frame. Their `outline` slices are derived views refreshed when the pool grows. Borrowed polygon views must not be held across scene mutations. `add_subdivision` copies its input; the caller retains ownership of that input allocation. `make_polygon` creates an owned polygon.
    
    `apply_failures` stages one generation, preserves old neighbor relationships, inherits only surviving boundary attachments, regroups affected pieces with temporary adjacency, filters connected groups, and leaves physics synchronization to the between-step adapter. A failed connection cannot be healed by proximity. Failure IDs and new groups use stable ordering, including when storage rows are shuffled. `discard_subdivisions` provides direct removal independently of a generative piece seed.
    
    Generation clips convex regions and ear-clips supported simple concave polygons. Each internal displaced cut is generated once and installed in both adjacent outlines. Outside boundaries remain intact. Count is a target before final triangulation; concave outlines and the shatter preset can produce more children. If generation cannot produce at least two regions, the failed subdivision is removed directly. A valid partition is retained even when area limits prevent reaching the requested count. Aspect ratio biases cut direction. Self-intersecting outlines and polygons with holes are outside this implementation's input domain.
    
    The load policy uses the strongest individual interaction, preserving opposing interactions against different bodies. Contact points and convex fixtures against the same other body are combined. Joint reactions also load their endpoint subdivisions. Thresholds use `load > 0 && load >= strength`; strength records are never reduced by prior events. `physics_tick` accepts a replacement `Load_Calculator` function.
    
    Blast radius controls both reach and power: direct load is `10 * max(0, radius - distance)`, with zero load for nonpositive radii. The fixed global `BLAST_LOAD_MULTIPLIER` is 10; increasing radius increases load at a fixed distance, without a fixed maximum. For example, a sample 0.5 units away receives load 5 at radius 1 and load 25 at radius 3, enough to fail strength 20. Impulses are `direction * load * mass * 0.1`. Both tuning constants and the falloff live in `destruction.odin`. The torque reference length is one world unit, and global joint damping is 0.7. Flexibility zero selects a stiff weld; positive flexibility selects spring softness.
    
    Contact `totalNormalImpulse` is converted using the full tick interval. The installed binding's tangent and rolling impulses use the final substep interval. Joint reactions already supply force and torque. See the [Box2D simulation documentation](https://box2d.org/documentation/md_simulation.html) and [contact solver source](https://github.com/erincatto/box2d/blob/v3.1.1/src/contact_solver.c) for the underlying quantities.
    
    Collision decomposition merges adjacent convex regions. Box2D can collapse microscopic ears during hull welding; those ears are omitted from fixtures, and a subdivision with no resolvable fixture receives a small bounding box proxy. The destruction outline, logical identity, polygon mass and inertia remain retained. Collision fixtures never become additional destruction entities.
    
    Group width is the minimum projection width of its reference geometry's convex hull. Small subdivisions remain live when their connected group is wide enough. Narrow resulting groups become one second visual remnants before fading. New groups are filtered before any new bodies are created. Rendering interpolates poses and optionally blends shared presentation vertices across flexible joints; it does not modify collision or failure geometry.
    
    ## Verification
    
    `odin test .` covers bridge and subdivision removal; surviving and broken inherited attachments; simultaneous endpoint replacement; processing and storage order independence; seed zero; subthreshold and infinite strengths; one generation per pass; removal of unsplittable attached regions under repeated failure; valid partial partitions; radius-dependent blast power above strength 20; rotational motion inheritance; a single blast impulse transfer; rotation independent width; group filtering; retained bodies; concave collision fixtures; physical impacts; overloaded joints; replaceable load policies; flexibility; repeated blasts for all presets; snapshots; interpolation; and real TCP transfer of a wall and its split. Odin's test allocator tracks allocations and reports leaks.
    
    The implementation intentionally uses ordinary arrays, complete affected-piece membership rebuilds, local candidate scans, and explicit snapshots. Large-world spatial selection, compression, rollback and parallel simulation can be added when a measured workload calls for them.

    run_receiver :: proc() {
        stream:=snapshot_stream_connect()
        defer snapshot_stream_destroy(&stream)
        if !stream.connected { fmt.println("No sender on 127.0.0.1:9901. Start BOM with --serve first."); return }
        rl.SetTraceLogLevel(.WARNING)
        rl.SetConfigFlags({.MSAA_4X_HINT,.WINDOW_RESIZABLE,.WINDOW_HIGHDPI})

        defer rl.CloseWindow()
        rl.SetTargetFPS(60)
        s:=new_scene(0); defer scene_destroy(&s)

        view:=View{offset={310,530},scale=210}
        age:=f32(1)
        for !rl.WindowShouldClose() {
            if received,ok:=snapshot_stream_poll(&stream); ok {
                clear(&previous)
                for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live { previous[sub.id]=sub.pose } }
                scene_destroy(&s); s=received; age=0
            }
            age+=rl.GetFrameTime()
            clear(&poses)
            for sub in s.subdivisions {
                pose:=sub.pose

            if rl.IsKeyPressed(.S) { _=save_snapshot(&s,"received-snapshot.json") }

    SNAPSHOT_PORT :: 9901
    MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES :: 4*1024*1024
    Snapshot_Server :: struct {
        listener,client: net.TCP_Socket,
        active,connected: bool,
        pending: []byte,
        sent: int,
        elapsed: f32,
        last_revision: u64,
    }
    Snapshot_Stream :: struct { socket: net.TCP_Socket, buffer: [dynamic]byte, connected: bool }
    snapshot_server_start :: proc(port: int = SNAPSHOT_PORT) -> Snapshot_Server {
        listener,err:=net.listen_tcp(net.Endpoint{address=net.IP4_Loopback,port=port})
        if err!=nil { return {} }
        if net.set_blocking(listener,false)!=.None { net.close(listener); return {} }
        return Snapshot_Server{listener=listener,active=true}
    }
    snapshot_server_destroy :: proc(server: ^Snapshot_Server) {
        if server.connected { net.close(server.client) }
        if server.active { net.close(server.listener) }
        delete(server.pending); server^={}
    }
    frame_snapshot :: proc(data: []byte) -> []byte {
        assert(len(data)<=MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES)
        frame:=make([]byte,len(data)+4)
        length:=u32(len(data))
        for i in 0..<4 { frame[i]=u8(length>>uint(8*i)) }
        copy(frame[4:],data)
        return frame
    }
    snapshot_server_update :: proc(server: ^Snapshot_Server,s: ^Scene,dt: f32) {
        if !server.active { return }
        server.elapsed+=dt
        accepted:=false
        if !server.connected {
            client,_,err:=net.accept_tcp(server.listener,{no_delay=true})
            if err!=.None { return }
            if net.set_blocking(client,false)!=.None { net.close(client); return }
            server.client=client; server.connected=true; accepted=true
        }
        // Send complete state on changes and at 10 Hz for motion interpolation.
        // Finish an in-flight frame before taking a newer state; queues cannot grow.
        if len(server.pending)==0 && (accepted || s.revision!=server.last_revision || server.elapsed>=0.1) {
            data,ok:=encode_snapshot(s)
            defer delete(data)
            if !ok || len(data)>MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES { return }
            server.pending=frame_snapshot(data)
            server.sent=0; server.elapsed=0; server.last_revision=s.revision
        }
        if len(server.pending)==0 { return }
        n,err:=net.send_tcp(server.client,server.pending[server.sent:])
        server.sent+=n
        if err!=.None && err!=.Would_Block {
            net.close(server.client); server.connected=false
            delete(server.pending); server.pending=nil; server.sent=0
            return
        }
        if server.sent==len(server.pending) { delete(server.pending); server.pending=nil; server.sent=0 }
    }

    package main
    
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    Player_Tuning :: struct {
    	speed, acceleration, jump_speed, coyote_time, jump_buffer: f32,
    }
    PLAYER_TUNING :: Player_Tuning{4,32,6.3,0.1,0.1}
    PLAYER_RADIUS :: f32(0.26)
    PLAYER_SEGMENT :: f32(0.30)
    PLAYER_HALF_HEIGHT :: PLAYER_RADIUS+PLAYER_SEGMENT
    PLAYER_SPAWN :: Vec2{-4.5,0.65}
    
    // The player is an ordinary body in the shared world, outside the destruction graph.
    Player :: struct {
    	body: b2.BodyId,
    	grounded: bool,
    	coyote, buffered_jump: f32,
    	support_velocity: Vec2,
    }
    player_create :: proc(world: b2.WorldId) -> Player {
    	def:=b2.DefaultBodyDef()
    	def.type=.dynamicBody
    	def.position=to_b2(PLAYER_SPAWN)
    	def.fixedRotation=true
    	def.enableSleep=false
    	body:=b2.CreateBody(world,def)
    	shape:=b2.DefaultShapeDef()
    	shape.density=0.65
    	shape.material.friction=0.15
    	_ = b2.CreateCapsuleShape(body,shape,b2.Capsule{center1={0,-PLAYER_SEGMENT},center2={0,PLAYER_SEGMENT},radius=PLAYER_RADIUS})
    	return Player{body=body}
    }
    player_respawn :: proc(player: ^Player) {
    	body:=player.body
    	b2.Body_SetTransform(body,to_b2(PLAYER_SPAWN),b2.MakeRot(0))
    	b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,{})
    	b2.Body_SetAngularVelocity(body,0)
    	player^=Player{body=body}
    }
    player_clear_input :: proc(player: ^Player) {
    	player.buffered_jump=0
    	player.coyote=0
    }
    player_read_support :: proc(player: ^Player) {
    	player.grounded=false
    	player.support_velocity={}
    	position:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(player.body))
    	if b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(player.body).y>0.8 { return }
    	buffer:=make([]b2.ContactData,int(b2.Body_GetContactCapacity(player.body)))
    	defer delete(buffer)
    	for contact in b2.Body_GetContactData(player.body,buffer) {
    		a,b:=b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdA),b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdB)
    		normal:=from_b2(contact.manifold.normal)
    		other:=a
    		if a==player.body { normal=vmul(normal,-1); other=b }
    		if normal.y<0.55 { continue }
    		for i in 0..<int(contact.manifold.pointCount) {
    			point:=contact.manifold.points[i]
    			if point.separation<=0.025 && point.point.y<position.y-0.1 {
    				player.grounded=true
    				player.support_velocity=from_b2(b2.Body_GetWorldPointVelocity(other,point.point))
    			}
    		}
    	}
    }
    player_before_step :: proc(player: ^Player,move: f32,jump_pressed: bool,dt: f32) {
    	player_read_support(player)
    	if player.grounded { player.coyote=PLAYER_TUNING.coyote_time } else { player.coyote=max(f32(0),player.coyote-dt) }
    	if jump_pressed { player.buffered_jump=PLAYER_TUNING.jump_buffer }
    	velocity:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(player.body))
    	target:=clamp(move,f32(-1),f32(1))*PLAYER_TUNING.speed
    	velocity.x+=clamp(target-velocity.x,-PLAYER_TUNING.acceleration*dt,PLAYER_TUNING.acceleration*dt)
    	if player.buffered_jump>0 && player.coyote>0 {
    		velocity.y=PLAYER_TUNING.jump_speed+max(f32(0),player.support_velocity.y)
    		player.grounded=false
    		player.coyote=0
    		player.buffered_jump=0
    	}
    	player.buffered_jump=max(f32(0),player.buffered_jump-dt)
    	b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(player.body,to_b2(velocity))
    }
    player_after_step :: proc(player: ^Player) -> bool {
    	position:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(player.body))
    	if position.x < -8.5 || position.x > 9.5 || position.y < -3 || position.y > 12 || math.is_nan(position.y) {
    		player_respawn(player)
    		return true
    	}
    	player_read_support(player)
    	return false
    }

    package main
    
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    Sandbox_Settings :: struct {
    	blast_radius: f32,
    	pattern: int,
    	fragment_strength, connection_strength, flexibility: f32,
    	generate_children: bool,
    	seed: u8,
    }
    default_sandbox_settings :: proc() -> Sandbox_Settings {
    	return {blast_radius=4.2,fragment_strength=30,connection_strength=24,flexibility=0.15,generate_children=true,seed=42}
    }
    sandbox_material :: proc(settings: Sandbox_Settings) -> Material {
    	material:=material_preset(settings.pattern)
    	material.subdivision_strength=settings.fragment_strength
    	material.connection_strength=settings.connection_strength
    	material.flexibility=settings.flexibility
    	return material
    }
    Sandbox :: struct {
    	scene: Scene,
    	floor: b2.BodyId,
    	player: Player,
    	applied,draft: Sandbox_Settings,
    	previous: map[u64]Pose,
    	previous_player: Vec2,
    	panel_open,inspection,tuning_open,surface,joints: bool,
    	block_jump,block_blast,jump_queued: bool,
    	selected: u64,
    	accumulator: f32,
    	status: string,
    	status_time: f32,
    }
    sandbox_create :: proc(settings: Sandbox_Settings = default_sandbox_settings()) -> Sandbox {
    	game:=Sandbox{applied=settings,draft=settings,previous=make(map[u64]Pose),surface=true,joints=true}
    	sandbox_reset(&game)
    	return game
    }
    sandbox_destroy :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
    	scene_destroy(&game.scene)
    	delete(game.previous)
    	game^={}
    }
    sandbox_notice :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,text: string) { game.status=text; game.status_time=2.5 }
    sandbox_clear_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
    	game.accumulator=0
    	game.jump_queued=false
    	game.block_jump=true
    	game.block_blast=true
    	player_clear_input(&game.player)
    	clear(&game.previous)
    	game.previous_player=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
    }
    sandbox_reset :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
    	revision:=game.scene.revision+1
    	scene_destroy(&game.scene)
    	s:=&game.scene
    	s^=new_scene(0.10)
    	s.revision=revision
    	material:=add_material(s,sandbox_material(game.applied))
    	seed:=game.applied.seed
    	if !game.applied.generate_children { seed=0 }
    	owner:=add_piece(s,material,seed)
    	// A stepped stack, with one common reference frame and real shared edges.
    	for row in 0..<3 {
    		for column in 0..<4-row {
    			x,y:=f32(1.5)+f32(column)*0.85,f32(row)*0.85+0.005
    			points:=[4]Vec2{{x,y},{x+0.85,y},{x+0.85,y+0.85},{x,y+0.85}}
    			outline:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
    			id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline)})
    			append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
    		}
    	}
    	for a in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
    		for b in a+1..<len(s.subdivisions) { add_connection(s,s.subdivisions[a].id,s.subdivisions[b].id) }
    	}
    	for connection in s.connections { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].connections,connection.id) }
    	physics_init(s,{0,-9.8})
    	def:=b2.DefaultBodyDef()
    	def.position={0.5,-0.3}
    	game.floor=b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
    	shape:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); shape.material.friction=0.65
    	_ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(game.floor,shape,b2.MakeBox(8.5,0.3))
    	game.player=player_create(s.physics.world)
    	game.selected=0
    	sandbox_clear_input(game)
    	sandbox_notice(game,"Yard reset")
    }
    sandbox_set_panel :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,open: bool) {
    	game.panel_open=open
    	if open { game.draft=game.applied }
    	sandbox_clear_input(game)
    }
    sandbox_set_radius :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,radius: f32) {
    	game.applied.blast_radius=clamp(radius,f32(0.5),f32(6))
    	game.draft.blast_radius=game.applied.blast_radius
    }
    sandbox_apply_settings :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
    	game.applied=game.draft
    	sandbox_reset(game)
    	game.panel_open=false
    	sandbox_notice(game,"Settings applied")
    }
    // Inclusive edges are solid too. Use the logical posed outline, not the cosmetic mesh.
    point_in_subdivision :: proc(sub: Subdivision,point: Vec2) -> bool {
    	local:=vadd(sub.rest_center,vrotate(vsub(point,sub.pose.position),-sub.pose.angle))
    	inside:=false
    	for a,i in sub.outline.points {
    		b:=sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)]
    		edge:=vsub(b,a); relative:=vsub(local,a)
    		if math.abs(vcross(edge,relative))<0.00001 && vdot(relative,edge)>=0 && vdot(relative,edge)<=vdot(edge,edge) { return true }
    		if (a.y>local.y)!=(b.y>local.y) && local.x<(b.x-a.x)*(local.y-a.y)/(b.y-a.y)+a.x { inside=!inside }
    	}
    	return inside
    }
    sandbox_valid_aim :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2) -> bool {
    	for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live && point_in_subdivision(sub,point) { return false } }
    	return true
    }
    sandbox_blast :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2) -> bool {
    	if game.panel_open { return false }
    	if !sandbox_valid_aim(&game.scene,point) { sandbox_notice(game,"Aim outside the solid shape"); return false }
    	blast_pass(&game.scene,Blast{position=point,radius=game.applied.blast_radius})
    	clear(&game.previous)
    	return true
    }
    
    // Input routing is independent of raylib, so menu consumption has a direct regression check.
    Sandbox_Input :: struct {
    	move: f32,
    	jump_pressed,jump_down,blast_pressed,blast_down: bool,
    	menu_pressed,reset_pressed,inspection_pressed: bool,
    	wheel: f32,
    }
    sandbox_route_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,raw: Sandbox_Input,over_ui: bool) -> Sandbox_Input {
    	if raw.inspection_pressed { game.inspection=!game.inspection }
    	if raw.menu_pressed { sandbox_set_panel(game,!game.panel_open); return {} }
    	if !raw.jump_down { game.block_jump=false }
    	if !raw.blast_down { game.block_blast=false }
    	if game.panel_open { return {} }
    	if raw.reset_pressed { sandbox_reset(game); return {} }
    	result:=raw
    	result.jump_pressed=raw.jump_pressed && !game.block_jump
    	result.blast_pressed=raw.blast_pressed && !game.block_blast && !over_ui
    	if over_ui { result.wheel=0 }
    	if result.wheel!=0 { sandbox_set_radius(game,game.applied.blast_radius+result.wheel*0.2) }
    	return result
    }
    sandbox_tick :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,move: f32,jump: bool,dt: f32 = 1.0/60.0) {
    	clear(&game.previous)
    	for sub in game.scene.subdivisions { if sub.live { game.previous[sub.id]=sub.pose } }
    	game.previous_player=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
    	player_before_step(&game.player,move,jump,dt)
    	physics_tick(&game.scene,dt)
    	if player_after_step(&game.player) {
    		game.previous_player=PLAYER_SPAWN
    		sandbox_notice(game,"Back at spawn")
    	}
    }
    sandbox_advance :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,dt: f32,input: Sandbox_Input) {
    	if game.panel_open { game.accumulator=0; game.jump_queued=false; return }
    	if input.jump_pressed { game.jump_queued=true }
    	game.status_time=max(f32(0),game.status_time-dt)
    	game.accumulator+=clamp(dt,f32(0),f32(0.1))
    	for game.accumulator>=1.0/60.0 {
    		sandbox_tick(game,input.move,game.jump_queued)
    		game.jump_queued=false
    		game.accumulator-=1.0/60.0
    	}
    }

    package main
    
    import rl "vendor:raylib"
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    
    YARD_INK :: rl.Color{229,239,241,255}
    YARD_MUTED :: rl.Color{144,165,178,255}
    YARD_ACCENT :: rl.Color{111,220,190,255}
    
    // Fit a fixed rectangle with letterboxing. Fragments never affect the camera.
    sandbox_view :: proc(width,height: f32) -> View {
    	scale:=min((width-64)/16,(height-170)/8.4)
    	return View{offset={width*0.5-0.5*scale,(height+30)*0.5+2.8*scale},scale=scale}
    }
    sandbox_settings_button :: proc(width: f32) -> rl.Rectangle { return {width-174,24,150,38} }
    sandbox_reset_button :: proc(width: f32) -> rl.Rectangle { return {width-284,24,98,38} }
    sandbox_over_hud :: proc(mouse: rl.Vector2,width,height: f32,inspection: bool) -> bool {
    	if mouse.y<88 || mouse.y>height-56 { return true }
    	return inspection && rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(mouse,{24,106,450,150})
    }
    sandbox_gui_style :: proc() {
    	rl.GuiLoadStyleDefault()
    	rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiDefaultProperty.TEXT_SIZE),18)
    	rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BORDER_COLOR_NORMAL),transmute(i32)u32(0x435969ff))
    	rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BASE_COLOR_NORMAL),transmute(i32)u32(0x233444ff))
    	rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.TEXT_COLOR_NORMAL),transmute(i32)u32(0xe5eff1ff))
    	rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BORDER_COLOR_FOCUSED),transmute(i32)u32(0x6fdcbeff))
    	rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BASE_COLOR_FOCUSED),transmute(i32)u32(0x304e58ff))
    	rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.TEXT_COLOR_FOCUSED),transmute(i32)u32(0xe5fff4ff))
    	rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BORDER_COLOR_PRESSED),transmute(i32)u32(0x6fdcbeff))
    	rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BASE_COLOR_PRESSED),transmute(i32)u32(0x416d68ff))
    	rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.TEXT_COLOR_PRESSED),transmute(i32)u32(0xffffffff))
    }
    sandbox_slider :: proc(x,y,width: f32,label: cstring,value: ^f32,low,high: f32,decimals: bool = false) {
    	rl.DrawText(label,i32(x),i32(y),17,YARD_INK)
    	text:=rl.TextFormat("%.0f",value^)
    	if decimals { text=rl.TextFormat("%.2f",value^) }
    	rl.DrawText(text,i32(x+width)-rl.MeasureText(text,17),i32(y),17,YARD_ACCENT)

    	y+=40
    	tuning_label:=cstring("+  Tuning")

    		sandbox_slider(x,y,504,"Flexibility",&game.draft.flexibility,0,1,true); y+=50
    	}
    	rl.DrawText("A/D or arrows: move    Space: jump",i32(x),i32(y),16,YARD_MUTED); y+=22
    	rl.DrawText("Click: blast    Wheel: radius / power    R: reset",i32(x),i32(y),16,YARD_MUTED); y+=22
    	rl.DrawText("Tab / Esc: settings    F3: inspection",i32(x),i32(y),16,YARD_MUTED); y+=28
    	rl.DrawText("Radius is live. Other edits apply with a reset.",i32(x),i32(y),15,YARD_MUTED)
    	button_y:=(height-panel_height)*0.5+panel_height-60

    	if rl.GuiButton({x+196,button_y,308,36},"Apply & Reset") { return .Apply }
    	return .None
    }

    	}

    	rl.DrawLineEx({spawn.x-16,spawn.y+12},{spawn.x+16,spawn.y+12},3,YARD_ACCENT)

    }
    sandbox_draw_aim :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,view: View,mouse: rl.Vector2) {
    	point:=world_point(view,mouse)
    	color:=rl.Color{245,206,133,210}
    	valid:=sandbox_valid_aim(&game.scene,point)
    	if !valid { color={244,132,131,230} }
    	rl.DrawCircleLinesV(mouse,game.applied.blast_radius*view.scale,color)
    	rl.DrawCircleV(mouse,3,color)
    	if !valid {
    		rl.DrawLineEx({mouse.x-7,mouse.y-7},{mouse.x+7,mouse.y+7},2,color)
    		rl.DrawLineEx({mouse.x+7,mouse.y-7},{mouse.x-7,mouse.y+7},2,color)
    		label:=cstring("Aim outside the solid shape")
    		x:=clamp(mouse.x+18,f32(12),f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()-rl.MeasureText(label,16)-12))
    		y:=clamp(mouse.y+18,f32(94),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight()-80))
    		rl.DrawRectangle(i32(x)-7,i32(y)-5,rl.MeasureText(label,16)+14,26,{19,28,42,240})
    		rl.DrawText(label,i32(x),i32(y),16,color)
    	}
    }
    sandbox_draw_hud :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,width,height: f32) -> Sandbox_UI_Action {
    	rl.DrawRectangle(0,0,i32(width),88,{19,28,42,250})
    	rl.DrawText("BLAST YARD",24,24,26,YARD_INK)
    	rl.DrawText("Walk in. Break things. Try again.",25,56,15,YARD_MUTED)
    	if !game.panel_open {
    		if rl.GuiButton(sandbox_reset_button(width),"R  Reset") { return .Reset }
    		if rl.GuiButton(sandbox_settings_button(width),"Tab  Settings") { return .Open }
    	}
    	rl.DrawRectangle(0,i32(height)-56,i32(width),56,{19,28,42,250})
    	rl.DrawText("A/D Move   /   Space Jump   /   Click Blast   /   R Reset",24,i32(height)-35,17,YARD_INK)
    	rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("Radius %.1f  /  Wheel",game.applied.blast_radius),i32(width)-222,i32(height)-35,17,YARD_ACCENT)
    	if game.status_time>0 {
    		text:=rl.TextFormat("%s",game.status)
    		x:=i32(width)*0.5-rl.MeasureText(text,17)/2
    		rl.DrawRectangle(x-16,i32(height)-102,rl.MeasureText(text,17)+32,32,{23,40,51,240})
    		rl.DrawText(text,x,i32(height)-94,17,YARD_ACCENT)
    	}
    	if game.inspection {
    		rl.DrawRectangleRounded({24,106,450,150},0.07,8,{22,36,51,240})
    		rl.DrawText("INSPECTION  /  F3",40,120,18,YARD_ACCENT)
    		a,b,c:=counts_runtime(&game.scene)
    		rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%d regions  /  %d links  /  %d pieces",a,b,c),40,150,17,YARD_INK)
    		rl.DrawText("Right click: select   Delete / Ctrl+click: remove",40,180,16,YARD_MUTED)
    		rl.DrawText("Shift+click / X: break link   J: links   V: surface",40,204,16,YARD_MUTED)
    		rl.DrawText("S: save snapshot   D: move   Space: jump",40,228,16,YARD_MUTED)
    	}
    	if game.panel_open { return sandbox_draw_panel(game,width,height) }
    	return .None
    }
    sandbox_inspect_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2,view: View,over_ui: bool) -> bool {
    	if !game.inspection || game.panel_open { return false }
    	if rl.IsKeyPressed(.J) { game.joints=!game.joints }
    	if rl.IsKeyPressed(.V) { game.surface=!game.surface }
    	if rl.IsKeyPressed(.S) {
    		if save_snapshot(&game.scene,"snapshot.json") { sandbox_notice(game,"Saved snapshot.json") }
    	}
    	if over_ui { return false }
    	hover:=pick_subdivision(&game.scene,point)
    	if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.RIGHT) { game.selected=hover }
    	remove:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.DELETE)
    	link:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.X)
    	consumed:=false
    	if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) {
    		if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_CONTROL) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT_CONTROL) { game.selected=hover; remove=true; consumed=true }
    		if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_SHIFT) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT_SHIFT) { link=true; consumed=true }
    	}
    	failures:=Failures{}
    	if remove && game.selected!=0 { append(&failures.discard_subdivisions,game.selected); game.selected=0 }
    	if link {
    		id:=pick_connection(&game.scene,point,24/view.scale)
    		if id!=0 { append(&failures.connections,id) }
    	}
    	if len(failures.discard_subdivisions)+len(failures.connections)>0 {
    		apply_failures(&game.scene,failures)
    		physics_sync_structure(&game.scene)
    		clear(&game.previous)
    	}
    	delete(failures.discard_subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
    	return consumed
    }
    run_sandbox :: proc(smoke: bool = false,serve: bool = false,smoke_panel: bool = false) {
    	server:=Snapshot_Server{}
    	if serve { server=snapshot_server_start() }
    	defer snapshot_server_destroy(&server)
    	rl.SetTraceLogLevel(.WARNING)
    	flags:=rl.ConfigFlags{.MSAA_4X_HINT,.WINDOW_RESIZABLE,.WINDOW_HIGHDPI}
    	if smoke { flags+={.WINDOW_HIDDEN} }
    	rl.SetConfigFlags(flags)
    	rl.InitWindow(1280,800,"Blast Yard | Odin + Box2D")
    	defer rl.CloseWindow()
    	rl.SetWindowMinSize(900,700)
    	rl.SetExitKey(.KEY_NULL)
    	rl.SetTargetFPS(60)
    	sandbox_gui_style()
    	game:=sandbox_create()
    	defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
    	if smoke_panel { sandbox_set_panel(&game,true); game.tuning_open=true }
    	if serve {
    		if server.active { sandbox_notice(&game,"Sending destruction snapshots on localhost:9901") } else { sandbox_notice(&game,"Snapshot port 9901 is unavailable") }
    	}
    	poses:=make(map[u64]Pose); defer delete(poses)
    	target:=rl.RenderTexture2D{}
    	if smoke { target=rl.LoadRenderTexture(rl.GetScreenWidth(),rl.GetScreenHeight()) }
    	defer { if smoke { rl.UnloadRenderTexture(target) } }
    	frames:=0
    	for !rl.WindowShouldClose() {
    		width,height:=f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight())
    		view:=sandbox_view(width,height)
    		mouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()
    		over_ui:=sandbox_over_hud(mouse,width,height,game.inspection)
    		move:=f32(0)
    		if rl.IsKeyDown(.A) || rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT) { move-=1 }
    		if rl.IsKeyDown(.D) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT) { move+=1 }
    		raw:=Sandbox_Input{move=move,jump_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.SPACE),jump_down=rl.IsKeyDown(.SPACE),blast_pressed=rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT),blast_down=rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT),menu_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.TAB) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.ESCAPE),reset_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.R),inspection_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.F3),wheel=rl.GetMouseWheelMove()}
    		input:=sandbox_route_input(&game,raw,over_ui)
    		point:=world_point(view,mouse)
    		if !sandbox_inspect_input(&game,point,view,over_ui) && input.blast_pressed { sandbox_blast(&game,point) }
    		sandbox_advance(&game,rl.GetFrameTime(),input)
    		clear(&poses)
    		for sub in game.scene.subdivisions {
    			if !sub.live { continue }
    			pose:=sub.pose
    			if old,ok:=game.previous[sub.id]; ok && !game.panel_open { pose=interpolate_pose(old,pose,game.accumulator*60) }
    			poses[sub.id]=pose
    		}
    		snapshot_server_update(&server,&game.scene,rl.GetFrameTime())
    		rl.BeginDrawing()
    		if smoke { rl.BeginTextureMode(target) }
    		rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
    		sandbox_draw_world(&game,view,poses)
    		if !game.panel_open && !over_ui { sandbox_draw_aim(&game,view,mouse) }
    		action:=sandbox_draw_hud(&game,width,height)
    		if smoke {
    			rl.EndTextureMode()
    			rl.DrawTextureRec(target.texture,{0,0,f32(target.texture.width),-f32(target.texture.height)},{0,0},rl.WHITE)
    		}
    		rl.EndDrawing()
    		switch action {
    		case .Open: sandbox_set_panel(&game,true)
    		case .Resume: sandbox_set_panel(&game,false)
    		case .Apply: sandbox_apply_settings(&game)
    		case .Reset: sandbox_reset(&game)
    		case .None:
    		}
    		frames+=1
    		if smoke && frames==2 {
    			image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
    			rl.ImageFlipVertical(&image)
    			name:=cstring("sandbox-preview.png"); if smoke_panel { name="sandbox-settings-preview.png" }
    			_ = rl.ExportImage(image,name)
    			rl.UnloadImage(image)
    			break
    		}
    	}
    }

    @(test)
    yard_rests_under_gravity_and_player_moves_and_jumps :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
    	sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
    	game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
    	for _ in 0..<360 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
    	a,b,c:=counts(&game.scene)
    	testing.expect(t,a==9 && b==11 && c==1,"The initial structure must remain intact under ordinary gravity")
    	testing.expect(t,game.player.grounded)
    	testing.expect(t,close(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y,PLAYER_HALF_HEIGHT))
    	for sub in game.scene.subdivisions { testing.expect(t,vlen(vsub(sub.pose.position,sub.rest_center))<0.04) }
    	for _ in 0..<50 { sandbox_tick(&game,1,false) }
    	testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).x > PLAYER_SPAWN.x+2)
    	sandbox_tick(&game,0,true)
    	testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y>5 && !game.player.grounded)
    	max_height:=f32(0)
    	for _ in 0..<150 {
    		sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
    		max_height=max(max_height,b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y)
    	}
    	testing.expect(t,max_height>2 && game.player.grounded,"One jump must reach its apex and land without another airborne jump")
    	testing.expect(t,close(b2.Body_GetAngle(game.player.body),0))
    	expect_valid(t,&game.scene)
    }
    
    @(test)
    player_stands_on_and_pushes_a_real_fragment :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
    	sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
    	game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
    	// Detach a ground-level block, leaving an actual destruction body to stand on.
    	id:=game.scene.subdivisions[3].id
    	failures:=Failures{}
    	for connection in game.scene.connections {
    		if connection.a==id || connection.b==id { append(&failures.connections,connection.id) }
    	}
    	apply_failures(&game.scene,failures); free_failures(&failures)
    	physics_sync_structure(&game.scene)
    	body:=game.scene.physics.bodies[id]
    	position:=b2.Body_GetPosition(body)
    	b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{position.x,1.6},b2.MakeRot(0))
    	for _ in 0..<120 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
    	testing.expect(t,game.player.grounded && b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y>1.35,"Support must come from fragment contacts")
    	// Move alongside the detached block and push it using the same collision world.
    	position=b2.Body_GetPosition(body)
    	b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{position.x+1,0.6},b2.MakeRot(0))
    	b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(game.player.body,{})
    	for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
    	start:=b2.Body_GetPosition(body).x
    	for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_tick(&game,-1,false) }
    	testing.expect(t,b2.Body_IsValid(body),"Routine player contact should leave the fragment intact")
    	if b2.Body_IsValid(body) { testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetPosition(body).x<start-0.05,"The player should physically push debris") }
    }

    player_read_support :: proc(player: ^Player) {
        player.grounded=false
        player.support_velocity={}
        position:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(player.body))
        if b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(player.body).y>0.8 { return }
        buffer:=make([]b2.ContactData,int(b2.Body_GetContactCapacity(player.body)))
        defer delete(buffer)
        for contact in b2.Body_GetContactData(player.body,buffer) {
            a,b:=b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdA),b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdB)
            normal:=from_b2(contact.manifold.normal)
            other:=a
            if a==player.body { normal=vmul(normal,-1); other=b }
            if normal.y<0.55 { continue }
            for i in 0..<int(contact.manifold.pointCount) {
                point:=contact.manifold.points[i]
                if point.separation<=0.025 && point.point.y<position.y-0.1 {
                    player.grounded=true
                    player.support_velocity=from_b2(b2.Body_GetWorldPointVelocity(other,point.point))
                }
            }
        }
    }
    player_before_step :: proc(player: ^Player,move: f32,jump_pressed: bool,dt: f32) {
        player_read_support(player)
        if player.grounded { player.coyote=PLAYER_TUNING.coyote_time } else { player.coyote=max(f32(0),player.coyote-dt) }
        if jump_pressed { player.buffered_jump=PLAYER_TUNING.jump_buffer }
        velocity:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(player.body))

    package main
    
    import rl "vendor:raylib"
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:fmt"
    
    // raylib 5.x automation event IDs (rcore.c); the Odin binding exposes the raw event.
    smoke_key :: proc(key: rl.KeyboardKey,down: bool) -> rl.AutomationEvent {
    	type:=u32(1); if down { type=2 }
    	return {type=type,params={i32(key),0,0,0}}
    }
    smoke_mouse :: proc(x,y: i32) -> rl.AutomationEvent { return {type=7,params={x,y,0,0}} }
    smoke_button :: proc(down: bool) -> rl.AutomationEvent {
    	type:=u32(5); if down { type=6 }
    	return {type=type,params={0,0,0,0}}
    }
    sandbox_smoke_frame :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,target: rl.RenderTexture2D,events: ..rl.AutomationEvent) {
    	for event in events { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(event) }
    	width,height:=f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight())
    	view:=sandbox_view(width,height)
    	mouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()
    	over_ui:=sandbox_over_hud(mouse,width,height,game.inspection)
    	raw:=sandbox_read_input()
    	input:=sandbox_route_input(game,raw,over_ui)
    	if !raw.menu_pressed && !raw.reset_pressed {
    		if !sandbox_inspect_input(game,world_point(view,mouse),view,over_ui) && input.blast_pressed { sandbox_blast(game,world_point(view,mouse)) }
    	}
    	sandbox_advance(game,1.0/60.0,input)
    	poses:=make(map[u64]Pose); defer delete(poses)
    	rl.BeginDrawing()
    	rl.BeginTextureMode(target)
    	rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
    	sandbox_draw_world(game,view,poses)
    	if !game.panel_open && !over_ui { sandbox_draw_aim(game,view,mouse) }
    	action:=sandbox_draw_hud(game,width,height)
    	rl.EndTextureMode()
    	rl.EndDrawing()
    	sandbox_handle_ui(game,action)
    }
    sandbox_smoke_click :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,target: rl.RenderTexture2D,x,y: i32) {
    	sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(x,y),smoke_button(true))
    	sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(x,y),smoke_button(false))
    }
    sandbox_smoke_inputs :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
    	rl.SetTargetFPS(0)

## User

Update the current Odin build with the destruction behavior below. I value simplicity: make a focused patch using the existing structures and preserve the current playable UX.

The attached C++ work has already explored the performance alternatives. Use its findings as reference; you do not need to repeat those experiments or redesign the data layout.

The intended behavior is:

- A piece’s current subdivisions exist when it is created. Future generations are generated when needed.
- When an explosion destroys a subdivision, eligible children can be generated and destroyed by that same explosion. Continue resolving until the remaining geometry survives or is removed.
- Assign child seed context when children are created. If every child is below the subdivision size cutoff, mark the batch terminal together. Otherwise retain the individual size guard. Seed zero means live geometry that cannot subdivide further.
- If generation cannot produce a genuine split, remove the failed subdivision rather than repeatedly replacing it with equivalent geometry.

Use a simple loop or work queue. Preserve connection inheritance, keep broken connections broken, and evaluate newly created connections against the same blast. Resolve the resulting geometry before creating final physics bodies, and apply the blast impulse once to each final survivor. New physics reactions can wait for the next solver step.

Add the useful optimization demonstrated by the benchmarks: before generating children, directly remove a failed outline when the conservative farthest-vertex bound proves that all descendants would also be destroyed.     package main
    
    import "core:math"
    
    polygon_area :: proc(p: Polygon) -> f32 {
        a: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) { a += vcross(p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]) }
        return math.abs(a)*0.5
    }
    clip_polygon :: proc(p: Polygon, axis: int, cut: f32, keep_low: bool) -> Polygon {
        points: [dynamic]Vec2
        defer delete(points)
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            a,b := p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
            av,bv := a.x-cut,b.x-cut
            if axis == 1 { av = a.y-cut; bv = b.y-cut }
            if !keep_low { av = -av; bv = -bv }
            inside_a, inside_b := av <= 0.00001,bv <= 0.00001
            if inside_a { append(&points,a) }
            if inside_a != inside_b {
                t := av/(av-bv)
                append(&points,vadd(a,vmul(vsub(b,a),t)))
            }
        }
        return make_polygon(points[:])
    }
    is_convex :: proc(p: Polygon) -> bool {
        if len(p.points) < 3 { return false }
        sign: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            cross := vcross(vsub(p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)],p.points[i]),vsub(p.points[(i+2)%len(p.points)],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]))
            if math.abs(cross) < 0.00001 { continue }
            if sign == 0 { sign = cross } else if cross*sign < 0 { return false }
        }
        return true
    }
    point_in_triangle :: proc(p,a,b,c: Vec2, orientation: f32) -> bool {
        return vcross(vsub(b,a),vsub(p,a))*orientation >= -0.00001 &&
               vcross(vsub(c,b),vsub(p,b))*orientation >= -0.00001 &&
               vcross(vsub(a,c),vsub(p,c))*orientation >= -0.00001
    }
    triangulate_polygon :: proc(p: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
        result: [dynamic]Polygon
        indices: [dynamic]int
        defer delete(indices)
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) { append(&indices,i) }
        signed: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) { signed += vcross(p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]) }
        orientation := f32(1)
        if signed < 0 { orientation = -1 }
        for len(indices) > 3 {
            found := false
            for k in 0..<len(indices) {
                i,j,l := indices[(k+len(indices)-1)%len(indices)],indices[k],indices[(k+1)%len(indices)]
                a,b,c := p.points[i],p.points[j],p.points[l]
                if vcross(vsub(b,a),vsub(c,b))*orientation <= 0.00001 { continue }
                contains := false
                for n in indices { if n != i && n != j && n != l && point_in_triangle(p.points[n],a,b,c,orientation) { contains = true; break } }
                if contains { continue }
                append(&result,make_polygon([]Vec2{a,b,c}))
                ordered_remove(&indices,k)
                found = true
                break
            }
            if !found { break }
        }
        if len(indices) == 3 { append(&result,make_polygon([]Vec2{p.points[indices[0]],p.points[indices[1]],p.points[indices[2]]})) }
        return result
    }
    // Straight shared cuts are constructed by clipping both sides at one value.
    // Outside edges are never moved; no gap or overlap is introduced at the cut.
    generate_children :: proc(parent: Polygon, recipe: Material, seed: u8) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
        result: [dynamic]Polygon
        if seed == 0 { return result }
        if !is_convex(parent) || recipe.triangulate { result = triangulate_polygon(parent) } else {
            append(&result,make_polygon(parent.points))
        }
        target := max(recipe.generation_count,len(result))
        for len(result) < target {
            chosen := -1
            largest: f32
            for p,i in result { a := polygon_area(p); if a > largest { largest = a; chosen = i } }
            if chosen < 0 || largest < 0.0001 { break }
            p := result[chosen]
            min_x,min_y := f32(1e30),f32(1e30)
            max_x,max_y := f32(-1e30),f32(-1e30)
            for point in p.points { min_x=min(min_x,point.x); max_x=max(max_x,point.x); min_y=min(min_y,point.y); max_y=max(max_y,point.y) }
            axis := 0
            if (max_x-min_x) < (max_y-min_y)*max(recipe.aspect_ratio,0.1) { axis = 1 }
            fraction := 0.4+0.2*f32(derive_seed(seed,u64(len(result))))/255
            cut := min_x+(max_x-min_x)*fraction
            if axis == 1 { cut = min_y+(max_y-min_y)*fraction }
            low, high := clip_polygon(p,axis,cut,true),clip_polygon(p,axis,cut,false)
            if polygon_area(low) < 0.0001 || polygon_area(high) < 0.0001 { delete(low.points); delete(high.points); break }
            delete(p.points)
            result[chosen] = low
            append(&result,high)
        }
        displace_shared_boundaries(result[:],seed)
        if recipe.triangulate {
            triangles: [dynamic]Polygon
            for polygon in result {
                parts:=triangulate_polygon(polygon)
                for part in parts { append(&triangles,part) }
                delete(parts); delete(polygon.points)
            }
            delete(result)
            result=triangles
        }
        // A failed region must split or disappear; one child would just recreate it.
        if len(result)<2 {
            for child in result { delete(child.points) }
            delete(result)
            return nil
        }
        return result
    }
    
    apply_failures :: proc(s: ^Scene, failures: Failures) {
        if len(failures.subdivisions) == 0 && len(failures.connections) == 0 && len(failures.discard_subdivisions) == 0 { return }
        s.revision+=1
        affected := make(map[u64]bool)
        replacements := make(map[u64][dynamic]u64)
        defer delete(affected)
        defer { for _,children in replacements { delete(children) }; delete(replacements) }
        failed_subs := sorted_ids(failures.subdivisions[:])
        for id in failures.discard_subdivisions { if !contains_id(failed_subs[:],id) { append(&failed_subs,id) } }
        sort_ids(failed_subs[:])
        failed_conns := sorted_ids(failures.connections[:])
        defer delete(failed_subs); defer delete(failed_conns)
        old_connection_count := len(s.connections)
        old_connections: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(old_connections)
        for i in 0..<old_connection_count { append(&old_connections,s.connections[i].id) }
        sort_ids(old_connections[:])
        for id in failed_subs {
            row, ok := s.sub_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.subdivisions[row].live { continue }
            parent := s.subdivisions[row]
            affected[parent.owner] = true
            seed := s.pieces[s.piece_rows[parent.owner]].seed
            if contains_id(failures.discard_subdivisions[:],id) { seed=0 }
            children := generate_children(parent.outline,s.materials[parent.material],seed)
            for outline in children {
                center := centroid(outline)
                world_center := posed_point(parent,center)
                r := vsub(world_center,parent.pose.position)
                pose := Pose{position=world_center,angle=parent.pose.angle,velocity=vadd(parent.pose.velocity,Vec2{-parent.pose.angular_velocity*r.y,parent.pose.angular_velocity*r.x}),angular_velocity=parent.pose.angular_velocity}
                child := add_subdivision(s,parent.owner,outline,pose)
                delete(outline.points)
                child_ids := replacements[id]
                append(&child_ids,child)
                replacements[id] = child_ids
            }
            delete(children)
            s.subdivisions[row].live = false
        }
        for id in failed_conns {
            row, ok := s.conn_rows[id]
            if ok && s.connections[row].live {
                c := s.connections[row]
                affected[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].owner] = true
                affected[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].owner] = true
                s.connections[row].live = false
            }
        }
        for old_id in old_connections {
            i := s.conn_rows[old_id]
            c := s.connections[i]
            if !c.live { continue }
            a_dead := !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].live
            b_dead := !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].live
            if !a_dead && !b_dead { continue }
            s.connections[i].live = false
            left_default,right_default := [1]u64{c.a},[1]u64{c.b}
            left,right := left_default[:],right_default[:]
            if a_dead { left = replacements[c.a][:] }
            if b_dead { right = replacements[c.b][:] }
            old_a,old_b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            old_length,_ := shared_boundary(old_a.outline,old_b.outline)
            if old_length <= 0 { continue }
            for a in left {
                for b in right {
                    if inherits_old_boundary(s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[a]].outline,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[b]].outline,old_a.outline,old_b.outline) { add_connection(s,a,b) }
                }
            }
        }
        for id in failed_subs {
            children := replacements[id]
            for i in 0..<len(children) { for j in i+1..<len(children) { add_connection(s,children[i],children[j]) } }
        }
        owners: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(owners)
        for owner in affected { append(&owners,owner) }
        sort_ids(owners[:])
        for owner in owners { rebuild_piece(s,owner) }
    }
    
    BLAST_LOAD_MULTIPLIER :: f32(10)
    BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE :: f32(0.1)
    blast_load :: proc(distance,radius: f32) -> f32 {
        if radius <= 0 || distance >= radius { return 0 }
        return BLAST_LOAD_MULTIPLIER*max(f32(0),radius-distance)
    }
    fails :: proc(load,strength: f32) -> bool { return load > 0 && load >= strength }
    evaluate_blast :: proc(s: ^Scene, blast: Blast) -> Failures {
        f := Failures{}
        for i in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            sub := &s.subdivisions[i]
            if !sub.live { continue }
            offset := vsub(subdivision_sample(sub^),blast.position)
            distance := vlen(offset)
            load := blast_load(distance,blast.radius)
            if load <= 0 { continue }
            if distance > 0.00001 { apply_blast_motion(s,sub,vmul(offset,1/distance),load) }
            if fails(load,s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&f.subdivisions,sub.id) }
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            a := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]]
            load := blast_load(vlen(vsub(connection_sample(s,c),blast.position)),blast.radius)
            if fails(load,s.materials[a.material].connection_strength) { append(&f.connections,c.id) }
        }
        return f
    }
    blast_pass :: proc(s: ^Scene, blast: Blast) {
        physics_read_motion(s)
        f := evaluate_blast(s,blast)
        apply_failures(s,f)
        delete(f.subdivisions); delete(f.connections)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
    }
    fade_step :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) {
        for i := len(s.remnants)-1; i >= 0; i -= 1 {
            s.remnants[i].age += dt
            if s.remnants[i].age >= 1 { ordered_remove(&s.remnants,i) }
        }
    }
