    package main
    
    import "core:math"
    
    Segment :: struct { a,b: Vec2 }
    Cut_Boundary :: struct { a,b: int, segment: Segment }
    convex_hull :: proc(points: []Vec2) -> [dynamic]Vec2 {
        sorted: [dynamic]Vec2
        defer delete(sorted)
        for point in points { append(&sorted,point) }
        for i in 1..<len(sorted) {
            j:=i
            for j>0 && (sorted[j].x<sorted[j-1].x || (sorted[j].x==sorted[j-1].x && sorted[j].y<sorted[j-1].y)) { sorted[j],sorted[j-1]=sorted[j-1],sorted[j]; j-=1 }
        }
        hull: [dynamic]Vec2
        if len(sorted)<2 { for p in sorted { append(&hull,p) }; return hull }
        for p in sorted {
            for len(hull)>=2 && vcross(vsub(hull[len(hull)-1],hull[len(hull)-2]),vsub(p,hull[len(hull)-1]))<=0 { resize(&hull,len(hull)-1) }
            append(&hull,p)
        }
        upper_start:=len(hull)+1
        for i:=len(sorted)-2; i>=0; i-=1 {
            p:=sorted[i]
            for len(hull)>=upper_start && vcross(vsub(hull[len(hull)-1],hull[len(hull)-2]),vsub(p,hull[len(hull)-1]))<=0 { resize(&hull,len(hull)-1) }
            append(&hull,p)
        }
        resize(&hull,len(hull)-1)
        return hull
    }
    segment_overlap :: proc(a,b: Segment) -> (Segment,bool) {
        d := vsub(a.b,a.a)
        length := vlen(d)
        if length < 0.00001 { return {},false }
        if math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(b.a,a.a))) > 0.0001*length || math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(b.b,a.a))) > 0.0001*length { return {},false }
        unit := vmul(d,1/length)
        t0,t1 := vdot(vsub(b.a,a.a),unit),vdot(vsub(b.b,a.a),unit)
        lo,hi := max(f32(0),min(t0,t1)),min(length,max(t0,t1))
        if hi-lo <= 0.0001 { return {},false }
        return Segment{vadd(a.a,vmul(unit,lo)),vadd(a.a,vmul(unit,hi))},true
    }
    shared_segments :: proc(a,b: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Segment {
        result: [dynamic]Segment
        for i in 0..<len(a.points) {
            for j in 0..<len(b.points) {
                if segment,ok := segment_overlap(Segment{a.points[i],a.points[(i+1)%len(a.points)]},Segment{b.points[j],b.points[(j+1)%len(b.points)]}); ok { append(&result,segment) }
            }
        }
        return result
    }
    inherits_old_boundary :: proc(a,b,old_a,old_b: Polygon) -> bool {
        current := shared_segments(a,b)
        original := shared_segments(old_a,old_b)
        defer delete(current); defer delete(original)
        for x in current { for y in original { if _,ok := segment_overlap(x,y); ok { return true } } }
        return false
    }
    insert_polygon_vertex :: proc(p: ^Polygon,index: int,point: Vec2) {
        points:=make([]Vec2,len(p.points)+1)
        copy(points[:index],p.points[:index]); points[index]=point
        copy(points[index+1:],p.points[index:])
        delete(p.points); p.points=points
    }
    insert_boundary_endpoint :: proc(p: ^Polygon,point: Vec2) {
        for existing in p.points { if vlen(vsub(existing,point)) < 0.00001 { return } }
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            a,b := p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
            edge := vsub(b,a)
            length := vlen(edge)
            if length < 0.00001 { continue }
            t := vdot(vsub(point,a),edge)/(length*length)
            if t > 0 && t < 1 && math.abs(vcross(edge,vsub(point,a))) < 0.00001*length { insert_polygon_vertex(p,i+1,point); return }
        }
    }
    insert_shared_midpoint :: proc(p: ^Polygon,segment: Segment,point: Vec2) {
        insert_boundary_endpoint(p,segment.a)
        insert_boundary_endpoint(p,segment.b)
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            a,b := p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
            if (vlen(vsub(a,segment.a)) < 0.00001 && vlen(vsub(b,segment.b)) < 0.00001) || (vlen(vsub(b,segment.a)) < 0.00001 && vlen(vsub(a,segment.b)) < 0.00001) {
                insert_polygon_vertex(p,i+1,point)
                return
            }
        }
    }
    // Capture each common cut once, then install the exact same displaced midpoint
    // in both outlines. Parent boundary vertices are untouched, including T junctions.
    displace_shared_boundaries :: proc(children: []Polygon,seed: u8) {
        boundaries: [dynamic]Cut_Boundary
        defer delete(boundaries)
        for i in 0..<len(children) {
            for j in i+1..<len(children) {
                segments := shared_segments(children[i],children[j])
                for segment in segments { append(&boundaries,Cut_Boundary{i,j,segment}) }
                delete(segments)
            }
        }
        for boundary,index in boundaries {
            edge := vsub(boundary.segment.b,boundary.segment.a)
            length := vlen(edge)
            normal := Vec2{-edge.y/length,edge.x/length}
            amplitude := min(length*0.04,min(polygon_area(children[boundary.a]),polygon_area(children[boundary.b]))/length*0.08)
            if derive_seed(seed,u64(index+1))%2 == 0 { amplitude = -amplitude }
            mid := vadd(vmul(vadd(boundary.segment.a,boundary.segment.b),0.5),vmul(normal,amplitude))
            insert_shared_midpoint(&children[boundary.a],boundary.segment,mid)
            insert_shared_midpoint(&children[boundary.b],boundary.segment,mid)
        }
    }
    
    // Merge adjacent triangles whenever their union is convex. In particular this
    // avoids feeding thin ears from a displaced boundary to Box2D as tiny fixtures.
    convex_decomposition :: proc(outline: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
        parts:=triangulate_polygon(outline)
        for {
            merged:=false
            for i in 0..<len(parts) {
                for j in i+1..<len(parts) {
                    if length,_:=shared_boundary(parts[i],parts[j]); length<=0 { continue }
                    points: [dynamic]Vec2
                    for point in parts[i].points { append(&points,point) }
                    for point in parts[j].points { append(&points,point) }
                    hull:=convex_hull(points[:]); delete(points)
                    combined:=make_polygon(hull[:]); delete(hull)
                    error:=math.abs(polygon_area(combined)-polygon_area(parts[i])-polygon_area(parts[j]))
                    if len(combined.points)<=8 && error<0.000001 {
                        delete(parts[i].points); delete(parts[j].points)
                        parts[i]=combined; ordered_remove(&parts,j); merged=true; break
                    }
                    delete(combined.points)
                }
                if merged { break }
            }
            if !merged { break }
        }
        return parts
    }
    package main
    
    import "core:encoding/json"
    import "core:math"
    import "core:os"
    import "core:strings"
    
    Wire_Material :: struct {
        name: string,
        subdivision_strength,connection_strength: f32,
        subdivision_infinite,connection_infinite: bool,
        flexibility: f32,
        generation_count: int,
        aspect_ratio: f32,
        triangulate: bool,
    }
    Wire_Connection :: struct { id,a,b: u64 }
    Snapshot :: struct {
        version: int,
        next_id: u64,
        revision: u64,
        minimum_width: f32,
        materials: [dynamic]Wire_Material,
        subdivisions: [dynamic]Subdivision,
        connections: [dynamic]Wire_Connection,
        pieces: [dynamic]Piece,
    }
    finite :: proc(value: f32) -> bool { return !math.is_nan(value) && !math.is_inf(value) }
    valid_vec :: proc(v: Vec2) -> bool { return finite(v.x) && finite(v.y) }
    validate_scene :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> (bool,string) {
        membership := make(map[u64]int)
        defer delete(membership)
        for p in s.pieces {
            if !p.live { continue }
            if len(p.subdivisions) == 0 { return false,"empty live piece" }
            if p.material < 0 || p.material >= len(s.materials) { return false,"invalid material" }
            for id in p.subdivisions {
                row,ok := s.sub_rows[id]
                if !ok { return false,"missing subdivision" }
                sub := s.subdivisions[row]
                if !sub.live || sub.owner != p.id || sub.material != p.material { return false,"invalid subdivision ownership" }
                membership[id] += 1
            }
            for id in p.connections {
                row,ok := s.conn_rows[id]
                if !ok || !s.connections[row].live { return false,"invalid connection membership" }
                c := s.connections[row]
                if !contains_id(p.subdivisions[:],c.a) || !contains_id(p.subdivisions[:],c.b) { return false,"connection crosses pieces" }
            }
            visited := make(map[u64]bool)
            queue: [dynamic]u64
            append(&queue,p.subdivisions[0]); visited[p.subdivisions[0]] = true
            for head := 0; head < len(queue); head += 1 {
                for id in p.connections {
                    c := s.connections[s.conn_rows[id]]
                    other := u64(0)
                    if c.a == queue[head] { other=c.b } else if c.b == queue[head] { other=c.a }
                    if other != 0 && !visited[other] { visited[other]=true; append(&queue,other) }
                }
            }
            connected := len(queue) == len(p.subdivisions)
            delete(queue); delete(visited)
            if !connected { return false,"piece is disconnected" }
        }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            if membership[sub.id] != 1 { return false,"subdivision must belong to exactly one piece" }
            if len(sub.outline.points) < 3 || polygon_area(sub.outline) <= 0 { return false,"invalid polygon" }
            for point in sub.outline.points { if !valid_vec(point) { return false,"invalid polygon coordinate" } }
            if !valid_vec(sub.pose.position) || !valid_vec(sub.pose.velocity) || !finite(sub.pose.angle) || !finite(sub.pose.angular_velocity) { return false,"invalid motion" }
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            a_row,a_ok := s.sub_rows[c.a]; b_row,b_ok := s.sub_rows[c.b]
            if !a_ok || !b_ok { return false,"missing endpoint" }
            a,b := s.subdivisions[a_row],s.subdivisions[b_row]
            if !a.live || !b.live || a.owner != b.owner { return false,"invalid live connection endpoints" }
            p := s.pieces[s.piece_rows[a.owner]]
            if !contains_id(p.connections[:],c.id) { return false,"connection absent from its piece" }
        }
        return true,""
    }
    
    // A shallow read view. Geometry and memberships remain owned by the scene.
    read_state :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> Snapshot {
        out := Snapshot{version=1,next_id=s.next_id,revision=s.revision,minimum_width=s.minimum_width}
        for m in s.materials {
            wire := Wire_Material{name=m.name,subdivision_strength=m.subdivision_strength,connection_strength=m.connection_strength,flexibility=m.flexibility,generation_count=m.generation_count,aspect_ratio=m.aspect_ratio,triangulate=m.triangulate}
            if math.is_inf(m.subdivision_strength) { wire.subdivision_infinite=true; wire.subdivision_strength=0 }
            if math.is_inf(m.connection_strength) { wire.connection_infinite=true; wire.connection_strength=0 }
            append(&out.materials,wire)
        }
        ids: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(ids)
        for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live { append(&ids,sub.id) } }
        sort_ids(ids[:])
        for id in ids { append(&out.subdivisions,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]]) }
        clear(&ids)
        for c in s.connections { if c.live { append(&ids,c.id) } }
        sort_ids(ids[:])
        for id in ids { c:=s.connections[s.conn_rows[id]]; append(&out.connections,Wire_Connection{c.id,c.a,c.b}) }
        clear(&ids)
        for p in s.pieces { if p.live { append(&ids,p.id) } }
        sort_ids(ids[:])
        for id in ids { append(&out.pieces,s.pieces[s.piece_rows[id]]) }
        return out
    }
    release_state_view :: proc(snapshot: ^Snapshot) {
        delete(snapshot.materials); delete(snapshot.subdivisions); delete(snapshot.connections); delete(snapshot.pieces)
        snapshot^ = {}
    }
    encode_snapshot :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> ([]byte,bool) {
        view := read_state(s)
        defer release_state_view(&view)
        data,err := json.marshal(view,{pretty=true})
        return data,err == nil
    }
    destroy_decoded_snapshot :: proc(snapshot: ^Snapshot) {
        for m in snapshot.materials { delete(m.name) }
        for sub in snapshot.subdivisions { delete(sub.outline.points) }
        for p in snapshot.pieces { delete(p.subdivisions); delete(p.connections) }
        release_state_view(snapshot)
    }
    decode_snapshot :: proc(data: []byte) -> (Scene,bool) {
        wire := Snapshot{}
        defer destroy_decoded_snapshot(&wire)
        if err := json.unmarshal(data,&wire); err != nil { return {},false }
        if wire.version != 1 || !finite(wire.minimum_width) || wire.minimum_width < 0 { return {},false }
        s := new_scene(wire.minimum_width)
        s.next_id = wire.next_id
        s.revision = wire.revision
        seen := make(map[u64]bool)
        defer delete(seen)
        ok := false
        defer { if !ok { scene_destroy(&s) } }
        for m in wire.materials {
            if !finite(m.subdivision_strength) || !finite(m.connection_strength) || m.subdivision_strength < 0 || m.connection_strength < 0 || !finite(m.flexibility) || m.flexibility < 0 || m.generation_count < 1 || !finite(m.aspect_ratio) || m.aspect_ratio <= 0 { return {},false }
            material := Material{name=strings.clone(m.name),subdivision_strength=m.subdivision_strength,connection_strength=m.connection_strength,flexibility=m.flexibility,generation_count=m.generation_count,aspect_ratio=m.aspect_ratio,triangulate=m.triangulate}
            append(&s.owned_names,material.name)
            if m.subdivision_infinite { material.subdivision_strength = math.inf_f32(1) }
            if m.connection_infinite { material.connection_strength = math.inf_f32(1) }
            add_material(&s,material)
        }
        for p in wire.pieces {
            if p.id == 0 || p.id > s.next_id || seen[p.id] || !p.live { return {},false }
            seen[p.id] = true
            copy := p
            copy.subdivisions=nil; copy.connections=nil
            for id in p.subdivisions { append(&copy.subdivisions,id) }
            for id in p.connections { append(&copy.connections,id) }
            s.piece_rows[p.id]=len(s.pieces); append(&s.pieces,copy)
        }
        for sub in wire.subdivisions {
            if sub.id == 0 || sub.id > s.next_id || seen[sub.id] || !sub.live { return {},false }
            seen[sub.id] = true
            if len(sub.outline.points)<3 { return {},false }
            retain_subdivision(&s,sub)
        }
        for c in wire.connections {
            if c.id == 0 || c.id > s.next_id || seen[c.id] { return {},false }
            seen[c.id] = true
            a_row,a_ok := s.sub_rows[c.a]; b_row,b_ok := s.sub_rows[c.b]
            if !a_ok || !b_ok || c.a == c.b { return {},false }
            a,b := s.subdivisions[a_row],s.subdivisions[b_row]
            length,point := shared_boundary(a.outline,b.outline)
            if length <= 0 { return {},false }
            s.conn_rows[c.id]=len(s.connections)
            append(&s.connections,Connection{id=c.id,a=c.a,b=c.b,rest_point=point,local_a=vsub(point,a.rest_center),local_b=vsub(point,b.rest_center),live=true})
        }
        if valid,_ := validate_scene(&s); !valid { return {},false }
        ok = true
        return s,true
    }
    save_snapshot :: proc(s: ^Scene,path: string) -> bool {
        data,ok := encode_snapshot(s)
        defer delete(data)
        return ok && os.write_entire_file(path,data) == nil
    }
    load_snapshot :: proc(path: string) -> (Scene,bool) {
        data,err := os.read_entire_file(path,context.allocator)
        defer delete(data)
        if err != nil { return {},false }
        return decode_snapshot(data)
    }
    interpolate_pose :: proc(previous,current: Pose,alpha: f32) -> Pose {
        t := clamp(alpha,f32(0),f32(1))
        angle := current.angle-previous.angle
        for angle > math.PI { angle -= 2*math.PI }
        for angle < -math.PI { angle += 2*math.PI }
        result := current
    # Odin destruction sandbox
    
    A standalone implementation of `destruction-model-implementation-plan.md` and `playable-sandbox-ux-plan.md`, using Odin's bundled Box2D, raylib and raygui libraries. The default application is a small playable destruction yard. The original diagnostic lab and localhost snapshot transport remain available.
    
    ## Run
    
    Requires an Odin installation with compiled `vendor:box2d` and `vendor:raylib` libraries. Tested on Windows with Odin `dev-2026-05-nightly:ea5175d`.
    
    ```powershell
    odin run .
    odin test .
    odin build . -o:speed -out:BOM.exe
    ```
    
    The application opens into a fixed side-view yard with a floor, an invulnerable capsule player and a destructible stepped tower. Walk, jump onto or push debris, aim outside a solid shape and click to blast. Ordinary gravity runs at a fixed 60 Hz with four Box2D substeps. The camera keeps the yard framed when the window resizes. Falling outside the yard returns the player to spawn.
    
    | Control | Action |
    | --- | --- |
    | A / D or left / right arrows | Move |
    | Space | Jump, with a 0.1 second jump buffer and coyote window |
    | Left click in the world | One blast at a valid cursor position |
    | Mouse wheel over the world | Adjust blast radius and power |
    | R / Reset button | Restore the same applied setup and seed |
    | Tab / Escape / Settings button | Open settings and pause; close to resume |
    | F3 | Toggle IDs, connections, counts and inspection tools |
    
    The aiming circle shows the active blast radius. A red cross and message mark origins inside or on live logical outlines; those blasts are suppressed. UI clicks do not blast the world. The settings panel pauses physics, fading and player actions without accumulating simulation time.
    
    Radius changes are immediate, including inside settings. Breakup pattern, fragment strength, connection strength, flexibility and Generate children are staged until **Apply & Reset**. Resume keeps the previously applied setup. Strength and flexibility stay independent of Chunk / Splinter / Shatter. The initial setup uses seed 42, strengths 30 / 24, flexibility 0.15 and radius 4.2. Turning Generate children off uses seed zero; geometry stays live until it fails.
    
    With F3 enabled: right click selects, Delete or Ctrl+click directly removes a region, Shift+click or X near an anchor breaks a connection, J toggles links, V toggles the cosmetic surface, and S saves `snapshot.json`. D and Space retain movement and jump in inspection mode.
    
    Run `odin run . -- --lab` for the original zero-gravity diagnostic fixture and its legacy shortcuts (projectile I, presets 1/2/3, terminal T, pause/step Space/N, radius Q/E, pan/zoom, and snapshot save/load S/L). The existing sender and receiver use that diagnostic fixture; player and floor replication are outside this local milestone.
    
    For automated execution:
    
    ```powershell
    odin run . -- --headless
    odin run . -- --smoke
    odin run . -- --smoke-settings
    odin run . -- --smoke-input
    ```
    
    `--headless` evaluates the original diagnostic blast, runs 60 physics ticks, validates the graph, writes `snapshot.json`, and reconstructs a receiver. `--smoke` renders the yard in a hidden window to `sandbox-preview.png`. `--smoke-settings` renders the expanded paused panel to `sandbox-settings-preview.png`. Both exit after two frames.
    
    `--smoke-input` uses raylib's native automation events in a hidden window to exercise the actual keyboard bindings and raygui widgets: movement, holding jump through landing, paused settings, closing a slider drag with Escape, immediate radius updates, staged pattern/generation changes, Apply & Reset, the first subsequent blast click, inspection and R reset. It asserts the results and exports `sandbox-playthrough.png`. The normal behavior suite stays independent of a window or display.
    
    ## Live transmission
    
    Build once, then run these in separate terminals:
    
    ```powershell
    .\BOM.exe --serve
    .\BOM.exe --receive
    ```
    
    The sender listens on **127.0.0.1:9901** for one receiver. It sends explicit complete snapshots after structural changes and at 10 Hz for motion. The receiver renders polygons, connections, ownership and interpolated motion without simulating physics. Destroy or split the wall in the sender to see the receiver update.
    
    Frames contain a four byte little endian payload length followed by UTF-8 JSON, capped at 4 MiB. Partial reads, partial writes, coalesced frames and disconnects are handled. One in-flight send is retained; the sender does not accumulate a queue of old states. `read_state`, `encode_snapshot` and `decode_snapshot` can also be used with another transport.
    
    Snapshots carry current geometry, materials, stable IDs, piece memberships, future generation seeds, structural revision, and body motion. They reconstruct derived anchors from the transmitted outlines. Infinite strengths have explicit flags so snapshots remain valid JSON. A piece's current seed is never used to reconstruct its existing damaged geometry.
    
    ## Implementation
    
    | File | Responsibility |
    | --- | --- |
    | `model.odin` | Stable identity, shared reference vertex pool, retained memberships, component traversal and width filtering |
    | `geometry.odin` | Shared boundaries, displaced cuts, convex hull and collision decomposition |
    | `destruction.odin` | Seeded generation, blast evaluation and the shared structural update |
    | `physics.odin` | Box2D bodies, fixtures, weld joints, interaction aggregation and load policy |
    | `state.odin` | State reader, snapshot validation, serialization and pose interpolation |
    | `transmission.odin` | Framed localhost TCP snapshots and the receiver application |
    | `debug_view.odin` | Native controls, rendering and material presets |
    | `player.odin` | Capsule controller, contact support, buffered jumps and respawn |
    | `yard.odin` | Yard creation/reset, applied and staged settings, aim validation and input routing |
    | `sandbox_view.odin` | Fixed camera, compact HUD, raygui panel and inspection input |
    | `sandbox_smoke.odin` | Hidden-window native input and widget playthrough |
    | `behavior_test.odin` | Focused behavior and integration checks |
    | `sandbox_test.odin` | Gravity stability, movement, debris contact, resets, settings and input consumption |
    
    IDs are monotonic and mapped to storage rows. Removed rows and outline ranges remain retained until `scene_destroy`; no world repacking is performed. Subdivision outlines use ranges into one append-only vertex pool in a common undeformed reference frame. Their `outline` slices are derived views refreshed when the pool grows. Borrowed polygon views must not be held across scene mutations. `add_subdivision` copies its input; the caller retains ownership of that input allocation. `make_polygon` creates an owned polygon.
    
    `apply_failures` stages one generation, preserves old neighbor relationships, inherits only surviving boundary attachments, regroups affected pieces with temporary adjacency, filters connected groups, and leaves physics synchronization to the between-step adapter. A failed connection cannot be healed by proximity. Failure IDs and new groups use stable ordering, including when storage rows are shuffled. `discard_subdivisions` provides direct removal independently of a generative piece seed.

    make_wall :: proc(seed: u8 = 0, minimum_width: f32 = 0) -> Scene {
        s := new_scene(minimum_width)
        m := add_material(&s,Material{name="brick",subdivision_strength=6,connection_strength=4,flexibility=0.25,generation_count=2,aspect_ratio=1.5})

        }

        return s
    }

        for name in s.owned_names { delete(name) }
        delete(s.owned_names)
        delete(s.sub_rows); delete(s.conn_rows); delete(s.piece_rows)
        s^ = {}
    }

    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    Physics :: struct {
        world: b2.WorldId,
        bodies: map[u64]b2.BodyId,
        joints: map[u64]b2.JointId,
        fixture_counts: map[u64]int,
        active: bool,
    }
    Interaction :: struct { force: Vec2, torque: f32 }
    REFERENCE_LENGTH :: f32(1)
    PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS :: 4
    GLOBAL_DAMPING :: f32(0.7)
    
    to_b2 :: proc(v: Vec2) -> b2.Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    from_b2 :: proc(v: b2.Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    interaction_load :: proc(i: Interaction) -> f32 {
        return max(vlen(i.force),math.abs(i.torque)/REFERENCE_LENGTH)
    }
    equivalent_force :: proc(impulse: Vec2, interval: f32) -> Vec2 {
        assert(interval > 0)
        return vmul(impulse,1/interval)
    }
    physics_init :: proc(s: ^Scene, gravity: Vec2 = {}) {
        assert(!s.physics.active)
        def := b2.DefaultWorldDef()
        def.gravity = to_b2(gravity)
        s.physics = Physics{world=b2.CreateWorld(def),bodies=make(map[u64]b2.BodyId),joints=make(map[u64]b2.JointId),fixture_counts=make(map[u64]int),active=true}
        physics_sync_structure(s)
    }
    physics_destroy :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        b2.DestroyWorld(s.physics.world)
        delete(s.physics.bodies); delete(s.physics.joints); delete(s.physics.fixture_counts)
        s.physics = {}
    }
    physics_read_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row := s.sub_rows[id]
            rotation := b2.Body_GetRotation(body)
            s.subdivisions[row].pose = Pose{
                position=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(body)),angle=math.atan2(rotation.s,rotation.c),
                velocity=from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body)),angular_velocity=b2.Body_GetAngularVelocity(body),
            }
        }
    }
    physics_create_fixture :: proc(s: ^Scene, body: b2.BodyId, sub: Subdivision, outline: Polygon) -> bool {
        points: [dynamic]b2.Vec2
        defer delete(points)
        for point in outline.points { append(&points,to_b2(vsub(point,sub.rest_center))) }
        hull := b2.ComputeHull(points[:])
        // Hull welding can collapse a thin ear below Box2D's collision tolerance.
        if hull.count < 3 { return false }
        polygon := b2.MakePolygon(hull,0)
        def := b2.DefaultShapeDef()
        def.density = 1
        _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
        s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id] += 1
        return true
    }
    physics_finish_mass :: proc(s: ^Scene,body: b2.BodyId,sub: Subdivision) {
        if s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id]==0 {
            // A microscopic attached subdivision is still one live logical entity.
            // Use a bounding fixture when the engine cannot resolve any of its ears.
            lo,hi:=Vec2{1e30,1e30},Vec2{-1e30,-1e30}
            for rest in sub.outline.points { p:=vsub(rest,sub.rest_center); lo={min(lo.x,p.x),min(lo.y,p.y)}; hi={max(hi.x,p.x),max(hi.y,p.y)} }
            polygon:=b2.MakeOffsetBox(max(f32(0.0025),(hi.x-lo.x)*0.5),max(f32(0.0025),(hi.y-lo.y)*0.5),to_b2(vmul(vadd(lo,hi),0.5)),b2.MakeRot(0))
            def:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); def.density=1
            _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
            s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id]=1
        }
        // Keep mass and the body origin tied to the exact logical polygon, including
        // when Box2D simplifies a fixture. This also makes rotational inheritance exact.
        inertia: f32
        for i in 0..<len(sub.outline.points) {
            a,b:=vsub(sub.outline.points[i],sub.rest_center),vsub(sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)],sub.rest_center)
            inertia+=vcross(a,b)*(vdot(a,a)+vdot(a,b)+vdot(b,b))/12
        }
        b2.Body_SetMassData(body,b2.MassData{mass=polygon_area(sub.outline),center={},rotationalInertia=math.abs(inertia)})
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,to_b2(sub.pose.velocity))
        b2.Body_SetAngularVelocity(body,sub.pose.angular_velocity)
    }
    // This runs only between World_Step calls. Existing handles survive ownership changes.
    physics_sync_structure :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        dead_joints: [dynamic]u64
        dead_bodies: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(dead_joints); defer delete(dead_bodies)
        for id,joint in s.physics.joints {
            row,ok := s.conn_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.connections[row].live { b2.DestroyJoint(joint); append(&dead_joints,id) }
        }
        for id in dead_joints { delete_key(&s.physics.joints,id) }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row,ok := s.sub_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.subdivisions[row].live { b2.DestroyBody(body); append(&dead_bodies,id) }
        }
        for id in dead_bodies { delete_key(&s.physics.bodies,id); delete_key(&s.physics.fixture_counts,id) }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            if _,exists := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]; exists { continue }
            def := b2.DefaultBodyDef()
            def.type = .dynamicBody
            def.position = to_b2(sub.pose.position)
            def.rotation = b2.MakeRot(sub.pose.angle)
            def.linearVelocity = to_b2(sub.pose.velocity)
            def.angularVelocity = sub.pose.angular_velocity
            body := b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
            s.physics.bodies[sub.id] = body
            if is_convex(sub.outline) && len(sub.outline.points) <= 8 {
                physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,sub.outline)
            } else {
                triangles := convex_decomposition(sub.outline)
                for triangle in triangles { physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,triangle); delete(triangle.points) }
                delete(triangles)
            }
            physics_finish_mass(s,body,sub)
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            if _,exists := s.physics.joints[c.id]; exists { continue }
            a := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]]
            b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            def := b2.DefaultWeldJointDef()
            def.bodyIdA = s.physics.bodies[c.a]
            def.bodyIdB = s.physics.bodies[c.b]
            def.localAnchorA = to_b2(c.local_a)
            def.localAnchorB = to_b2(c.local_b)
            // All outlines share one undeformed frame. Its relative rest angle is zero.
            def.referenceAngle = 0
            flexibility := max(s.materials[a.material].flexibility,s.materials[b.material].flexibility)
            if flexibility > 0 {
                def.linearHertz = 1/max(flexibility,0.01)
                def.angularHertz = def.linearHertz
            }
            def.linearDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
            def.angularDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
            s.physics.joints[c.id] = b2.CreateWeldJoint(s.physics.world,def)
        }
    }
    apply_blast_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene, sub: ^Subdivision, direction: Vec2, load: f32) {
        delta_v := vmul(direction,load*BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE)
        if s.physics.active {
            body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
            impulse := vmul(delta_v,b2.Body_GetMass(body))
            b2.Body_ApplyLinearImpulseToCenter(body,to_b2(impulse),true)
            sub.pose.velocity = from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body))
        } else {
            sub.pose.velocity = vadd(sub.pose.velocity,delta_v)
        }
    }
    // Contact points and fixtures against the same other body form one interaction.
    // Joint reactions are already forces; totalNormalImpulse covers the full tick.
    // Box2D's tangent/rolling impulses cover the final substep in this binding version.
    calculate_physics_loads :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) -> Failures {
        assert(dt > 0)
        failures := Failures{}
        loads := make(map[u64]f32)
        defer delete(loads)
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
            capacity := int(b2.Body_GetContactCapacity(body))
            buffer := make([]b2.ContactData,capacity)
            contacts := b2.Body_GetContactData(body,buffer)
            interactions := make(map[b2.BodyId]Interaction)
            for contact in contacts {
                body_a,body_b := b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdA),b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdB)
                other := body_b
                sign := f32(-1)
                if body_b == body { other=body_a; sign=1 }
                normal := from_b2(contact.manifold.normal)
                tangent := Vec2{normal.y,-normal.x}
                interaction := interactions[other]
                for k in 0..<int(contact.manifold.pointCount) {
                    point := contact.manifold.points[k]
                    force := vadd(equivalent_force(vmul(normal,point.totalNormalImpulse*sign),dt),equivalent_force(vmul(tangent,point.tangentImpulse*sign),dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)))
                    interaction.force = vadd(interaction.force,force)
                    interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(from_b2(point.point),sub.pose.position),force)
                }
                interaction.torque += contact.manifold.rollingImpulse*sign/(dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS))
                interactions[other] = interaction
            }
            for _,interaction in interactions { loads[sub.id] = max(loads[sub.id],interaction_load(interaction)) }
            delete(interactions); delete(buffer)
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            joint := s.physics.joints[c.id]
            interaction := Interaction{force=from_b2(b2.Joint_GetConstraintForce(joint)),torque=b2.Joint_GetConstraintTorque(joint)}
            load := interaction_load(interaction)
            a,b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            a_interaction,b_interaction := interaction,interaction
            a_interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(posed_point(a,c.rest_point),a.pose.position),interaction.force)
            b_interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(posed_point(b,c.rest_point),b.pose.position),interaction.force)
            loads[c.a] = max(loads[c.a],interaction_load(a_interaction))
            loads[c.b] = max(loads[c.b],interaction_load(b_interaction))
            material := s.materials[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].material]
            if fails(load,material.connection_strength) { append(&failures.connections,c.id) }
        }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if sub.live && fails(loads[sub.id],s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&failures.subdivisions,sub.id) }
        }
        return failures
    }
    Load_Calculator :: #type proc(s: ^Scene,dt: f32) -> Failures
    physics_tick :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32,calculate_loads: Load_Calculator = calculate_physics_loads) {
        assert(s.physics.active && dt > 0)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        b2.World_Step(s.physics.world,dt,PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)
        physics_read_motion(s)
        failures := calculate_loads(s,dt)
        apply_failures(s,failures)
        delete(failures.subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
        delete(failures.discard_subdivisions)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        fade_step(s,dt)
    }

    counts :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> (int,int,int) {
        a,b,c := 0,0,0
        for x in s.subdivisions { if x.live { a+=1 } }
        for x in s.connections { if x.live { b+=1 } }
        for x in s.pieces { if x.live { c+=1 } }

        f := Failures{}

        return f

    unpartitionable_attached_subdivision_is_removed :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        cases:=[4]struct { width,height: f32, count: int, triangular: bool }{
            {0.005,0.01,2,false}, // Below the minimum split area.
            {0.015,0.01,2,false}, // Both cut children would be too small.
            {0.01,0.01,2,true},   // Triangulation yields the same single triangle.
            {0.5,1,1,false},      // A recipe requesting only one region.
        }
        for fixture in cases {
            s:=new_scene(0.1); defer scene_destroy(&s)
            m:=add_material(&s,Material{name="small attached",subdivision_strength=6,connection_strength=math.inf_f32(1),generation_count=fixture.count,aspect_ratio=1,triangulate=fixture.triangular})
            owner:=add_piece(&s,m,42)
            w,h:=fixture.width,fixture.height
            small:=make_polygon([]Vec2{{0,0},{w,0},{w,h},{0,h}})
            if fixture.triangular { delete(small.points); small=make_polygon([]Vec2{{0,0},{w,0},{w,h}}) }
            defer delete(small.points)
            large:=make_polygon([]Vec2{{w,0},{w+1,0},{w+1,1},{w,1}}); defer delete(large.points)
            small_id:=add_subdivision(&s,owner,small,Pose{position=centroid(small)})
            large_id:=add_subdivision(&s,owner,large,Pose{position=centroid(large)})
            append(&s.pieces[0].subdivisions,small_id,large_id)
            connection:=add_connection(&s,small_id,large_id)
            append(&s.pieces[0].connections,connection)
            testing.expect(t,connection!=0 && piece_width(&s,s.pieces[0].subdivisions[:])>=s.minimum_width)
            physics_init(&s)
            large_body:=s.physics.bodies[large_id]
            vertex_count:=len(s.vertices)
            last_id:=s.next_id
            for pass in 0..<4 {
                // Re-select any replacement of the small region on each overload pass.
                f:=Failures{}
                for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live && sub.id!=large_id { append(&f.subdivisions,sub.id) } }
                apply_failures(&s,f); free_failures(&f); physics_sync_structure(&s)
                subs,conns,pieces:=counts(&s)
                testing.expect(t,subs==1 && conns==0 && pieces==1)
                testing.expect(t,len(s.subdivisions)==2 && len(s.vertices)==vertex_count && len(s.physics.bodies)==1)
                testing.expect(t,s.physics.bodies[large_id]==large_body)
                if pass>0 { testing.expect(t,s.next_id==last_id) }
                last_id=s.next_id
                expect_valid(t,&s)
            }
        }
    }

    package main
    
    import "core:math"
    
    Segment :: struct { a,b: Vec2 }
    Cut_Boundary :: struct { a,b: int, segment: Segment }
    convex_hull :: proc(points: []Vec2) -> [dynamic]Vec2 {
        sorted: [dynamic]Vec2
        defer delete(sorted)
        for point in points { append(&sorted,point) }
        for i in 1..<len(sorted) {
            j:=i
            for j>0 && (sorted[j].x<sorted[j-1].x || (sorted[j].x==sorted[j-1].x && sorted[j].y<sorted[j-1].y)) { sorted[j],sorted[j-1]=sorted[j-1],sorted[j]; j-=1 }
        }
        hull: [dynamic]Vec2
        if len(sorted)<2 { for p in sorted { append(&hull,p) }; return hull }
        for p in sorted {
            for len(hull)>=2 && vcross(vsub(hull[len(hull)-1],hull[len(hull)-2]),vsub(p,hull[len(hull)-1]))<=0 { resize(&hull,len(hull)-1) }
            append(&hull,p)
        }
        upper_start:=len(hull)+1
        for i:=len(sorted)-2; i>=0; i-=1 {
            p:=sorted[i]
            for len(hull)>=upper_start && vcross(vsub(hull[len(hull)-1],hull[len(hull)-2]),vsub(p,hull[len(hull)-1]))<=0 { resize(&hull,len(hull)-1) }
            append(&hull,p)
        }
        resize(&hull,len(hull)-1)
        return hull
    }
    segment_overlap :: proc(a,b: Segment) -> (Segment,bool) {
        d := vsub(a.b,a.a)
        length := vlen(d)
        if length < 0.00001 { return {},false }
        if math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(b.a,a.a))) > 0.0001*length || math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(b.b,a.a))) > 0.0001*length { return {},false }
        unit := vmul(d,1/length)
        t0,t1 := vdot(vsub(b.a,a.a),unit),vdot(vsub(b.b,a.a),unit)
        lo,hi := max(f32(0),min(t0,t1)),min(length,max(t0,t1))
        if hi-lo <= 0.0001 { return {},false }
        return Segment{vadd(a.a,vmul(unit,lo)),vadd(a.a,vmul(unit,hi))},true
    }
    shared_segments :: proc(a,b: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Segment {
        result: [dynamic]Segment
        for i in 0..<len(a.points) {
            for j in 0..<len(b.points) {
                if segment,ok := segment_overlap(Segment{a.points[i],a.points[(i+1)%len(a.points)]},Segment{b.points[j],b.points[(j+1)%len(b.points)]}); ok { append(&result,segment) }
            }
        }
        return result
    }
    inherits_old_boundary :: proc(a,b,old_a,old_b: Polygon) -> bool {
        current := shared_segments(a,b)
        original := shared_segments(old_a,old_b)
        defer delete(current); defer delete(original)
        for x in current { for y in original { if _,ok := segment_overlap(x,y); ok { return true } } }
        return false
    }
    insert_polygon_vertex :: proc(p: ^Polygon,index: int,point: Vec2) {
        points:=make([]Vec2,len(p.points)+1)
        copy(points[:index],p.points[:index]); points[index]=point
        copy(points[index+1:],p.points[index:])
        delete(p.points); p.points=points
    }
    insert_boundary_endpoint :: proc(p: ^Polygon,point: Vec2) {
        for existing in p.points { if vlen(vsub(existing,point)) < 0.00001 { return } }
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            a,b := p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
            edge := vsub(b,a)
            length := vlen(edge)
            if length < 0.00001 { continue }
            t := vdot(vsub(point,a),edge)/(length*length)
            if t > 0 && t < 1 && math.abs(vcross(edge,vsub(point,a))) < 0.00001*length { insert_polygon_vertex(p,i+1,point); return }
        }
    }
    insert_shared_midpoint :: proc(p: ^Polygon,segment: Segment,point: Vec2) {
        insert_boundary_endpoint(p,segment.a)
        insert_boundary_endpoint(p,segment.b)
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            a,b := p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
            if (vlen(vsub(a,segment.a)) < 0.00001 && vlen(vsub(b,segment.b)) < 0.00001) || (vlen(vsub(b,segment.a)) < 0.00001 && vlen(vsub(a,segment.b)) < 0.00001) {
                insert_polygon_vertex(p,i+1,point)
                return
            }
        }
    }
    // Capture each common cut once, then install the exact same displaced midpoint
    // in both outlines. Parent boundary vertices are untouched, including T junctions.
    displace_shared_boundaries :: proc(children: []Polygon,seed: u8) {
        boundaries: [dynamic]Cut_Boundary
        defer delete(boundaries)
        for i in 0..<len(children) {
            for j in i+1..<len(children) {
                segments := shared_segments(children[i],children[j])
                for segment in segments { append(&boundaries,Cut_Boundary{i,j,segment}) }
                delete(segments)
            }
        }
        for boundary,index in boundaries {
            edge := vsub(boundary.segment.b,boundary.segment.a)
            length := vlen(edge)
            normal := Vec2{-edge.y/length,edge.x/length}
            amplitude := min(length*0.04,min(polygon_area(children[boundary.a]),polygon_area(children[boundary.b]))/length*0.08)
            if derive_seed(seed,u64(index+1))%2 == 0 { amplitude = -amplitude }
            mid := vadd(vmul(vadd(boundary.segment.a,boundary.segment.b),0.5),vmul(normal,amplitude))
            insert_shared_midpoint(&children[boundary.a],boundary.segment,mid)
            insert_shared_midpoint(&children[boundary.b],boundary.segment,mid)
        }
    }
    
    // Merge adjacent triangles whenever their union is convex. In particular this
    // avoids feeding thin ears from a displaced boundary to Box2D as tiny fixtures.
    convex_decomposition :: proc(outline: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
        parts:=triangulate_polygon(outline)
        for {
            merged:=false
            for i in 0..<len(parts) {
                for j in i+1..<len(parts) {
                    if length,_:=shared_boundary(parts[i],parts[j]); length<=0 { continue }
                    points: [dynamic]Vec2
                    for point in parts[i].points { append(&points,point) }
                    for point in parts[j].points { append(&points,point) }
                    hull:=convex_hull(points[:]); delete(points)
                    combined:=make_polygon(hull[:]); delete(hull)
                    error:=math.abs(polygon_area(combined)-polygon_area(parts[i])-polygon_area(parts[j]))
                    if len(combined.points)<=8 && error<0.000001 {
                        delete(parts[i].points); delete(parts[j].points)
                        parts[i]=combined; ordered_remove(&parts,j); merged=true; break
                    }
                    delete(combined.points)
                }
                if merged { break }
            }
            if !merged { break }
        }
        return parts
    }

    package main
    
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    Sandbox_Settings :: struct {
        blast_radius: f32,
        pattern: int,
        fragment_strength, connection_strength, flexibility: f32,
        generate_children: bool,
        seed: u8,
    }
    DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS :: Sandbox_Settings{blast_radius=4.2,fragment_strength=30,connection_strength=24,flexibility=0.15,generate_children=true,seed=42}
    sandbox_material :: proc(settings: Sandbox_Settings) -> Material {
        material:=material_preset(settings.pattern)
        material.subdivision_strength=settings.fragment_strength
        material.connection_strength=settings.connection_strength
        material.flexibility=settings.flexibility
        return material
    }
    Sandbox :: struct {
        scene: Scene,
        floor: b2.BodyId,
        player: Player,
        applied,draft: Sandbox_Settings,
        previous: map[u64]Pose,
        previous_player: Vec2,
        panel_open,inspection,tuning_open,surface,joints: bool,
        block_jump,block_blast,jump_queued: bool,
        selected: u64,
        accumulator: f32,
        status: string,
        status_time: f32,
    }
    sandbox_create :: proc(settings: Sandbox_Settings = DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS) -> Sandbox {
        game:=Sandbox{applied=settings,draft=settings,previous=make(map[u64]Pose),surface=true,joints=true}
        sandbox_reset(&game)
        return game
    }
    sandbox_destroy :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        scene_destroy(&game.scene)
        delete(game.previous)
        game^={}
    }
    sandbox_notice :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,text: string) { game.status=text; game.status_time=2.5 }
    sandbox_clear_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        game.accumulator=0
        game.jump_queued=false
        game.block_jump=true
        game.block_blast=true
        player_clear_input(&game.player)
        clear(&game.previous)
        game.previous_player=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
    }
    sandbox_reset :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        revision:=game.scene.revision+1
        scene_destroy(&game.scene)
        s:=&game.scene
        s^=new_scene(0.10)
        s.revision=revision
        material:=add_material(s,sandbox_material(game.applied))
        seed:=game.applied.seed
        if !game.applied.generate_children { seed=0 }
        owner:=add_piece(s,material,seed)
        // A stepped stack, with one common reference frame and real shared edges.
        for row in 0..<3 {
            for column in 0..<4-row {
                x,y:=f32(1.5)+f32(column)*0.85,f32(row)*0.85+0.005
                points:=[4]Vec2{{x,y},{x+0.85,y},{x+0.85,y+0.85},{x,y+0.85}}
                outline:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
                id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline)})
                append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
            }
        }
        for a in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            for b in a+1..<len(s.subdivisions) { add_connection(s,s.subdivisions[a].id,s.subdivisions[b].id) }
        }
        for connection in s.connections { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].connections,connection.id) }
        physics_init(s,{0,-9.8})
        def:=b2.DefaultBodyDef()
        def.position={0.5,-0.3}
        game.floor=b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
        shape:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); shape.material.friction=0.65
        _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(game.floor,shape,b2.MakeBox(8.5,0.3))
        game.player=player_create(s.physics.world)
        game.selected=0
        sandbox_clear_input(game)
        sandbox_notice(game,"Yard reset")
    }
    sandbox_set_panel :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,open: bool) {
        game.panel_open=open
        if open { game.draft=game.applied }
        sandbox_clear_input(game)
    }
    sandbox_set_radius :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,radius: f32) {
        game.applied.blast_radius=clamp(radius,f32(0.5),f32(6))
        game.draft.blast_radius=game.applied.blast_radius
    }
    sandbox_apply_settings :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        game.applied=game.draft
        sandbox_reset(game)
        game.panel_open=false
        sandbox_notice(game,"Settings applied")
    }
    // Inclusive edges are solid too. Use the logical posed outline, not the cosmetic mesh.
    point_in_subdivision :: proc(sub: Subdivision,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        local:=vadd(sub.rest_center,vrotate(vsub(point,sub.pose.position),-sub.pose.angle))
        inside:=false
        for a,i in sub.outline.points {
            b:=sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)]
            edge:=vsub(b,a); relative:=vsub(local,a)
            if math.abs(vcross(edge,relative))<0.00001 && vdot(relative,edge)>=0 && vdot(relative,edge)<=vdot(edge,edge) { return true }
            if (a.y>local.y)!=(b.y>local.y) && local.x<(b.x-a.x)*(local.y-a.y)/(b.y-a.y)+a.x { inside=!inside }
        }
        return inside
    }
    sandbox_valid_aim :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live && point_in_subdivision(sub,point) { return false } }
        return true
    }
    sandbox_blast :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        if game.panel_open { return false }
        if !sandbox_valid_aim(&game.scene,point) { sandbox_notice(game,"Aim outside the solid shape"); return false }
        blast_pass(&game.scene,Blast{position=point,radius=game.applied.blast_radius})
        clear(&game.previous)
        return true
    }
    
    // Input routing is independent of raylib, so menu consumption has a direct regression check.
    Sandbox_Input :: struct {
        move: f32,
        jump_pressed,jump_down,blast_pressed,blast_down: bool,
        menu_pressed,reset_pressed,inspection_pressed: bool,

    package main
    
    import "core:math"
    
    Segment :: struct { a,b: Vec2 }
    Cut_Boundary :: struct { a,b: int, segment: Segment }
    convex_hull :: proc(points: []Vec2) -> [dynamic]Vec2 {
        sorted: [dynamic]Vec2
        defer delete(sorted)
        for point in points { append(&sorted,point) }
        for i in 1..<len(sorted) {
            j:=i
            for j>0 && (sorted[j].x<sorted[j-1].x || (sorted[j].x==sorted[j-1].x && sorted[j].y<sorted[j-1].y)) { sorted[j],sorted[j-1]=sorted[j-1],sorted[j]; j-=1 }
        }
        hull: [dynamic]Vec2
        if len(sorted)<2 { for p in sorted { append(&hull,p) }; return hull }
        for p in sorted {
            for len(hull)>=2 && vcross(vsub(hull[len(hull)-1],hull[len(hull)-2]),vsub(p,hull[len(hull)-1]))<=0 { resize(&hull,len(hull)-1) }
            append(&hull,p)
        }
        upper_start:=len(hull)+1
        for i:=len(sorted)-2; i>=0; i-=1 {
            p:=sorted[i]
            for len(hull)>=upper_start && vcross(vsub(hull[len(hull)-1],hull[len(hull)-2]),vsub(p,hull[len(hull)-1]))<=0 { resize(&hull,len(hull)-1) }
            append(&hull,p)
        }
        resize(&hull,len(hull)-1)
        return hull
    }
    segment_overlap :: proc(a,b: Segment) -> (Segment,bool) {
        d := vsub(a.b,a.a)
        length := vlen(d)
        if length < 0.00001 { return {},false }
        if math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(b.a,a.a))) > 0.0001*length || math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(b.b,a.a))) > 0.0001*length { return {},false }
        unit := vmul(d,1/length)
        t0,t1 := vdot(vsub(b.a,a.a),unit),vdot(vsub(b.b,a.a),unit)
        lo,hi := max(f32(0),min(t0,t1)),min(length,max(t0,t1))
        if hi-lo <= 0.0001 { return {},false }
        return Segment{vadd(a.a,vmul(unit,lo)),vadd(a.a,vmul(unit,hi))},true
    }
    shared_segments :: proc(a,b: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Segment {
        result: [dynamic]Segment
        for i in 0..<len(a.points) {
            for j in 0..<len(b.points) {
                if segment,ok := segment_overlap(Segment{a.points[i],a.points[(i+1)%len(a.points)]},Segment{b.points[j],b.points[(j+1)%len(b.points)]}); ok { append(&result,segment) }

    @(test)
    child_seed_batches_and_individual_width_guard :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
    	s:=make_wall(42,0.75); defer scene_destroy(&s)
    	f:=failure_for(s.subdivisions[1].id); defer free_failures(&f)
    	apply_failures(&s,f)
    	for i in 3..<len(s.subdivisions) {
    		testing.expect(t,s.subdivisions[i].live && s.subdivisions[i].seed==0,"All-small siblings are terminal live geometry at birth")
    	}
    	terminal:=failure_for(s.subdivisions[3].id,s.subdivisions[4].id); defer free_failures(&terminal)
    	apply_failures(&s,terminal)
    	testing.expect(t,len(s.subdivisions)==5,"Terminal geometry cannot generate another batch")
    	expect_valid(t,&s)
    
    	r:=make_wall(42); defer scene_destroy(&r)
    	r.materials[0].generation_count=3
    	parent:=r.subdivisions[1]
    	preview:=generate_children(parent.outline,r.materials[0],parent.seed)
    	lo,hi:=f32(1e30),f32(0)
    	for polygon in preview {
    		width:=outline_width(polygon.points)
    		lo=min(lo,width); hi=max(hi,width)
    		delete(polygon.points)
    	}
    	delete(preview)
    	testing.expect(t,hi>lo && hi<parent.width)
    	r.minimum_width=(lo+hi)*0.5
    	g:=failure_for(parent.id); defer free_failures(&g)
    	apply_failures(&r,g)
    	guarded:=u64(0)
    	for i in 3..<len(r.subdivisions) {
    		child:=r.subdivisions[i]
    		testing.expect(t,child.live && child.seed!=0,"A mixed batch retains child context, including its small members")
    		if child.width<=r.minimum_width { guarded=child.id }
    	}
    	testing.expect(t,guarded!=0)
    	if guarded==0 { return }
    	before:=len(r.subdivisions)
    	h:=failure_for(guarded); defer free_failures(&h)
    	apply_failures(&r,h)
    	testing.expect(t,len(r.subdivisions)==before && !r.subdivisions[r.sub_rows[guarded]].live,"The individual width guard still stops small mixed-batch children")
    	expect_valid(t,&r)
    }
    
    @(test)
    recursive_failure_terminates_without_a_width_cutoff :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
    	s:=new_scene(0); defer scene_destroy(&s)
    	m:=add_material(&s,Material{name="tiny",subdivision_strength=1,connection_strength=1,generation_count=4,aspect_ratio=1})
    	p:=add_piece(&s,m,42)
    	points:=[4]Vec2{{0,0},{0.03,0},{0.03,0.01},{0,0.01}}
    	outline:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
    	id:=add_subdivision(&s,p,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline)})
    	append(&s.pieces[0].subdivisions,id)
    	blast:=Blast{position={-0.1,0},radius=1}
    	blast_pass(&s,blast,false)
    	a,b,c:=counts(&s)
    	testing.expect(t,a==0 && b==0 && c==0 && len(s.subdivisions)==3,"The first genuine split is followed by direct removal when area limits prevent another")
    	last_id:=s.next_id
    	for _ in 0..<4 { blast_pass(&s,blast,false) }
    	testing.expect(t,s.next_id==last_id && s.revision==1)
    	expect_valid(t,&s)
    }
    
    @(test)
    blast_deletion_bound_is_conservative :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
    	s:=make_wall(42); defer scene_destroy(&s)
    	sub:=s.subdivisions[0]
    	farthest:=vlen(Vec2{1,1})
    	// At equality the ordinary test fails, but the shortcut must decline:
    	// outward distance rounding and its strict 1e-4 load margin are intentional.
    	blast:=Blast{position={0,0},radius=farthest+0.6}
    	testing.expect(t,!blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,6))
    	blast.radius+=0.000001
    	testing.expect(t,!blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,6))
    	blast.radius+=0.01
    	testing.expect(t,blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,6))
    	testing.expect(t,!blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,math.inf_f32(1)))
    	testing.expect(t,!blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,math.nan_f32()))
    	testing.expect(t,!blast_erases_descendants(sub,Blast{position={0,0},radius=math.inf_f32(1)},6))
    	sub.pose.angle=0.7
    	sub.pose.position={8,-3}
    	posed_blast:=Blast{position=posed_point(sub,Vec2{}),radius=blast.radius}
    	testing.expect(t,blast_erases_descendants(sub,posed_blast,6),"The bound uses the posed outline")
    }
    
    same_outline :: proc(a,b: Polygon) -> bool {
    	if len(a.points)!=len(b.points) { return false }
    	for p,i in a.points { if p!=b.points[i] { return false } }
    	return true
    }
    // Allocation IDs intentionally differ when a dead subtree is skipped. Compare
    // the observable graph by exact retained outlines, seeds, motion and membership.
    expect_same_blast_result :: proc(t: ^testing.T, a,b: ^Scene) {
    	expect_valid(t,a); expect_valid(t,b)
    	as,ac,ap:=counts(a); bs,bc,bp:=counts(b)
    	testing.expect(t,as==bs && ac==bc && ap==bp && len(a.remnants)==len(b.remnants))
    	matches:=make(map[u64]u64); defer delete(matches)
    	used:=make(map[u64]bool); defer delete(used)
    	for x in a.subdivisions {
    		if !x.live { continue }
    		found:=false
    		for y in b.subdivisions {
    			if !y.live || used[y.id] || !same_outline(x.outline,y.outline) { continue }
    			matches[x.id]=y.id; used[y.id]=true; found=true
    			testing.expect(t,x.seed==y.seed && x.material==y.material && x.width==y.width && close_vec(x.pose.position,y.pose.position) && close_vec(x.pose.velocity,y.pose.velocity) && close(x.pose.angle,y.pose.angle) && close(x.pose.angular_velocity,y.pose.angular_velocity))
    			left,right:=a.pieces[a.piece_rows[x.owner]],b.pieces[b.piece_rows[y.owner]]
    			testing.expect(t,left.seed==right.seed && len(left.subdivisions)==len(right.subdivisions) && len(left.connections)==len(right.connections))
    			break
    		}
    		testing.expect(t,found,"A retained outline differs between recursive and shortcut evaluation")
    	}
    	for c in a.connections {
    		if !c.live { continue }
    		found:=false
    		for d in b.connections {
    			if d.live && ((d.a==matches[c.a] && d.b==matches[c.b]) || (d.b==matches[c.a] && d.a==matches[c.b])) {
    				found=true
    				testing.expect(t,close_vec(connection_sample(a,c),connection_sample(b,d)))
    				break
    			}
    		}
    		testing.expect(t,found,"A surviving inherited or internal link differs")
    	}
    	for p in a.pieces {
    		if !p.live { continue }
    		owner:=b.subdivisions[b.sub_rows[matches[p.subdivisions[0]]]].owner
    		for id in p.subdivisions { testing.expect(t,b.subdivisions[b.sub_rows[matches[id]]].owner==owner,"Retained memberships differ") }
    	}
    	for remnant,i in a.remnants {
    		if i>=len(b.remnants) { break }
    		testing.expect(t,same_outline(a.subdivisions[a.sub_rows[remnant.subdivision]].outline,b.subdivisions[b.sub_rows[b.remnants[i].subdivision]].outline))
    	}
    }
    
    @(test)
    deletion_shortcut_agrees_with_recursive_blasts :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
    	for pattern in 0..<3 {
    		for whole in 0..<2 {
    			a:=make_wall(42,0.08); defer scene_destroy(&a)
    			b:=make_wall(42,0.08); defer scene_destroy(&b)
    			for s in [2]^Scene{&a,&b} {
    				s.materials[0]=material_preset(pattern)
    				s.materials[0].subdivision_strength=6
    				s.materials[0].connection_strength=4
    				for &sub in s.subdivisions {
    					sub.pose.position=vadd(Vec2{2,-1},vrotate(sub.rest_center,0.7))
    					sub.pose.angle=0.7
    					sub.pose.velocity=vadd(Vec2{1,2},Vec2{-2*sub.pose.position.y,2*sub.pose.position.x})
    					sub.pose.angular_velocity=2
    				}
    			}
    			blast:=Blast{position=vadd(Vec2{2,-1},vrotate(Vec2{-1,0.25},0.7)),radius=3.5}
    			if whole==1 { blast.radius=10 }
    			blast_pass(&a,blast,true); blast_pass(&b,blast,false)
    			testing.expect(t,len(a.subdivisions)<len(b.subdivisions),"The proven deletion must avoid actual generation work")
    			expect_same_blast_result(t,&a,&b)
    			if whole==0 {
    				remaining,_,_:=counts(&a)
    				testing.expect(t,remaining>0)
    				// Future events must also agree: a skipped earlier branch cannot
    				// shift seeds through IDs, piece regrouping or an RNG stream.
    				next:=Blast{position=vadd(Vec2{2,-1},vrotate(Vec2{3.3,-0.2},0.7)),radius=1.7}
    				blast_pass(&a,next,true); blast_pass(&b,next,false)
    				expect_same_blast_result(t,&a,&b)
    			}
    		}
    	}
    }

    new_blast_connections_fail_before_further_inheritance :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
