    vadd :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {a.x+b.x, a.y+b.y} }
    vsub :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y} }
    vmul :: proc(a: Vec2, s: f32) -> Vec2 { return {a.x*s, a.y*s} }
    vdot :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> f32 { return a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y }
    vcross :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> f32 { return a.x*b.y-a.y*b.x }
    vlen :: proc(a: Vec2) -> f32 { return math.sqrt(vdot(a,a)) }
    vrotate :: proc(a: Vec2, angle: f32) -> Vec2 {
        c, s := f32(math.cos(angle)), f32(math.sin(angle))
        return {a.x*c-a.y*s,a.x*s+a.y*c}
    }
    centroid :: proc(p: Polygon) -> Vec2 {
        area, x, y: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            a, b := p.points[i], p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
            cross := vcross(a,b)
            area += cross
            x += (a.x+b.x)*cross
            y += (a.y+b.y)*cross
        }
        if math.abs(area) < 0.00001 {
            for point in p.points { x += point.x; y += point.y }
            return {x/f32(len(p.points)),y/f32(len(p.points))}
        }
        return {x/(3*area),y/(3*area)}
    }
    posed_point :: proc(sub: Subdivision, rest: Vec2) -> Vec2 {
        return vadd(sub.pose.position,vrotate(vsub(rest,sub.rest_center),sub.pose.angle))
    }
    posed_polygon :: proc(sub: Subdivision) -> Polygon {
        result := Polygon{points=make([]Vec2,len(sub.outline.points))}
        for point,i in sub.outline.points { result.points[i]=posed_point(sub,point) }
        return result
    }
    make_polygon :: proc(points: []Vec2) -> Polygon {
        result:=Polygon{points=make([]Vec2,len(points))}
        copy(result.points,points)
        return result
    }
    // Returns the common collinear edge length and its length-weighted midpoint.
    shared_boundary :: proc(a, b: Polygon) -> (f32, Vec2) {
        total: f32
        weighted := Vec2{}
        for i in 0..<len(a.points) {
            p, q := a.points[i], a.points[(i+1)%len(a.points)]
            d := vsub(q,p)
            length := vlen(d)
            if length < 0.00001 { continue }
            unit := vmul(d,1/length)
            for j in 0..<len(b.points) {
                r, s := b.points[j], b.points[(j+1)%len(b.points)]
                if math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(r,p))) > 0.0001*length || math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(s,p))) > 0.0001*length { continue }
                t0, t1 := vdot(vsub(r,p),unit), vdot(vsub(s,p),unit)
                lo := max(f32(0),min(t0,t1))
                hi := min(length,max(t0,t1))
                if hi-lo > 0.0001 {
                    span := hi-lo
                    total += span
                    weighted = vadd(weighted,vmul(vadd(p,vmul(unit,(lo+hi)*0.5)),span))
                }
            }
        }
        if total == 0 { return 0, {} }
        return total,vmul(weighted,1/total)
    }
    new_id :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> u64 { s.next_id += 1; return s.next_id }
    new_scene :: proc(minimum_width: f32) -> Scene {
        return Scene{sub_rows=make(map[u64]int),conn_rows=make(map[u64]int),piece_rows=make(map[u64]int),minimum_width=minimum_width}
    }
    add_material :: proc(s: ^Scene, m: Material) -> int { append(&s.materials,m); return len(s.materials)-1 }
    add_piece :: proc(s: ^Scene, material: int, seed: u8) -> u64 {
        id := new_id(s)
        s.piece_rows[id] = len(s.pieces)
        append(&s.pieces,Piece{id=id,material=material,seed=seed,live=true})
        return id
    }
    add_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene, owner: u64, outline: Polygon, pose: Pose) -> u64 {
        id := new_id(s)
        piece := s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]]
        retain_subdivision(s,Subdivision{id=id,owner=owner,material=piece.material,seed=piece.seed,outline=outline,pose=pose,live=true})
        return id
    }
    // Outlines use ranges in one append-only undeformed vertex pool. The outline
    // slice is a derived read view, refreshed whenever appending can move the pool.
    // Callers may release their source polygon immediately after this call.
    retain_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene,source: Subdivision) {
        sub:=source
        points:=make_polygon(source.outline.points)
        defer delete(points.points)
        sub.rest_center=centroid(points)
        sub.width=outline_width(points.points)
        sub.outline_start=len(s.vertices); sub.outline_count=len(points.points)
        for point in points.points { append(&s.vertices,point) }
        for i in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            existing:=&s.subdivisions[i]
            existing.outline.points=s.vertices[existing.outline_start:existing.outline_start+existing.outline_count]
        }
        sub.outline.points=s.vertices[sub.outline_start:sub.outline_start+sub.outline_count]
        s.sub_rows[sub.id]=len(s.subdivisions)
        append(&s.subdivisions,sub)
    }
    add_connection :: proc(s: ^Scene, a, b: u64) -> u64 {
        if a == b { return 0 }
        for c in s.connections { if c.live && ((c.a == a && c.b == b) || (c.a == b && c.b == a)) { return c.id } }
        sa, sb := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[b]]
        length, point := shared_boundary(sa.outline,sb.outline)
        if length <= 0 { return 0 }
        id := new_id(s)
        s.conn_rows[id] = len(s.connections)
        append(&s.connections,Connection{id=id,a=a,b=b,rest_point=point,local_a=vsub(point,sa.rest_center),local_b=vsub(point,sb.rest_center),live=true})
        return id
    }
    connection_sample :: proc(s: ^Scene, c: Connection) -> Vec2 {
        a,b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
        return vmul(vadd(vadd(a.pose.position,vrotate(c.local_a,a.pose.angle)),vadd(b.pose.position,vrotate(c.local_b,b.pose.angle))),0.5)
    }
    subdivision_sample :: proc(sub: Subdivision) -> Vec2 { return sub.pose.position }
    contains_id :: proc(ids: []u64,id: u64) -> bool { for x in ids { if x == id { return true } }; return false }
    sort_ids :: proc(ids: []u64) {
        for i in 1..<len(ids) {
            j := i
            for j > 0 && ids[j] < ids[j-1] { ids[j],ids[j-1] = ids[j-1],ids[j]; j -= 1 }
        }
    }
    sorted_ids :: proc(ids: []u64) -> [dynamic]u64 {
        result: [dynamic]u64
        for id in ids { if !contains_id(result[:],id) { append(&result,id) } }
        sort_ids(result[:])
        return result
    }
    derive_seed :: proc(seed: u8, identity: u64) -> u8 {
        if seed == 0 { return 0 }
        x := identity ~ (u64(seed)*0x9e3779b97f4a7c15)
        x ~= x >> 30; x *= 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9
        x ~= x >> 27; x *= 0x94d049bb133111eb
        x ~= x >> 31
        return u8(x%255+1)
    }
    piece_width :: proc(s: ^Scene, ids: []u64) -> f32 {
        if len(ids) == 0 { return 0 }
        points: [dynamic]Vec2
        defer delete(points)
        for id in ids { for point in s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].outline.points { append(&points,point) } }
        return outline_width(points[:])
    }
    outline_width :: proc(points: []Vec2) -> f32 {
        hull:=convex_hull(points)
        defer delete(hull)
        if len(hull)<3 { return 0 }
        width := f32(1e30)
        for i in 0..<len(hull) {
            edge:=vsub(hull[(i+1)%len(hull)],hull[i]); length:=vlen(edge)
            if length<0.00001 { continue }
            normal:=Vec2{-edge.y/length,edge.x/length}
            lo,hi:=f32(1e30),f32(-1e30)
            for point in hull { projection:=vdot(point,normal); lo=min(lo,projection); hi=max(hi,projection) }
            width=min(width,hi-lo)
        }
        return width
    }
    rebuild_piece :: proc(s: ^Scene, old_id: u64) {
        old_row, ok := s.piece_rows[old_id]
        if !ok || !s.pieces[old_row].live { return }
        material := s.pieces[old_row].material
        groups: [dynamic][dynamic]u64
        visited := make(map[u64]bool)
        adjacency:=make(map[u64][dynamic]u64)
        defer delete(visited)
        defer { for _,neighbors in adjacency { delete(neighbors) }; delete(adjacency) }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            a,b:=s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            if !a.live || !b.live || a.owner!=old_id || b.owner!=old_id { continue }
            left,right:=adjacency[c.a],adjacency[c.b]
            append(&left,c.b); append(&right,c.a)
            adjacency[c.a]=left; adjacency[c.b]=right
        }
        defer {
            for group in groups { delete(group) }
            delete(groups)
        }
        // Find the lowest unvisited ID each time, independent of storage order.
        for {
            start := u64(0)
            for sub in s.subdivisions {
                if sub.live && sub.owner == old_id && !visited[sub.id] && (start == 0 || sub.id < start) { start = sub.id }
            }
            if start == 0 { break }
            group: [dynamic]u64
            queue := [dynamic]u64{start}
            visited[start] = true
            for head := 0; head < len(queue); head += 1 {
                id := queue[head]
                append(&group,id)
                neighbors:=adjacency[id]
                for other in neighbors {
                    if !visited[other] {
                        visited[other] = true; append(&queue,other)
                    }
                }
            }
            delete(queue)
            sort_ids(group[:])
            append(&groups,group)
        }
        s.pieces[old_row].live = false
        for group in groups {
            if piece_width(s,group[:]) < s.minimum_width {
                for id in group {
                    row := s.sub_rows[id]
                    append(&s.remnants,Remnant{subdivision=id,pose=s.subdivisions[row].pose})
                    s.subdivisions[row].live = false
                }
                continue
            }
            // Subdivision contexts belong to their geometry, never allocation-order
            // IDs or a later ownership change. Keep a representative piece context.
            seed: u8
            for id in group { if child_seed := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].seed; child_seed != 0 { seed=child_seed; break } }
            new_owner := add_piece(s,material,seed)
            for id in group {
                s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].owner = new_owner
                append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[new_owner]].subdivisions,id)
            }
            for c in s.connections {
                if c.live && contains_id(group[:],c.a) && contains_id(group[:],c.b) { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[new_owner]].connections,c.id) }
            }
            sort_ids(s.pieces[s.piece_rows[new_owner]].connections[:])
        }
        for i in 0..<len(s.connections) {
            c := &s.connections[i]
            if c.live && (!s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].live || !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].live) { c.live = false }
        }
    }
    
    make_wall :: proc(seed: u8 = 0, minimum_width: f32 = 0) -> Scene {
        s := new_scene(minimum_width)
        m := add_material(&s,Material{name="brick",subdivision_strength=6,connection_strength=4,flexibility=0.25,generation_count=2,aspect_ratio=1.5})
        p := add_piece(&s,m,seed)
        ids: [3]u64
        for i in 0..<3 {
            x := f32(i)
            poly := make_polygon([]Vec2{{x,0},{x+1,0},{x+1,1},{x,1}})
            center := centroid(poly)
            ids[i] = add_subdivision(&s,p,poly,Pose{position=center})
            delete(poly.points)
        }
        add_connection(&s,ids[0],ids[1]); add_connection(&s,ids[1],ids[2])
        for id in ids { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[p]].subdivisions,id) }
        for c in s.connections { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[p]].connections,c.id) }
        return s
    }
    
    scene_destroy :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        physics_destroy(s)
        delete(s.vertices)
        for p in s.pieces { delete(p.subdivisions); delete(p.connections) }
        delete(s.subdivisions); delete(s.connections); delete(s.pieces)
        delete(s.materials); delete(s.remnants)
        for name in s.owned_names { delete(name) }
        delete(s.owned_names)
        delete(s.sub_rows); delete(s.conn_rows); delete(s.piece_rows)
        s^ = {}
    }

    Sandbox_Settings :: struct {
        blast_radius: f32,
        blast_mode: Blast_Mode,

        fragment_strength, connection_strength, flexibility: f32,
        generate_children: bool,
        seed: u8,
    }
    DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS :: Sandbox_Settings{blast_radius=4.2,fragment_strength=30,connection_strength=24,flexibility=0.15,generate_children=true,seed=42}
    sandbox_material :: proc(settings: Sandbox_Settings) -> Material {
        material:=material_preset(settings.pattern)
        material.subdivision_strength=settings.fragment_strength
        material.connection_strength=settings.connection_strength
        material.flexibility=settings.flexibility
        return material
    }
    Sandbox :: struct {
        scene: Scene,
        floor: b2.BodyId,
        player: Player,
        bomb_rain: Bomb_Rain,
        applied,draft: Sandbox_Settings,
        previous: map[u64]Pose,
        previous_player: Vec2,
        panel_open,inspection,tuning_open,surface,joints: bool,
        block_jump,block_blast,jump_queued: bool,
        selected: u64,
        accumulator: f32,
        status: string,
        status_time: f32,
    }
    sandbox_create :: proc(settings: Sandbox_Settings = DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS) -> Sandbox {
        game:=Sandbox{applied=settings,draft=settings,previous=make(map[u64]Pose),surface=true,joints=true}
        sandbox_reset(&game)
        return game
    }
    sandbox_destroy :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        scene_destroy(&game.scene)
        delete(game.bomb_rain.bombs); delete(game.bomb_rain.bursts)
        delete(game.previous)
        game^={}
    }
    sandbox_notice :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,text: string) { game.status=text; game.status_time=2.5 }
    sandbox_clear_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        game.accumulator=0
        game.jump_queued=false
        game.block_jump=true
        game.block_blast=true
        player_clear_input(&game.player)
        clear(&game.previous)
        game.previous_player=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
    }
    sandbox_reset :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        revision:=game.scene.revision+1
        scene_destroy(&game.scene)
        s:=&game.scene
        s^=new_scene(0.10)
        s.revision=revision
        material:=add_material(s,sandbox_material(game.applied))
        seed:=game.applied.seed
        if !game.applied.generate_children { seed=0 }
        owner:=add_piece(s,material,seed)
        // A stepped stack, with one common reference frame and real shared edges.
        for row in 0..<3 {
            for column in 0..<4-row {
                x,y:=f32(1.5)+f32(column)*0.85,f32(row)*0.85+0.005
                points:=[4]Vec2{{x,y},{x+0.85,y},{x+0.85,y+0.85},{x,y+0.85}}
                outline:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
                id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline)})
                append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
            }
        }
        for a in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            for b in a+1..<len(s.subdivisions) { add_connection(s,s.subdivisions[a].id,s.subdivisions[b].id) }
        }
        for connection in s.connections { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].connections,connection.id) }
        physics_init(s,{0,-9.8})
        def:=b2.DefaultBodyDef()
        def.position={0.5,-0.3}
        game.floor=b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
        shape:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); shape.material.friction=0.65
        _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(game.floor,shape,b2.MakeBox(8.5,0.3))
        game.player=player_create(s.physics.world)
        bomb_rain_reset(&game.bomb_rain,game.applied.seed)
        game.selected=0
        sandbox_clear_input(game)
        sandbox_notice(game,"Yard reset")
    }
    sandbox_set_panel :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,open: bool) {
        game.panel_open=open
        if open { game.draft=game.applied }
        sandbox_clear_input(game)
    }
    sandbox_set_radius :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,radius: f32) {
        game.applied.blast_radius=clamp(radius,f32(0.5),f32(6))
        game.draft.blast_radius=game.applied.blast_radius
    }
    sandbox_apply_settings :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        game.applied=game.draft
        sandbox_reset(game)
        game.panel_open=false
        sandbox_notice(game,"Settings applied")
    }
    // Inclusive edges are solid too. Use the logical posed outline, not the cosmetic mesh.
    point_in_subdivision :: proc(sub: Subdivision,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        local:=vadd(sub.rest_center,vrotate(vsub(point,sub.pose.position),-sub.pose.angle))
        inside:=false
        for a,i in sub.outline.points {
            b:=sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)]
            edge:=vsub(b,a); relative:=vsub(local,a)
            if math.abs(vcross(edge,relative))<0.00001 && vdot(relative,edge)>=0 && vdot(relative,edge)<=vdot(edge,edge) { return true }
            if (a.y>local.y)!=(b.y>local.y) && local.x<(b.x-a.x)*(local.y-a.y)/(b.y-a.y)+a.x { inside=!inside }
        }
        return inside
    }
    sandbox_valid_aim :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live && point_in_subdivision(sub,point) { return false } }
        return true
    }
    sandbox_blast :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        if game.panel_open || game.applied.blast_mode!=.Manual { return false }
        if !sandbox_valid_aim(&game.scene,point) { sandbox_notice(game,"Aim outside the solid shape"); return false }
        sandbox_explode(game,point)
        return true
    }
    sandbox_explode :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2) {
        blast_pass(&game.scene,Blast{position=point,radius=game.applied.blast_radius})
        clear(&game.previous)
    }
    
    // Input routing is independent of raylib, so menu consumption has a direct regression check.
    Sandbox_Input :: struct {
        move: f32,
        jump_pressed,jump_down,blast_pressed,blast_down: bool,
        menu_pressed,reset_pressed,inspection_pressed: bool,
        wheel: f32,
    }
    sandbox_route_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,raw: Sandbox_Input,over_ui: bool) -> Sandbox_Input {
        if raw.inspection_pressed { game.inspection=!game.inspection }
        if raw.menu_pressed {
            sandbox_set_panel(game,!game.panel_open)
            game.block_jump=raw.jump_down
            game.block_blast=raw.blast_down
            return {}
        }
        if !raw.jump_down { game.block_jump=false }
        if !raw.blast_down { game.block_blast=false }
        if game.panel_open { return {} }
        if raw.reset_pressed {
            sandbox_reset(game)
            game.block_jump=raw.jump_down
            game.block_blast=raw.blast_down
            return {}
        }
        result:=raw
        result.jump_pressed=raw.jump_pressed && !game.block_jump
        result.blast_pressed=raw.blast_pressed && !game.block_blast && !over_ui && game.applied.blast_mode==.Manual
        if over_ui { result.wheel=0 }
        if result.wheel!=0 { sandbox_set_radius(game,game.applied.blast_radius+result.wheel*0.2) }
        return result
    }
    sandbox_tick :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,move: f32,jump: bool,dt: f32 = 1.0/60.0) {
        clear(&game.previous)
        for sub in game.scene.subdivisions { if sub.live { game.previous[sub.id]=sub.pose } }
        game.previous_player=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
        bomb_rain_before_step(game,dt)
        player_before_step(&game.player,move,jump,dt)
        physics_tick(&game.scene,dt)
        bomb_rain_after_step(game,dt)
        if player_after_step(&game.player) {
            game.previous_player=PLAYER_SPAWN
            sandbox_notice(game,"Back at spawn")
        }
    }
    sandbox_advance :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,dt: f32,input: Sandbox_Input) {
        if game.panel_open { game.accumulator=0; game.jump_queued=false; return }
        if input.jump_pressed { game.jump_queued=true }
        game.status_time=max(f32(0),game.status_time-dt)
        game.accumulator+=clamp(dt,f32(0),f32(0.1))
        for game.accumulator>=1.0/60.0 {
            sandbox_tick(game,input.move,game.jump_queued)
            game.jump_queued=false
            game.accumulator-=1.0/60.0
        }
    }

    // Merge adjacent triangles whenever their union is convex. In particular this
    // avoids feeding thin ears from a displaced boundary to Box2D as tiny fixtures.
    convex_decomposition :: proc(outline: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
        parts:=triangulate_polygon(outline)
        for {
            merged:=false
            for i in 0..<len(parts) {
                for j in i+1..<len(parts) {
                    if length,_:=shared_boundary(parts[i],parts[j]); length<=0 { continue }
                    points: [dynamic]Vec2
                    for point in parts[i].points { append(&points,point) }
                    for point in parts[j].points { append(&points,point) }
                    hull:=convex_hull(points[:]); delete(points)
                    combined:=make_polygon(hull[:]); delete(hull)
                    error:=math.abs(polygon_area(combined)-polygon_area(parts[i])-polygon_area(parts[j]))
                    if len(combined.points)<=8 && error<0.000001 {
                        delete(parts[i].points); delete(parts[j].points)
                        parts[i]=combined; ordered_remove(&parts,j); merged=true; break
                    }
                    delete(combined.points)
                }
                if merged { break }
            }
            if !merged { break }
        }
        return parts
    }

    View :: struct { offset: Vec2, scale: f32 }
    screen_point :: proc(view: View,point: Vec2) -> rl.Vector2 { return {view.offset.x+point.x*view.scale,view.offset.y-point.y*view.scale} }
    world_point :: proc(view: View,point: rl.Vector2) -> Vec2 { return {(point.x-view.offset.x)/view.scale,(view.offset.y-point.y)/view.scale} }
    piece_color :: proc(id: u64,alpha: u8 = 255) -> rl.Color {
        colors := [6]rl.Color{{64,173,165,255},{97,142,206,255},{194,134,204,255},{212,161,88,255},{139,178,113,255},{211,116,125,255}}
        c:=colors[id%6]; c.a=alpha; return c
    }
    render_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene,sub: Subdivision,poses: map[u64]Pose) -> Subdivision {
        result:=sub
        if pose,ok:=poses[sub.id]; ok { result.pose=pose }
        return result
    }
    point_on_boundary :: proc(point: Vec2,a,b: Polygon) -> bool {
        for i in 0..<len(a.points) {
            for j in 0..<len(b.points) {
                if segment,ok:=segment_overlap(Segment{a.points[i],a.points[(i+1)%len(a.points)]},Segment{b.points[j],b.points[(j+1)%len(b.points)]}); ok {
                    d:=vsub(segment.b,segment.a); length:=vlen(d)
                    projection:=vdot(vsub(point,segment.a),d)/(length*length)
                    if projection >= -0.0001 && projection <= 1.0001 && math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(point,segment.a))) < 0.0001*length { return true }
                }
            }
        }
        return false
    }
    // Only presentation vertices are blended. Stored outlines and fixtures stay exact.
    cosmetic_point :: proc(s: ^Scene,sub: Subdivision,rest: Vec2,poses: map[u64]Pose) -> Vec2 {
        self:=render_subdivision(s,sub,poses)
        point:=posed_point(self,rest)
        flex:=clamp(s.materials[sub.material].flexibility,f32(0),f32(1))
        if flex==0 { return point }
        weighted:=point
        count:=f32(1)
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            other_id:=u64(0)
            if c.a==sub.id { other_id=c.b } else if c.b==sub.id { other_id=c.a }
            if other_id==0 { continue }
            other:=render_subdivision(s,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[other_id]],poses)
            if point_on_boundary(rest,sub.outline,other.outline) { weighted=vadd(weighted,posed_point(other,rest)); count+=1 }
        }
        return vadd(point,vmul(vsub(vmul(weighted,1/count),point),flex))
    }
    draw_polygon :: proc(view: View,outline: Polygon,color: rl.Color,stroke: rl.Color) {
        triangles:=triangulate_polygon(outline)
        for triangle in triangles {
            a,b,c:=screen_point(view,triangle.points[0]),screen_point(view,triangle.points[1]),screen_point(view,triangle.points[2])
            // Raylib's triangle winding uses the screen's downward Y axis.
            cross:=vcross(vsub(triangle.points[1],triangle.points[0]),vsub(triangle.points[2],triangle.points[0]))
            if cross > 0 { rl.DrawTriangle(a,b,c,color) } else { rl.DrawTriangle(c,b,a,color) }
            delete(triangle.points)
        }
        delete(triangles)
        for i in 0..<len(outline.points) { rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,outline.points[i]),screen_point(view,outline.points[(i+1)%len(outline.points)]),2,stroke) }
    }
    pick_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2) -> u64 {
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            points: [dynamic]rl.Vector2
            for rest in sub.outline.points { p:=posed_point(sub,rest); append(&points,rl.Vector2{p.x,p.y}) }
            hit:=rl.CheckCollisionPointPoly({point.x,point.y},raw_data(points),i32(len(points)))
            delete(points)
            if hit { return sub.id }
        }
        return 0
    }
    pick_connection :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2,max_distance: f32) -> u64 {
        best:=u64(0); distance:=max_distance
        for c in s.connections { if c.live { d:=vlen(vsub(point,connection_sample(s,c))); if d<distance { distance=d; best=c.id } } }
        return best
    }
    material_preset :: proc(index: int) -> Material {
        switch index {
        case 1: return Material{name="splinter",subdivision_strength=7,connection_strength=6,flexibility=0.6,generation_count=5,aspect_ratio=0.2}
        case 2: return Material{name="shatter",subdivision_strength=5,connection_strength=4,flexibility=0.05,generation_count=6,aspect_ratio=1,triangulate=true}
        }
        return Material{name="chunk",subdivision_strength=6,connection_strength=4,flexibility=0.25,generation_count=3,aspect_ratio=1}
    }
    reset_demo :: proc(s: ^Scene,preset: int,terminal: bool) {
        scene_destroy(s)
        seed:=u8(42); if terminal { seed=0 }
        s^=make_wall(seed,0.08)
        s.materials[0]=material_preset(preset)
        physics_init(s)
    }
    add_projectile :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        material:=add_material(s,Material{name="projectile",subdivision_strength=math.inf_f32(1),connection_strength=math.inf_f32(1),generation_count=2,aspect_ratio=1})
        owner:=add_piece(s,material,0)
        points:=[4]Vec2{{-1.2,0.3},{-0.8,0.3},{-0.8,0.7},{-1.2,0.7}}
        outline:=make_polygon(points[:]); defer delete(outline.points)
        id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline),velocity={8,0}})
        append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        b2.Body_SetBullet(s.physics.bodies[id],true)
        s.revision+=1
    }
    draw_scene :: proc(s: ^Scene,view: View,poses: map[u64]Pose,selected: u64,surface,joints: bool,ids: bool = true) {
        for i in -20..=20 {
            tint:=rl.Color{31,44,62,255}
            if i==0 { tint={45,65,85,255} }
            rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,Vec2{f32(i),-20}),screen_point(view,Vec2{f32(i),20}),1,tint)
            rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,Vec2{-20,f32(i)}),screen_point(view,Vec2{20,f32(i)}),1,tint)
        }
        for remnant in s.remnants {
            sub:=s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[remnant.subdivision]]; sub.pose=remnant.pose
            outline:=posed_polygon(sub)
            draw_polygon(view,outline,rl.Color{140,152,170,u8(160*(1-remnant.age))},rl.Color{140,152,170,u8(160*(1-remnant.age))})
            delete(outline.points)
        }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            outline:=Polygon{points=make([]Vec2,len(sub.outline.points))}
            posed:=render_subdivision(s,sub,poses)
            for rest,i in sub.outline.points {
                point:=posed_point(posed,rest)
                if surface { point=cosmetic_point(s,sub,rest,poses) }
                outline.points[i]=point
            }
            stroke:=rl.Color{202,220,231,255}
            if sub.id==selected { stroke={255,255,255,255} }
            draw_polygon(view,outline,piece_color(sub.owner,210),stroke)
            delete(outline.points)
            center:=screen_point(view,posed.pose.position)
            if ids { rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%d",sub.id),i32(center.x)-5,i32(center.y)-23,16,rl.Color{16,29,40,255}) }
        }
        if joints {
            for c in s.connections {
                if !c.live { continue }
                a,b:=render_subdivision(s,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],poses),render_subdivision(s,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]],poses)
                anchor:=vmul(vadd(posed_point(a,c.rest_point),posed_point(b,c.rest_point)),0.5)
                color:=rl.Color{248,205,109,255}
                rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,a.pose.position),screen_point(view,b.pose.position),2,color)
                rl.DrawCircleV(screen_point(view,anchor),5,color)
                p:=screen_point(view,anchor)
                rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("c%d",c.id),i32(p.x)+7,i32(p.y)+7,14,color)
            }
        }
    }
    run_debug_view :: proc(smoke: bool,serve: bool = false) {
        server:=Snapshot_Server{}
        if serve { server=snapshot_server_start() }
        defer snapshot_server_destroy(&server)
        rl.SetTraceLogLevel(.WARNING)
        flags:=rl.ConfigFlags{.MSAA_4X_HINT,.WINDOW_RESIZABLE,.WINDOW_HIGHDPI}
        if smoke { flags+={.WINDOW_HIDDEN} }
        rl.SetConfigFlags(flags)
        rl.InitWindow(1280,800,"Destruction lab | Odin + Box2D")
        defer rl.CloseWindow()
        smoke_target:=rl.RenderTexture2D{}
        if smoke { smoke_target=rl.LoadRenderTexture(rl.GetScreenWidth(),rl.GetScreenHeight()) }

    Vec2 :: struct { x, y: f32 }
    Polygon :: struct { points: []Vec2 }
    Pose :: struct { position: Vec2, angle: f32, velocity: Vec2, angular_velocity: f32 }
    Material :: struct {
        name: string,
        subdivision_strength, connection_strength: f32,
        flexibility: f32,
        generation_count: int,
        aspect_ratio: f32,
        triangulate: bool,
    }
    Subdivision :: struct {
        id, owner: u64,
        material: int,
        seed: u8,
        outline: Polygon,
        outline_start,outline_count: int `json:"-"`,
        width: f32 `json:"-"`,

        live: bool,
    }
    Connection :: struct {

        rest_point, local_a, local_b: Vec2,
        live: bool,
    }

        id: u64,
        material: int,
        seed: u8,

        live: bool,
    }
    Remnant :: struct { subdivision: u64, pose: Pose, age: f32 }
    Scene :: struct {
        physics: Physics,
        materials: [dynamic]Material,
        owned_names: [dynamic]string,
        subdivisions: [dynamic]Subdivision,
        vertices: [dynamic]Vec2,
        connections: [dynamic]Connection,
        pieces: [dynamic]Piece,
        remnants: [dynamic]Remnant,
        sub_rows, conn_rows, piece_rows: map[u64]int,
        next_id: u64,
        revision: u64,
        minimum_width: f32,
    }
    Blast :: struct { position: Vec2, radius: f32 }
    Failures :: struct { subdivisions, connections, discard_subdivisions: [dynamic]u64 }
    
    vadd :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {a.x+b.x, a.y+b.y} }
    vsub :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y} }
    vmul :: proc(a: Vec2, s: f32) -> Vec2 { return {a.x*s, a.y*s} }
    vdot :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> f32 { return a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y }
    vcross :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> f32 { return a.x*b.y-a.y*b.x }
    vlen :: proc(a: Vec2) -> f32 { return math.sqrt(vdot(a,a)) }
    vrotate :: proc(a: Vec2, angle: f32) -> Vec2 {
        c, s := f32(math.cos(angle)), f32(math.sin(angle))
        return {a.x*c-a.y*s,a.x*s+a.y*c}
    }
    centroid :: proc(p: Polygon) -> Vec2 {
        area, x, y: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            a, b := p.points[i], p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
            cross := vcross(a,b)
            area += cross
            x += (a.x+b.x)*cross
            y += (a.y+b.y)*cross
        }
        if math.abs(area) < 0.00001 {
            for point in p.points { x += point.x; y += point.y }
            return {x/f32(len(p.points)),y/f32(len(p.points))}
        }
        return {x/(3*area),y/(3*area)}
    }
    posed_point :: proc(sub: Subdivision, rest: Vec2) -> Vec2 {
        return vadd(sub.pose.position,vrotate(vsub(rest,sub.rest_center),sub.pose.angle))
    }
    posed_polygon :: proc(sub: Subdivision) -> Polygon {
        result := Polygon{points=make([]Vec2,len(sub.outline.points))}
        for point,i in sub.outline.points { result.points[i]=posed_point(sub,point) }
        return result
    }
    make_polygon :: proc(points: []Vec2) -> Polygon {
        result:=Polygon{points=make([]Vec2,len(points))}
        copy(result.points,points)
        return result
    }
    // Returns the common collinear edge length and its length-weighted midpoint.
    shared_boundary :: proc(a, b: Polygon) -> (f32, Vec2) {
        total: f32
        weighted := Vec2{}
        for i in 0..<len(a.points) {
            p, q := a.points[i], a.points[(i+1)%len(a.points)]
            d := vsub(q,p)
            length := vlen(d)
            if length < 0.00001 { continue }
            unit := vmul(d,1/length)
            for j in 0..<len(b.points) {
                r, s := b.points[j], b.points[(j+1)%len(b.points)]
                if math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(r,p))) > 0.0001*length || math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(s,p))) > 0.0001*length { continue }
                t0, t1 := vdot(vsub(r,p),unit), vdot(vsub(s,p),unit)
                lo := max(f32(0),min(t0,t1))
                hi := min(length,max(t0,t1))
                if hi-lo > 0.0001 {
                    span := hi-lo
                    total += span
                    weighted = vadd(weighted,vmul(vadd(p,vmul(unit,(lo+hi)*0.5)),span))
                }
            }
        }
        if total == 0 { return 0, {} }
        return total,vmul(weighted,1/total)
    }
    new_id :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> u64 { s.next_id += 1; return s.next_id }
    new_scene :: proc(minimum_width: f32) -> Scene {
        return Scene{sub_rows=make(map[u64]int),conn_rows=make(map[u64]int),piece_rows=make(map[u64]int),minimum_width=minimum_width}
    }
    add_material :: proc(s: ^Scene, m: Material) -> int { append(&s.materials,m); return len(s.materials)-1 }
    add_piece :: proc(s: ^Scene, material: int, seed: u8) -> u64 {
        id := new_id(s)
        s.piece_rows[id] = len(s.pieces)
        append(&s.pieces,Piece{id=id,material=material,seed=seed,live=true})
        return id
    }
    add_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene, owner: u64, outline: Polygon, pose: Pose) -> u64 {
        id := new_id(s)
        piece := s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]]
        retain_subdivision(s,Subdivision{id=id,owner=owner,material=piece.material,seed=piece.seed,outline=outline,pose=pose,live=true})
        return id
    }
    // Outlines use ranges in one append-only undeformed vertex pool. The outline
    // slice is a derived read view, refreshed whenever appending can move the pool.
    // Callers may release their source polygon immediately after this call.
    retain_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene,source: Subdivision) {
        sub:=source
        points:=make_polygon(source.outline.points)
        defer delete(points.points)
        sub.rest_center=centroid(points)
        sub.width=outline_width(points.points)
        sub.outline_start=len(s.vertices); sub.outline_count=len(points.points)
        for point in points.points { append(&s.vertices,point) }
        for i in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            existing:=&s.subdivisions[i]
            existing.outline.points=s.vertices[existing.outline_start:existing.outline_start+existing.outline_count]
        }

    unpartitionable_attached_subdivision_is_removed :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        cases:=[4]struct { width,height: f32, count: int, triangular: bool }{
            {0.005,0.01,2,false}, // Below the minimum split area.
            {0.015,0.01,2,false}, // Both cut children would be too small.
            {0.01,0.01,2,true},   // Triangulation yields the same single triangle.
            {0.5,1,1,false},      // A recipe requesting only one region.
        }
        for fixture in cases {
            s:=new_scene(0.1); defer scene_destroy(&s)
            m:=add_material(&s,Material{name="small attached",subdivision_strength=6,connection_strength=math.inf_f32(1),generation_count=fixture.count,aspect_ratio=1,triangulate=fixture.triangular})
            owner:=add_piece(&s,m,42)
            w,h:=fixture.width,fixture.height
            small:=make_polygon([]Vec2{{0,0},{w,0},{w,h},{0,h}})
            if fixture.triangular { delete(small.points); small=make_polygon([]Vec2{{0,0},{w,0},{w,h}}) }
            defer delete(small.points)
            large:=make_polygon([]Vec2{{w,0},{w+1,0},{w+1,1},{w,1}}); defer delete(large.points)
            small_id:=add_subdivision(&s,owner,small,Pose{position=centroid(small)})
            large_id:=add_subdivision(&s,owner,large,Pose{position=centroid(large)})
            append(&s.pieces[0].subdivisions,small_id,large_id)
            connection:=add_connection(&s,small_id,large_id)
            append(&s.pieces[0].connections,connection)
            testing.expect(t,connection!=0 && piece_width(&s,s.pieces[0].subdivisions[:])>=s.minimum_width)
            physics_init(&s)
            large_body:=s.physics.bodies[large_id]
            vertex_count:=len(s.vertices)
            last_id:=s.next_id
            for pass in 0..<4 {
                // Re-select any replacement of the small region on each overload pass.
                f:=Failures{}
                for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live && sub.id!=large_id { append(&f.subdivisions,sub.id) } }
                apply_failures(&s,f); free_failures(&f); physics_sync_structure(&s)
                subs,conns,pieces:=counts(&s)
                testing.expect(t,subs==1 && conns==0 && pieces==1)
                testing.expect(t,len(s.subdivisions)==2 && len(s.vertices)==vertex_count && len(s.physics.bodies)==1)
                testing.expect(t,s.physics.bodies[large_id]==large_body)
                if pass>0 { testing.expect(t,s.next_id==last_id) }
                last_id=s.next_id
                expect_valid(t,&s)
            }
        }
    }

        for polygon in preview {
            width:=outline_width(polygon.points)
            lo=min(lo,width); hi=max(hi,width)
            delete(polygon.points)
        }
        delete(preview)
        testing.expect(t,hi>lo && hi<parent.width)
        r.minimum_width=(lo+hi)*0.5
        g:=failure_for(parent.id); defer free_failures(&g)
        apply_failures(&r,g)
        guarded:=u64(0)
        for i in 3..<len(r.subdivisions) {
            child:=r.subdivisions[i]
            testing.expect(t,child.live && child.seed!=0,"A mixed batch retains child context, including its small members")
            if child.width<=r.minimum_width { guarded=child.id }
        }
        testing.expect(t,guarded!=0)
        if guarded==0 { return }
        before:=len(r.subdivisions)
        h:=failure_for(guarded); defer free_failures(&h)
        apply_failures(&r,h)
        testing.expect(t,len(r.subdivisions)==before && !r.subdivisions[r.sub_rows[guarded]].live,"The individual width guard still stops small mixed-batch children")
        expect_valid(t,&r)
    }
    
    @(test)
    recursive_failure_terminates_without_a_width_cutoff :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        s:=new_scene(0); defer scene_destroy(&s)
        m:=add_material(&s,Material{name="tiny",subdivision_strength=1,connection_strength=1,generation_count=4,aspect_ratio=1})
        p:=add_piece(&s,m,42)

        outline:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
        id:=add_subdivision(&s,p,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline)})
        append(&s.pieces[0].subdivisions,id)

        blast_pass(&s,blast,false)
        a,b,c:=counts(&s)
        testing.expect(t,a==0 && b==0 && c==0 && len(s.subdivisions)==3,"The first genuine split is followed by direct removal when area limits prevent another")
        last_id:=s.next_id
        for _ in 0..<4 { blast_pass(&s,blast,false) }
        testing.expect(t,s.next_id==last_id && s.revision==1)
        expect_valid(t,&s)

    @(test)
    blast_deletion_bound_is_conservative :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        s:=make_wall(42); defer scene_destroy(&s)
        sub:=s.subdivisions[0]
        farthest:=vlen(Vec2{1,1})
        // At equality the ordinary test fails, but the shortcut must decline:
        // outward distance rounding and its strict 1e-4 load margin are intentional.
        blast:=Blast{position={0,0},radius=farthest+0.6}
        testing.expect(t,!blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,6))
        blast.radius+=0.000001
        testing.expect(t,!blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,6))
        blast.radius+=0.01
        testing.expect(t,blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,6))
        testing.expect(t,!blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,math.inf_f32(1)))
        testing.expect(t,!blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,math.nan_f32()))
        testing.expect(t,!blast_erases_descendants(sub,Blast{position={0,0},radius=math.inf_f32(1)},6))
        sub.pose.angle=0.7
        sub.pose.position={8,-3}
        posed_blast:=Blast{position=posed_point(sub,Vec2{}),radius=blast.radius}
        testing.expect(t,blast_erases_descendants(sub,posed_blast,6),"The bound uses the posed outline")
    }
    
    same_outline :: proc(a,b: Polygon) -> bool {
        if len(a.points)!=len(b.points) { return false }
        for p,i in a.points { if p!=b.points[i] { return false } }
        return true
    }
    // Allocation IDs intentionally differ when a dead subtree is skipped. Compare
    // the observable graph by exact retained outlines, seeds, motion and membership.
    expect_same_blast_result :: proc(t: ^testing.T, a,b: ^Scene) {
        expect_valid(t,a); expect_valid(t,b)
        as,ac,ap:=counts(a); bs,bc,bp:=counts(b)
        testing.expect(t,as==bs && ac==bc && ap==bp && len(a.remnants)==len(b.remnants))
        matches:=make(map[u64]u64); defer delete(matches)
        used:=make(map[u64]bool); defer delete(used)
        for x in a.subdivisions {
            if !x.live { continue }
            found:=false
            for y in b.subdivisions {
                if !y.live || used[y.id] || !same_outline(x.outline,y.outline) { continue }
                matches[x.id]=y.id; used[y.id]=true; found=true
                testing.expect(t,x.seed==y.seed && x.material==y.material && x.width==y.width && close_vec(x.pose.position,y.pose.position) && close_vec(x.pose.velocity,y.pose.velocity) && close(x.pose.angle,y.pose.angle) && close(x.pose.angular_velocity,y.pose.angular_velocity))
                left,right:=a.pieces[a.piece_rows[x.owner]],b.pieces[b.piece_rows[y.owner]]
                testing.expect(t,left.seed==right.seed && len(left.subdivisions)==len(right.subdivisions) && len(left.connections)==len(right.connections))
                break
            }
            testing.expect(t,found,"A retained outline differs between recursive and shortcut evaluation")
        }
        if len(matches)!=as { return }
        for c in a.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            found:=false
            for d in b.connections {
                if d.live && ((d.a==matches[c.a] && d.b==matches[c.b]) || (d.b==matches[c.a] && d.a==matches[c.b])) {
                    found=true
                    testing.expect(t,close_vec(connection_sample(a,c),connection_sample(b,d)))
                    break
                }
            }
            testing.expect(t,found,"A surviving inherited or internal link differs")
        }
        for p in a.pieces {
            if !p.live { continue }
            owner:=b.subdivisions[b.sub_rows[matches[p.subdivisions[0]]]].owner
            for id in p.subdivisions { testing.expect(t,b.subdivisions[b.sub_rows[matches[id]]].owner==owner,"Retained memberships differ") }
        }
        for remnant,i in a.remnants {
            if i>=len(b.remnants) { break }
            testing.expect(t,same_outline(a.subdivisions[a.sub_rows[remnant.subdivision]].outline,b.subdivisions[b.sub_rows[b.remnants[i].subdivision]].outline))
        }
    }
    
    @(test)
    deletion_shortcut_agrees_with_recursive_blasts :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        for pattern in 0..<3 {
            for whole in 0..<2 {
                a:=make_wall(42,0.08); defer scene_destroy(&a)
                b:=make_wall(42,0.08); defer scene_destroy(&b)
                scenes:=[2]^Scene{&a,&b}
                for s in scenes {
                    s.materials[0]=material_preset(pattern)
                    s.materials[0].subdivision_strength=6
                    s.materials[0].connection_strength=4
                    for &sub in s.subdivisions {
                        sub.pose.position=vadd(Vec2{2,-1},vrotate(sub.rest_center,0.7))
                        sub.pose.angle=0.7
                        sub.pose.velocity=vadd(Vec2{1,2},Vec2{-2*sub.pose.position.y,2*sub.pose.position.x})
                        sub.pose.angular_velocity=2
                    }
                }
                blast:=Blast{position=vadd(Vec2{2,-1},vrotate(Vec2{-1,0.25},0.7)),radius=3.5}
                if whole==1 { blast.radius=10 }
                blast_pass(&a,blast,true); blast_pass(&b,blast,false)
                testing.expect(t,len(a.subdivisions)<len(b.subdivisions),"The proven deletion must avoid actual generation work")
                expect_same_blast_result(t,&a,&b)
                if whole==0 {
                    remaining,_,_:=counts(&a)
                    testing.expect(t,remaining>0)
                    // Future events must also agree: a skipped earlier branch cannot
                    // shift seeds through IDs, piece regrouping or an RNG stream.
                    next:=Blast{position=vadd(Vec2{2,-1},vrotate(Vec2{3.3,-0.2},0.7)),radius=1.7}
                    blast_pass(&a,next,true); blast_pass(&b,next,false)
                    expect_same_blast_result(t,&a,&b)
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @(test)
    new_blast_connections_fail_before_further_inheritance :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        s:=make_wall(42,0.08); defer scene_destroy(&s)
        s.materials[0].subdivision_strength=4.5
        s.materials[0].connection_strength=0
        broken:=Failures{connections=[dynamic]u64{s.connections[0].id}}; defer free_failures(&broken)
        apply_failures(&s,broken)
        left:=s.subdivisions[0].id
        blast:=Blast{position={1.5,0.5},radius=0.8}
        blast_pass(&s,blast,false)
        new_broken:=0
        for c,i in s.connections {
            if i>=2 && !c.live { new_broken+=1 }
            if !c.live { continue }
            testing.expect(t,c.a!=left && c.b!=left,"The earlier broken boundary must stay broken")
            testing.expect(t,!fails(blast_load(vlen(vsub(connection_sample(&s,c),blast.position)),blast.radius),0),"New connections are evaluated by the same blast")
        }
        testing.expect(t,new_broken>0)
        expect_valid(t,&s)
    }

    birth_context_survives_snapshots_and_legacy_loads :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {

        if !decoded { return }
        next:=Blast{position={2.5,-0.1},radius=1.5}
        blast_pass(&s,next); blast_pass(&r,next)
        a,a_ok:=encode_snapshot(&s); defer delete(a)
        b,b_ok:=encode_snapshot(&r); defer delete(b)
        testing.expect(t,a_ok && b_ok && string(a)==string(b),"Future refinement must use the transmitted birth contexts")
    
        old:=make_wall(42); defer scene_destroy(&old)
        view:=read_state(&old); defer release_state_view(&view)
        view.version=1
        for &sub in view.subdivisions { sub.seed=0 }
        legacy,err:=json.marshal(view); defer delete(legacy)
        testing.expect(t,err==nil)
        loaded,accepted:=decode_snapshot(legacy); defer scene_destroy(&loaded)
        testing.expect(t,accepted)
        if accepted { for sub in loaded.subdivisions { testing.expect(t,sub.seed==42 && sub.width>0,"Legacy snapshots inherit their original piece context") } }
    }

    package main
    
    import "core:math"
    import "core:sync"
    import "core:testing"
    
    // Independent double-precision area and triangle intersection checks catch
    // compensating gaps/overlaps that a sum of the generator's f32 areas can miss.
    Partition_Point :: struct { x,y: f64 }
    partition_area :: proc(points: []Vec2) -> f64 {
    	area: f64
    	for p,i in points {
    		q:=points[(i+1)%len(points)]
    		area+=(f64(p.x)-f64(points[0].x))*(f64(q.y)-f64(points[0].y))-(f64(p.y)-f64(points[0].y))*(f64(q.x)-f64(points[0].x))
    	}
    	return math.abs(area)*0.5
    }
    partition_side :: proc(a,b,p: Partition_Point) -> f64 { return (b.x-a.x)*(p.y-a.y)-(b.y-a.y)*(p.x-a.x) }
    partition_triangle_overlap :: proc(a,b: Polygon) -> f64 {
    	points: [12]Partition_Point
    	for p,i in a.points { points[i]={f64(p.x),f64(p.y)} }
    	count:=len(a.points)
    	clip: [3]Partition_Point
    	for p,i in b.points { clip[i]={f64(p.x),f64(p.y)} }
    	orientation:=f64(1)
    	if partition_side(clip[0],clip[1],clip[2])<0 { orientation=-1 }
    	for edge in 0..<3 {
    		next: [12]Partition_Point
    		next_count:=0
    		for i in 0..<count {
    			p,q:=points[i],points[(i+1)%count]
    			ps:=orientation*partition_side(clip[edge],clip[(edge+1)%3],p)
    			qs:=orientation*partition_side(clip[edge],clip[(edge+1)%3],q)
    			if ps>=0 { next[next_count]=p; next_count+=1 }
    			if (ps>=0)!=(qs>=0) {
    				fraction:=ps/(ps-qs)
    				next[next_count]={p.x+(q.x-p.x)*fraction,p.y+(q.y-p.y)*fraction}; next_count+=1
    			}
    		}
    		points=next; count=next_count
    	}
    	area: f64
    	for i in 0..<count { area+=partition_side(points[0],points[i],points[(i+1)%count]) }
    	return math.abs(area)*0.5
    }
    expect_generation_partition :: proc(t: ^testing.T,parent: Polygon,children: []Polygon) {
    	testing.expect(t,len(children)>=2)
    	parent_area:=partition_area(parent.points)
    	tolerance:=max(f64(0.00000005),parent_area*0.00005)
    	parent_triangles:=triangulate_polygon(parent)
    	defer { for triangle in parent_triangles { delete(triangle.points) }; delete(parent_triangles) }
    	triangles: [dynamic][dynamic]Polygon
    	defer { for batch in triangles { for triangle in batch { delete(triangle.points) }; delete(batch) }; delete(triangles) }
    	area: f64
    	for child in children {
    		child_area:=partition_area(child.points)
    		area+=child_area
    		testing.expect(t,child_area>0 && child_area<parent_area)
    		parts:=triangulate_polygon(child)
    		inside: f64
    		for part in parts { for triangle in parent_triangles { inside+=partition_triangle_overlap(part,triangle) } }
    		testing.expect(t,math.abs(inside-child_area)<=tolerance,"Every child must stay within its parent, including displaced seams")
    		append(&triangles,parts)
    	}
    	testing.expect(t,math.abs(area-parent_area)<=tolerance,"The partition must preserve its parent's area")
    	for i in 0..<len(triangles) {
    		for j in i+1..<len(triangles) {
    			overlap: f64
    			for a in triangles[i] { for b in triangles[j] { overlap+=partition_triangle_overlap(a,b) } }
    			testing.expect(t,overlap<=tolerance,"Sibling interiors must not overlap")
    		}
    	}
    	// Each child edge must be covered by the parent boundary or an exact sibling
    	// seam. T junctions may split one side into several collinear segments.
    	for child,i in children {
    		perimeter,covered:=f32(0),f32(0)
    		for p,k in child.points { perimeter+=vlen(vsub(child.points[(k+1)%len(child.points)],p)) }
    		segments:=shared_segments(child,parent)
    		for segment in segments { covered+=vlen(vsub(segment.b,segment.a)) }; delete(segments)
    		for other,j in children {
    			if i==j { continue }
    			seams:=shared_segments(child,other)
    			for seam in seams { covered+=vlen(vsub(seam.b,seam.a)) }; delete(seams)
    		}
    		testing.expect(t,math.abs(covered-perimeter)<0.0001,"Every generated edge must retain a matching shared boundary")
    	}
    }
    
    @(test)
    concave_generation_merges_ears_and_preserves_material_patterns :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
    	points:=[4]Vec2{{1.5,0.005},{2.35,0.005},{2.35,0.855},{1.5,0.855}}
    	parent:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
    	seeds:=[4]u8{42,85,177,98}
    	for pattern in 0..<3 {
    		recipe:=material_preset(pattern)
    		concave_parents:=0
    		for seed in seeds {
    			children:=generate_children(parent,recipe,seed)
    			defer { for child in children { delete(child.points) }; delete(children) }
    			expect_generation_partition(t,parent,children[:])
    			if !recipe.triangulate { testing.expect(t,len(children)==recipe.generation_count) }
    			for child,i in children {
    				if recipe.triangulate {
    					testing.expect(t,len(child.points)==3,"Shatter deliberately retains triangular subdivisions")
    					if i>0 { continue } // One descendant is sufficient to check intentional triangles again.
    				}
    				if !is_convex(child) { concave_parents+=1 }
    				if pattern==1 {
    					lo,hi:=Vec2{1e30,1e30},Vec2{-1e30,-1e30}
    					for point in child.points { lo={min(lo.x,point.x),min(lo.y,point.y)}; hi={max(hi.x,point.x),max(hi.y,point.y)} }
    					testing.expect(t,hi.y-lo.y>2*(hi.x-lo.x),"Splinter must keep its elongated cuts")
    				}
    				grandchildren:=generate_children(child,recipe,derive_seed(seed,u64(i+1)))
    				defer { for grandchild in grandchildren { delete(grandchild.points) }; delete(grandchildren) }
    				expect_generation_partition(t,child,grandchildren[:])
    				if !recipe.triangulate {
    					testing.expect(t,len(grandchildren)==recipe.generation_count,"A bent boundary must not turn triangulation ears into extra fragments")
    				}
    				for grandchild in grandchildren {
    					if pattern==0 {
    						lo,hi:=Vec2{1e30,1e30},Vec2{-1e30,-1e30}
    						for point in grandchild.points { lo={min(lo.x,point.x),min(lo.y,point.y)}; hi={max(hi.x,point.x),max(hi.y,point.y)} }
    						testing.expect(t,outline_width(grandchild.points)/max(hi.x-lo.x,hi.y-lo.y)>0.1,"Chunk must not create thin corner fans from small shared-edge bends")
    					}
    					if recipe.triangulate { testing.expect(t,len(grandchild.points)==3) }
    				}
    			}
    		}
    		if !recipe.triangulate { testing.expect(t,concave_parents>0,"Shared-edge displacement must remain enabled in this regression") }
    	}
    }
    
    @(test)
    yard_roots_get_distinct_deterministic_generation_contexts :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
    	sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
    	game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
    	seeds: [9]u8
    	for sub,i in game.scene.subdivisions {
    		seeds[i]=sub.seed
    		testing.expect(t,sub.seed!=0)
    		for j in 0..<i { testing.expect(t,seeds[j]!=sub.seed,"Adjacent starting blocks must not reuse the same generation context") }
    	}
    	children_a:=generate_children(game.scene.subdivisions[0].outline,game.scene.materials[0],seeds[0])
    	children_b:=generate_children(game.scene.subdivisions[1].outline,game.scene.materials[0],seeds[1])
    	defer { for child in children_a { delete(child.points) }; delete(children_a); for child in children_b { delete(child.points) }; delete(children_b) }
    	a:=vsub(centroid(children_a[0]),game.scene.subdivisions[0].rest_center)
    	b:=vsub(centroid(children_b[0]),game.scene.subdivisions[1].rest_center)
    	testing.expect(t,!close_vec(a,b),"Translated copies of neighboring blocks should not generate identical partitions")
    	sandbox_reset(&game)
    	for sub,i in game.scene.subdivisions { testing.expect(t,sub.seed==seeds[i],"Reset must repeat the applied setup's birth contexts") }
    	game.applied.generate_children=false
    	sandbox_reset(&game)
    	for sub in game.scene.subdivisions { testing.expect(t,sub.seed==0,"Seed zero must still disable future generations") }
    }

    // Straight shared cuts are constructed by clipping both sides at one value.
    // Outside edges are never moved; no gap or overlap is introduced at the cut.
    generate_children :: proc(parent: Polygon, recipe: Material, seed: u8) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
        result: [dynamic]Polygon
        if seed == 0 { return result }
        if recipe.triangulate { result = triangulate_polygon(parent) } else if !is_convex(parent) {
            // Bent shared edges can make a parent slightly concave. Merge its ears
            // before partitioning so collision decomposition does not dictate fragments.
            result = convex_decomposition(parent)
        } else {
            append(&result,make_polygon(parent.points))
        }
        target := max(recipe.generation_count,len(result))
        for len(result) < target {
            chosen := -1
            largest: f32
            for p,i in result { a := polygon_area(p); if a > largest { largest = a; chosen = i } }
            if chosen < 0 || largest < 0.0001 { break }
            p := result[chosen]
            min_x,min_y := f32(1e30),f32(1e30)
            max_x,max_y := f32(-1e30),f32(-1e30)
            for point in p.points { min_x=min(min_x,point.x); max_x=max(max_x,point.x); min_y=min(min_y,point.y); max_y=max(max_y,point.y) }
            axis := 0
            if (max_x-min_x) < (max_y-min_y)*max(recipe.aspect_ratio,0.1) { axis = 1 }
            fraction := 0.4+0.2*f32(derive_seed(seed,u64(len(result))))/255
            cut := min_x+(max_x-min_x)*fraction
            if axis == 1 { cut = min_y+(max_y-min_y)*fraction }
            low, high := clip_polygon(p,axis,cut,true),clip_polygon(p,axis,cut,false)
            if polygon_area(low) < 0.0001 || polygon_area(high) < 0.0001 { delete(low.points); delete(high.points); break }
            delete(p.points)
            result[chosen] = low
            append(&result,high)
        }
        displace_shared_boundaries(result[:],seed)
        if recipe.triangulate {
            triangles: [dynamic]Polygon
            for polygon in result {
                parts:=triangulate_polygon(polygon)
                for part in parts { append(&triangles,part) }
                delete(parts); delete(polygon.points)
                x,y:=f32(1.5)+f32(column)*0.85,f32(row)*0.85+0.005
                points:=[4]Vec2{{x,y},{x+0.85,y},{x+0.85,y+0.85},{x,y+0.85}}
                outline:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
                id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline)})
                // Stable block coordinates give neighboring roots distinct birth contexts.
                s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].seed=derive_seed(seed,u64(row*4+column+1))
                append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
            }
        }
        for a in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            for b in a+1..<len(s.subdivisions) { add_connection(s,s.subdivisions[a].id,s.subdivisions[b].id) }
        }
        for connection in s.connections { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].connections,connection.id) }

        game.floor=b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)

My read: **responsive movement, clearer fractures, and explosions that still need more punch.** This is based on captures, code and automated playthroughs; I haven’t done a proper hands-on feel pass.

- **Movement has a good foundation.** Quick acceleration, buffered jumps and coyote time should make the capsule forgiving to control. Strong air control likely gives it a light, arcade feel.
- **Fractures read better now.** Chunk has broader pieces, Splinter produces recognizable strips, and Shatter looks brittle.
- **Bombs add anticipation.** Watching one fall and waiting through its fuse gives destruction a useful rhythm. A stronger landing cue and escalating fuse feedback would make that second more engaging.
- **Explosions lack impact feedback.** Material can disappear abruptly, and the expanding ring carries much of the effect. Sound, a brief flash and a little dust would help communicate the force.
- **Bomb mode has low stakes.** The player is invulnerable and receives no direct blast knockback. It currently supports relaxed experimentation more than urgent movement.

I’d improve **landing, fuse and explosion feedback first**, then try modest player knockback. Those would make the existing physics easier to feel without complicating destruction.

## Assistant

For the world’s physical response, **I’d expect it to feel quick, slightly springy, and heavy on translation.**

- **Explosions respond immediately.** Fracturing finishes within the blast event, and surviving fragments receive their velocity change immediately.
- **Impact-driven fracture can unfold over several frames.** Collision failures generate one generation per physics step. A hard impact can therefore seem to progressively subdivide material.
- **Connections are compliant.** The default joints allow flex, so connected blocks can bend and wobble under force. That’s the main setting I’d examine if the structure feels mushy.
- **Blast impulses produce no direct spin.** They act through each fragment’s center. Rotation comes from inherited motion, collisions and joint reactions, which can make fragments look pushed away rather than violently thrown.
- **Mass doesn’t affect the blast’s velocity kick.** Equally distant large and small pieces accelerate equally, reducing their apparent difference in weight.

My first physics adjustment would be **stiffer default connections**, followed by checking whether impacts need faster fracture propagation. Those directly affect how promptly and decisively the world yields to force.
