    package main
    
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    Physics :: struct {
        world: b2.WorldId,
        bodies: map[u64]b2.BodyId,
        joints: map[u64]b2.JointId,
        fixture_counts: map[u64]int,
        active: bool,
    }
    Interaction :: struct { force: Vec2, torque: f32 }
    REFERENCE_LENGTH :: f32(1)
    PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS :: 4
    GLOBAL_DAMPING :: f32(0.7)
    
    to_b2 :: proc(v: Vec2) -> b2.Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    from_b2 :: proc(v: b2.Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    interaction_load :: proc(i: Interaction) -> f32 {
        return max(vlen(i.force),math.abs(i.torque)/REFERENCE_LENGTH)
    }
    equivalent_force :: proc(impulse: Vec2, interval: f32) -> Vec2 {
        assert(interval > 0)
        return vmul(impulse,1/interval)
    }
    physics_init :: proc(s: ^Scene, gravity: Vec2 = {}) {
        assert(!s.physics.active)
        def := b2.DefaultWorldDef()
        def.gravity = to_b2(gravity)
        s.physics = Physics{world=b2.CreateWorld(def),bodies=make(map[u64]b2.BodyId),joints=make(map[u64]b2.JointId),fixture_counts=make(map[u64]int),active=true}
        physics_sync_structure(s)
    }
    physics_destroy :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        b2.DestroyWorld(s.physics.world)
        delete(s.physics.bodies); delete(s.physics.joints); delete(s.physics.fixture_counts)
        s.physics = {}
    }
    physics_read_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row := s.sub_rows[id]
            rotation := b2.Body_GetRotation(body)
            s.subdivisions[row].pose = Pose{
                position=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(body)),angle=math.atan2(rotation.s,rotation.c),
                velocity=from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body)),angular_velocity=b2.Body_GetAngularVelocity(body),
            }
        }
    }
    physics_create_fixture :: proc(s: ^Scene, body: b2.BodyId, sub: Subdivision, outline: Polygon) -> bool {
        points: [dynamic]b2.Vec2
        defer delete(points)
        for point in outline.points { append(&points,to_b2(vsub(point,sub.rest_center))) }
        hull := b2.ComputeHull(points[:])
        // Hull welding can collapse a thin ear below Box2D's collision tolerance.
        if hull.count < 3 { return false }
        polygon := b2.MakePolygon(hull,0)
        def := b2.DefaultShapeDef()
        def.density = 1
        _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
        s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id] += 1
        return true
    }
    physics_finish_mass :: proc(s: ^Scene,body: b2.BodyId,sub: Subdivision) {
        if s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id]==0 {
            // A microscopic attached subdivision is still one live logical entity.
            // Use a bounding fixture when the engine cannot resolve any of its ears.
            lo,hi:=Vec2{1e30,1e30},Vec2{-1e30,-1e30}
            for rest in sub.outline.points { p:=vsub(rest,sub.rest_center); lo={min(lo.x,p.x),min(lo.y,p.y)}; hi={max(hi.x,p.x),max(hi.y,p.y)} }
            polygon:=b2.MakeOffsetBox(max(f32(0.0025),(hi.x-lo.x)*0.5),max(f32(0.0025),(hi.y-lo.y)*0.5),to_b2(vmul(vadd(lo,hi),0.5)),b2.MakeRot(0))
            def:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); def.density=1
            _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
            s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id]=1
        }
        // Keep mass and the body origin tied to the exact logical polygon, including
        // when Box2D simplifies a fixture. This also makes rotational inheritance exact.
        inertia: f32
        for i in 0..<len(sub.outline.points) {
            a,b:=vsub(sub.outline.points[i],sub.rest_center),vsub(sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)],sub.rest_center)
            inertia+=vcross(a,b)*(vdot(a,a)+vdot(a,b)+vdot(b,b))/12
        }
        b2.Body_SetMassData(body,b2.MassData{mass=polygon_area(sub.outline),center={},rotationalInertia=math.abs(inertia)})
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,to_b2(sub.pose.velocity))
        b2.Body_SetAngularVelocity(body,sub.pose.angular_velocity)
    }
    // This runs only between World_Step calls. Existing handles survive ownership changes.
    physics_sync_structure :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        dead_joints: [dynamic]u64
        dead_bodies: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(dead_joints); defer delete(dead_bodies)
        for id,joint in s.physics.joints {
            row,ok := s.conn_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.connections[row].live { b2.DestroyJoint(joint); append(&dead_joints,id) }
        }
        for id in dead_joints { delete_key(&s.physics.joints,id) }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row,ok := s.sub_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.subdivisions[row].live { b2.DestroyBody(body); append(&dead_bodies,id) }
        }
        for id in dead_bodies { delete_key(&s.physics.bodies,id); delete_key(&s.physics.fixture_counts,id) }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            if _,exists := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]; exists { continue }
            def := b2.DefaultBodyDef()
            def.type = .dynamicBody
            def.position = to_b2(sub.pose.position)
            def.rotation = b2.MakeRot(sub.pose.angle)
            def.linearVelocity = to_b2(sub.pose.velocity)
            def.angularVelocity = sub.pose.angular_velocity
            body := b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
            s.physics.bodies[sub.id] = body
            if is_convex(sub.outline) && len(sub.outline.points) <= 8 {
                physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,sub.outline)
            } else {
                triangles := convex_decomposition(sub.outline)
                for triangle in triangles { physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,triangle); delete(triangle.points) }
                delete(triangles)
            }
            physics_finish_mass(s,body,sub)
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            if _,exists := s.physics.joints[c.id]; exists { continue }
            a := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]]
            b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            def := b2.DefaultWeldJointDef()
            def.bodyIdA = s.physics.bodies[c.a]
            def.bodyIdB = s.physics.bodies[c.b]
            def.localAnchorA = to_b2(c.local_a)
            def.localAnchorB = to_b2(c.local_b)
            // All outlines share one undeformed frame. Its relative rest angle is zero.
            def.referenceAngle = 0
            flexibility := max(s.materials[a.material].flexibility,s.materials[b.material].flexibility)
            if flexibility > 0 {
                def.linearHertz = 1/max(flexibility,0.01)
                def.angularHertz = def.linearHertz
            }
            def.linearDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
            def.angularDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
            s.physics.joints[c.id] = b2.CreateWeldJoint(s.physics.world,def)
        }
    }
    apply_blast_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene, sub: ^Subdivision, direction: Vec2, load: f32) {
        delta_v := vmul(direction,load*BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE)
        if s.physics.active {
            body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
            impulse := vmul(delta_v,b2.Body_GetMass(body))
            b2.Body_ApplyLinearImpulseToCenter(body,to_b2(impulse),true)
            sub.pose.velocity = from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body))
        } else {
            sub.pose.velocity = vadd(sub.pose.velocity,delta_v)
        }
    }
    // Contact points and fixtures against the same other body form one interaction.
    // Joint reactions are already forces; totalNormalImpulse covers the full tick.
    // Box2D's tangent/rolling impulses cover the final substep in this binding version.
    calculate_physics_loads :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) -> Failures {
        assert(dt > 0)
        failures := Failures{}
        loads := make(map[u64]f32)
        defer delete(loads)
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
            capacity := int(b2.Body_GetContactCapacity(body))
            buffer := make([]b2.ContactData,capacity)
            contacts := b2.Body_GetContactData(body,buffer)
            interactions := make(map[b2.BodyId]Interaction)
            for contact in contacts {
                body_a,body_b := b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdA),b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdB)
                other := body_b
                sign := f32(-1)
                if body_b == body { other=body_a; sign=1 }
                normal := from_b2(contact.manifold.normal)
                tangent := Vec2{normal.y,-normal.x}
                interaction := interactions[other]
                for k in 0..<int(contact.manifold.pointCount) {
                    point := contact.manifold.points[k]
                    force := vadd(equivalent_force(vmul(normal,point.totalNormalImpulse*sign),dt),equivalent_force(vmul(tangent,point.tangentImpulse*sign),dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)))
                    interaction.force = vadd(interaction.force,force)
                    interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(from_b2(point.point),sub.pose.position),force)
                }
                interaction.torque += contact.manifold.rollingImpulse*sign/(dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS))
                interactions[other] = interaction
            }
            for _,interaction in interactions { loads[sub.id] = max(loads[sub.id],interaction_load(interaction)) }
            delete(interactions); delete(buffer)
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            joint := s.physics.joints[c.id]
            interaction := Interaction{force=from_b2(b2.Joint_GetConstraintForce(joint)),torque=b2.Joint_GetConstraintTorque(joint)}
            load := interaction_load(interaction)
            a,b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            a_interaction,b_interaction := interaction,interaction
            a_interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(posed_point(a,c.rest_point),a.pose.position),interaction.force)
            b_interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(posed_point(b,c.rest_point),b.pose.position),interaction.force)
            loads[c.a] = max(loads[c.a],interaction_load(a_interaction))
            loads[c.b] = max(loads[c.b],interaction_load(b_interaction))
            material := s.materials[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].material]
            if fails(load,material.connection_strength) { append(&failures.connections,c.id) }
        }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if sub.live && fails(loads[sub.id],s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&failures.subdivisions,sub.id) }
        }
        return failures
    }
    Load_Calculator :: #type proc(s: ^Scene,dt: f32) -> Failures
    physics_tick :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32,calculate_loads: Load_Calculator = calculate_physics_loads) {
        assert(s.physics.active && dt > 0)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        b2.World_Step(s.physics.world,dt,PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)
        physics_read_motion(s)
        failures := calculate_loads(s,dt)
        apply_failures(s,failures)
        delete(failures.subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
        delete(failures.discard_subdivisions)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        fade_step(s,dt)
    }
    #+feature dynamic-literals
    package main
    
    import "core:math"
    
    polygon_area :: proc(p: Polygon) -> f32 {
        a: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) { a += vcross(p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]) }
        return math.abs(a)*0.5
    }
    clip_polygon :: proc(p: Polygon, axis: int, cut: f32, keep_low: bool) -> Polygon {
        points: [dynamic]Vec2
        defer delete(points)
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            a,b := p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
            av,bv := a.x-cut,b.x-cut
            if axis == 1 { av = a.y-cut; bv = b.y-cut }
            if !keep_low { av = -av; bv = -bv }
            inside_a, inside_b := av <= 0,bv <= 0
            if inside_a { append(&points,a) }
            if inside_a != inside_b {
                t := av/(av-bv)
                append(&points,vadd(a,vmul(vsub(b,a),t)))
            }
        }
        return make_polygon(points[:])
    }
    is_convex :: proc(p: Polygon) -> bool {
        if len(p.points) < 3 { return false }
        sign: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            cross := vcross(vsub(p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)],p.points[i]),vsub(p.points[(i+2)%len(p.points)],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]))
            if math.abs(cross) < 0.00001 { continue }
            if sign == 0 { sign = cross } else if cross*sign < 0 { return false }
        }
        return true
    }
    point_in_triangle :: proc(p,a,b,c: Vec2, orientation: f32) -> bool {
        return vcross(vsub(b,a),vsub(p,a))*orientation >= -0.00001 &&
               vcross(vsub(c,b),vsub(p,b))*orientation >= -0.00001 &&
               vcross(vsub(a,c),vsub(p,c))*orientation >= -0.00001
    }
    triangulate_polygon :: proc(p: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
        result: [dynamic]Polygon
        indices: [dynamic]int
        defer delete(indices)
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) { append(&indices,i) }
        signed: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) { signed += vcross(p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]) }
        orientation := f32(1)
        if signed < 0 { orientation = -1 }
        for len(indices) > 3 {
            found := false
            for k in 0..<len(indices) {
                i,j,l := indices[(k+len(indices)-1)%len(indices)],indices[k],indices[(k+1)%len(indices)]
                a,b,c := p.points[i],p.points[j],p.points[l]
                if vcross(vsub(b,a),vsub(c,b))*orientation <= 0.00001 { continue }
                contains := false
                for n in indices { if n != i && n != j && n != l && point_in_triangle(p.points[n],a,b,c,orientation) { contains = true; break } }
                if contains { continue }
                append(&result,make_polygon([]Vec2{a,b,c}))
                ordered_remove(&indices,k)
                found = true
                break
            }
            if !found { break }
        }
        if len(indices) == 3 { append(&result,make_polygon([]Vec2{p.points[indices[0]],p.points[indices[1]],p.points[indices[2]]})) }
        return result
    }
    // Straight shared cuts are constructed by clipping both sides at one value.
    // Outside edges are never moved; no gap or overlap is introduced at the cut.
    generate_children :: proc(parent: Polygon, recipe: Material, seed: u8) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
        result: [dynamic]Polygon
        if seed == 0 { return result }
        if recipe.triangulate { result = triangulate_polygon(parent) } else if !is_convex(parent) {
            // Bent shared edges can make a parent slightly concave. Merge its ears
            // before partitioning so collision decomposition does not dictate fragments.
            result = convex_decomposition(parent)
        } else {
            append(&result,make_polygon(parent.points))
        }
        target := max(recipe.generation_count,len(result))
        for len(result) < target {
            chosen := -1
            largest: f32
            for p,i in result { a := polygon_area(p); if a > largest { largest = a; chosen = i } }
            if chosen < 0 || largest < 0.0001 { break }
            p := result[chosen]
            min_x,min_y := f32(1e30),f32(1e30)
            max_x,max_y := f32(-1e30),f32(-1e30)
            for point in p.points { min_x=min(min_x,point.x); max_x=max(max_x,point.x); min_y=min(min_y,point.y); max_y=max(max_y,point.y) }
            axis := 0
            if (max_x-min_x) < (max_y-min_y)*max(recipe.aspect_ratio,0.1) { axis = 1 }
            fraction := 0.4+0.2*f32(derive_seed(seed,u64(len(result))))/255
            cut := min_x+(max_x-min_x)*fraction
            if axis == 1 { cut = min_y+(max_y-min_y)*fraction }
            low, high := clip_polygon(p,axis,cut,true),clip_polygon(p,axis,cut,false)
            if polygon_area(low) < 0.0001 || polygon_area(high) < 0.0001 { delete(low.points); delete(high.points); break }
            delete(p.points)
            result[chosen] = low
            append(&result,high)
        }
        displace_shared_boundaries(result[:],seed)
        if recipe.triangulate {
            triangles: [dynamic]Polygon
            for polygon in result {
                parts:=triangulate_polygon(polygon)
                for part in parts { append(&triangles,part) }
                delete(parts); delete(polygon.points)
            }
            delete(result)
            result=triangles
        }
        // Incomplete triangulation or a no-progress recipe must remove the failed
        // outline, rather than retaining an equivalent child or a partial partition.
        area: f32
        genuine := len(result)>=2
        parent_area := polygon_area(parent)
        for child in result {
            child_area := polygon_area(child)
            genuine = genuine && child_area>0 && child_area<parent_area
            area += child_area
        }
        if !genuine || math.abs(area-parent_area)>max(f32(0.000002),parent_area*0.0002) {
            for child in result { delete(child.points) }
            delete(result)
            return nil
        }
        return result
    }
    
    apply_failures :: proc(s: ^Scene, failures: Failures) {
        if len(failures.subdivisions) == 0 && len(failures.connections) == 0 && len(failures.discard_subdivisions) == 0 { return }
        s.revision+=1
        affected := make(map[u64]bool)
        defer delete(affected)
        stage_failures(s,failures,&affected)
        rebuild_affected_pieces(s,affected)
    }
    // Reuse the existing one-wave graph update for physics and for each blast wave.
    // Ownership, size filtering and engine handles are committed only at the end.
    stage_failures :: proc(s: ^Scene, failures: Failures, affected: ^map[u64]bool) {
        replacements := make(map[u64][dynamic]u64)
        defer { for _,children in replacements { delete(children) }; delete(replacements) }
        failed_subs := sorted_ids(failures.subdivisions[:])
        for id in failures.discard_subdivisions { if !contains_id(failed_subs[:],id) { append(&failed_subs,id) } }
        sort_ids(failed_subs[:])
        failed_conns := sorted_ids(failures.connections[:])
        defer delete(failed_subs); defer delete(failed_conns)
        old_connection_count := len(s.connections)
        old_connections: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(old_connections)
        for i in 0..<old_connection_count { append(&old_connections,s.connections[i].id) }
        sort_ids(old_connections[:])
        for id in failed_subs {
            row, ok := s.sub_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.subdivisions[row].live { continue }
            parent := s.subdivisions[row]
            affected[parent.owner] = true
            seed := parent.seed
            if parent.width<=s.minimum_width || contains_id(failures.discard_subdivisions[:],id) { seed=0 }
            children := generate_children(parent.outline,s.materials[parent.material],seed)
            max_width: f32
            for outline,ordinal in children {
                center := centroid(outline)
                world_center := posed_point(parent,center)
                r := vsub(world_center,parent.pose.position)
                pose := Pose{position=world_center,angle=parent.pose.angle,velocity=vadd(parent.pose.velocity,Vec2{-parent.pose.angular_velocity*r.y,parent.pose.angular_velocity*r.x}),angular_velocity=parent.pose.angular_velocity}
                child := add_subdivision(s,parent.owner,outline,pose)
                child_row := s.sub_rows[child]
                // Parent context plus child ordinal is independent of other branches'
                // allocations. A deletion shortcut cannot perturb their future seeds.
                s.subdivisions[child_row].seed=derive_seed(parent.seed,u64(ordinal+1))
                max_width=max(max_width,s.subdivisions[child_row].width)
                delete(outline.points)
                child_ids := replacements[id]
                append(&child_ids,child)
                replacements[id] = child_ids
            }
            delete(children)
            if max_width<=s.minimum_width {
                child_ids := replacements[id]
                for child in child_ids { s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[child]].seed=0 }
            }
            s.subdivisions[row].live = false
        }
        for id in failed_conns {
            row, ok := s.conn_rows[id]
            if ok && s.connections[row].live {
                c := s.connections[row]
                affected[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].owner] = true
                affected[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].owner] = true
                s.connections[row].live = false
            }
        }
        for old_id in old_connections {
            i := s.conn_rows[old_id]
            c := s.connections[i]
            if !c.live { continue }
            a_dead := !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].live
            b_dead := !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].live
            if !a_dead && !b_dead { continue }
            s.connections[i].live = false
            left_default,right_default := [1]u64{c.a},[1]u64{c.b}
            left,right := left_default[:],right_default[:]
            if a_dead { left = replacements[c.a][:] }
            if b_dead { right = replacements[c.b][:] }
            old_a,old_b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            old_length,_ := shared_boundary(old_a.outline,old_b.outline)
            if old_length <= 0 { continue }
            for a in left {
                for b in right {
                    if inherits_old_boundary(s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[a]].outline,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[b]].outline,old_a.outline,old_b.outline) { add_connection(s,a,b) }
                }
            }
        }
        for id in failed_subs {
            children := replacements[id]
            for i in 0..<len(children) { for j in i+1..<len(children) { add_connection(s,children[i],children[j]) } }
        }
    }
    rebuild_affected_pieces :: proc(s: ^Scene, affected: map[u64]bool) {
        owners: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(owners)
        for owner in affected { append(&owners,owner) }
        sort_ids(owners[:])
        for owner in owners { rebuild_piece(s,owner) }
    }
    
    BLAST_LOAD_MULTIPLIER :: f32(10)
    BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE :: f32(0.1)
    blast_load :: proc(distance,radius: f32) -> f32 {
        if radius <= 0 || distance >= radius { return 0 }
        return BLAST_LOAD_MULTIPLIER*max(f32(0),radius-distance)
    }
    fails :: proc(load,strength: f32) -> bool { return load > 0 && load >= strength }
    evaluate_blast :: proc(s: ^Scene, blast: Blast, first_subdivision: int = 0, first_connection: int = 0) -> Failures {
        f := Failures{}
        for i in first_subdivision..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            sub := &s.subdivisions[i]
            if !sub.live { continue }
            offset := vsub(subdivision_sample(sub^),blast.position)
            distance := vlen(offset)
            load := blast_load(distance,blast.radius)
            if load <= 0 { continue }
            if fails(load,s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&f.subdivisions,sub.id) }
        }
        for i in first_connection..<len(s.connections) {
            c := s.connections[i]
            if !c.live { continue }
            a := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]]
            load := blast_load(vlen(vsub(connection_sample(s,c),blast.position)),blast.radius)
            if fails(load,s.materials[a.material].connection_strength) { append(&f.connections,c.id) }
        }
        return f
    }
    // Descendants partition the outline, inherit its material and keep its rigid
    // transform during this event. Their samples lie in the posed convex hull.
    // Outward rounding and a strict load margin avoid pruning borderline failures.
    blast_erases_descendants :: proc(sub: Subdivision, blast: Blast, strength: f32) -> bool {
        if !finite(strength) || !finite(blast.radius) || !valid_vec(blast.position) { return false }
        farthest: f32
        for point in sub.outline.points {
            distance := vlen(vsub(posed_point(sub,point),blast.position))
            if !finite(distance) { return false }
            farthest=max(farthest,distance)
        }
        farthest=math.nextafter(farthest,math.inf_f32(1))
        return blast_load(farthest,blast.radius)>strength+0.0001
    }
    blast_pass :: proc(s: ^Scene, blast: Blast, deletion_shortcut: bool = true) {
        physics_read_motion(s)
        affected := make(map[u64]bool)
        defer delete(affected)
        f := evaluate_blast(s,blast)
        changed := false
        for len(f.subdivisions)>0 || len(f.connections)>0 {
            changed=true
            if deletion_shortcut {
                for id in f.subdivisions {
                    sub := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]]
                    if sub.seed!=0 && sub.width>s.minimum_width && blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&f.discard_subdivisions,id) }
                }
            }
            first_subdivision,first_connection := len(s.subdivisions),len(s.connections)
            stage_failures(s,f,&affected)
            delete(f.subdivisions); delete(f.connections); delete(f.discard_subdivisions)
            // Earlier survivors have unchanged samples. Only children and new links
            // need this blast again; failed old links are already excluded from inheritance.
            f=evaluate_blast(s,blast,first_subdivision,first_connection)
        }
        delete(f.subdivisions); delete(f.connections); delete(f.discard_subdivisions)
        if changed { s.revision+=1; rebuild_affected_pieces(s,affected) }
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        for i in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            sub := &s.subdivisions[i]
            if !sub.live { continue }
            offset := vsub(subdivision_sample(sub^),blast.position)
            distance := vlen(offset)
            load := blast_load(distance,blast.radius)
            if load>0 && distance>0.00001 { apply_blast_motion(s,sub,vmul(offset,1/distance),load) }
        }
    }
    fade_step :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) {
        for i := len(s.remnants)-1; i >= 0; i -= 1 {
            s.remnants[i].age += dt
            if s.remnants[i].age >= 1 { ordered_remove(&s.remnants,i) }
        }
    }

            a,b:=b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdA),b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdB)
            normal:=from_b2(contact.manifold.normal)
            other:=a
            if a==player.body { normal=vmul(normal,-1); other=b }
            if normal.y<0.55 { continue }
            for i in 0..<int(contact.manifold.pointCount) {
                point:=contact.manifold.points[i]

                if point.separation<=0.025 && point.point.y<position.y-0.1 && vdot(vsub(velocity,support_velocity),normal)<0.8 {
                    player.grounded=true
                    player.support_velocity=support_velocity
                }
            }
        }

    player_before_step :: proc(player: ^Player,move: f32,jump_pressed: bool,dt: f32) {
        player_read_support(player)
        if player.grounded { player.coyote=PLAYER_TUNING.coyote_time } else { player.coyote=max(f32(0),player.coyote-dt) }
        if jump_pressed { player.buffered_jump=PLAYER_TUNING.jump_buffer }
        velocity:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(player.body))
        target:=clamp(move,f32(-1),f32(1))*PLAYER_TUNING.speed
        velocity.x+=clamp(target-velocity.x,-PLAYER_TUNING.acceleration*dt,PLAYER_TUNING.acceleration*dt)
        if player.buffered_jump>0 && player.coyote>0 {
            velocity.y=PLAYER_TUNING.jump_speed+max(f32(0),player.support_velocity.y)
            player.grounded=false
            player.coyote=0
            player.buffered_jump=0
        }
        player.buffered_jump=max(f32(0),player.buffered_jump-dt)
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(player.body,to_b2(velocity))
    }
    player_after_step :: proc(player: ^Player) -> bool {
        position:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(player.body))
        if position.x < -8.5 || position.x > 9.5 || position.y < -3 || position.y > 12 || math.is_nan(position.y) {
            player_respawn(player)
            return true
        }
        player_read_support(player)
        return false
    }

    physics_test_mutex: sync.Mutex
    
    counts :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> (int,int,int) {
        a,b,c := 0,0,0
        for x in s.subdivisions { if x.live { a+=1 } }
        for x in s.connections { if x.live { b+=1 } }
        for x in s.pieces { if x.live { c+=1 } }
        return a,b,c
    }
    expect_valid :: proc(t: ^testing.T,s: ^Scene) { ok,message:=validate_scene(s); testing.expect(t,ok,message) }
    close :: proc(a,b: f32) -> bool { return math.abs(a-b) < 0.001 }
    close_vec :: proc(a,b: Vec2) -> bool { return vlen(vsub(a,b)) < 0.001 }
    failure_for :: proc(ids: ..u64) -> Failures {
        f := Failures{}
        for id in ids { append(&f.subdivisions,id) }
        return f
    }
    free_failures :: proc(f: ^Failures) { delete(f.subdivisions); delete(f.connections); delete(f.discard_subdivisions); f^={} }

        a,b,c:=counts(&s)
        testing.expect(t,a==3 && b==1 && c==2)
        expect_valid(t,&s)
        s2:=make_wall(); defer scene_destroy(&s2)

    blast_impulse_is_applied_once_to_final_survivors :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        s:=make_wall(42,0.04); defer scene_destroy(&s)
        s.materials[0].subdivision_strength=4.5
        s.materials[0].connection_strength=math.inf_f32(1)
        for &sub in s.subdivisions {
            sub.pose.velocity=vadd(Vec2{1,2},Vec2{-3*sub.pose.position.y,3*sub.pose.position.x})
            sub.pose.angular_velocity=3
        }
        physics_init(&s)
        retained_id:=s.subdivisions[0].id
        retained_body:=s.physics.bodies[retained_id]
        blast:=Blast{position={1.5,0.5},radius=0.8}
        blast_pass(&s,blast)
        impulsed_children:=0
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            expected:=vadd(Vec2{1,2},Vec2{-3*sub.pose.position.y,3*sub.pose.position.x})
            if sub.live {
                offset:=vsub(sub.pose.position,blast.position)
                distance:=vlen(offset)
                load:=blast_load(distance,blast.radius)
                if load>0 && distance>0.00001 {
                    expected=vadd(expected,vmul(offset,load*BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE/distance))
                    if sub.id>s.subdivisions[2].id { impulsed_children+=1 }
                }
                testing.expect(t,close_vec(from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(s.physics.bodies[sub.id])),expected))
                testing.expect(t,close(sub.pose.angular_velocity,3))
            } else {
                _,has_body:=s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
                testing.expect(t,!has_body)
            }
            testing.expect(t,close_vec(sub.pose.velocity,expected),"Removed ancestors receive no impulse; each final child uses its own sample once")
        }
        a,_,_:=counts(&s)
        testing.expect(t,impulsed_children>0 && len(s.physics.bodies)==a && s.physics.bodies[retained_id]==retained_body)
        expect_valid(t,&s)
    }

    README.md:31:Mode and radius changes are immediate, including inside settings. Breakup pattern, fragment strength, connection strength, flexibility and Generate children are staged until **Apply & Reset**. Resume keeps the previously applied setup. Strength and flexibility stay independent of Chunk / Splinter / Shatter. The initial setup uses manual blasts, seed 42, strengths 30 / 24, flexibility 0.15 and radius 4.2. Turning Generate children off uses seed zero; geometry stays live until it fails.
    README.md:59:The sender listens on **127.0.0.1:9901** for one receiver. It sends explicit complete snapshots after structural changes and at 10 Hz for motion. The receiver renders polygons, connections, ownership and interpolated motion without simulating physics. Destroy or split the wall in the sender to see the receiver update.
    README.md:99:Blast radius controls both reach and power: direct load is `10 * max(0, radius - distance)`, with zero load for nonpositive radii. The fixed global `BLAST_LOAD_MULTIPLIER` is 10; increasing radius increases load at a fixed distance, without a fixed maximum. For example, a sample 0.5 units away receives load 5 at radius 1 and load 25 at radius 3, enough to fail strength 20. Impulses are `direction * load * mass * 0.1`, applied once at each final survivor's own sample. Generated motion includes the parent's linear and angular motion; removed ancestors receive no blast impulse. New contact and joint reactions wait for the next solver step. Both tuning constants and the falloff live in `destruction.odin`. The torque reference length is one world unit, and global joint damping is 0.7. Flexibility zero selects a stiff weld; positive flexibility selects spring softness.

    package main
    
    import "core:fmt"
    import "core:os"
    
    main :: proc() {
        for arg in os.args[1:] {
            if arg=="--smoke" { run_sandbox(true); return }
            if arg=="--smoke-settings" { run_sandbox(true,true); return }
            if arg=="--smoke-input" { run_sandbox(true,false,true); return }
            if arg=="--lab" { run_debug_view(false); return }
            if arg=="--headless" { run_headless(); return }
            if arg=="--serve" { run_debug_view(false,true); return }
            if arg=="--receive" { run_receiver(); return }
            if arg=="--help" { fmt.println("odin run . -- [--headless | --smoke | --smoke-settings | --smoke-input | --lab | --serve | --receive | --help]"); return }
        }
        run_sandbox()
    }
    
    run_headless :: proc() {
        s:=make_wall(42,0.08)
        defer scene_destroy(&s)
        physics_init(&s)
        fmt.println("Initial:",counts_runtime(&s))
        blast_pass(&s,Blast{position={1.5,0.5},radius=0.8})
        fmt.println("After blast:",counts_runtime(&s))
        for _ in 0..<60 { physics_tick(&s,1.0/60.0) }
        valid,message:=validate_scene(&s)
        assert(valid,message)
        assert(save_snapshot(&s,"snapshot.json"))
        fmt.println("After 60 ticks:",counts_runtime(&s),"| snapshot.json saved")
        receiver,ok:=load_snapshot("snapshot.json")
        assert(ok,"Snapshot receiver failed")
        defer scene_destroy(&receiver)
        fmt.println("Receiver:",counts_runtime(&receiver))
    }

    package main

    @(test)
    yard_rests_under_gravity_and_player_moves_and_jumps :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        for _ in 0..<360 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        a,b,c:=counts(&game.scene)
        testing.expect(t,a==9 && b==11 && c==1,"The initial structure must remain intact under ordinary gravity")
        testing.expect(t,game.player.grounded)
        testing.expect(t,close(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y,PLAYER_HALF_HEIGHT))
        for sub in game.scene.subdivisions { testing.expect(t,vlen(vsub(sub.pose.position,sub.rest_center))<0.04) }
        for _ in 0..<50 { sandbox_tick(&game,1,false) }
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).x > PLAYER_SPAWN.x+2)
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,true)
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y>5 && !game.player.grounded)
        max_height:=f32(0)
        for _ in 0..<150 {
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
            max_height=max(max_height,b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y)
        }
        testing.expect(t,max_height>2 && game.player.grounded,"One jump must reach its apex and land without another airborne jump")
        testing.expect(t,close(b2.Body_GetRotation(game.player.body).s,0))
        expect_valid(t,&game.scene)
    }
    
    @(test)
    player_stands_on_and_pushes_a_real_fragment :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        // Detach a ground-level block, leaving an actual destruction body to stand on.
        id:=game.scene.subdivisions[3].id
        failures:=Failures{}
        for connection in game.scene.connections {
            if connection.a==id || connection.b==id { append(&failures.connections,connection.id) }
        }
        apply_failures(&game.scene,failures); free_failures(&failures)
        physics_sync_structure(&game.scene)
        body:=game.scene.physics.bodies[id]
        position:=b2.Body_GetPosition(body)
        b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{position.x,1.6},b2.MakeRot(0))
        for _ in 0..<120 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        testing.expect(t,game.player.grounded && b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y>1.35,"Support must come from fragment contacts")
        // Move alongside the detached block and push it using the same collision world.
        b2.Body_SetTransform(body,{-1,0.43},b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,{})
        b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{-2,0.6},b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(game.player.body,{})
        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        start:=b2.Body_GetPosition(body).x
        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_tick(&game,1,false) }
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_IsValid(body),"Routine player contact should leave the fragment intact")
        if b2.Body_IsValid(body) { testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetPosition(body).x>start+0.05,"The player should physically push debris") }
    }
    
    @(test)
    player_jump_buffer_and_coyote_window :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        // Queue a jump shortly before landing.
        b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{-4.5,0.64},b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(game.player.body,{0,-1})
        jumped:=false
        for i in 0..<10 {
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,i==0)
            if b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y>5 { jumped=true }
        }
        testing.expect(t,jumped,"A buffered press just before landing should jump")
        // The support was lost recently, but the player is still inside the coyote window.
        b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{-4.5,2},b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(game.player.body,{0,-0.1})
        game.player.coyote=0.08
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,true)
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y>5)
        game.player.coyote=0
        game.player.buffered_jump=0
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(game.player.body,{0,-0.1})
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,true)
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y<0,"Jump assistance must not permit an airborne second jump")
    }

    @(test)
    sandbox_settings_stage_together_and_pattern_preserves_tuning :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        sandbox_set_panel(&game,true)
        game.draft.pattern=1
        game.draft.fragment_strength=53
        game.draft.connection_strength=47
        game.draft.flexibility=0.65
        game.draft.generate_children=false
        sandbox_set_radius(&game,3.6)
        testing.expect(t,game.scene.materials[0].subdivision_strength==30 && game.applied.pattern==0)
        testing.expect(t,game.applied.blast_radius==3.6 && game.draft.blast_radius==3.6)
        sandbox_apply_settings(&game)
        material:=game.scene.materials[0]
        testing.expect(t,!game.panel_open && material.generation_count==5 && material.aspect_ratio==0.2 && !material.triangulate)
        testing.expect(t,material.subdivision_strength==53 && material.connection_strength==47 && material.flexibility==0.65)
        testing.expect(t,game.scene.pieces[0].seed==0 && counts_live_subdivisions(&game.scene)==9,"Disabling children must preserve the live starting geometry")
        sandbox_set_panel(&game,true)
        game.draft.pattern=2
        sandbox_apply_settings(&game)
        material=game.scene.materials[0]
        testing.expect(t,material.generation_count==6 && material.triangulate && material.subdivision_strength==53 && material.flexibility==0.65)
        sandbox_set_panel(&game,true)
        game.draft.fragment_strength=99
        sandbox_set_panel(&game,false)
        sandbox_reset(&game)
        testing.expect(t,game.scene.materials[0].subdivision_strength==53)
        sandbox_set_panel(&game,true)
        testing.expect(t,game.draft.fragment_strength==53,"Opening the panel should start from the applied setup")
    }
    
    counts_live_subdivisions :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> int { result:=0; for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live { result+=1 } }; return result }

        testing.expect(t,game.accumulator==0 && !game.jump_queued && b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)==pose && game.scene.remnants[0].age==0.2)
        testing.expect(t,!sandbox_blast(&game,{0,1}))
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true,jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,!game.panel_open && !input.jump_pressed && !input.blast_pressed)

        testing.expect(t,!input.jump_pressed && !input.blast_pressed,"Held menu inputs must be released before they can act")
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{},false)
        radius:=game.applied.blast_radius

        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,input.jump_pressed && input.blast_pressed)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true},false)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true},false)
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,input.jump_pressed && input.blast_pressed,"A fresh press immediately after closing settings must work")
        sandbox_advance(&game,1.0/60.0,{})

    package main
    
    import rl "vendor:raylib"
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:fmt"
    
    // raylib 5.x automation event IDs (rcore.c); the Odin binding exposes the raw event.
    smoke_key :: proc(key: rl.KeyboardKey,down: bool) -> rl.AutomationEvent {
        type:=u32(1); if down { type=2 }
        return {type=type,params={i32(key),0,0,0}}
    }
    smoke_mouse :: proc(x,y: i32) -> rl.AutomationEvent {
        dpi:=rl.GetWindowScaleDPI()
        return {type=7,params={i32(f32(x)*dpi.x),i32(f32(y)*dpi.y),0,0}}
    }
    smoke_button :: proc(down: bool) -> rl.AutomationEvent {
        type:=u32(5); if down { type=6 }
        return {type=type,params={0,0,0,0}}
    }
    sandbox_smoke_frame :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,target: rl.RenderTexture2D,events: ..rl.AutomationEvent) {
        for event in events { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(event) }
        width,height:=f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight())
        view:=sandbox_view(width,height)
        mouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()
        over_ui:=sandbox_over_hud(mouse,width,height,game.inspection)
        raw:=sandbox_read_input()
        input:=sandbox_route_input(game,raw,over_ui)
        if !raw.menu_pressed && !raw.reset_pressed {
            if !sandbox_inspect_input(game,world_point(view,mouse),view,over_ui) && input.blast_pressed { sandbox_blast(game,world_point(view,mouse)) }
        }
        sandbox_advance(game,1.0/60.0,input)
        poses:=make(map[u64]Pose); defer delete(poses)
        rl.BeginDrawing()
        rl.BeginTextureMode(target)
        rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
        sandbox_draw_world(game,view,poses)
        if !game.panel_open && !over_ui { sandbox_draw_aim(game,view,mouse) }
        action:=sandbox_draw_hud(game,width,height)
        rl.EndTextureMode()
        rl.EndDrawing()
        sandbox_handle_ui(game,action)
    }
    sandbox_smoke_click :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,target: rl.RenderTexture2D,x,y: i32) {
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(x,y),smoke_button(true))
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(x,y),smoke_button(false))
    }
    sandbox_smoke_inputs :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        rl.SetTargetFPS(0)
        target:=rl.LoadRenderTexture(rl.GetScreenWidth(),rl.GetScreenHeight())
        defer rl.UnloadRenderTexture(target)
        for _ in 0..<60 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(30,40)) }
        assert(game.player.grounded,"Player did not land")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.D,true))
        for _ in 0..<45 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.D,false))
        assert(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).x>PLAYER_SPAWN.x+2,"D did not move the player")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.SPACE,true))
        assert(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y>5,"Space did not jump")
        // Keep holding jump through landing: there must be no repeated jump.
        for _ in 0..<120 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        assert(game.player.grounded,"Holding Space repeated a jump")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.SPACE,false))
        revision:=game.scene.revision
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        assert(game.panel_open && game.scene.revision==revision,"Settings click leaked into the world")
        pose:=b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)
        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.D,true),smoke_key(.SPACE,true)) }
        assert(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)==pose,"Menu did not pause the player")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.D,false),smoke_key(.SPACE,false))
        // Begin a slider drag, close with Escape, release outside, then reopen by button.
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(820,294),smoke_button(true))
        assert(game.applied.blast_radius>4.5,"Radius slider did not update the preview value")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,true))
        assert(!game.panel_open && !rl.WindowShouldClose(),"Escape should resume without exiting")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,false),smoke_mouse(550,450),smoke_button(false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        assert(game.panel_open,"Closing a slider during drag left toolbar buttons captured")
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,785,368)
        assert(game.draft.pattern==2 && game.applied.pattern==0,"Breakup choice should be staged")
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,400,416)
        assert(!game.draft.generate_children && game.applied.generate_children)
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,780,622)
        assert(!game.panel_open && game.scene.materials[0].triangulate && game.scene.pieces[0].seed==0,"Apply & Reset did not apply the staged settings")
        assert(game.scene.materials[0].subdivision_strength==30 && game.scene.materials[0].flexibility==0.15,"Pattern changed independent tuning")
        a,b,c:=counts_runtime(&game.scene)
        assert(a==9 && b==11 && c==1,"Apply click also blasted the yard")
        // Blast outside the tower, then inspect and reset the moving result.
        view:=sandbox_view(1280,800)
        aim:=screen_point(view,{1,1.3})
        revision=game.scene.revision
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,i32(aim.x),i32(aim.y))
        remaining,_,_:=counts_runtime(&game.scene)
        assert(game.scene.revision>revision && remaining<9,"The first fresh world click after Apply did not blast")
        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.F3,true))
        assert(game.inspection)
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.F3,false))
        image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
        rl.ImageFlipVertical(&image)
        _ = rl.ExportImage(image,"sandbox-playthrough.png")
        rl.UnloadImage(image)
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.R,true))
        assert(b2.World_GetCounters(game.scene.physics.world).bodyCount==11 && len(game.scene.subdivisions)==9,"R did not restore a clean yard")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.R,false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        revision=game.scene.revision
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,785,230)
        assert(game.applied.blast_mode==.Falling_Bombs && game.scene.revision==revision,"Falling bombs toggle should apply without resetting the yard")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,true))
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,i32(aim.x),i32(aim.y))
        assert(game.scene.revision==revision,"World click still caused a manual blast in bomb mode")
        for _ in 0..<160 {

    @(test)
    falling_bomb_waits_for_landing_then_explodes_once :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        settings:=DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS; settings.blast_mode=.Falling_Bombs
        game:=sandbox_create(settings); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        game.bomb_rain.until_drop=1000
        bomb_spawn(&game,{-2,4.5})
        body:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].body
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetPosition(body).y<4.5 && b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body).y<0)
        testing.expect(t,!game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed && game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].fuse==BOMB_FUSE)
        for _ in 0..<180 {
            if game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed { break }
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
        }
        testing.expect(t,game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed && game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].fuse==BOMB_FUSE)
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetPosition(body).y>=BOMB_RADIUS-0.025 && b2.Body_GetPosition(body).y<=BOMB_RADIUS+0.025)
        for _ in 0..<59 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_IsValid(body) && len(game.bomb_rain.bursts)==0,"The bomb must remain physical for a full second after first landing")
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
        testing.expect(t,!b2.Body_IsValid(body) && len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==0 && len(game.bomb_rain.bursts)==1)
        testing.expect(t,close_vec(game.bomb_rain.bursts[0].position,{-2,BOMB_RADIUS}))
        for _ in 0..<60 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        testing.expect(t,len(game.bomb_rain.bursts)==0 && b2.World_GetCounters(game.scene.physics.world).bodyCount==11,"An exploded bomb must leave no physics object or repeated explosion")
    }

    bomb_fuse_needs_support_and_accepts_destructible_surfaces :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {

        settings:=DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS; settings.blast_mode=.Falling_Bombs

        b2.Body_SetTransform(body,{1.5-BOMB_RADIUS-0.005,1.25},b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,{1,0})
        for _ in 0..<20 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        testing.expect(t,!game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed,"Brushing a vertical wall must not count as landing")
        b2.Body_SetTransform(body,{2.8,3.2},b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,{})
        b2.Body_SetGravityScale(body,1)
        for _ in 0..<90 {
            if game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed { break }
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
        }
        testing.expect(t,game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed && b2.Body_GetPosition(body).y>2.6,"A bomb should rest and arm on the tower, not pass through it")
    }

        for _ in 0..<10 {
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
            if game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed && game.bomb_rain.bombs[1].landed { break }
        }
        testing.expect(t,game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed && game.bomb_rain.bombs[1].landed)
        revision:=game.scene.revision
        testing.expect(t,!sandbox_blast(&game,{1,1.3}) && game.scene.revision==revision,"Manual clicks must be disabled while bombs are active")
        sandbox_set_radius(&game,4.2)
        for _ in 0..<60 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        testing.expect(t,len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==0 && !b2.Body_IsValid(first) && !b2.Body_IsValid(second))
        testing.expect(t,len(game.bomb_rain.bursts)==2 && game.bomb_rain.bursts[0].radius==4.2)
        testing.expect(t,game.scene.revision>revision && !game.scene.subdivisions[game.scene.sub_rows[target]].live,"Landed bombs must invoke real destruction using the live radius")
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_IsValid(game.player.body) && b2.Body_IsValid(game.floor))
        expect_valid(t,&game.scene)
    }
    
    @(test)
    bomb_rain_random_drops_pause_switch_and_reset :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        settings:=DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS; settings.blast_mode=.Falling_Bombs
        game:=sandbox_create(settings); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        first_delay:=game.bomb_rain.until_drop
        testing.expect(t,first_delay>=BOMB_DROP_MIN && first_delay<=BOMB_DROP_MAX)
        for _ in 0..<160 {
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
            if len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0 { break }
        }
        first_body:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].body
        first_position:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].previous
        second_delay:=game.bomb_rain.until_drop
        testing.expect(t,first_position.y==BOMB_SKY_HEIGHT && first_position.x>=-7 && first_position.x<=8)
        testing.expect(t,second_delay>=BOMB_DROP_MIN-1.0/60.0 && second_delay<=BOMB_DROP_MAX && second_delay!=first_delay)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{},false)
        input:=sandbox_route_input(&game,{blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,!input.blast_pressed,"Input routing must also suppress manual blasts in bomb mode")
        for _ in 0..<160 {
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
            if game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed { break }
        }
        fuse:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].fuse
        delay:=game.bomb_rain.until_drop
        position:=b2.Body_GetPosition(first_body)
        bomb_count:=len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)
        sandbox_set_panel(&game,true)
        sandbox_advance(&game,5,{})
        testing.expect(t,game.bomb_rain.until_drop==delay && len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==bomb_count)
        testing.expect(t,game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].fuse==fuse && b2.Body_GetPosition(first_body)==position,"Settings must pause landed fuses as well as the spawn schedule and physics")
        revision:=game.scene.revision
        sandbox_set_blast_mode(&game,.Manual)
        testing.expect(t,game.applied.blast_mode==.Manual && game.draft.blast_mode==.Manual && game.scene.revision==revision)
        testing.expect(t,len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==0 && !b2.Body_IsValid(first_body),"Switching back must clear existing bombs without resetting the yard")
        sandbox_set_panel(&game,false)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{},false)
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{blast_pressed=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,input.blast_pressed)
        // Reset repeats the applied seed's drops and restores clean physics ownership.
        sandbox_set_blast_mode(&game,.Falling_Bombs)
        sandbox_reset(&game)
        testing.expect(t,game.bomb_rain.until_drop==first_delay && len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==0 && len(game.bomb_rain.bursts)==0)
        for _ in 0..<160 {
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
            if len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0 { break }
        }
        testing.expect(t,close_vec(game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].previous,first_position))
        game.bomb_rain.until_drop=0
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
        testing.expect(t,len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==2 && game.bomb_rain.bombs[1].previous.x!=first_position.x,"Successive drops should use different random sky positions")
        b2.Body_SetTransform(game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].body,{-2,-4},b2.MakeRot(0))
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
        testing.expect(t,len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==1 && len(game.bomb_rain.bursts)==0,"Bombs lost outside the yard must be cleaned up")
        sandbox_reset(&game)
        testing.expect(t,b2.World_GetCounters(game.scene.physics.world).bodyCount==11 && len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==0)
    }

    package main
    
    import "core:fmt"
    import "core:math"
    import rl "vendor:raylib"
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    
    review_tick: int
    review_log_failures: bool
    review_loads :: proc(s: ^Scene,dt: f32) -> Failures {
    	f:=calculate_physics_loads(s,dt)
    	if review_log_failures && len(f.subdivisions)+len(f.connections)>0 {
    		fmt.println("gravity tick",review_tick,"failed subs",f.subdivisions[:],"links",f.connections[:])
    		for id in f.connections {
    			c:=s.connections[s.conn_rows[id]]; joint:=s.physics.joints[id]
    			fmt.println("link",id,"endpoints",c.a,c.b,"force",b2.Joint_GetConstraintForce(joint),"torque",b2.Joint_GetConstraintTorque(joint))
    		}
    	}
    	return f
    }
    review_stats :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,label: string) {
    	speed,spin,height:=f32(0),f32(0),f32(0)
    	awake:=0
    	for sub in game.scene.subdivisions {
    		if !sub.live { continue }
    		speed=max(speed,vlen(sub.pose.velocity)); spin=max(spin,math.abs(sub.pose.angular_velocity)); height=max(height,sub.pose.position.y)
    		if b2.Body_IsAwake(game.scene.physics.bodies[sub.id]) { awake+=1 }
    	}
    	valid,message:=validate_scene(&game.scene); assert(valid,message)
    	fmt.printf("%s: regions/links/pieces=%v, max speed=%.4f spin=%.4f height=%.3f awake=%d bodies=%d bombs=%d\n",label,counts_runtime(&game.scene),speed,spin,height,awake,b2.World_GetCounters(game.scene.physics.world).bodyCount,len(game.bomb_rain.bombs))
    }
    main :: proc() {
    	fmt.println("IMPULSE SCALE",BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE,"defaults",DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS)
    	{
    		game:=sandbox_create()
    		review_log_failures=true
    		for i in 0..<360 { review_tick=i+1; physics_tick(&game.scene,1.0/60.0,review_loads) }
    		review_stats(&game,"untouched after 6s")
    		review_log_failures=false
    		sandbox_destroy(&game)
    	}
    	{
    		settings:=DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS; settings.blast_mode=.Falling_Bombs
    		game:=sandbox_create(settings); game.bomb_rain.until_drop=1000
    		bomb_spawn(&game,{-2,4.5})
    		for i in 0..<240 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false); if i==179 { review_stats(&game,"far fuse test after 3s") } }
    		review_stats(&game,"far fuse test after 4s")
    		sandbox_destroy(&game)
    	}
    	rl.SetTraceLogLevel(.WARNING)
    	rl.SetConfigFlags({.WINDOW_HIDDEN,.MSAA_4X_HINT})
    	rl.InitWindow(1600,960,"Physics response comparison"); defer rl.CloseWindow()
    	target:=rl.LoadRenderTexture(1600,960); defer rl.UnloadRenderTexture(target)
    	poses:=make(map[u64]Pose); defer delete(poses)
    	rl.BeginDrawing(); rl.BeginTextureMode(target); rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
    	for scenario in 0..<3 {

    		if scenario==1 { label="support hit" }

    		fmt.println("SCENARIO",label)
    		if scenario==2 {
    			sandbox_set_blast_mode(&game,.Falling_Bombs); game.bomb_rain.until_drop=1000
    			bomb_spawn(&game,{1.1,4})
    			body:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].body
    			for _ in 0..<240 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false); if !b2.Body_IsValid(body) { break } }
    			assert(!b2.Body_IsValid(body),"Bomb must land and finish its one-second fuse")
    		} else {
    			point:=Vec2{1,1.3}; if scenario==1 { point={3.8,-0.15} }
    			assert(sandbox_blast(&game,point))
    		}
    		review_stats(&game,"immediate launch")
    		frames:=[4]int{0,10,60,900}
    		tick:=0
    		for frame,column in frames {
    			for tick<frame { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false); tick+=1 }
    			review_stats(&game,fmt.tprintf("after %d ticks",frame))
    			x,y:=i32(column*400),i32(scenario*320)
    			rl.BeginScissorMode(x,y,400,320)
    			view:=View{offset={f32(x)+52,f32(y)+292},scale=48}
    			sandbox_draw_world(&game,view,poses)
    			rl.DrawRectangle(x,y,400,35,{19,28,42,255})
    			rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%s / %.1f / t=%.2f",label,BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE,f32(frame)/60),x+10,y+10,16,rl.WHITE)
    			rl.EndScissorMode()
    		}
    		sandbox_destroy(&game)
    	}
    	rl.EndTextureMode(); rl.EndDrawing()
    	img:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture); rl.ImageFlipVertical(&img)
    	assert(rl.ExportImage(img,rl.TextFormat("physics-response-%.1f.png",BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE))); rl.UnloadImage(img)
    }

    package main
    
    import rl "vendor:raylib"
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:fmt"
    
    // raylib 5.x automation event IDs (rcore.c); the Odin binding exposes the raw event.
    smoke_key :: proc(key: rl.KeyboardKey,down: bool) -> rl.AutomationEvent {
        type:=u32(1); if down { type=2 }
        return {type=type,params={i32(key),0,0,0}}
    }
    smoke_mouse :: proc(x,y: i32) -> rl.AutomationEvent {
        dpi:=rl.GetWindowScaleDPI()
        return {type=7,params={i32(f32(x)*dpi.x),i32(f32(y)*dpi.y),0,0}}
    }
    smoke_button :: proc(down: bool) -> rl.AutomationEvent {
        type:=u32(5); if down { type=6 }
        return {type=type,params={0,0,0,0}}
    }
    sandbox_smoke_frame :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,target: rl.RenderTexture2D,events: ..rl.AutomationEvent) {
        for event in events { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(event) }
        width,height:=f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight())
        view:=sandbox_view(width,height)
        mouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()
        over_ui:=sandbox_over_hud(mouse,width,height,game.inspection)
        raw:=sandbox_read_input()
        input:=sandbox_route_input(game,raw,over_ui)
        if !raw.menu_pressed && !raw.reset_pressed {
            if !sandbox_inspect_input(game,world_point(view,mouse),view,over_ui) && input.blast_pressed { sandbox_blast(game,world_point(view,mouse)) }
        }
        sandbox_advance(game,1.0/60.0,input)
        poses:=make(map[u64]Pose); defer delete(poses)
        rl.BeginDrawing()
        rl.BeginTextureMode(target)
        rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
        sandbox_draw_world(game,view,poses)
        if !game.panel_open && !over_ui { sandbox_draw_aim(game,view,mouse) }
        action:=sandbox_draw_hud(game,width,height)
        rl.EndTextureMode()
        rl.EndDrawing()
        sandbox_handle_ui(game,action)
    }
    sandbox_smoke_click :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,target: rl.RenderTexture2D,x,y: i32) {
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(x,y),smoke_button(true))
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(x,y),smoke_button(false))
    }
    sandbox_smoke_inputs :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        rl.SetTargetFPS(0)
        target:=rl.LoadRenderTexture(rl.GetScreenWidth(),rl.GetScreenHeight())
        defer rl.UnloadRenderTexture(target)
        for _ in 0..<60 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(30,40)) }
        assert(game.player.grounded,"Player did not land")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.D,true))
        for _ in 0..<45 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.D,false))
        assert(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).x>PLAYER_SPAWN.x+2,"D did not move the player")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.SPACE,true))
        assert(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y>5,"Space did not jump")
        // Keep holding jump through landing: there must be no repeated jump.
        for _ in 0..<120 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        assert(game.player.grounded,"Holding Space repeated a jump")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.SPACE,false))
        revision:=game.scene.revision
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        assert(game.panel_open && game.scene.revision==revision,"Settings click leaked into the world")
        pose:=b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)
        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.D,true),smoke_key(.SPACE,true)) }
        assert(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)==pose,"Menu did not pause the player")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.D,false),smoke_key(.SPACE,false))
        // Begin a slider drag, close with Escape, release outside, then reopen by button.
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(820,294),smoke_button(true))
        assert(game.applied.blast_radius>5.1,"Radius slider did not update the preview value")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,true))
        assert(!game.panel_open && !rl.WindowShouldClose(),"Escape should resume without exiting")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,false),smoke_mouse(550,450),smoke_button(false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        assert(game.panel_open,"Closing a slider during drag left toolbar buttons captured")
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,785,368)
        assert(game.draft.pattern==2 && game.applied.pattern==0,"Breakup choice should be staged")
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,400,416)
        assert(!game.draft.generate_children && game.applied.generate_children)
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,780,622)
        assert(!game.panel_open && game.scene.materials[0].triangulate && game.scene.pieces[0].seed==0,"Apply & Reset did not apply the staged settings")
        assert(game.scene.materials[0].subdivision_strength==30 && game.scene.materials[0].flexibility==0,"Pattern changed independent tuning")
        a,b,c:=counts_runtime(&game.scene)
        assert(a==9 && b==11 && c==1,"Apply click also blasted the yard")
        // Blast outside the tower, then inspect and reset the moving result.
        view:=sandbox_view(1280,800)
        aim:=screen_point(view,{1,1.3})
        revision=game.scene.revision
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,i32(aim.x),i32(aim.y))
        remaining,_,_:=counts_runtime(&game.scene)
        assert(game.scene.revision>revision && remaining<9,"The first fresh world click after Apply did not blast")
        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.F3,true))
        assert(game.inspection)
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.F3,false))
        image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
        rl.ImageFlipVertical(&image)
        _ = rl.ExportImage(image,"sandbox-playthrough.png")
        rl.UnloadImage(image)
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.R,true))
        assert(b2.World_GetCounters(game.scene.physics.world).bodyCount==11 && len(game.scene.subdivisions)==9,"R did not restore a clean yard")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.R,false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        revision=game.scene.revision
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,785,230)
        assert(game.applied.blast_mode==.Falling_Bombs && game.scene.revision==revision,"Falling bombs toggle should apply without resetting the yard")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,true))
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,i32(aim.x),i32(aim.y))
        assert(game.scene.revision==revision,"World click still caused a manual blast in bomb mode")
        for _ in 0..<160 {
            sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target)
            if len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0 { break }
        }
        assert(len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0,"Bomb mode did not spawn a falling physics object")
        first_bomb:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].body
        for _ in 0..<180 {
            if game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed { break }
            sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target)
        }
        assert(game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed,"The falling bomb did not land")
        for _ in 0..<20 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        bomb_image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
        rl.ImageFlipVertical(&bomb_image)
        _ = rl.ExportImage(bomb_image,"sandbox-bombs-preview.png")
        rl.UnloadImage(bomb_image)
        for _ in 0..<45 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        assert(!b2.Body_IsValid(first_bomb),"The landed bomb did not explode and disappear")
        for _ in 0..<160 {
            if len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0 { break }
            sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target)
        }
        bomb_body:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].body
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,480,230)
        assert(game.applied.blast_mode==.Manual && len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==0 && !b2.Body_IsValid(bomb_body),"Manual mode toggle did not remove pending bombs")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,true))
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,i32(aim.x),i32(aim.y))
        assert(game.scene.revision>revision,"Switching back did not restore manual blasts")
        fmt.println("Sandbox input smoke passed: movement, held jump, paused settings, slider drag, staged apply, blast, inspection, reset, both bomb-mode toggles, bomb landing and detonation.")
    }
    package main
    
    import "core:fmt"
    import "core:os"
    
    main :: proc() {
        for arg in os.args[1:] {
            if arg=="--smoke" { run_sandbox(true); return }
            if arg=="--smoke-settings" { run_sandbox(true,true); return }
            if arg=="--smoke-input" { run_sandbox(true,false,true); return }
            if arg=="--lab" { run_debug_view(false); return }
            if arg=="--headless" { run_headless(); return }
            if arg=="--serve" { run_debug_view(false,true); return }
            if arg=="--receive" { run_receiver(); return }
            if arg=="--help" { fmt.println("odin run . -- [--headless | --smoke | --smoke-settings | --smoke-input | --lab | --serve | --receive | --help]"); return }
        }
        run_sandbox()
    }
    
    run_headless :: proc() {
        s:=make_wall(42,0.08)
        defer scene_destroy(&s)
        physics_init(&s)
        fmt.println("Initial:",counts_runtime(&s))
        blast_pass(&s,Blast{position={1.5,0.5},radius=0.8})
        fmt.println("After blast:",counts_runtime(&s))
        for _ in 0..<60 { physics_tick(&s,1.0/60.0) }
        valid,message:=validate_scene(&s)
        assert(valid,message)
        assert(save_snapshot(&s,"snapshot.json"))
        fmt.println("After 60 ticks:",counts_runtime(&s),"| snapshot.json saved")
        receiver,ok:=load_snapshot("snapshot.json")
        assert(ok,"Snapshot receiver failed")
        defer scene_destroy(&receiver)
        fmt.println("Receiver:",counts_runtime(&receiver))
    }
