    package main
    
    import rl "vendor:raylib"
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    
    YARD_INK :: rl.Color{229,239,241,255}
    YARD_MUTED :: rl.Color{144,165,178,255}
    YARD_ACCENT :: rl.Color{111,220,190,255}
    
    // Fit a fixed rectangle with letterboxing. Fragments never affect the camera.
    sandbox_view :: proc(width,height: f32) -> View {
        scale:=min((width-64)/16,(height-170)/8.4)
        return View{offset={width*0.5-0.5*scale,(height+30)*0.5+2.8*scale},scale=scale}
    }
    sandbox_settings_button :: proc(width: f32) -> rl.Rectangle { return {width-174,24,150,38} }
    sandbox_reset_button :: proc(width: f32) -> rl.Rectangle { return {width-284,24,98,38} }
    sandbox_over_hud :: proc(mouse: rl.Vector2,width,height: f32,inspection: bool) -> bool {
        if mouse.y<88 || mouse.y>height-56 { return true }
        return inspection && rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(mouse,{24,106,450,150})
    }
    sandbox_gui_style :: proc() {
        rl.GuiLoadStyleDefault()
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiDefaultProperty.TEXT_SIZE),18)
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BORDER_COLOR_NORMAL),transmute(i32)u32(0x435969ff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BASE_COLOR_NORMAL),transmute(i32)u32(0x233444ff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.TEXT_COLOR_NORMAL),transmute(i32)u32(0xe5eff1ff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BORDER_COLOR_FOCUSED),transmute(i32)u32(0x6fdcbeff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BASE_COLOR_FOCUSED),transmute(i32)u32(0x304e58ff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.TEXT_COLOR_FOCUSED),transmute(i32)u32(0xe5fff4ff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BORDER_COLOR_PRESSED),transmute(i32)u32(0x6fdcbeff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BASE_COLOR_PRESSED),transmute(i32)u32(0x416d68ff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.TEXT_COLOR_PRESSED),transmute(i32)u32(0xffffffff))
    }
    sandbox_slider :: proc(x,y,width: f32,label: cstring,value: ^f32,low,high: f32,decimals: bool = false) {
        rl.DrawText(label,i32(x),i32(y),17,YARD_INK)
        text:=rl.TextFormat("%.0f",value^)
        if decimals { text=rl.TextFormat("%.2f",value^) }
        rl.DrawText(text,i32(x+width)-rl.MeasureText(text,17),i32(y),17,YARD_ACCENT)
        _ = rl.GuiSliderBar({x,y+25,width,16},nil,nil,value,low,high)
    }
    Sandbox_UI_Action :: enum { None, Open, Resume, Apply, Reset }
    sandbox_draw_panel :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,width,height: f32) -> Sandbox_UI_Action {
        rl.DrawRectangle(0,0,i32(width),i32(height),{8,14,23,205})
        panel_height:=f32(528)
        if game.tuning_open { panel_height=680 }
        x,y:=(width-560)*0.5,(height-panel_height)*0.5
        rl.DrawRectangleRounded({x,y,560,panel_height},0.025,8,{23,35,49,255})
        rl.DrawRectangleRoundedLinesEx({x,y,560,panel_height},0.025,8,1,{65,88,104,255})
        x+=28; y+=24
        rl.DrawText("SETTINGS",i32(x),i32(y),26,YARD_INK)
        rl.DrawText("Paused",i32(x+423),i32(y+7),16,YARD_ACCENT)
        y+=54
        mode:=i32(game.applied.blast_mode)
        _ = rl.GuiToggleGroup({x,y,248,32},"Manual blasts;Falling bombs",&mode)
        sandbox_set_blast_mode(game,Blast_Mode(mode))
        y+=48
        radius:=game.applied.blast_radius
        sandbox_slider(x,y,504,"Blast radius",&radius,0.5,6,true)
        sandbox_set_radius(game,radius)
        y+=63
        rl.DrawText("Breakup pattern",i32(x),i32(y),17,YARD_INK)
        y+=28
        active:=i32(game.draft.pattern)
        _ = rl.GuiToggleGroup({x,y,160,32},"Chunk;Splinter;Shatter",&active)
        game.draft.pattern=int(active)
        y+=54
        _ = rl.GuiCheckBox({x,y,22,22},"Generate children",&game.draft.generate_children)
        y+=40
        tuning_label:=cstring("+  Tuning")
        if game.tuning_open { tuning_label="-  Tuning" }
        if rl.GuiButton({x,y,504,30},tuning_label) { game.tuning_open=!game.tuning_open }
        y+=46
        if game.tuning_open {
            sandbox_slider(x,y,504,"Fragment strength",&game.draft.fragment_strength,5,100); y+=51
            sandbox_slider(x,y,504,"Connection strength",&game.draft.connection_strength,5,100); y+=51
            sandbox_slider(x,y,504,"Flexibility",&game.draft.flexibility,0,1,true); y+=50
        }
        rl.DrawText("A/D or arrows: move    Space: jump",i32(x),i32(y),16,YARD_MUTED); y+=22
        controls:=cstring("Click: blast    Wheel: radius / power    R: reset")
        if game.applied.blast_mode==.Falling_Bombs { controls="Bombs: 1 sec after landing    Wheel: power    R: reset" }
        rl.DrawText(controls,i32(x),i32(y),16,YARD_MUTED); y+=22
        rl.DrawText("Tab / Esc: settings    F3: inspection",i32(x),i32(y),16,YARD_MUTED); y+=28
        rl.DrawText("Mode and radius are live. Apply other edits to reset.",i32(x),i32(y),15,YARD_MUTED)
        button_y:=(height-panel_height)*0.5+panel_height-60
        if rl.GuiButton({x,button_y,180,36},"Resume") { return .Resume }
        if rl.GuiButton({x+196,button_y,308,36},"Apply & Reset") { return .Apply }
        return .None
    }
    sandbox_draw_bombs :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,view: View) {
        for burst in game.bomb_rain.bursts {
            progress:=burst.age/BOMB_BURST_TIME
            color:=rl.Color{255,200,112,u8(220*(1-progress))}
            rl.DrawCircleLinesV(screen_point(view,burst.position),burst.radius*view.scale*(0.2+0.8*progress),color)
        }
        for bomb in game.bomb_rain.bombs {
            position:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(bomb.body))
            if !game.panel_open { position=vadd(bomb.previous,vmul(vsub(position,bomb.previous),game.accumulator*60)) }
            center:=screen_point(view,position)
            radius:=BOMB_RADIUS*view.scale
            color:=rl.Color{245,206,133,255}
            if bomb.landed { color={255,132,112,255} }
            rl.DrawCircleV(center,radius,{39,42,50,255})
            rl.DrawCircleLinesV(center,radius,color)
            tip:=rl.Vector2{center.x+radius*0.5,center.y-radius*1.4}
            rl.DrawLineEx({center.x,center.y-radius*0.7},tip,2,color)
            rl.DrawCircleV(tip,2,color)
            if bomb.landed { rl.DrawRing(center,radius+3,radius+5,-90,-90+360*bomb.fuse/BOMB_FUSE,24,color) }
        }
    }
    sandbox_draw_world :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,view: View,poses: map[u64]Pose) {
        s:=&game.scene
        draw_scene(s,view,poses,game.selected,game.surface,game.inspection && game.joints,game.inspection)
        left,top:=screen_point(view,{-8,0}),screen_point(view,{9,-0.6})
        rl.DrawRectangleRec({left.x,left.y,top.x-left.x,top.y-left.y},{42,58,68,255})
        rl.DrawLineEx(left,screen_point(view,{9,0}),3,{116,151,151,255})
        for i in -15..=16 {
            x:=f32(i)*0.5
            rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,{x,-0.10}),screen_point(view,{x+0.15,-0.33}),2,{66,86,91,255})
        }
        spawn:=screen_point(view,{PLAYER_SPAWN.x,0})
        rl.DrawLineEx({spawn.x-16,spawn.y+12},{spawn.x+16,spawn.y+12},3,YARD_ACCENT)
        rl.DrawText("SPAWN",i32(spawn.x)-24,i32(spawn.y)+27,12,YARD_MUTED)
        sandbox_draw_bombs(game,view)
        position:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
        if !game.panel_open { position=vadd(game.previous_player,vmul(vsub(position,game.previous_player),game.accumulator*60)) }
        center:=screen_point(view,position)
        radius:=PLAYER_RADIUS*view.scale
        segment:=PLAYER_SEGMENT*view.scale
        rl.DrawRectangleRec({center.x-radius,center.y-segment,2*radius,2*segment},YARD_ACCENT)
        rl.DrawCircleV({center.x,center.y-segment},radius,YARD_ACCENT)
        rl.DrawCircleV({center.x,center.y+segment},radius,YARD_ACCENT)
        rl.DrawLineEx({center.x-radius*0.45,center.y-segment},{center.x+radius*0.45,center.y-segment},3,{21,51,53,255})
    }
    sandbox_draw_aim :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,view: View,mouse: rl.Vector2) {
        if game.applied.blast_mode!=.Manual { return }
        point:=world_point(view,mouse)
        color:=rl.Color{245,206,133,210}
        valid:=sandbox_valid_aim(&game.scene,point)
        if !valid { color={244,132,131,230} }
        rl.DrawCircleLinesV(mouse,game.applied.blast_radius*view.scale,color)
        rl.DrawCircleV(mouse,3,color)
        if !valid {
            rl.DrawLineEx({mouse.x-7,mouse.y-7},{mouse.x+7,mouse.y+7},2,color)
            rl.DrawLineEx({mouse.x+7,mouse.y-7},{mouse.x-7,mouse.y+7},2,color)
            label:=cstring("Aim outside the solid shape")
            x:=clamp(mouse.x+18,f32(12),f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()-rl.MeasureText(label,16)-12))
            y:=clamp(mouse.y+18,f32(94),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight()-80))
            rl.DrawRectangle(i32(x)-7,i32(y)-5,rl.MeasureText(label,16)+14,26,{19,28,42,240})
            rl.DrawText(label,i32(x),i32(y),16,color)
        }
    }
    sandbox_draw_hud :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,width,height: f32) -> Sandbox_UI_Action {
        // raygui clears its private slider capture only when a slider sees mouse-up.
        // Keep that release path alive if Escape closed the panel during a drag.
        if !game.panel_open && !rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT) {
            dummy:=f32(0)
            _ = rl.GuiSliderBar({-100,-100,20,10},nil,nil,&dummy,0,1)
        }
        rl.DrawRectangle(0,0,i32(width),88,{19,28,42,250})
        rl.DrawText("BLAST YARD",24,24,26,YARD_INK)
        mode_label:=cstring("Manual blasts / Click to place")
        if game.applied.blast_mode==.Falling_Bombs { mode_label="Falling bombs / 1 sec fuse on landing" }
        rl.DrawText(mode_label,25,56,15,YARD_MUTED)
        if !game.panel_open {
            if rl.GuiButton(sandbox_reset_button(width),"R  Reset") { return .Reset }
            if rl.GuiButton(sandbox_settings_button(width),"Tab  Settings") { return .Open }
        }
        rl.DrawRectangle(0,i32(height)-56,i32(width),56,{19,28,42,250})
        controls:=cstring("A/D Move   /   Space Jump   /   Click Blast   /   R Reset")
        if game.applied.blast_mode==.Falling_Bombs { controls="A/D Move   /   Space Jump   /   Falling Bombs   /   R Reset" }
        rl.DrawText(controls,24,i32(height)-35,17,YARD_INK)
        rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("Radius %.1f  /  Wheel",game.applied.blast_radius),i32(width)-222,i32(height)-35,17,YARD_ACCENT)
        if game.status_time>0 {
            text:=rl.TextFormat("%s",game.status)
            x:=i32(width)/2-rl.MeasureText(text,17)/2
            rl.DrawRectangle(x-16,i32(height)-102,rl.MeasureText(text,17)+32,32,{23,40,51,240})
            rl.DrawText(text,x,i32(height)-94,17,YARD_ACCENT)
        }
        if game.inspection {
            rl.DrawRectangleRounded({24,106,450,150},0.07,8,{22,36,51,240})
            rl.DrawText("INSPECTION  /  F3",40,120,18,YARD_ACCENT)
            a,b,c:=counts_runtime(&game.scene)
            rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%d regions  /  %d links  /  %d pieces",a,b,c),40,150,17,YARD_INK)
            rl.DrawText("Right click: select   Delete / Ctrl+click: remove",40,180,16,YARD_MUTED)
            rl.DrawText("Shift+click / X: break link   J: links   V: surface",40,204,16,YARD_MUTED)
            rl.DrawText("S: save snapshot   D: move   Space: jump",40,228,16,YARD_MUTED)
        }
        if game.panel_open { return sandbox_draw_panel(game,width,height) }
        return .None
    }
    sandbox_inspect_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2,view: View,over_ui: bool) -> bool {
        if !game.inspection || game.panel_open { return false }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.J) { game.joints=!game.joints }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.V) { game.surface=!game.surface }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.S) {
            if save_snapshot(&game.scene,"snapshot.json") { sandbox_notice(game,"Saved snapshot.json") }
        }
        if over_ui { return false }
        hover:=pick_subdivision(&game.scene,point)
        if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.RIGHT) { game.selected=hover }
        remove:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.DELETE)
        link:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.X)
        consumed:=false
        if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) && !game.block_blast {
            if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_CONTROL) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT_CONTROL) { game.selected=hover; remove=true; consumed=true }
            if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_SHIFT) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT_SHIFT) { link=true; consumed=true }
        }
        failures:=Failures{}
        if remove && game.selected!=0 { append(&failures.discard_subdivisions,game.selected); game.selected=0 }
        if link {
            id:=pick_connection(&game.scene,point,24/view.scale)
            if id!=0 { append(&failures.connections,id) }
        }
        if len(failures.discard_subdivisions)+len(failures.connections)>0 {
            apply_failures(&game.scene,failures)
            physics_sync_structure(&game.scene)
            clear(&game.previous)
        }
        delete(failures.discard_subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
        return consumed
    }
    sandbox_read_input :: proc() -> Sandbox_Input {
        move:=f32(0)
        if rl.IsKeyDown(.A) || rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT) { move-=1 }
        if rl.IsKeyDown(.D) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT) { move+=1 }
        return Sandbox_Input{move=move,jump_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.SPACE),jump_down=rl.IsKeyDown(.SPACE),blast_pressed=rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT),blast_down=rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT),menu_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.TAB) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.ESCAPE),reset_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.R),inspection_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.F3),wheel=rl.GetMouseWheelMove()}
    }
    sandbox_handle_ui :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,action: Sandbox_UI_Action) {
        switch action {
        case .Open: sandbox_set_panel(game,true)
        case .Resume: sandbox_set_panel(game,false)
        case .Apply: sandbox_apply_settings(game)
        case .Reset: sandbox_reset(game)
        case .None:
        }
        if action!=.None {
            game.block_jump=rl.IsKeyDown(.SPACE)
            game.block_blast=rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT)
        }
    }
    run_sandbox :: proc(smoke: bool = false,smoke_panel: bool = false,smoke_input: bool = false) {
        rl.SetTraceLogLevel(.WARNING)
        flags:=rl.ConfigFlags{.MSAA_4X_HINT,.WINDOW_RESIZABLE,.WINDOW_HIGHDPI}
        if smoke { flags+={.WINDOW_HIDDEN} }
        rl.SetConfigFlags(flags)
        rl.InitWindow(1280,800,"Blast Yard | Odin + Box2D")
        defer rl.CloseWindow()
        rl.SetWindowMinSize(900,700)
        rl.SetExitKey(.KEY_NULL)
        rl.SetTargetFPS(60)
        sandbox_gui_style()
        game:=sandbox_create()
        defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        if smoke_input { sandbox_smoke_inputs(&game); return }
        if smoke_panel { sandbox_set_panel(&game,true); game.tuning_open=true }
        poses:=make(map[u64]Pose); defer delete(poses)
        target:=rl.RenderTexture2D{}
        if smoke { target=rl.LoadRenderTexture(rl.GetScreenWidth(),rl.GetScreenHeight()) }
        defer { if smoke { rl.UnloadRenderTexture(target) } }
        frames:=0
        for !rl.WindowShouldClose() {
            width,height:=f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight())
            view:=sandbox_view(width,height)
            mouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()
            over_ui:=sandbox_over_hud(mouse,width,height,game.inspection)
            raw:=sandbox_read_input()
            input:=sandbox_route_input(&game,raw,over_ui)
            point:=world_point(view,mouse)
            if !raw.menu_pressed && !raw.reset_pressed {
                if !sandbox_inspect_input(&game,point,view,over_ui) && input.blast_pressed { sandbox_blast(&game,point) }
            }
            sandbox_advance(&game,rl.GetFrameTime(),input)
            clear(&poses)
            for sub in game.scene.subdivisions {
                if !sub.live { continue }
                pose:=sub.pose
                if old,ok:=game.previous[sub.id]; ok && !game.panel_open { pose=interpolate_pose(old,pose,game.accumulator*60) }
                poses[sub.id]=pose
            }
            rl.BeginDrawing()
            if smoke { rl.BeginTextureMode(target) }
            rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
            sandbox_draw_world(&game,view,poses)
            if !game.panel_open && !over_ui { sandbox_draw_aim(&game,view,mouse) }
            action:=sandbox_draw_hud(&game,width,height)
            if smoke {
                rl.EndTextureMode()
                rl.DrawTextureRec(target.texture,{0,0,f32(target.texture.width),-f32(target.texture.height)},{0,0},rl.WHITE)
            }
            rl.EndDrawing()
            sandbox_handle_ui(&game,action)
            frames+=1
            if smoke && frames==2 {
                image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
                rl.ImageFlipVertical(&image)
                name:=cstring("sandbox-preview.png"); if smoke_panel { name="sandbox-settings-preview.png" }
                _ = rl.ExportImage(image,name)
                rl.UnloadImage(image)
                break
            }
        }
    }
    package main
    
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    Player_Tuning :: struct {
        speed, acceleration, jump_speed, coyote_time, jump_buffer: f32,
    }
    PLAYER_TUNING :: Player_Tuning{4,32,6.3,0.1,0.1}
    PLAYER_RADIUS :: f32(0.26)
    PLAYER_SEGMENT :: f32(0.30)
    PLAYER_HALF_HEIGHT :: PLAYER_RADIUS+PLAYER_SEGMENT
    PLAYER_SPAWN :: Vec2{-4.5,0.65}
    
    // The player is an ordinary body in the shared world, outside the destruction graph.
    Player :: struct {
        body: b2.BodyId,
        grounded: bool,
        coyote, buffered_jump: f32,
        support_velocity: Vec2,
    }
    player_create :: proc(world: b2.WorldId) -> Player {
        def:=b2.DefaultBodyDef()
        def.type=.dynamicBody
        def.position=to_b2(PLAYER_SPAWN)
        def.fixedRotation=true
        def.enableSleep=false
        body:=b2.CreateBody(world,def)
        shape:=b2.DefaultShapeDef()
        shape.density=0.65
        shape.material.friction=0.15
        _ = b2.CreateCapsuleShape(body,shape,b2.Capsule{center1={0,-PLAYER_SEGMENT},center2={0,PLAYER_SEGMENT},radius=PLAYER_RADIUS})
        return Player{body=body}
    }
    player_respawn :: proc(player: ^Player) {
        body:=player.body
        b2.Body_SetTransform(body,to_b2(PLAYER_SPAWN),b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,{})
        b2.Body_SetAngularVelocity(body,0)
        player^=Player{body=body}
    }
    player_clear_input :: proc(player: ^Player) {
        player.buffered_jump=0
        player.coyote=0
    }
    player_read_support :: proc(player: ^Player) {
        player.grounded=false
        player.support_velocity={}
        position:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(player.body))
        velocity:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(player.body))
        buffer:=make([]b2.ContactData,int(b2.Body_GetContactCapacity(player.body)))
        defer delete(buffer)
        for contact in b2.Body_GetContactData(player.body,buffer) {
            a,b:=b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdA),b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdB)
            normal:=from_b2(contact.manifold.normal)
            other:=a
            if a==player.body { normal=vmul(normal,-1); other=b }
            if normal.y<0.55 { continue }
            for i in 0..<int(contact.manifold.pointCount) {
                point:=contact.manifold.points[i]
                support_velocity:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetWorldPointVelocity(other,point.point))
                if point.separation<=0.025 && point.point.y<position.y-0.1 && vdot(vsub(velocity,support_velocity),normal)<0.8 {
                    player.grounded=true
                    player.support_velocity=support_velocity
                }
            }
        }
    }
    player_before_step :: proc(player: ^Player,move: f32,jump_pressed: bool,dt: f32) {
        player_read_support(player)
        if player.grounded { player.coyote=PLAYER_TUNING.coyote_time } else { player.coyote=max(f32(0),player.coyote-dt) }
        if jump_pressed { player.buffered_jump=PLAYER_TUNING.jump_buffer }
        velocity:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(player.body))
        target:=clamp(move,f32(-1),f32(1))*PLAYER_TUNING.speed
        velocity.x+=clamp(target-velocity.x,-PLAYER_TUNING.acceleration*dt,PLAYER_TUNING.acceleration*dt)
        if player.buffered_jump>0 && player.coyote>0 {
            velocity.y=PLAYER_TUNING.jump_speed+max(f32(0),player.support_velocity.y)
            player.grounded=false
            player.coyote=0
            player.buffered_jump=0
        }
        player.buffered_jump=max(f32(0),player.buffered_jump-dt)
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(player.body,to_b2(velocity))
    }
    player_after_step :: proc(player: ^Player) -> bool {
        position:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(player.body))
        if position.x < -8.5 || position.x > 9.5 || position.y < -3 || position.y > 12 || math.is_nan(position.y) {
            player_respawn(player)
            return true
        }
        player_read_support(player)
        return false
    }
    # Odin destruction sandbox
    
    A standalone implementation of `destruction-model-implementation-plan.md` and `playable-sandbox-ux-plan.md`, using Odin's bundled Box2D, raylib and raygui libraries. The default application is a small playable destruction yard. The original diagnostic lab and localhost snapshot transport remain available.
    
    ## Run
    
    Requires an Odin installation with compiled `vendor:box2d` and `vendor:raylib` libraries. Tested on Windows with Odin `dev-2026-05-nightly:ea5175d`.
    
    ```powershell
    odin run .
    odin test . -out:BOM-tests.exe
    odin build . -o:speed -out:BOM.exe
    ```
    
    The application opens into a fixed side-view yard with a floor, an invulnerable capsule player and a destructible stepped tower. Walk, jump onto or push debris, aim outside a solid shape and click to blast. Ordinary gravity runs at a fixed 60 Hz with four Box2D substeps. The camera keeps the yard framed when the window resizes. Falling outside the yard returns the player to spawn.
    
    | Control | Action |
    | --- | --- |
    | A / D or left / right arrows | Move |
    | Space | Jump, with a 0.1 second jump buffer and coyote window |
    | Left click in the world | One blast at a valid cursor position |
    | Mouse wheel over the world | Adjust blast radius and power |
    | R / Reset button | Restore the same applied setup and seed |
    | Tab / Escape / Settings button | Open settings and pause; close to resume |
    | F3 | Toggle IDs, connections, counts and inspection tools |
    
    The aiming circle shows the active blast radius. A red cross and message mark origins inside or on live logical outlines; those blasts are suppressed. UI clicks do not blast the world. The settings panel pauses physics, fading and player actions without accumulating simulation time.
    
    In Settings, switch **Manual blasts / Falling bombs** to choose the explosion source immediately, without resetting the yard. Falling bombs spawn at random horizontal positions across the yard every 1â€“2.5 seconds. Each is an ordinary circle body that collides with the floor, debris and player. Its one-second fuse starts on first landing on a supporting surface, including the tower; airborne time and side contacts do not start the fuse. A red countdown ring marks a lit fuse. The body disappears when it explodes at its current position, using the current blast radius, with a brief expanding flash. Manual placement and its aiming circle are disabled in this mode. Returning to Manual clears pending bombs. Settings pauses drops, fuses and flashes along with physics. Reset clears bombs and repeats the applied seed's drop sequence, independently of destruction generation.
    
    Mode and radius changes are immediate, including inside settings. Breakup pattern, fragment strength, connection strength, flexibility and Generate children are staged until **Apply & Reset**. Resume keeps the previously applied setup. Strength and flexibility stay independent of Chunk / Splinter / Shatter. The initial setup uses manual blasts, seed 42, strengths 30 / 24, flexibility 0 (stiff welds) and radius 5.0. Positive flexibility remains available in Settings. Turning Generate children off uses seed zero; geometry stays live until it fails.
    
    With F3 enabled: right click selects, Delete or Ctrl+click directly removes a region, Shift+click or X near an anchor breaks a connection, J toggles links, V toggles the cosmetic surface, and S saves `snapshot.json`. D and Space retain movement and jump in inspection mode.
    
    Run `odin run . -- --lab` for the original zero-gravity diagnostic fixture and its legacy shortcuts (projectile I, presets 1/2/3, terminal T, pause/step Space/N, radius Q/E, pan/zoom, and snapshot save/load S/L). The existing sender and receiver use that diagnostic fixture; player and floor replication are outside this local milestone.
    
    For automated execution:
    
    ```powershell
    odin run . -- --headless
    odin run . -- --smoke
    odin run . -- --smoke-settings
    odin run . -- --smoke-input
    ```
    
    `--headless` evaluates the original diagnostic blast, runs 60 physics ticks, validates the graph, writes `snapshot.json`, and reconstructs a receiver. `--smoke` renders the yard in a hidden window to `sandbox-preview.png`. `--smoke-settings` renders the expanded paused panel to `sandbox-settings-preview.png`. Both exit after two frames.
    
    `--smoke-input` uses raylib's native automation events in a hidden window to exercise the actual keyboard bindings and raygui widgets: movement, holding jump through landing, paused settings, closing a slider drag with Escape, immediate radius updates, staged pattern/generation changes, Apply & Reset, the first subsequent blast click, inspection, R reset, switching into Falling bombs, automatic spawning, landing, detonation and switching back to manual placement. It asserts the results and exports `sandbox-playthrough.png` and `sandbox-bombs-preview.png`. The normal behavior suite stays independent of a window or display.
    
    ## Live transmission
    
    Build once, then run these in separate terminals:
    
    ```powershell
    .\BOM.exe --serve
    .\BOM.exe --receive
    ```
    
    The sender listens on **127.0.0.1:9901** for one receiver. It sends explicit complete snapshots after structural changes and at 10 Hz for motion. The receiver renders polygons, connections, ownership and interpolated motion without simulating physics. Destroy or split the wall in the sender to see the receiver update.
    
    Frames contain a four byte little endian payload length followed by UTF-8 JSON, capped at 4 MiB. Partial reads, partial writes, coalesced frames and disconnects are handled. One in-flight send is retained; the sender does not accumulate a queue of old states. `read_state`, `encode_snapshot` and `decode_snapshot` can also be used with another transport.
    
    Snapshots carry current geometry, materials, stable IDs, piece memberships, future generation seeds, structural revision, and body motion. Version 2 retains each subdivision's birth seed context; version 1 snapshots still load using their original piece contexts. Widths and anchors are derived from the transmitted outlines. Infinite strengths have explicit flags so snapshots remain valid JSON. Seeds never reconstruct existing damaged geometry.
    
    ## Implementation
    
    | File | Responsibility |
    | --- | --- |
    | `model.odin` | Stable identity, shared reference vertex pool, birth contexts, cached outline widths, memberships and group filtering |
    | `geometry.odin` | Shared boundaries, displaced cuts, convex hull and collision decomposition |
    | `destruction.odin` | Seeded generation, blast evaluation and the shared structural update |
    | `physics.odin` | Box2D bodies, fixtures, weld joints, interaction aggregation and load policy |
    | `state.odin` | State reader, snapshot validation, serialization and pose interpolation |
    | `transmission.odin` | Framed localhost TCP snapshots and the receiver application |
    | `debug_view.odin` | Native controls, rendering and material presets |
    | `player.odin` | Capsule controller, contact support, buffered jumps and respawn |
    | `yard.odin` | Yard creation/reset, applied and staged settings, aim validation and input routing |
    | `bombs.odin` | Falling-bomb mode, independent drop randomness, physics bodies, landing fuses and explosions |
    | `sandbox_view.odin` | Fixed camera, compact HUD, raygui panel and inspection input |
    | `sandbox_smoke.odin` | Hidden-window native input and widget playthrough |
    | `behavior_test.odin` | Focused behavior and integration checks |
    | `recursive_blast_test.odin` | Same-blast termination, child contexts, conservative deletion and recursive agreement |
    | `generation_test.odin` | Concave parent merging, material patterns, partition coverage and distinct yard birth contexts |
    | `sandbox_test.odin` | Gravity stability, movement, debris contact, resets, settings and input consumption |
    | `bombs_test.odin` | Real landing contacts, one-second fuses, blast integration, pause, mode switches and bomb cleanup |
    
    IDs are monotonic and mapped to storage rows. Removed rows and outline ranges remain retained until `scene_destroy`; no world repacking is performed. Subdivision outlines use ranges into one append-only vertex pool in a common undeformed reference frame. Their `outline` slices are derived views refreshed when the pool grows. Borrowed polygon views must not be held across scene mutations. `add_subdivision` copies its input; the caller retains ownership of that input allocation. `make_polygon` creates an owned polygon.
    
    Current subdivisions and connections exist when a piece is created. Future geometry is generated only when a subdivision fails. `apply_failures` stages one generation for physics reactions and manual failures. `blast_pass` reuses that staging operation in a simple loop: evaluate the current geometry, replace failures, and evaluate new children and connections against the same blast until nothing else fails. Only then regroup affected pieces, filter connected groups and synchronize physics. A failed connection cannot be healed by proximity; only surviving old attachments are inherited. Failure IDs and groups use stable ordering, including when storage rows are shuffled. `discard_subdivisions` provides direct removal independently of a generative seed.
    
    Each child receives its future seed context at birth, derived from its parent's context and child ordinal. Allocation IDs and later ownership changes do not affect that context. When every sibling's cached outline width is at or below the subdivision cutoff, the whole batch receives seed zero. Mixed batches retain nonzero contexts, with an individual width guard before further generation. Seed-zero geometry remains live until it fails. Connected-group width filtering remains a separate final step.
    
    Before generating a failed outline, the blast can remove it directly when its farthest posed vertex proves every descendant will fail. This assumes partition-preserving generation, shared material strength, an unoccluded radial load and unchanged transforms during the event. The bound rounds distance outward with `nextafter`, uses a strict `1e-4` load margin and declines nonfinite inputs. Skipping a branch leaves other branches' seeds unchanged. `blast_pass(..., false)` disables the shortcut for correctness comparisons; normal play enables it.
    
    Generation clips convex regions. For a concave Chunk or Splinter parent, the existing convex decomposition merges adjacent triangulation ears before applying the requested cuts; a small shared-edge bend does not automatically become a fan of independent fragments. Shatter deliberately retains triangulation. Each internal displaced cut is generated once and installed in both adjacent outlines. Displacement is limited by clearance to other edges as well as area and length. Outside boundaries remain intact. Count is a target before final triangulation; complex concave outlines and the shatter preset can produce more children. If generation cannot produce a genuine partition of at least two smaller regions, the failed subdivision is removed directly. A valid partition is retained even when area limits prevent reaching the requested count. Aspect ratio biases cut direction. Self-intersecting outlines and polygons with holes are outside this implementation's input domain. Starting yard blocks derive distinct birth contexts from the applied seed and their stable grid coordinates; reset repeats the same contexts.
    
    The load policy uses the strongest individual interaction, preserving opposing interactions against different bodies. Contact points and convex fixtures against the same other body are combined. Joint reactions also load their endpoint subdivisions. Thresholds use `load > 0 && load >= strength`; strength records are never reduced by prior events. `physics_tick` accepts a replacement `Load_Calculator` function.
    
    Blast radius controls both reach and power: direct load is `10 * max(0, radius - distance)`, with zero load for nonpositive radii. The fixed global `BLAST_LOAD_MULTIPLIER` is 10; increasing radius increases load at a fixed distance, without a fixed maximum. For example, a sample 0.5 units away receives load 5 at radius 1 and load 25 at radius 3, enough to fail strength 20. At the default radius 5.0 and strengths 30 / 24, subdivision samples can fail within 2.0 units and connection samples within 2.6. Impulses are `direction * load * mass * 0.2`, applied through each final survivor's center once at its own sample. This doubles the previous direct velocity kick; a surviving default-material fragment receives less than roughly 6 units/second of added speed. Generated motion includes the parent's linear and angular motion; removed ancestors receive no blast impulse. New contact and joint reactions wait for the next solver step. Both tuning constants and the falloff live in `destruction.odin`. The torque reference length is one world unit, and global joint damping is 0.7. Flexibility zero selects a stiff weld; positive flexibility selects spring softness.
    
    Contact `totalNormalImpulse` is converted using the full tick interval. The installed binding's tangent and rolling impulses use the final substep interval. Joint reactions already supply force and torque. See the [Box2D simulation documentation](https://box2d.org/documentation/md_simulation.html) and [contact solver source](https://github.com/erincatto/box2d/blob/v3.1.1/src/contact_solver.c) for the underlying quantities.
    
    Collision decomposition merges adjacent convex regions. Box2D can collapse microscopic ears during hull welding; those ears are omitted from fixtures, and a subdivision with no resolvable fixture receives a small bounding box proxy. The destruction outline, logical identity, polygon mass and inertia remain retained. Collision fixtures never become additional destruction entities.
    
    Group width is the minimum projection width of its reference geometry's convex hull. Small subdivisions remain live when their connected group is wide enough. Narrow resulting groups become one second visual remnants before fading. New groups are filtered before any new bodies are created. Rendering interpolates poses and optionally blends shared presentation vertices across flexible joints; it does not modify collision or failure geometry.
    
    ## Verification

    sandbox_reset :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        revision:=game.scene.revision+1
        scene_destroy(&game.scene)
        s:=&game.scene
        s^=new_scene(0.10)
        s.revision=revision
        material:=add_material(s,sandbox_material(game.applied))
        seed:=game.applied.seed
        if !game.applied.generate_children { seed=0 }
        owner:=add_piece(s,material,seed)
        // A stepped stack, with one common reference frame and real shared edges.
        for row in 0..<3 {
            for column in 0..<4-row {
                // Start on the floor: the former 5 mm drop overloaded stiff joints on landing.
                x,y:=f32(1.5)+f32(column)*0.85,f32(row)*0.85
                points:=[4]Vec2{{x,y},{x+0.85,y},{x+0.85,y+0.85},{x,y+0.85}}
                outline:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
                id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline)})
                // Stable block coordinates give neighboring roots distinct birth contexts.
                s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].seed=derive_seed(seed,u64(row*4+column+1))
                append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
            }
        }
        for a in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            for b in a+1..<len(s.subdivisions) { add_connection(s,s.subdivisions[a].id,s.subdivisions[b].id) }
        }
        for connection in s.connections { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].connections,connection.id) }
        physics_init(s,{0,-9.8})
        def:=b2.DefaultBodyDef()
        def.position={0.5,-0.3}
        game.floor=b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
        shape:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); shape.material.friction=0.65
        _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(game.floor,shape,b2.MakeBox(8.5,0.3))
        game.player=player_create(s.physics.world)
        bomb_rain_reset(&game.bomb_rain,game.applied.seed)
        game.selected=0
        sandbox_clear_input(game)
        sandbox_notice(game,"Yard reset")
    }

    // Inclusive edges are solid too. Use the logical posed outline, not the cosmetic mesh.
    point_in_subdivision :: proc(sub: Subdivision,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        local:=vadd(sub.rest_center,vrotate(vsub(point,sub.pose.position),-sub.pose.angle))
        inside:=false
        for a,i in sub.outline.points {
            b:=sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)]
            edge:=vsub(b,a); relative:=vsub(local,a)
            if math.abs(vcross(edge,relative))<0.00001 && vdot(relative,edge)>=0 && vdot(relative,edge)<=vdot(edge,edge) { return true }
            if (a.y>local.y)!=(b.y>local.y) && local.x<(b.x-a.x)*(local.y-a.y)/(b.y-a.y)+a.x { inside=!inside }
        }
        return inside
    }
    sandbox_valid_aim :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live && point_in_subdivision(sub,point) { return false } }
        return true
    }
    sandbox_blast :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        if game.panel_open || game.applied.blast_mode!=.Manual { return false }
        if !sandbox_valid_aim(&game.scene,point) { sandbox_notice(game,"Aim outside the solid shape"); return false }
        sandbox_explode(game,point)
        return true
    }
    sandbox_explode :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2) {

        clear(&game.previous)

    sandbox_route_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,raw: Sandbox_Input,over_ui: bool) -> Sandbox_Input {
        if raw.inspection_pressed { game.inspection=!game.inspection }
        if raw.menu_pressed {
            sandbox_set_panel(game,!game.panel_open)
            game.block_jump=raw.jump_down
            game.block_blast=raw.blast_down
            return {}
        }
        if !raw.jump_down { game.block_jump=false }
        if !raw.blast_down { game.block_blast=false }
        if game.panel_open { return {} }
        if raw.reset_pressed {
            sandbox_reset(game)
            game.block_jump=raw.jump_down
            game.block_blast=raw.blast_down
            return {}
        }
        result:=raw
        result.jump_pressed=raw.jump_pressed && !game.block_jump
        result.blast_pressed=raw.blast_pressed && !game.block_blast && !over_ui && game.applied.blast_mode==.Manual
        if over_ui { result.wheel=0 }
        if result.wheel!=0 { sandbox_set_radius(game,game.applied.blast_radius+result.wheel*0.2) }
        return result
    }

    sandbox_inspect_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2,view: View,over_ui: bool) -> bool {
        if !game.inspection || game.panel_open { return false }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.J) { game.joints=!game.joints }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.V) { game.surface=!game.surface }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.S) {
            if save_snapshot(&game.scene,"snapshot.json") { sandbox_notice(game,"Saved snapshot.json") }
        }
        if over_ui { return false }
        hover:=pick_subdivision(&game.scene,point)
        if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.RIGHT) { game.selected=hover }
        remove:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.DELETE)
        link:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.X)
        consumed:=false
        if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) && !game.block_blast {
            if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_CONTROL) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT_CONTROL) { game.selected=hover; remove=true; consumed=true }
            if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_SHIFT) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT_SHIFT) { link=true; consumed=true }
        }
        failures:=Failures{}
        if remove && game.selected!=0 { append(&failures.discard_subdivisions,game.selected); game.selected=0 }
        if link {
            id:=pick_connection(&game.scene,point,24/view.scale)
            if id!=0 { append(&failures.connections,id) }
        }
        if len(failures.discard_subdivisions)+len(failures.connections)>0 {
            apply_failures(&game.scene,failures)
            physics_sync_structure(&game.scene)
            clear(&game.previous)
        }
        delete(failures.discard_subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
        return consumed
    }

        return Sandbox_Input{move=move,jump_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.SPACE),jump_down=rl.IsKeyDown(.SPACE),blast_pressed=rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT),blast_down=rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT),menu_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.TAB) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.ESCAPE),reset_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.R),inspection_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.F3),wheel=rl.GetMouseWheelMove()}
    }

        case .Resume: sandbox_set_panel(game,false)

        case .None:
        }

            game.block_jump=rl.IsKeyDown(.SPACE)
            game.block_blast=rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT)

    }

            }

    import "core:encoding/json"
    import "core:math"
    import "core:os"
    import "core:strings"
    
    Wire_Material :: struct {
        name: string,
        subdivision_strength,connection_strength: f32,
        subdivision_infinite,connection_infinite: bool,
        flexibility: f32,
        generation_count: int,
        aspect_ratio: f32,
        triangulate: bool,
    }
    Wire_Connection :: struct { id,a,b: u64 }
    Snapshot :: struct {
        version: int,
        next_id: u64,
        revision: u64,
        minimum_width: f32,
        materials: [dynamic]Wire_Material,
        subdivisions: [dynamic]Subdivision,
        connections: [dynamic]Wire_Connection,
        pieces: [dynamic]Piece,
    }
    finite :: proc(value: f32) -> bool { return !math.is_nan(value) && !math.is_inf(value) }
    valid_vec :: proc(v: Vec2) -> bool { return finite(v.x) && finite(v.y) }
    validate_scene :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> (bool,string) {
        membership := make(map[u64]int)
        defer delete(membership)
        for p in s.pieces {
            if !p.live { continue }
            if len(p.subdivisions) == 0 { return false,"empty live piece" }
            if p.material < 0 || p.material >= len(s.materials) { return false,"invalid material" }
            for id in p.subdivisions {
                row,ok := s.sub_rows[id]
                if !ok { return false,"missing subdivision" }
                sub := s.subdivisions[row]
                if !sub.live || sub.owner != p.id || sub.material != p.material { return false,"invalid subdivision ownership" }
                membership[id] += 1
            }
            for id in p.connections {
                row,ok := s.conn_rows[id]
                if !ok || !s.connections[row].live { return false,"invalid connection membership" }
                c := s.connections[row]
                if !contains_id(p.subdivisions[:],c.a) || !contains_id(p.subdivisions[:],c.b) { return false,"connection crosses pieces" }
            }
            visited := make(map[u64]bool)
            queue: [dynamic]u64
            append(&queue,p.subdivisions[0]); visited[p.subdivisions[0]] = true
            for head := 0; head < len(queue); head += 1 {
                for id in p.connections {
                    c := s.connections[s.conn_rows[id]]
                    other := u64(0)
                    if c.a == queue[head] { other=c.b } else if c.b == queue[head] { other=c.a }
                    if other != 0 && !visited[other] { visited[other]=true; append(&queue,other) }
                }
            }
            connected := len(queue) == len(p.subdivisions)
            delete(queue); delete(visited)
            if !connected { return false,"piece is disconnected" }
        }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            if membership[sub.id] != 1 { return false,"subdivision must belong to exactly one piece" }
            if len(sub.outline.points) < 3 || polygon_area(sub.outline) <= 0 { return false,"invalid polygon" }
            for point in sub.outline.points { if !valid_vec(point) { return false,"invalid polygon coordinate" } }
            if !valid_vec(sub.pose.position) || !valid_vec(sub.pose.velocity) || !finite(sub.pose.angle) || !finite(sub.pose.angular_velocity) { return false,"invalid motion" }
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            a_row,a_ok := s.sub_rows[c.a]; b_row,b_ok := s.sub_rows[c.b]
            if !a_ok || !b_ok { return false,"missing endpoint" }
            a,b := s.subdivisions[a_row],s.subdivisions[b_row]
            if !a.live || !b.live || a.owner != b.owner { return false,"invalid live connection endpoints" }
            p := s.pieces[s.piece_rows[a.owner]]
            if !contains_id(p.connections[:],c.id) { return false,"connection absent from its piece" }
        }
        return true,""
    }
    
    // A shallow read view. Geometry and memberships remain owned by the scene.
    read_state :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> Snapshot {
        out := Snapshot{version=2,next_id=s.next_id,revision=s.revision,minimum_width=s.minimum_width}
        for m in s.materials {
            wire := Wire_Material{name=m.name,subdivision_strength=m.subdivision_strength,connection_strength=m.connection_strength,flexibility=m.flexibility,generation_count=m.generation_count,aspect_ratio=m.aspect_ratio,triangulate=m.triangulate}
            if math.is_inf(m.subdivision_strength) { wire.subdivision_infinite=true; wire.subdivision_strength=0 }
            if math.is_inf(m.connection_strength) { wire.connection_infinite=true; wire.connection_strength=0 }
            append(&out.materials,wire)
        }
        ids: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(ids)
        for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live { append(&ids,sub.id) } }
        sort_ids(ids[:])
        for id in ids { append(&out.subdivisions,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]]) }
        clear(&ids)
        for c in s.connections { if c.live { append(&ids,c.id) } }
        sort_ids(ids[:])
        for id in ids { c:=s.connections[s.conn_rows[id]]; append(&out.connections,Wire_Connection{c.id,c.a,c.b}) }
        clear(&ids)
        for p in s.pieces { if p.live { append(&ids,p.id) } }
        sort_ids(ids[:])
        for id in ids { append(&out.pieces,s.pieces[s.piece_rows[id]]) }
        return out
    }
    release_state_view :: proc(snapshot: ^Snapshot) {
        delete(snapshot.materials); delete(snapshot.subdivisions); delete(snapshot.connections); delete(snapshot.pieces)
        snapshot^ = {}
    }
    encode_snapshot :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> ([]byte,bool) {
        view := read_state(s)
        defer release_state_view(&view)
        data,err := json.marshal(view,{pretty=true})
        return data,err == nil
    }
    destroy_decoded_snapshot :: proc(snapshot: ^Snapshot) {
        for m in snapshot.materials { delete(m.name) }
        for sub in snapshot.subdivisions { delete(sub.outline.points) }
        for p in snapshot.pieces { delete(p.subdivisions); delete(p.connections) }
        release_state_view(snapshot)
    }

    import "core:testing"

    @(test)
    yard_rests_under_gravity_and_player_moves_and_jumps :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        for _ in 0..<360 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        a,b,c:=counts(&game.scene)
        testing.expect(t,a==9 && b==11 && c==1,"The initial structure must remain intact under ordinary gravity")
        testing.expect(t,game.player.grounded)
        testing.expect(t,close(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y,PLAYER_HALF_HEIGHT))
        for sub in game.scene.subdivisions { testing.expect(t,vlen(vsub(sub.pose.position,sub.rest_center))<0.04) }
        for _ in 0..<50 { sandbox_tick(&game,1,false) }
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).x > PLAYER_SPAWN.x+2)
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,true)
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y>5 && !game.player.grounded)
        max_height:=f32(0)
        for _ in 0..<150 {
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
            max_height=max(max_height,b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y)
        }
        testing.expect(t,max_height>2 && game.player.grounded,"One jump must reach its apex and land without another airborne jump")
        testing.expect(t,close(b2.Body_GetRotation(game.player.body).s,0))
        expect_valid(t,&game.scene)
    }
    
    @(test)
    player_stands_on_and_pushes_a_real_fragment :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        // Detach a ground-level block, leaving an actual destruction body to stand on.
        id:=game.scene.subdivisions[3].id
        failures:=Failures{}
        for connection in game.scene.connections {
            if connection.a==id || connection.b==id { append(&failures.connections,connection.id) }
        }
        apply_failures(&game.scene,failures); free_failures(&failures)
        physics_sync_structure(&game.scene)
        body:=game.scene.physics.bodies[id]
        position:=b2.Body_GetPosition(body)
        b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{position.x,1.6},b2.MakeRot(0))
        for _ in 0..<120 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        testing.expect(t,game.player.grounded && b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y>1.35,"Support must come from fragment contacts")
        // Move alongside the detached block and push it using the same collision world.
        b2.Body_SetTransform(body,{-1,0.43},b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,{})
        b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{-2,0.6},b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(game.player.body,{})
        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        start:=b2.Body_GetPosition(body).x
        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_tick(&game,1,false) }
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_IsValid(body),"Routine player contact should leave the fragment intact")
        if b2.Body_IsValid(body) { testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetPosition(body).x>start+0.05,"The player should physically push debris") }
    }
    
    @(test)
    player_jump_buffer_and_coyote_window :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        // Queue a jump shortly before landing.
        b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{-4.5,0.64},b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(game.player.body,{0,-1})
        jumped:=false
        for i in 0..<10 {
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,i==0)
            if b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y>5 { jumped=true }
        }
        testing.expect(t,jumped,"A buffered press just before landing should jump")
        // The support was lost recently, but the player is still inside the coyote window.
        b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{-4.5,2},b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(game.player.body,{0,-0.1})
        game.player.coyote=0.08
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,true)
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y>5)
        game.player.coyote=0
        game.player.buffered_jump=0
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(game.player.body,{0,-0.1})
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,true)
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y<0,"Jump assistance must not permit an airborne second jump")
    }
    
    @(test)
    yard_reset_restores_same_setup_after_blast_and_respawn :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        for _ in 0..<3 {
            testing.expect(t,sandbox_blast(&game,{1,1.3}))
            for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_tick(&game,1,false) }
            b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{0,-4},b2.MakeRot(0))
            game.player.coyote=0.1; game.player.buffered_jump=0.1
            testing.expect(t,player_after_step(&game.player))
            testing.expect(t,close_vec(from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)),PLAYER_SPAWN))
            testing.expect(t,!game.player.grounded && game.player.coyote==0 && game.player.buffered_jump==0)
            sandbox_reset(&game)
            a,b,c:=counts(&game.scene)
            testing.expect(t,a==9 && b==11 && c==1 && len(game.scene.subdivisions)==9 && len(game.scene.remnants)==0)
            testing.expect(t,b2.World_GetCounters(game.scene.physics.world).bodyCount==11,"Reset must create exactly one player, one floor and nine regions")
            testing.expect(t,game.scene.pieces[0].seed==42 && game.applied.blast_radius==5.0 && game.scene.materials[0].flexibility==0)
            testing.expect(t,game.accumulator==0 && !game.jump_queued && game.selected==0)
            for sub in game.scene.subdivisions { testing.expect(t,close_vec(sub.pose.position,sub.rest_center) && close_vec(sub.pose.velocity,{})) }
            expect_valid(t,&game.scene)
        }
    }

    sandbox_settings_stage_together_and_pattern_preserves_tuning :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {

        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)

    vadd :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {a.x+b.x, a.y+b.y} }
    vsub :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y} }
    vmul :: proc(a: Vec2, s: f32) -> Vec2 { return {a.x*s, a.y*s} }
    vdot :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> f32 { return a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y }
    vcross :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> f32 { return a.x*b.y-a.y*b.x }
    vlen :: proc(a: Vec2) -> f32 { return math.sqrt(vdot(a,a)) }
    vrotate :: proc(a: Vec2, angle: f32) -> Vec2 {
        c, s := f32(math.cos(angle)), f32(math.sin(angle))
        return {a.x*c-a.y*s,a.x*s+a.y*c}
    }
    centroid :: proc(p: Polygon) -> Vec2 {
        area, x, y: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            a, b := p.points[i], p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
            cross := vcross(a,b)
            area += cross
            x += (a.x+b.x)*cross
            y += (a.y+b.y)*cross
        }
        if math.abs(area) < 0.00001 {
            for point in p.points { x += point.x; y += point.y }
            return {x/f32(len(p.points)),y/f32(len(p.points))}
        }
        return {x/(3*area),y/(3*area)}
    }
    posed_point :: proc(sub: Subdivision, rest: Vec2) -> Vec2 {
        return vadd(sub.pose.position,vrotate(vsub(rest,sub.rest_center),sub.pose.angle))
    }
    posed_polygon :: proc(sub: Subdivision) -> Polygon {
        result := Polygon{points=make([]Vec2,len(sub.outline.points))}
        for point,i in sub.outline.points { result.points[i]=posed_point(sub,point) }
        return result
    }
    make_polygon :: proc(points: []Vec2) -> Polygon {

    package main
    
    import "core:fmt"
    import "core:os"
    import "core:strings"
    import "core:math"
    import rl "vendor:raylib"
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    
    playtest_name: string
    playtest_output: string
    playtest_log: strings.Builder
    playtest_duration := 1080
    
    main :: proc() {
    	assert(len(os.args)==3,"Expected scenario and output directory")
    	playtest_name=os.args[1]
    	playtest_output=os.args[2]
    	if playtest_name=="bombs" { playtest_duration=2400 }
    	_ = fmt.sbprintf(&playtest_log,"frame,time,frame_dt,px,py,vx,vy,grounded,support_vx,support_vy,regions,links,pieces,area,max_speed,max_spin,awake,in_yard_awake,bombs,landed_bombs,revision\n")
    	run_sandbox(true)
    	assert(os.write_entire_file(fmt.tprintf("%s/telemetry.csv",playtest_output),transmute([]byte)strings.to_string(playtest_log))==nil)
    	strings.builder_destroy(&playtest_log)
    	fmt.println("Finished native playtest:",playtest_name)
    }
    
    playtest_key :: proc(frame,at: int,key: rl.KeyboardKey,down: bool) {
    	if frame==at { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(smoke_key(key,down)) }
    }
    playtest_click :: proc(frame,at: int,x,y: i32) {
    	if frame==at { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(smoke_mouse(x,y)) }
    	if frame==at+1 { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(smoke_button(true)) }
    	if frame==at+4 { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(smoke_button(false)) }
    }
    playtest_blast :: proc(frame,at: int,view: View,point: Vec2) {
    	aim:=screen_point(view,point)
    	playtest_click(frame,at,i32(aim.x),i32(aim.y))
    	if frame==at+6 { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(smoke_mouse(30,40)) }
    }
    playtest_hold :: proc(frame,start,end: int,key: rl.KeyboardKey) {
    	playtest_key(frame,start,key,true)
    	playtest_key(frame,end,key,false)
    }
    
    playtest_before_frame :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,view: View,frame: int) {
    	if frame==0 { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(smoke_mouse(30,40)) }
    	if playtest_name=="controls" {
    		playtest_hold(frame,150,180,.D)
    		playtest_hold(frame,210,240,.A)
    		playtest_hold(frame,270,330,.D)
    		playtest_hold(frame,300,310,.SPACE)
    		playtest_hold(frame,330,360,.A)
    		playtest_hold(frame,390,570,.D)
    		playtest_hold(frame,630,710,.D)
    		playtest_hold(frame,630,637,.SPACE)
    		playtest_hold(frame,840,1020,.A)
    		playtest_hold(frame,900,907,.SPACE)
    	} else if playtest_name=="bombs" {
    		playtest_hold(frame,10,12,.TAB)
    		playtest_click(frame,20,785,230)
    		playtest_hold(frame,40,42,.TAB)
    		playtest_hold(frame,50,52,.R)
    		playtest_hold(frame,90,180,.D)
    		playtest_hold(frame,200,210,.SPACE)
    		playtest_hold(frame,300,420,.A)
    		playtest_hold(frame,330,340,.SPACE)
    		playtest_hold(frame,480,600,.D)
    		playtest_hold(frame,520,530,.SPACE)
    		playtest_hold(frame,720,840,.A)
    		playtest_hold(frame,750,760,.SPACE)
    	} else {
    		if playtest_name=="splinter" || playtest_name=="shatter" {
    			playtest_hold(frame,10,12,.TAB)
    			x:=i32(620)
    			if playtest_name=="shatter" { x=790 }
    			playtest_click(frame,24,x,368)
    			playtest_click(frame,40,780,622)
    		}
    		playtest_hold(frame,60,110,.D)
    		point:=Vec2{1,1.3}
    		if playtest_name=="support" { point={3.8,-0.15} }
    		playtest_blast(frame,150,view,point)
    		playtest_hold(frame,420,570,.D)
    		playtest_hold(frame,450,460,.SPACE)
    		playtest_hold(frame,600,660,.A)
    		if playtest_name=="splinter" || playtest_name=="shatter" {
    			playtest_blast(frame,720,view,{5.2,-0.15})
    		}
    	}
    }
    
    playtest_after_frame :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,target: rl.RenderTexture2D,frame: int) {
    	position:=b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)
    	velocity:=b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body)
    	a,b,c:=counts_runtime(&game.scene)
    	area,max_speed,max_spin: f32
    	awake,in_yard_awake: int
    	for sub in game.scene.subdivisions {
    		if !sub.live { continue }
    		area+=polygon_area(sub.outline)
    		max_speed=max(max_speed,vlen(sub.pose.velocity))
    		max_spin=max(max_spin,math.abs(sub.pose.angular_velocity))
    		body,ok:=game.scene.physics.bodies[sub.id]
    		if ok && b2.Body_IsAwake(body) {
    			awake+=1
    			if sub.pose.position.x>=-8 && sub.pose.position.x<=9 && sub.pose.position.y>=-1 { in_yard_awake+=1 }
    		}
    	}
    	landed:=0
    	for bomb in game.bomb_rain.bombs { if bomb.landed { landed+=1 } }
    	_ = fmt.sbprintf(&playtest_log,"%d,%.6f,%.6f,%.6f,%.6f,%.6f,%.6f,%t,%.6f,%.6f,%d,%d,%d,%.6f,%.6f,%.6f,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d\n",frame,rl.GetTime(),rl.GetFrameTime(),position.x,position.y,velocity.x,velocity.y,game.player.grounded,game.player.support_velocity.x,game.player.support_velocity.y,a,b,c,area,max_speed,max_spin,awake,in_yard_awake,len(game.bomb_rain.bombs),landed,game.scene.revision)
    	if frame%2==0 {
    		image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
    		rl.ImageFlipVertical(&image)
    		rl.ImageResize(&image,960,600)
    		path:=fmt.ctprintf("%s/frame-%04d.png",playtest_output,frame/2)
    		assert(rl.ExportImage(image,path))
    		rl.UnloadImage(image)
    	}
    	if frame%60==0 || frame==152 || frame==722 {
    		valid,message:=validate_scene(&game.scene)
    		assert(valid,message)
    		assert(save_snapshot(&game.scene,fmt.tprintf("%s/state-%04d.json",playtest_output,frame)))
    	}
    	if frame%300==0 {
    		fmt.printf("%s frame %d: player (%.2f, %.2f) grounded %t, regions %d links %d pieces %d, max speed %.2f, in-yard awake %d\n",playtest_name,frame,position.x,position.y,game.player.grounded,a,b,c,max_speed,in_yard_awake)
    	}
    }

        from pathlib import Path
        import hashlib, json
        root=Path.cwd()
        review=root/'.gamefeel-playtest'
        manifest={}
        for source in root.glob('*.odin'):
            if source.name.endswith('_test.odin') or source.name=='main.odin':
                continue
            content=source.read_text()
            manifest[source.name]=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            if source.name=='sandbox_view.odin':
                old='\t\tview:=sandbox_view(width,height)\n\t\tmouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()'
                assert content.count(old)==1
                content=content.replace(old,'\t\tview:=sandbox_view(width,height)\n\t\tplaytest_before_frame(&game,view,frames)\n\t\tmouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()')
                old='\t\tframes+=1\n\t\tif smoke && frames==2 {'
                assert content.count(old)==1
                content=content.replace(old,'\t\tframes+=1\n\t\tplaytest_after_frame(&game,target,frames)\n\t\tif frames>=playtest_duration { break }\n\t\tif false {')
            (review/source.name).write_text(content)
        manifest['BOM.exe']=hashlib.sha256((root/'BOM.exe').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        (root/'playtests/2026-10-30/build-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
        for name in ['controls','chunk','support','splinter','shatter','bombs']:
            (root/'playtests/2026-10-30'/name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        print('Prepared native playback; gameplay sources copied unchanged, capture/input hooks only in temporary render loop.')

        from pathlib import Path
        from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont
        root=Path('playtests/2026-10-30')
        font=ImageFont.truetype('C:/Windows/Fonts/consola.ttf',18)
        for scene in ['controls','chunk','support','splinter']:
            if not (root/scene/'telemetry.csv').exists(): continue
            frames=[148,154,169,190,241,301,421,481,541,721,841,1078]
            if scene=='controls':frames=[149,179,187,299,329,350,449,569,631,643,658,700]
            sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1440,884),(19,28,42))
            draw=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
            for index,f in enumerate(frames):
                path=root/scene/f'frame-{max(0,(f-1)//3):04d}.jpg'
                if not path.exists():continue
                im=Image.open(path).crop((40,175,920,530)).resize((480,194))
                x,y=(index%3)*480,(index//3)*221
                sheet.paste(im,(x,y+27))
                draw.text((x+8,y+3),f'{scene} {f/60:.2f}s',font=font,fill=(229,239,241))
            sheet.save(root/f'{scene}-sequence.jpg',quality=92)
        print('Updated cropped motion sequences')

Chunk, Splinter and Shatter produce visibly different rubble, and the 40-second bomb run showed normal landing and detonation. I’m saving clips and notes for the contact issues.

    from pathlib import Path
    import csv
    import hashlib
    import json
    import math
    import shutil
    import subprocess
    
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
    
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    output = root / 'playtests' / '2026-10-30'
    scenes = ['controls', 'chunk', 'support', 'splinter', 'shatter', 'bombs', 'push']
    font = ImageFont.truetype('C:/Windows/Fonts/consola.ttf', 18)
    summary = {}
    
    for name in scenes:
        folder = output / name
        rows = list(csv.DictReader((folder / 'telemetry.csv').open()))
        if name == 'controls':
            selected = [149, 179, 187, 299, 329, 350, 449, 569, 631, 643, 658, 700]
        elif name == 'push':
            selected = [110, 149, 155, 164, 180, 300, 509, 514, 526, 600, 750, 898]
        elif name == 'bombs':
            selected = [154, 200, 227, 280, 290, 490, 620, 965, 1105, 1237, 1801, 2284]
        else:
            selected = [148, 154, 169, 190, 241, 301, 421, 481, 541, 721, 841, 1078]
        sheet = Image.new('RGB', (1440, 884), (19, 28, 42))
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
        for index, frame in enumerate(selected):
            path = folder / f'frame-{(frame - 1) // 3:04d}.jpg'
            image = Image.open(path)
            if name == 'bombs':
                image = image.resize((480, 300))
            else:
                image = image.crop((40, 175, 920, 530)).resize((480, 194))
            x, y = (index % 3) * 480, (index // 3) * 221
            if name == 'bombs':
                image = image.resize((310, 194))
            sheet.paste(image, (x, y + 27))
            draw.text((x + 8, y + 3), f'{name} {frame / 60:.2f}s', font=font, fill=(229, 239, 241))
        sheet.save(output / f'{name}-sequence.jpg', quality=92)
    
        events = []
        previous = None
        for row in rows:
            counts = tuple(int(row[key]) for key in ['regions', 'links', 'pieces'])
            if counts != previous:
                events.append({'frame': int(row['frame']), 'time': int(row['frame']) / 60,
                               'regions': counts[0], 'links': counts[1], 'pieces': counts[2],
                               'player_x': float(row['px']), 'player_y': float(row['py'])})
                previous = counts
        snapshots = sorted(folder.glob('state-*.json'))
        final_state = json.loads(snapshots[-1].read_text())
        in_yard = [s for s in final_state['subdivisions']
                   if -8 <= s['pose']['position']['x'] <= 9 and s['pose']['position']['y'] >= -1]
        speed = lambda s: math.hypot(s['pose']['velocity']['x'], s['pose']['velocity']['y'])
        summary[name] = {
            'seconds': len(rows) / 60, 'frames': len(rows), 'validated_snapshots': len(snapshots),
            'events': events, 'final_area': float(rows[-1]['area']),
            'final_in_yard_regions': len(in_yard),
            'final_in_yard_max_speed': max(map(speed, in_yard), default=0),
            'final_player': {key: rows[-1][key] for key in ['px', 'py', 'grounded']},
        }
        subprocess.run([shutil.which('ffmpeg'), '-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-y',
                        '-framerate', '20', '-start_number', '0', '-i', str(folder / 'frame-%04d.jpg'),
                        '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'veryfast', '-crf', '21', '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p',
                        '-movflags', '+faststart', str(output / f'{name}.mp4')], check=True)
        print(f'{name}: {len(rows) / 60:g}s; {len(snapshots)} validated captures; clip saved', flush=True)
    
    controls = list(csv.DictReader((output / 'controls' / 'telemetry.csv').open()))
    floor_y = float(controls[149]['py'])
    free = max(float(r['py']) for r in controls[300:390])
    wall = max(float(r['py']) for r in controls[630:750])
    summary['measurements'] = {
        'floor_player_center': floor_y, 'free_jump_center_apex': free,
        'wall_jump_center_apex': wall, 'free_jump_rise': free - floor_y,
        'wall_jump_rise': wall - floor_y,
        'stop_ticks': next(int(r['frame']) - 180 for r in controls[180:210] if abs(float(r['vx'])) < .001),
        'stop_distance': float(controls[209]['px']) - float(controls[179]['px']),
    }
    manifest = json.loads((output / 'build-manifest.json').read_text())
    changed = [name for name, checksum in manifest.items()
               if hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != checksum]
    assert not changed, changed
    summary['production_files_and_executable_unchanged'] = True
    (output / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(summary['measurements'], indent=2))
    print('Production sources and BOM.exe match their pre-playtest checksums.')

    Add: C:\Users\jblic\Documents\BOM\playtests\2026-10-30\report.md
    The world reacts decisively to blasts. The main weaknesses are contact behaviour: pushing into a wall suppresses jumping, and a running collision can fracture the untouched tower with very little visible displacement.
    
    Eight recorded native-input playthroughs cover 163 seconds of simulation. Radius 5.0, flexibility 0, impulse scale 0.2, strengths 30/24 and seed 42 were retained. Only the breakup pattern or blast source changed where indicated. The playable executable and production sources were left unchanged.
    
    These were scripted playtests of the running game code, using its existing keyboard/mouse bindings, input routing, settings widgets, physics and renderer. Desktop capture was unavailable. An initial live-clock recording was slowed by capture readback and was excluded from timing comparisons. The retained recordings use the normal 60 Hz physics step and capture rendered frames at 20 fps; the MP4s play at simulation speed. These establish physical response and contact behaviour, not hardware input/display latency.
    
    | Recording | Actions and observations |
    | --- | --- |
    | [Movement and wall contact](controls.mp4), 18 s | Walk, stop, reverse in air, approach the tower, then jump while holding toward its wall. Movement starts on the next simulated update. Ground stopping takes 7 ticks, about 0.12 s, over 0.19 units. This approach leaves the tower intact. |
    | [Chunk side blast](chunk.mp4), 18 s | Blast at (1, 1.3), wait, jump across rubble and walk back into it. Survivors separate promptly, rotate during collisions and form a traversable pile. Landing on and walking through the pile causes further fractures. In-yard debris settles again. |
    | [Support blast](support.mp4), 18 s | Blast at (3.8, -0.15). Unsupported blocks launch, topple and fall onto other fragments. Debris physically pushes the idle player left by about 0.85 units. Climbing through this pile is slower and more obstructed than crossing the side-blast rubble. |
    | [Splinter](splinter.mp4), 18 s | Apply Splinter through Settings; repeat the side blast, traverse the rubble, then blast below it. Long strips slide, tip and pack together. Landing causes additional fractures. The second blast clears most of the pile. |
    | [Shatter](shatter.mp4), 18 s | Apply Shatter through Settings; repeat the same actions. The first hit and immediate physics reaction produce 74 logical regions in 17 pieces, including linked clusters. Fine shards give a more granular response. The later blast leaves only three small regions. |
    | [Falling bombs](bombs.mp4), 40 s | Switch modes, reset, walk and jump around the tower, then observe repeated drops. Bombs fall, contact supporting surfaces, remain for their fuse and disappear on detonation. The first observed landing and detonation are exactly 60 physics ticks apart. Bombs keep interacting with the remaining rubble and eventually clear the yard. One later bomb lands on the player's head. |
    | [Running impact and close blast](push.mp4), 15 s | After one second of settling, hold D from spawn for four seconds. The initial collision breaks a connection at 2.53 s; by 2.78 s the tower has changed from 9 regions / 11 links / 1 piece to 23 / 32 / 5. Its outline barely moves. Reset, approach, stop and blast almost exactly at the player's centre: the tower fractures while the player receives no direct velocity change. |
    | [Release pressure during wall jump](wall-release.mp4), 18 s | Repeat the movement run, but release D one tick after the wall jump begins. Jump rise recovers substantially, without changing any physics parameters. |
    
    The clearest issue is the wall jump. The same jump rises **2.01 units in open space**, **0.96 while holding into the wall**, and **1.80 when the direction key is released just after takeoff**. The paired input experiment points to contact friction interacting with the controller's horizontal drive. It can make the world feel sticky when pressing against obstacles. [Animated comparison](wall-contact.gif).
    
    The running-impact case gives the structure a brittle, plaster-like response: it gains many cracks and disconnected pieces after an ordinary player collision, while its silhouette remains almost unchanged. This is observable behaviour rather than a demonstrated solver bug. Whether that is desirable depends on the intended material weight; it merits a separate tuning decision from blast power.
    
    The close-blast case also exposes the existing separation between player and destruction physics. At the blast update the stationary player's position remains (-1.238068, 0.559931), with zero velocity, while the tower fractures. Debris can push the player through contact, as the support run demonstrates. Direct blast immunity is current policy, but it is a noticeable physical disconnect.
    
    The stronger blast impulse itself looks useful: immediate separation, readable toppling and secondary impacts, followed by settling. In-yard debris in the Chunk and support runs ends below 0.00001 units/s after the player stops. Some shards leave the finite floor and continue falling offscreen; their increasing free-fall speeds were excluded from the settling assessment. No persistent in-yard shaking or explosive solver motion appeared in these runs. The three patterns retain visibly different motion and rubble shapes.
    
    I would tune wall/contact stickiness first, then decide how easily ordinary player impacts should fracture the structure. These playtests give no reason to increase the blast impulse further.
    
    All **179 sampled scene validations passed** during the retained runs. Telemetry, snapshots and [machine-readable measurements](summary.json) accompany the recordings. [The input script](native-input-script.odin.txt) records the exact scheduled controls. The ordinary test suite was not rerun because this task changed no gameplay code. The temporary capture build was removed, and production source/executable checksums match the [pre-playtest manifest](build-manifest.json).
