    #+feature dynamic-literals
    package main
    
    import "core:math"
    
    polygon_area :: proc(p: Polygon) -> f32 {
        a: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) { a += vcross(p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]) }
        return math.abs(a)*0.5
    }
    clip_polygon :: proc(p: Polygon, axis: int, cut: f32, keep_low: bool) -> Polygon {
        points: [dynamic]Vec2
        defer delete(points)
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            a,b := p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
            av,bv := a.x-cut,b.x-cut
            if axis == 1 { av = a.y-cut; bv = b.y-cut }
            if !keep_low { av = -av; bv = -bv }
            inside_a, inside_b := av <= 0,bv <= 0
            if inside_a { append(&points,a) }
            if inside_a != inside_b {
                t := av/(av-bv)
                append(&points,vadd(a,vmul(vsub(b,a),t)))
            }
        }
        return make_polygon(points[:])
    }
    is_convex :: proc(p: Polygon) -> bool {
        if len(p.points) < 3 { return false }
        sign: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            cross := vcross(vsub(p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)],p.points[i]),vsub(p.points[(i+2)%len(p.points)],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]))
            if math.abs(cross) < 0.00001 { continue }
            if sign == 0 { sign = cross } else if cross*sign < 0 { return false }
        }
        return true
    }
    point_in_triangle :: proc(p,a,b,c: Vec2, orientation: f32) -> bool {
        return vcross(vsub(b,a),vsub(p,a))*orientation >= -0.00001 &&
               vcross(vsub(c,b),vsub(p,b))*orientation >= -0.00001 &&
               vcross(vsub(a,c),vsub(p,c))*orientation >= -0.00001
    }
    triangulate_polygon :: proc(p: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
        result: [dynamic]Polygon
        indices: [dynamic]int
        defer delete(indices)
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) { append(&indices,i) }
        signed: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) { signed += vcross(p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]) }
        orientation := f32(1)
        if signed < 0 { orientation = -1 }
        for len(indices) > 3 {
            found := false
            for k in 0..<len(indices) {
                i,j,l := indices[(k+len(indices)-1)%len(indices)],indices[k],indices[(k+1)%len(indices)]
                a,b,c := p.points[i],p.points[j],p.points[l]
                if vcross(vsub(b,a),vsub(c,b))*orientation <= 0.00001 { continue }
                contains := false
                for n in indices { if n != i && n != j && n != l && point_in_triangle(p.points[n],a,b,c,orientation) { contains = true; break } }
                if contains { continue }
                append(&result,make_polygon([]Vec2{a,b,c}))
                ordered_remove(&indices,k)
                found = true
                break
            }
            if !found { break }
        }
        if len(indices) == 3 { append(&result,make_polygon([]Vec2{p.points[indices[0]],p.points[indices[1]],p.points[indices[2]]})) }
        return result
    }
    // Straight shared cuts are constructed by clipping both sides at one value.
    // Outside edges are never moved; no gap or overlap is introduced at the cut.
    generate_children :: proc(parent: Polygon, recipe: Material, seed: u8) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
        result: [dynamic]Polygon
        if seed == 0 { return result }
        if recipe.triangulate { result = triangulate_polygon(parent) } else if !is_convex(parent) {
            // Bent shared edges can make a parent slightly concave. Merge its ears
            // before partitioning so collision decomposition does not dictate fragments.
            result = convex_decomposition(parent)
        } else {
            append(&result,make_polygon(parent.points))
        }
        target := max(recipe.generation_count,len(result))
        for len(result) < target {
            chosen := -1
            largest: f32
            for p,i in result { a := polygon_area(p); if a > largest { largest = a; chosen = i } }
            if chosen < 0 || largest < 0.0001 { break }
            p := result[chosen]
            min_x,min_y := f32(1e30),f32(1e30)
            max_x,max_y := f32(-1e30),f32(-1e30)
            for point in p.points { min_x=min(min_x,point.x); max_x=max(max_x,point.x); min_y=min(min_y,point.y); max_y=max(max_y,point.y) }
            axis := 0
            if (max_x-min_x) < (max_y-min_y)*max(recipe.aspect_ratio,0.1) { axis = 1 }
            fraction := 0.4+0.2*f32(derive_seed(seed,u64(len(result))))/255
            cut := min_x+(max_x-min_x)*fraction
            if axis == 1 { cut = min_y+(max_y-min_y)*fraction }
            low, high := clip_polygon(p,axis,cut,true),clip_polygon(p,axis,cut,false)
            if polygon_area(low) < 0.0001 || polygon_area(high) < 0.0001 { delete(low.points); delete(high.points); break }
            delete(p.points)
            result[chosen] = low
            append(&result,high)
        }
        displace_shared_boundaries(result[:],seed)
        if recipe.triangulate {
            triangles: [dynamic]Polygon
            for polygon in result {
                parts:=triangulate_polygon(polygon)
                for part in parts { append(&triangles,part) }
                delete(parts); delete(polygon.points)
            }
            delete(result)
            result=triangles
        }
        // Incomplete triangulation or a no-progress recipe must remove the failed
        // outline, rather than retaining an equivalent child or a partial partition.
        area: f32
        genuine := len(result)>=2
        parent_area := polygon_area(parent)
        for child in result {
            child_area := polygon_area(child)
            genuine = genuine && child_area>0 && child_area<parent_area
            area += child_area
        }
        if !genuine || math.abs(area-parent_area)>max(f32(0.000002),parent_area*0.0002) {
            for child in result { delete(child.points) }
            delete(result)
            return nil
        }
        return result
    }
    
    apply_failures :: proc(s: ^Scene, failures: Failures) {
        if len(failures.subdivisions) == 0 && len(failures.connections) == 0 && len(failures.discard_subdivisions) == 0 { return }
        s.revision+=1
        affected := make(map[u64]bool)
        defer delete(affected)
        stage_failures(s,failures,&affected)
        rebuild_affected_pieces(s,affected)
    }
    // Reuse the existing one-wave graph update for physics and for each blast wave.
    // Ownership, size filtering and engine handles are committed only at the end.
    stage_failures :: proc(s: ^Scene, failures: Failures, affected: ^map[u64]bool) {
        replacements := make(map[u64][dynamic]u64)
        defer { for _,children in replacements { delete(children) }; delete(replacements) }
        failed_subs := sorted_ids(failures.subdivisions[:])
        for id in failures.discard_subdivisions { if !contains_id(failed_subs[:],id) { append(&failed_subs,id) } }
        sort_ids(failed_subs[:])
        failed_conns := sorted_ids(failures.connections[:])
        defer delete(failed_subs); defer delete(failed_conns)
        old_connection_count := len(s.connections)
        old_connections: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(old_connections)
        for i in 0..<old_connection_count { append(&old_connections,s.connections[i].id) }
        sort_ids(old_connections[:])
        for id in failed_subs {
            row, ok := s.sub_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.subdivisions[row].live { continue }
            parent := s.subdivisions[row]
            affected[parent.owner] = true
            seed := parent.seed
            if parent.width<=s.minimum_width || contains_id(failures.discard_subdivisions[:],id) { seed=0 }
            children := generate_children(parent.outline,s.materials[parent.material],seed)
            max_width: f32
            for outline,ordinal in children {
                center := centroid(outline)
                world_center := posed_point(parent,center)
                r := vsub(world_center,parent.pose.position)
                pose := Pose{position=world_center,angle=parent.pose.angle,velocity=vadd(parent.pose.velocity,Vec2{-parent.pose.angular_velocity*r.y,parent.pose.angular_velocity*r.x}),angular_velocity=parent.pose.angular_velocity}
                child := add_subdivision(s,parent.owner,outline,pose)
                child_row := s.sub_rows[child]
                // Parent context plus child ordinal is independent of other branches'
                // allocations. A deletion shortcut cannot perturb their future seeds.
                s.subdivisions[child_row].seed=derive_seed(parent.seed,u64(ordinal+1))
                max_width=max(max_width,s.subdivisions[child_row].width)
                delete(outline.points)
                child_ids := replacements[id]
                append(&child_ids,child)
                replacements[id] = child_ids
            }
            delete(children)
            if max_width<=s.minimum_width {
                child_ids := replacements[id]
                for child in child_ids { s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[child]].seed=0 }
            }
            s.subdivisions[row].live = false
        }
        for id in failed_conns {
            row, ok := s.conn_rows[id]
            if ok && s.connections[row].live {
                c := s.connections[row]
                affected[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].owner] = true
                affected[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].owner] = true
                s.connections[row].live = false
            }
        }
        for old_id in old_connections {
            i := s.conn_rows[old_id]
            c := s.connections[i]
            if !c.live { continue }
            a_dead := !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].live
            b_dead := !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].live
            if !a_dead && !b_dead { continue }
            s.connections[i].live = false
            left_default,right_default := [1]u64{c.a},[1]u64{c.b}
            left,right := left_default[:],right_default[:]
            if a_dead { left = replacements[c.a][:] }
            if b_dead { right = replacements[c.b][:] }
            old_a,old_b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            old_length,_ := shared_boundary(old_a.outline,old_b.outline)
            if old_length <= 0 { continue }
            for a in left {
                for b in right {
                    if inherits_old_boundary(s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[a]].outline,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[b]].outline,old_a.outline,old_b.outline) { add_connection(s,a,b) }
                }
            }
        }
        for id in failed_subs {
            children := replacements[id]
            for i in 0..<len(children) { for j in i+1..<len(children) { add_connection(s,children[i],children[j]) } }
        }
    }
    rebuild_affected_pieces :: proc(s: ^Scene, affected: map[u64]bool) {
        owners: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(owners)
        for owner in affected { append(&owners,owner) }
        sort_ids(owners[:])
        for owner in owners { rebuild_piece(s,owner) }
    }
    
    BLAST_LOAD_MULTIPLIER :: f32(10)
    BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE :: f32(0.2)
    blast_load :: proc(distance,radius: f32) -> f32 {
        if radius <= 0 || distance >= radius { return 0 }
        return BLAST_LOAD_MULTIPLIER*max(f32(0),radius-distance)
    }
    fails :: proc(load,strength: f32) -> bool { return load > 0 && load >= strength }
    evaluate_blast :: proc(s: ^Scene, blast: Blast, first_subdivision: int = 0, first_connection: int = 0) -> Failures {
        f := Failures{}
        for i in first_subdivision..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            sub := &s.subdivisions[i]
            if !sub.live { continue }
            offset := vsub(subdivision_sample(sub^),blast.position)
            distance := vlen(offset)
            load := blast_load(distance,blast.radius)
            if load <= 0 { continue }
            if fails(load,s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&f.subdivisions,sub.id) }
        }
        for i in first_connection..<len(s.connections) {
            c := s.connections[i]
            if !c.live { continue }
            a := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]]
            load := blast_load(vlen(vsub(connection_sample(s,c),blast.position)),blast.radius)
            if fails(load,s.materials[a.material].connection_strength) { append(&f.connections,c.id) }
        }
        return f
    }
    // Descendants partition the outline, inherit its material and keep its rigid
    // transform during this event. Their samples lie in the posed convex hull.
    // Outward rounding and a strict load margin avoid pruning borderline failures.
    blast_erases_descendants :: proc(sub: Subdivision, blast: Blast, strength: f32) -> bool {
        if !finite(strength) || !finite(blast.radius) || !valid_vec(blast.position) { return false }
        farthest: f32
        for point in sub.outline.points {
            distance := vlen(vsub(posed_point(sub,point),blast.position))
            if !finite(distance) { return false }
            farthest=max(farthest,distance)
        }
        farthest=math.nextafter(farthest,math.inf_f32(1))
        return blast_load(farthest,blast.radius)>strength+0.0001
    }
    blast_pass :: proc(s: ^Scene, blast: Blast, deletion_shortcut: bool = true) {
        physics_read_motion(s)
        affected := make(map[u64]bool)
        defer delete(affected)
        f := evaluate_blast(s,blast)
        changed := false
        for len(f.subdivisions)>0 || len(f.connections)>0 {
            changed=true
            if deletion_shortcut {
                for id in f.subdivisions {
                    sub := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]]
                    if sub.seed!=0 && sub.width>s.minimum_width && blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&f.discard_subdivisions,id) }
                }
            }
            first_subdivision,first_connection := len(s.subdivisions),len(s.connections)
            stage_failures(s,f,&affected)
            delete(f.subdivisions); delete(f.connections); delete(f.discard_subdivisions)
            // Earlier survivors have unchanged samples. Only children and new links
            // need this blast again; failed old links are already excluded from inheritance.
            f=evaluate_blast(s,blast,first_subdivision,first_connection)
        }
        delete(f.subdivisions); delete(f.connections); delete(f.discard_subdivisions)
        if changed { s.revision+=1; rebuild_affected_pieces(s,affected) }
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        for i in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            sub := &s.subdivisions[i]
            if !sub.live { continue }
            offset := vsub(subdivision_sample(sub^),blast.position)
            distance := vlen(offset)
            load := blast_load(distance,blast.radius)
            if load>0 && distance>0.00001 { apply_blast_motion(s,sub,vmul(offset,1/distance),load) }
        }
    }
    fade_step :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) {
        for i := len(s.remnants)-1; i >= 0; i -= 1 {
            s.remnants[i].age += dt
            if s.remnants[i].age >= 1 { ordered_remove(&s.remnants,i) }
        }
    }
    package main
    
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    Physics :: struct {
        world: b2.WorldId,
        bodies: map[u64]b2.BodyId,
        joints: map[u64]b2.JointId,
        fixture_counts: map[u64]int,
        active: bool,
    }
    Interaction :: struct { force: Vec2, torque: f32 }
    REFERENCE_LENGTH :: f32(1)
    PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS :: 4
    GLOBAL_DAMPING :: f32(0.7)
    
    to_b2 :: proc(v: Vec2) -> b2.Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    from_b2 :: proc(v: b2.Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    interaction_load :: proc(i: Interaction) -> f32 {
        return max(vlen(i.force),math.abs(i.torque)/REFERENCE_LENGTH)
    }
    equivalent_force :: proc(impulse: Vec2, interval: f32) -> Vec2 {
        assert(interval > 0)
        return vmul(impulse,1/interval)
    }
    physics_init :: proc(s: ^Scene, gravity: Vec2 = {}) {
        assert(!s.physics.active)
        def := b2.DefaultWorldDef()
        def.gravity = to_b2(gravity)
        s.physics = Physics{world=b2.CreateWorld(def),bodies=make(map[u64]b2.BodyId),joints=make(map[u64]b2.JointId),fixture_counts=make(map[u64]int),active=true}
        physics_sync_structure(s)
    }
    physics_destroy :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        b2.DestroyWorld(s.physics.world)
        delete(s.physics.bodies); delete(s.physics.joints); delete(s.physics.fixture_counts)
        s.physics = {}
    }
    physics_read_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row := s.sub_rows[id]
            rotation := b2.Body_GetRotation(body)
            s.subdivisions[row].pose = Pose{
                position=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(body)),angle=math.atan2(rotation.s,rotation.c),
                velocity=from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body)),angular_velocity=b2.Body_GetAngularVelocity(body),
            }
        }
    }
    physics_create_fixture :: proc(s: ^Scene, body: b2.BodyId, sub: Subdivision, outline: Polygon) -> bool {
        points: [dynamic]b2.Vec2
        defer delete(points)
        for point in outline.points { append(&points,to_b2(vsub(point,sub.rest_center))) }
        hull := b2.ComputeHull(points[:])
        // Hull welding can collapse a thin ear below Box2D's collision tolerance.
        if hull.count < 3 { return false }
        polygon := b2.MakePolygon(hull,0)
        def := b2.DefaultShapeDef()
        def.density = 1
        _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
        s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id] += 1
        return true
    }
    physics_finish_mass :: proc(s: ^Scene,body: b2.BodyId,sub: Subdivision) {
        if s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id]==0 {
            // A microscopic attached subdivision is still one live logical entity.
            // Use a bounding fixture when the engine cannot resolve any of its ears.
            lo,hi:=Vec2{1e30,1e30},Vec2{-1e30,-1e30}
            for rest in sub.outline.points { p:=vsub(rest,sub.rest_center); lo={min(lo.x,p.x),min(lo.y,p.y)}; hi={max(hi.x,p.x),max(hi.y,p.y)} }
            polygon:=b2.MakeOffsetBox(max(f32(0.0025),(hi.x-lo.x)*0.5),max(f32(0.0025),(hi.y-lo.y)*0.5),to_b2(vmul(vadd(lo,hi),0.5)),b2.MakeRot(0))
            def:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); def.density=1
            _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
            s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id]=1
        }
        // Keep mass and the body origin tied to the exact logical polygon, including
        // when Box2D simplifies a fixture. This also makes rotational inheritance exact.
        inertia: f32
        for i in 0..<len(sub.outline.points) {
            a,b:=vsub(sub.outline.points[i],sub.rest_center),vsub(sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)],sub.rest_center)
            inertia+=vcross(a,b)*(vdot(a,a)+vdot(a,b)+vdot(b,b))/12
        }
        b2.Body_SetMassData(body,b2.MassData{mass=polygon_area(sub.outline),center={},rotationalInertia=math.abs(inertia)})
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,to_b2(sub.pose.velocity))
        b2.Body_SetAngularVelocity(body,sub.pose.angular_velocity)
    }
    // This runs only between World_Step calls. Existing handles survive ownership changes.
    physics_sync_structure :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        dead_joints: [dynamic]u64
        dead_bodies: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(dead_joints); defer delete(dead_bodies)
        for id,joint in s.physics.joints {
            row,ok := s.conn_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.connections[row].live { b2.DestroyJoint(joint); append(&dead_joints,id) }
        }
        for id in dead_joints { delete_key(&s.physics.joints,id) }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row,ok := s.sub_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.subdivisions[row].live { b2.DestroyBody(body); append(&dead_bodies,id) }
        }
        for id in dead_bodies { delete_key(&s.physics.bodies,id); delete_key(&s.physics.fixture_counts,id) }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            if _,exists := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]; exists { continue }
            def := b2.DefaultBodyDef()
            def.type = .dynamicBody
            def.position = to_b2(sub.pose.position)
            def.rotation = b2.MakeRot(sub.pose.angle)
            def.linearVelocity = to_b2(sub.pose.velocity)
            def.angularVelocity = sub.pose.angular_velocity
            body := b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
            s.physics.bodies[sub.id] = body
            if is_convex(sub.outline) && len(sub.outline.points) <= 8 {
                physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,sub.outline)
            } else {
                triangles := convex_decomposition(sub.outline)
                for triangle in triangles { physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,triangle); delete(triangle.points) }
                delete(triangles)
            }
            physics_finish_mass(s,body,sub)
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            if _,exists := s.physics.joints[c.id]; exists { continue }
            a := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]]
            b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            def := b2.DefaultWeldJointDef()
            def.bodyIdA = s.physics.bodies[c.a]
            def.bodyIdB = s.physics.bodies[c.b]
            def.localAnchorA = to_b2(c.local_a)
            def.localAnchorB = to_b2(c.local_b)
            // All outlines share one undeformed frame. Its relative rest angle is zero.
            def.referenceAngle = 0
            flexibility := max(s.materials[a.material].flexibility,s.materials[b.material].flexibility)
            if flexibility > 0 {
                def.linearHertz = 1/max(flexibility,0.01)
                def.angularHertz = def.linearHertz
            }
            def.linearDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
            def.angularDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
            s.physics.joints[c.id] = b2.CreateWeldJoint(s.physics.world,def)
        }
    }
    apply_blast_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene, sub: ^Subdivision, direction: Vec2, load: f32) {
        delta_v := vmul(direction,load*BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE)
        if s.physics.active {
            body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
            impulse := vmul(delta_v,b2.Body_GetMass(body))
            b2.Body_ApplyLinearImpulseToCenter(body,to_b2(impulse),true)
            sub.pose.velocity = from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body))
        } else {
            sub.pose.velocity = vadd(sub.pose.velocity,delta_v)
        }
    }
    // Contact points and fixtures against the same other body form one interaction.
    // Joint reactions are already forces; totalNormalImpulse covers the full tick.
    // Box2D's tangent/rolling impulses cover the final substep in this binding version.
    calculate_physics_loads :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) -> Failures {
        assert(dt > 0)
        failures := Failures{}
        loads := make(map[u64]f32)
        defer delete(loads)
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
            capacity := int(b2.Body_GetContactCapacity(body))
            buffer := make([]b2.ContactData,capacity)
            contacts := b2.Body_GetContactData(body,buffer)
            interactions := make(map[b2.BodyId]Interaction)
            for contact in contacts {
                body_a,body_b := b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdA),b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdB)
                other := body_b
                sign := f32(-1)
                if body_b == body { other=body_a; sign=1 }
                normal := from_b2(contact.manifold.normal)
                tangent := Vec2{normal.y,-normal.x}
                interaction := interactions[other]
                for k in 0..<int(contact.manifold.pointCount) {
                    point := contact.manifold.points[k]
                    force := vadd(equivalent_force(vmul(normal,point.totalNormalImpulse*sign),dt),equivalent_force(vmul(tangent,point.tangentImpulse*sign),dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)))
                    interaction.force = vadd(interaction.force,force)
                    interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(from_b2(point.point),sub.pose.position),force)
                }
                interaction.torque += contact.manifold.rollingImpulse*sign/(dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS))
                interactions[other] = interaction
            }
            for _,interaction in interactions { loads[sub.id] = max(loads[sub.id],interaction_load(interaction)) }
            delete(interactions); delete(buffer)
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            joint := s.physics.joints[c.id]
            interaction := Interaction{force=from_b2(b2.Joint_GetConstraintForce(joint)),torque=b2.Joint_GetConstraintTorque(joint)}
            load := interaction_load(interaction)
            a,b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            a_interaction,b_interaction := interaction,interaction
            a_interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(posed_point(a,c.rest_point),a.pose.position),interaction.force)
            b_interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(posed_point(b,c.rest_point),b.pose.position),interaction.force)
            loads[c.a] = max(loads[c.a],interaction_load(a_interaction))
            loads[c.b] = max(loads[c.b],interaction_load(b_interaction))
            material := s.materials[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].material]
            if fails(load,material.connection_strength) { append(&failures.connections,c.id) }
        }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if sub.live && fails(loads[sub.id],s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&failures.subdivisions,sub.id) }
        }
        return failures
    }
    Load_Calculator :: #type proc(s: ^Scene,dt: f32) -> Failures
    physics_tick :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32,calculate_loads: Load_Calculator = calculate_physics_loads) {
        assert(s.physics.active && dt > 0)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        b2.World_Step(s.physics.world,dt,PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)
        physics_read_motion(s)
        failures := calculate_loads(s,dt)
        apply_failures(s,failures)
        delete(failures.subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
        delete(failures.discard_subdivisions)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        fade_step(s,dt)
    }
    The world reacts decisively to blasts. The main weaknesses are contact behaviour: pushing into a wall suppresses jumping, and a running collision can fracture the untouched tower with very little visible displacement.
    
    Eight recorded native-input playthroughs cover 163 seconds of simulation. Radius 5.0, flexibility 0, impulse scale 0.2, strengths 30/24 and seed 42 were retained. Only the breakup pattern or blast source changed where indicated. The playable executable and production sources were left unchanged.
    
    These were scripted playtests of the running game code, using its existing keyboard/mouse bindings, input routing, settings widgets, physics and renderer. Desktop capture was unavailable. An initial live-clock recording was slowed by capture readback and was excluded from timing comparisons. The retained recordings use the normal 60 Hz physics step and capture rendered frames at 20 fps; the MP4s play at simulation speed. These establish physical response and contact behaviour, not hardware input/display latency.
    
    | Recording | Actions and observations |
    | --- | --- |
    | [Movement and wall contact](controls.mp4), 18 s | Walk, stop, reverse in air, approach the tower, then jump while holding toward its wall. Movement starts on the next simulated update. Ground stopping takes 7 ticks, about 0.12 s, over 0.19 units. This approach leaves the tower intact. |
    | [Chunk side blast](chunk.mp4), 18 s | Blast at (1, 1.3), wait, jump across rubble and walk back into it. Survivors separate promptly, rotate during collisions and form a traversable pile. Landing on and walking through the pile causes further fractures. In-yard debris settles again. |
    | [Support blast](support.mp4), 18 s | Blast at (3.8, -0.15). Unsupported blocks launch, topple and fall onto other fragments. Debris physically pushes the idle player left by about 0.85 units. Climbing through this pile is slower and more obstructed than crossing the side-blast rubble. |
    | [Splinter](splinter.mp4), 18 s | Apply Splinter through Settings; repeat the side blast, traverse the rubble, then blast below it. Long strips slide, tip and pack together. Landing causes additional fractures. The second blast clears most of the pile. |
    | [Shatter](shatter.mp4), 18 s | Apply Shatter through Settings; repeat the same actions. The first hit and immediate physics reaction produce 74 logical regions in 17 pieces, including linked clusters. Fine shards give a more granular response. The later blast leaves only three small regions. |
    | [Falling bombs](bombs.mp4), 40 s | Switch modes, reset, walk and jump around the tower, then observe repeated drops. Bombs fall, contact supporting surfaces, remain for their fuse and disappear on detonation. The first observed landing and detonation are exactly 60 physics ticks apart. Bombs keep interacting with the remaining rubble and eventually clear the yard. One later bomb lands on the player's head. |
    | [Running impact and close blast](push.mp4), 15 s | After one second of settling, hold D from spawn for four seconds. The initial collision breaks a connection at 2.53 s; by 2.78 s the tower has changed from 9 regions / 11 links / 1 piece to 23 / 32 / 5. Its outline barely moves. Reset, approach, stop and blast almost exactly at the player's centre: the tower fractures while the player receives no direct velocity change. |
    | [Release pressure during wall jump](wall-release.mp4), 18 s | Repeat the movement run, but release D one tick after the wall jump begins. Jump rise recovers substantially, without changing any physics parameters. |
    
    The clearest issue is the wall jump. The same jump rises **2.01 units in open space**, **0.96 while holding into the wall**, and **1.80 when the direction key is released just after takeoff**. The paired input experiment points to contact friction interacting with the controller's horizontal drive. It can make the world feel sticky when pressing against obstacles. [Animated comparison](wall-contact.gif).
    
    The running-impact case gives the structure a brittle, plaster-like response: it gains many cracks and disconnected pieces after an ordinary player collision, while its silhouette remains almost unchanged. This is observable behaviour rather than a demonstrated solver bug. Whether that is desirable depends on the intended material weight; it merits a separate tuning decision from blast power.
    
    The close-blast case also exposes the existing separation between player and destruction physics. At the blast update the stationary player's position remains (-1.238068, 0.559931), with zero velocity, while the tower fractures. Debris can push the player through contact, as the support run demonstrates. Direct blast immunity is current policy, but it is a noticeable physical disconnect.
    
    The stronger blast impulse itself looks useful: immediate separation, readable toppling and secondary impacts, followed by settling. In-yard debris in the Chunk and support runs ends below 0.00001 units/s after the player stops. Some shards leave the finite floor and continue falling offscreen; their increasing free-fall speeds were excluded from the settling assessment. No persistent in-yard shaking or explosive solver motion appeared in these runs. The three patterns retain visibly different motion and rubble shapes.
    
    I would tune wall/contact stickiness first, then decide how easily ordinary player impacts should fracture the structure. These playtests give no reason to increase the blast impulse further.
    
    All **179 sampled scene validations passed** during the retained runs. Telemetry, snapshots and [machine-readable measurements](summary.json) accompany the recordings. [The input script](native-input-script.odin.txt) records the exact scheduled controls. The ordinary test suite was not rerun because this task changed no gameplay code. The temporary capture build was removed, and production source/executable checksums match the [pre-playtest manifest](build-manifest.json).

    run_sandbox :: proc(smoke: bool = false,smoke_panel: bool = false,smoke_input: bool = false) {
        rl.SetTraceLogLevel(.WARNING)
        flags:=rl.ConfigFlags{.MSAA_4X_HINT,.WINDOW_RESIZABLE,.WINDOW_HIGHDPI}

        defer rl.CloseWindow()
        rl.SetWindowMinSize(900,700)
        rl.SetExitKey(.KEY_NULL)
        rl.SetTargetFPS(60)
        sandbox_gui_style()
        game:=sandbox_create()
        defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        if smoke_input { sandbox_smoke_inputs(&game); return }
        if smoke_panel { sandbox_set_panel(&game,true); game.tuning_open=true }
        poses:=make(map[u64]Pose); defer delete(poses)
        target:=rl.RenderTexture2D{}
        if smoke { target=rl.LoadRenderTexture(rl.GetScreenWidth(),rl.GetScreenHeight()) }
        defer { if smoke { rl.UnloadRenderTexture(target) } }
        frames:=0
        for !rl.WindowShouldClose() {
            width,height:=f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight())
            view:=sandbox_view(width,height)
            mouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()
            over_ui:=sandbox_over_hud(mouse,width,height,game.inspection)
            raw:=sandbox_read_input()
            input:=sandbox_route_input(&game,raw,over_ui)
            point:=world_point(view,mouse)
            if !raw.menu_pressed && !raw.reset_pressed {
                if !sandbox_inspect_input(&game,point,view,over_ui) && input.blast_pressed { sandbox_blast(&game,point) }
            }
            sandbox_advance(&game,rl.GetFrameTime(),input)
            clear(&poses)
            for sub in game.scene.subdivisions {
                if !sub.live { continue }
                pose:=sub.pose
                if old,ok:=game.previous[sub.id]; ok && !game.panel_open { pose=interpolate_pose(old,pose,game.accumulator*60) }
                poses[sub.id]=pose
            }
            rl.BeginDrawing()
            if smoke { rl.BeginTextureMode(target) }
            rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
            sandbox_draw_world(&game,view,poses)
            if !game.panel_open && !over_ui { sandbox_draw_aim(&game,view,mouse) }
            action:=sandbox_draw_hud(&game,width,height)
            if smoke {
                rl.EndTextureMode()
                rl.DrawTextureRec(target.texture,{0,0,f32(target.texture.width),-f32(target.texture.height)},{0,0},rl.WHITE)
            }
            rl.EndDrawing()
            sandbox_handle_ui(&game,action)
            frames+=1
            if smoke && frames==2 {
                image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
                rl.ImageFlipVertical(&image)
                name:=cstring("sandbox-preview.png"); if smoke_panel { name="sandbox-settings-preview.png" }
                _ = rl.ExportImage(image,name)
                rl.UnloadImage(image)
                break
            }
        }
    }
    package main
    
    import rl "vendor:raylib"
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    View :: struct { offset: Vec2, scale: f32 }
    screen_point :: proc(view: View,point: Vec2) -> rl.Vector2 { return {view.offset.x+point.x*view.scale,view.offset.y-point.y*view.scale} }
    world_point :: proc(view: View,point: rl.Vector2) -> Vec2 { return {(point.x-view.offset.x)/view.scale,(view.offset.y-point.y)/view.scale} }
    piece_color :: proc(id: u64,alpha: u8 = 255) -> rl.Color {
        colors := [6]rl.Color{{64,173,165,255},{97,142,206,255},{194,134,204,255},{212,161,88,255},{139,178,113,255},{211,116,125,255}}
        c:=colors[id%6]; c.a=alpha; return c
    }
    render_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene,sub: Subdivision,poses: map[u64]Pose) -> Subdivision {
        result:=sub
        if pose,ok:=poses[sub.id]; ok { result.pose=pose }
        return result
    }
    point_on_boundary :: proc(point: Vec2,a,b: Polygon) -> bool {
        for i in 0..<len(a.points) {
            for j in 0..<len(b.points) {
                if segment,ok:=segment_overlap(Segment{a.points[i],a.points[(i+1)%len(a.points)]},Segment{b.points[j],b.points[(j+1)%len(b.points)]}); ok {
                    d:=vsub(segment.b,segment.a); length:=vlen(d)
                    projection:=vdot(vsub(point,segment.a),d)/(length*length)
                    if projection >= -0.0001 && projection <= 1.0001 && math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(point,segment.a))) < 0.0001*length { return true }
                }
            }
        }
        return false
    }
    // Only presentation vertices are blended. Stored outlines and fixtures stay exact.
    cosmetic_point :: proc(s: ^Scene,sub: Subdivision,rest: Vec2,poses: map[u64]Pose) -> Vec2 {
        self:=render_subdivision(s,sub,poses)
        point:=posed_point(self,rest)
        flex:=clamp(s.materials[sub.material].flexibility,f32(0),f32(1))
        if flex==0 { return point }
        weighted:=point
        count:=f32(1)
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            other_id:=u64(0)
            if c.a==sub.id { other_id=c.b } else if c.b==sub.id { other_id=c.a }
            if other_id==0 { continue }
            other:=render_subdivision(s,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[other_id]],poses)
            if point_on_boundary(rest,sub.outline,other.outline) { weighted=vadd(weighted,posed_point(other,rest)); count+=1 }

    package main
    
    import "core:fmt"
    import "core:os"
    import "core:strings"

    review_name: string
    review_output: string
    review_log: strings.Builder
    review_duration := 360
    review_point := Vec2{1,1.3}
    review_radius := f32(5)
    
    main :: proc() {
    	assert(len(os.args)==3)
    	review_name,review_output=os.args[1],os.args[2]
    	switch review_name {
    	case "small-r2": review_radius=2
    	case "side-r4": review_radius=4
    	case "side-r6": review_radius=6
    	case "nearby-r5": review_point={1.1,1.3}
    	case "rim-r5": review_point={-1.24,0.56}
    	case "overhead-r5": review_point={2.75,3.15}
    	case "repeat-r5": review_duration=480
    	}
    	_ = fmt.sbprintf(&review_log,"frame,phase,regions,links,pieces,area,linear_energy,area_times_speed,moving_area,max_speed,max_spin,in_yard_max_speed,mean_rest_displacement\n")
    	run_sandbox(true)
    	assert(os.write_entire_file(fmt.tprintf("%s/telemetry.csv",review_output),transmute([]byte)strings.to_string(review_log))==nil)
    	strings.builder_destroy(&review_log)
    	fmt.println("Completed destruction playback:",review_name)
    }
    
    review_create :: proc() -> Sandbox {
    	settings:=DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS
    	settings.blast_radius=review_radius
    	return sandbox_create(settings)
    }
    review_before_frame :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,view: View,frame: int) {
    	if frame==0 { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(smoke_mouse(30,40)) }
    	for at in [2]int{120,240} {
    		if at==240 && review_name!="repeat-r5" { continue }
    		if frame==at {
    			aim:=screen_point(view,review_point)
    			rl.PlayAutomationEvent(smoke_mouse(i32(aim.x),i32(aim.y)))
    		}
    		if frame==at+1 { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(smoke_button(true)) }
    		if frame==at+4 { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(smoke_button(false)) }
    		if frame==at+6 { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(smoke_mouse(30,40)) }
    	}
    }
    review_record :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,frame: int,phase: string) {
    	a,b,c:=counts_runtime(&game.scene)
    	area,linear_energy,weighted_speed,moving_area,max_speed,max_spin,in_yard_max_speed,displacement: f32
    	for sub in game.scene.subdivisions {
    		if !sub.live { continue }
    		mass:=polygon_area(sub.outline)
    		speed:=vlen(sub.pose.velocity)
    		area+=mass
    		linear_energy+=0.5*mass*speed*speed
    		weighted_speed+=mass*speed
    		if speed>0.2 { moving_area+=mass }
    		max_speed=max(max_speed,speed)
    		max_spin=max(max_spin,math.abs(sub.pose.angular_velocity))
    		if sub.pose.position.x>=-8 && sub.pose.position.x<=9 && sub.pose.position.y>=-1 { in_yard_max_speed=max(in_yard_max_speed,speed) }
    		displacement+=mass*vlen(vsub(sub.pose.position,sub.rest_center))
    	}
    	if area>0 { displacement/=area }
    	_ = fmt.sbprintf(&review_log,"%d,%s,%d,%d,%d,%.7f,%.7f,%.7f,%.7f,%.7f,%.7f,%.7f,%.7f\n",frame,phase,a,b,c,area,linear_energy,weighted_speed,moving_area,max_speed,max_spin,in_yard_max_speed,displacement)
    }
    review_before_step :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,frame: int,point: Vec2) {
    	if frame==120 {
    		review_record(game,frame,"before")
    		assert(save_snapshot(&game.scene,fmt.tprintf("%s/before.json",review_output)))

    	if frame==121 || (frame==241 && review_name=="repeat-r5") {
    		assert(sandbox_valid_aim(&game.scene,point))
    		review_record(game,frame,"blast")
    		assert(save_snapshot(&game.scene,fmt.tprintf("%s/blast-%d.json",review_output,frame)))
    		fmt.printf("%s: blast at (%.4f, %.4f), radius %.1f\n",review_name,point.x,point.y,review_radius)

    for name in names:
        folder = output / name
        if not (folder / 'telemetry.csv').exists(): continue
        rows = list(csv.DictReader((folder / 'telemetry.csv').open()))
        before = next(r for r in rows if r['phase'] == 'before')
        blasts = [r for r in rows if r['phase'] == 'blast']
        ticks = {int(r['frame']): r for r in rows if r['phase'] == 'tick'}
        for row in [before, *blasts, *ticks.values()]:
            for key in row:
                if key == 'phase': continue
                row[key] = float(row[key])
        result[name] = {'before': before, 'blasts': blasts,
                        'after_1_tick': ticks[122], 'after_100ms': ticks[127],
                        'after_500ms': ticks[151], 'after_1s': ticks[181],
                        'after_2s': ticks[241], 'after_3s': ticks[301], 'final': rows[-1],
                        'validated_snapshots': len(list(folder.glob('tick-*.json')))}

    Add: C:\Users\jblic\Documents\BOM\playtests\2026-10-31-destruction\report.md
    Destruction-only verdict: the blast responds immediately and produces readable secondary collisions, but its physical punch is uneven across strengths. High power removes most of the material before it can become moving rubble. Marginal hits can fracture the structure while leaving its silhouette almost unchanged.
    
    This follow-up isolates the explosion system. The player stays at spawn without movement input. Nine native-input playbacks cover 56 seconds of simulation, using the unchanged current Chunk material, seed 42, strengths 30/24, flexibility 0 and impulse scale 0.2. Blasts occur after two seconds of settling. Only radius, placement or the presence of a second shot changes. As in the earlier recordings, the capture build uses the normal 60 Hz physics step and records at 20 fps independently of slow desktop readback. Production gameplay sources and BOM.exe remain unchanged.
    
    The clearest comparison is the same side hit at increasing radius:
    
    | Radius | Material removed immediately | Remaining material moving after 0.1 s | Initial survivor linear kinetic energy |
    | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
    | 4 | 5.0% | 6.18 area units | 52.20 |
    | 5 | 49.8% | 3.27 area units | 36.23 |
    | 6 | 83.2% | 1.09 area units | 14.97 |
    
    The original tower has 6.50 area units. “Moving” means a subdivision centre exceeds 0.2 units/s. Linear energy is measured immediately after the blast, before the solver runs, in game units; rotational energy is excluded. These figures describe this specific side hit, rather than universal percentages for every blast.
    
    The surviving fragments travel farther as power increases, but there is much less surviving material. In the radius-6 recording, most of the structure disappears in one update and a few pieces move away. The radius-4 hit leaves large chunks to detach, tilt and collide. My judgement from the rendered sequences is that the strongest shot looks cleaner and lighter, despite creating the largest hole. The removed core creates no physical debris under the current rules; the surviving rim carries the impact.
    
    [Animated strength comparison](blast-strength-comparison.gif) · [Strength contact sheet](strengths.jpg) · [Placement contact sheet](placement.jpg)
    
    Other findings:
    
    - A radius-2 hit removes no material. Within 0.5 s, solver reactions have changed the tower to 13 logical regions and two pieces, but average subdivision displacement is only 0.022 units. New cracks appear while the tower barely moves. That is a weak physical response for a successful fracture event.
    - The more distant radius-5 hit also removes no material. After 0.5 s it has 27 regions in three pieces; the structure shifts about 0.28 units on average and retains its stepped silhouette. This is another case where crack generation is much more obvious than chunk release.
    - An overhead hit removes 28.9% of the material immediately. Downward motion rapidly meets the floor: survivor linear energy falls from 54.57 to 2.59 within 0.1 s, with substantial secondary fracture. It reads as compression and crumbling, distinct from the side hit's launch and toppling.
    - Moving the side origin about 0.107 units toward the tower changes immediate removal from 49.8% to 52.3%. The crack layout and later collapse change, while the amount removed remains close. Macro damage is reasonably stable under this small aim change.
    - A fresh repeat of the standard shot produces a byte-for-byte identical snapshot immediately after the blast, including geometry and initial motion. Later contact outcomes can vary slightly. Initial shot repeatability holds up.
    - A second blast from the same point, two seconds later, removes no additional material immediately. It applies another kick to the remaining rubble and changes its connections. The shot's useful effect follows the current positions of the survivors.
    
    The immediate response, repeatable initial cut and collision-driven toppling are useful foundations. The next destruction tuning target should be the balance between **material removal, chunk release and ejection**. Stronger shots should communicate their power through a clear physical result; marginal hits should visibly loosen something when they fracture it. Increasing the impulse multiplier alone does not address the large amount of material that has already disappeared.
    
    Recordings:

    | [Side hit, radius 4](side-r4.mp4) | Radius 4 |

    | [Repeated hit](repeat-r5.mp4) | A second click two seconds after the first |
    | [Fresh repeat](recheck-r5.mp4) | Repeat the original setup and shot |
    
    The standard side origin recorded through the native cursor was (0.9907, 1.3147). All 130 sampled scene validations passed. [Telemetry summary](summary.json), per-playback CSVs and snapshots preserve the measurements, including snapshots after logical blast resolution and before the next solver step. ## Assistant

I ran **nine additional blast-only cases**, keeping the player idle. My destruction-only verdict: **the response is immediate, but the physical punch is uneven.**

- **Stronger blasts leave less material to throw.** For the same side hit, radius 4 removes **5%**, radius 5 removes **50%**, and radius 6 removes **83%** immediately. The strongest shot looks surprisingly clean and light because most of the structure disappears.
- **Marginal hits can produce cracks without much physical change.** The structure gains subdivisions while retaining almost the same silhouette. Those hits feel weak despite technically causing damage.
- **Initial repeatability holds up.** Resetting and repeating the default shot reproduced its initial geometry and motion exactly. Detachment, toppling and secondary collisions provide a useful foundation.

I’d prioritize the balance between **material disappearing, chunks breaking loose, and debris being thrown**. Those need to work together for power to feel consistent.

    Sandbox_Settings :: struct {
        blast_radius: f32,
        blast_mode: Blast_Mode,
        pattern: int,
        fragment_strength, connection_strength, flexibility: f32,
        generate_children: bool,
        seed: u8,
    }
    DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS :: Sandbox_Settings{blast_radius=5.0,fragment_strength=30,connection_strength=24,flexibility=0,generate_children=true,seed=42}
    sandbox_material :: proc(settings: Sandbox_Settings) -> Material {
        material:=material_preset(settings.pattern)
        material.subdivision_strength=settings.fragment_strength
        material.connection_strength=settings.connection_strength
        material.flexibility=settings.flexibility
        return material
    }
    Sandbox :: struct {
        scene: Scene,
        floor: b2.BodyId,
        player: Player,
        bomb_rain: Bomb_Rain,
        applied,draft: Sandbox_Settings,
        previous: map[u64]Pose,
        previous_player: Vec2,
        panel_open,inspection,tuning_open,surface,joints: bool,
        block_jump,block_blast,jump_queued: bool,
        selected: u64,
        accumulator: f32,
        status: string,
        status_time: f32,
    }
    sandbox_create :: proc(settings: Sandbox_Settings = DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS) -> Sandbox {
        game:=Sandbox{applied=settings,draft=settings,previous=make(map[u64]Pose),surface=true,joints=true}
        sandbox_reset(&game)
        return game
    }
    sandbox_destroy :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        scene_destroy(&game.scene)
        delete(game.bomb_rain.bombs); delete(game.bomb_rain.bursts)
        delete(game.previous)
        game^={}
    }
    sandbox_notice :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,text: string) { game.status=text; game.status_time=2.5 }
    sandbox_clear_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        game.accumulator=0
        game.jump_queued=false
        game.block_jump=true
        game.block_blast=true
        player_clear_input(&game.player)
        clear(&game.previous)
        game.previous_player=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
    }
    sandbox_reset :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        revision:=game.scene.revision+1
        scene_destroy(&game.scene)
        s:=&game.scene
        s^=new_scene(0.10)
        s.revision=revision
        material:=add_material(s,sandbox_material(game.applied))
        seed:=game.applied.seed
        if !game.applied.generate_children { seed=0 }
        owner:=add_piece(s,material,seed)
        // A stepped stack, with one common reference frame and real shared edges.
        for row in 0..<3 {
            for column in 0..<4-row {
                // Start on the floor: the former 5 mm drop overloaded stiff joints on landing.
                x,y:=f32(1.5)+f32(column)*0.85,f32(row)*0.85
                points:=[4]Vec2{{x,y},{x+0.85,y},{x+0.85,y+0.85},{x,y+0.85}}
                outline:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
                id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline)})
                // Stable block coordinates give neighboring roots distinct birth contexts.
                s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].seed=derive_seed(seed,u64(row*4+column+1))
                append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
            }
        }
        for a in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            for b in a+1..<len(s.subdivisions) { add_connection(s,s.subdivisions[a].id,s.subdivisions[b].id) }
        }
        for connection in s.connections { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].connections,connection.id) }
        physics_init(s,{0,-9.8})
        def:=b2.DefaultBodyDef()
        def.position={0.5,-0.3}
        game.floor=b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
        shape:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); shape.material.friction=0.65
        _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(game.floor,shape,b2.MakeBox(8.5,0.3))
        game.player=player_create(s.physics.world)
        bomb_rain_reset(&game.bomb_rain,game.applied.seed)
        game.selected=0
        sandbox_clear_input(game)
        sandbox_notice(game,"Yard reset")
    }
    sandbox_set_panel :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,open: bool) {
        game.panel_open=open
        if open { game.draft=game.applied }
        sandbox_clear_input(game)
    }
    sandbox_set_radius :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,radius: f32) {
        game.applied.blast_radius=clamp(radius,f32(0.5),f32(6))
        game.draft.blast_radius=game.applied.blast_radius
    }
    sandbox_apply_settings :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        game.applied=game.draft
        sandbox_reset(game)
        game.panel_open=false
        sandbox_notice(game,"Settings applied")
    }
    // Inclusive edges are solid too. Use the logical posed outline, not the cosmetic mesh.
    point_in_subdivision :: proc(sub: Subdivision,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        local:=vadd(sub.rest_center,vrotate(vsub(point,sub.pose.position),-sub.pose.angle))
        inside:=false
        for a,i in sub.outline.points {
            b:=sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)]
            edge:=vsub(b,a); relative:=vsub(local,a)
            if math.abs(vcross(edge,relative))<0.00001 && vdot(relative,edge)>=0 && vdot(relative,edge)<=vdot(edge,edge) { return true }
            if (a.y>local.y)!=(b.y>local.y) && local.x<(b.x-a.x)*(local.y-a.y)/(b.y-a.y)+a.x { inside=!inside }
        }
        return inside
    }
    sandbox_valid_aim :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live && point_in_subdivision(sub,point) { return false } }
        return true
    }
    sandbox_blast :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        if game.panel_open || game.applied.blast_mode!=.Manual { return false }
        if !sandbox_valid_aim(&game.scene,point) { sandbox_notice(game,"Aim outside the solid shape"); return false }
        sandbox_explode(game,point)
        return true
    }
    sandbox_explode :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2) {
        blast_pass(&game.scene,Blast{position=point,radius=game.applied.blast_radius})
        clear(&game.previous)
    }
    
    // Input routing is independent of raylib, so menu consumption has a direct regression check.
    Sandbox_Input :: struct {
        move: f32,
        jump_pressed,jump_down,blast_pressed,blast_down: bool,
        menu_pressed,reset_pressed,inspection_pressed: bool,
        wheel: f32,
    }
    sandbox_route_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,raw: Sandbox_Input,over_ui: bool) -> Sandbox_Input {
        if raw.inspection_pressed { game.inspection=!game.inspection }
        if raw.menu_pressed {
            sandbox_set_panel(game,!game.panel_open)
            game.block_jump=raw.jump_down
            game.block_blast=raw.blast_down
            return {}
        }
        if !raw.jump_down { game.block_jump=false }
        if !raw.blast_down { game.block_blast=false }
        if game.panel_open { return {} }
        if raw.reset_pressed {
            sandbox_reset(game)
            game.block_jump=raw.jump_down
            game.block_blast=raw.blast_down
            return {}
        }
        result:=raw
        result.jump_pressed=raw.jump_pressed && !game.block_jump
        result.blast_pressed=raw.blast_pressed && !game.block_blast && !over_ui && game.applied.blast_mode==.Manual
        if over_ui { result.wheel=0 }
        if result.wheel!=0 { sandbox_set_radius(game,game.applied.blast_radius+result.wheel*0.2) }
        return result
    }
    sandbox_tick :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,move: f32,jump: bool,dt: f32 = 1.0/60.0) {
        clear(&game.previous)
        for sub in game.scene.subdivisions { if sub.live { game.previous[sub.id]=sub.pose } }
        game.previous_player=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
        bomb_rain_before_step(game,dt)
        player_before_step(&game.player,move,jump,dt)
        physics_tick(&game.scene,dt)
        bomb_rain_after_step(game,dt)
        if player_after_step(&game.player) {
            game.previous_player=PLAYER_SPAWN
            sandbox_notice(game,"Back at spawn")
        }
    }
    sandbox_advance :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,dt: f32,input: Sandbox_Input) {
        if game.panel_open { game.accumulator=0; game.jump_queued=false; return }
        if input.jump_pressed { game.jump_queued=true }
        game.status_time=max(f32(0),game.status_time-dt)
        game.accumulator+=clamp(dt,f32(0),f32(0.1))
        for game.accumulator>=1.0/60.0 {
            sandbox_tick(game,input.move,game.jump_queued)
            game.jump_queued=false
            game.accumulator-=1.0/60.0
        }
    }

    @(test)
    yard_rests_under_gravity_and_player_moves_and_jumps :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        for _ in 0..<360 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        a,b,c:=counts(&game.scene)
        testing.expect(t,a==9 && b==11 && c==1,"The initial structure must remain intact under ordinary gravity")
        testing.expect(t,game.player.grounded)
        testing.expect(t,close(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y,PLAYER_HALF_HEIGHT))
        for sub in game.scene.subdivisions { testing.expect(t,vlen(vsub(sub.pose.position,sub.rest_center))<0.04) }
        for _ in 0..<50 { sandbox_tick(&game,1,false) }
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).x > PLAYER_SPAWN.x+2)
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,true)
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y>5 && !game.player.grounded)
        max_height:=f32(0)
        for _ in 0..<150 {
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
            max_height=max(max_height,b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y)
        }
        testing.expect(t,max_height>2 && game.player.grounded,"One jump must reach its apex and land without another airborne jump")
        testing.expect(t,close(b2.Body_GetRotation(game.player.body).s,0))
        expect_valid(t,&game.scene)
    }
    
    @(test)
    player_stands_on_and_pushes_a_real_fragment :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        // Detach a ground-level block, leaving an actual destruction body to stand on.
        id:=game.scene.subdivisions[3].id
        failures:=Failures{}
        for connection in game.scene.connections {
            if connection.a==id || connection.b==id { append(&failures.connections,connection.id) }
        }
        apply_failures(&game.scene,failures); free_failures(&failures)
        physics_sync_structure(&game.scene)
        body:=game.scene.physics.bodies[id]
        position:=b2.Body_GetPosition(body)
        b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{position.x,1.6},b2.MakeRot(0))
        for _ in 0..<120 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        testing.expect(t,game.player.grounded && b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y>1.35,"Support must come from fragment contacts")
        // Move alongside the detached block and push it using the same collision world.
        b2.Body_SetTransform(body,{-1,0.43},b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,{})
        b2.Body_SetTransform(game.player.body,{-2,0.6},b2.MakeRot(0))
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(game.player.body,{})
        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_tick(&game,0,false) }
        start:=b2.Body_GetPosition(body).x
        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_tick(&game,1,false) }
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_IsValid(body),"Routine player contact should leave the fragment intact")
        if b2.Body_IsValid(body) { testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetPosition(body).x>start+0.05,"The player should physically push debris") }
    }
    
    @(test)
    player_jump_buffer_and_coyote_window :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {

        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(game.player.body,{0,-0.1})

        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y>5)
        game.player.coyote=0
        game.player.buffered_jump=0
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(game.player.body,{0,-0.1})
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,true)
        testing.expect(t,b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y<0,"Jump assistance must not permit an airborne second jump")

    @(test)
    sandbox_menu_and_ui_consume_input_without_catchup :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{},false)
        game.jump_queued=true
        game.accumulator=0.01
        append(&game.scene.remnants,Remnant{subdivision=game.scene.subdivisions[0].id,age=0.2})
        pose:=b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)
        input:=sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true,jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true,move=1,wheel=1},false)
        sandbox_advance(&game,5,input)
        testing.expect(t,game.panel_open && !input.jump_pressed && !input.blast_pressed && input.move==0)
        testing.expect(t,game.accumulator==0 && !game.jump_queued && b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)==pose && game.scene.remnants[0].age==0.2)
        testing.expect(t,!sandbox_blast(&game,{0,1}))
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true,jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,!game.panel_open && !input.jump_pressed && !input.blast_pressed)
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,!input.jump_pressed && !input.blast_pressed,"Held menu inputs must be released before they can act")
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{},false)
        radius:=game.applied.blast_radius
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true,wheel=2},true)
        testing.expect(t,!input.blast_pressed && input.wheel==0 && game.applied.blast_radius==radius)
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,input.jump_pressed && input.blast_pressed)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true},false)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true},false)
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,input.jump_pressed && input.blast_pressed,"A fresh press immediately after closing settings must work")
        sandbox_advance(&game,1.0/60.0,{})
        testing.expect(t,game.accumulator<0.001 && game.scene.remnants[0].age<0.22,"Resume must advance only the current frame")
    }

    bomb_rain_random_drops_pause_switch_and_reset :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        settings:=DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS; settings.blast_mode=.Falling_Bombs

        first_delay:=game.bomb_rain.until_drop

        for _ in 0..<160 {
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
            if len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0 { break }
        }
        first_body:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].body
        first_position:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].previous
        second_delay:=game.bomb_rain.until_drop
        testing.expect(t,first_position.y==BOMB_SKY_HEIGHT && first_position.x>=-7 && first_position.x<=8)
        testing.expect(t,second_delay>=BOMB_DROP_MIN-1.0/60.0 && second_delay<=BOMB_DROP_MAX && second_delay!=first_delay)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{},false)
        input:=sandbox_route_input(&game,{blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,!input.blast_pressed,"Input routing must also suppress manual blasts in bomb mode")
        for _ in 0..<160 {
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
            if game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed { break }
        }
        fuse:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].fuse
        delay:=game.bomb_rain.until_drop
        position:=b2.Body_GetPosition(first_body)
        bomb_count:=len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)
        sandbox_set_panel(&game,true)
        sandbox_advance(&game,5,{})
        testing.expect(t,game.bomb_rain.until_drop==delay && len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==bomb_count)
        testing.expect(t,game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].fuse==fuse && b2.Body_GetPosition(first_body)==position,"Settings must pause landed fuses as well as the spawn schedule and physics")
        revision:=game.scene.revision
        sandbox_set_blast_mode(&game,.Manual)
        testing.expect(t,game.applied.blast_mode==.Manual && game.draft.blast_mode==.Manual && game.scene.revision==revision)
        testing.expect(t,len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==0 && !b2.Body_IsValid(first_body),"Switching back must clear existing bombs without resetting the yard")
        sandbox_set_panel(&game,false)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{},false)
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{blast_pressed=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,input.blast_pressed)
        // Reset repeats the applied seed's drops and restores clean physics ownership.
        sandbox_set_blast_mode(&game,.Falling_Bombs)
        sandbox_reset(&game)
        testing.expect(t,game.bomb_rain.until_drop==first_delay && len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==0 && len(game.bomb_rain.bursts)==0)
        for _ in 0..<160 {
            sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
            if len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0 { break }
        }
        testing.expect(t,close_vec(game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].previous,first_position))
        game.bomb_rain.until_drop=0
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
        testing.expect(t,len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==2 && game.bomb_rain.bombs[1].previous.x!=first_position.x,"Successive drops should use different random sky positions")
        b2.Body_SetTransform(game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].body,{-2,-4},b2.MakeRot(0))
        sandbox_tick(&game,0,false)
        testing.expect(t,len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==1 && len(game.bomb_rain.bursts)==0,"Bombs lost outside the yard must be cleaned up")
        sandbox_reset(&game)
        testing.expect(t,b2.World_GetCounters(game.scene.physics.world).bodyCount==11 && len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==0)
    }

        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.F3,true))
        assert(game.inspection)
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.F3,false))
        image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
        rl.ImageFlipVertical(&image)
        _ = rl.ExportImage(image,"sandbox-playthrough.png")
        rl.UnloadImage(image)
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.R,true))
        assert(b2.World_GetCounters(game.scene.physics.world).bodyCount==11 && len(game.scene.subdivisions)==9,"R did not restore a clean yard")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.R,false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        revision=game.scene.revision
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,785,230)
        assert(game.applied.blast_mode==.Falling_Bombs && game.scene.revision==revision,"Falling bombs toggle should apply without resetting the yard")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,true))
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,i32(aim.x),i32(aim.y))
        assert(game.scene.revision==revision,"World click still caused a manual blast in bomb mode")
        for _ in 0..<160 {
            sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target)
            if len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0 { break }
        }
        assert(len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0,"Bomb mode did not spawn a falling physics object")
        first_bomb:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].body
        for _ in 0..<180 {
            if game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed { break }
            sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target)
        }
        assert(game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed,"The falling bomb did not land")
        for _ in 0..<20 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        bomb_image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
        rl.ImageFlipVertical(&bomb_image)
        _ = rl.ExportImage(bomb_image,"sandbox-bombs-preview.png")
        rl.UnloadImage(bomb_image)
        for _ in 0..<45 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        assert(!b2.Body_IsValid(first_bomb),"The landed bomb did not explode and disappear")
        for _ in 0..<160 {
            if len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0 { break }
            sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target)
        }
        bomb_body:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].body
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,480,230)
        assert(game.applied.blast_mode==.Manual && len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==0 && !b2.Body_IsValid(bomb_body),"Manual mode toggle did not remove pending bombs")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,true))
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,i32(aim.x),i32(aim.y))
        assert(game.scene.revision>revision,"Switching back did not restore manual blasts")
        fmt.println("Sandbox input smoke passed: movement, held jump, paused settings, slider drag, staged apply, blast, inspection, reset, both bomb-mode toggles, bomb landing and detonation.")
    }
