        game.accumulator=0.01

        pose:=b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)
        input:=sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true,jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true,move=1,wheel=1},false)

        testing.expect(t,!sandbox_blast(&game,{0,1}))
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true,jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,!game.panel_open && !input.jump_pressed && !input.blast_pressed)

        radius:=game.applied.blast_radius

        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,input.jump_pressed && input.blast_pressed)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true},false)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true},false)
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,input.jump_pressed && input.blast_pressed,"A fresh press immediately after closing settings must work")
        sandbox_advance(&game,1.0/60.0,{})
        testing.expect(t,game.accumulator<0.001 && game.scene.remnants[0].age<0.22,"Resume must advance only the current frame")
    }

    package main
    
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    Physics :: struct {
        world: b2.WorldId,
        bodies: map[u64]b2.BodyId,
        joints: map[u64]b2.JointId,
        fixture_counts: map[u64]int,
        anchor_y: f32,
        active: bool,
    }
    Interaction :: struct { force: Vec2, torque: f32 }
    REFERENCE_LENGTH :: f32(1)
    PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS :: 4
    GLOBAL_DAMPING :: f32(0.7)
    
    to_b2 :: proc(v: Vec2) -> b2.Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    from_b2 :: proc(v: b2.Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    interaction_load :: proc(i: Interaction) -> f32 {
        return max(vlen(i.force),math.abs(i.torque)/REFERENCE_LENGTH)
    }
    equivalent_force :: proc(impulse: Vec2, interval: f32) -> Vec2 {
        assert(interval > 0)
        return vmul(impulse,1/interval)
    }
    physics_init :: proc(s: ^Scene, gravity: Vec2 = {}, anchor_y: f32 = -1e30) {
        assert(!s.physics.active)
        def := b2.DefaultWorldDef()
        def.gravity = to_b2(gravity)
        s.physics = Physics{world=b2.CreateWorld(def),bodies=make(map[u64]b2.BodyId),joints=make(map[u64]b2.JointId),fixture_counts=make(map[u64]int),anchor_y=anchor_y,active=true}
        physics_sync_structure(s)
    }
    physics_destroy :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        b2.DestroyWorld(s.physics.world)
        delete(s.physics.bodies); delete(s.physics.joints); delete(s.physics.fixture_counts)
        s.physics = {}
    }
    physics_read_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row := s.sub_rows[id]
            rotation := b2.Body_GetRotation(body)
            s.subdivisions[row].pose = Pose{
                position=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(body)),angle=math.atan2(rotation.s,rotation.c),
                velocity=from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body)),angular_velocity=b2.Body_GetAngularVelocity(body),
            }
        }
    }
    physics_create_fixture :: proc(s: ^Scene, body: b2.BodyId, sub: Subdivision, outline: Polygon) -> bool {
        points: [dynamic]b2.Vec2
        defer delete(points)
        for point in outline.points { append(&points,to_b2(vsub(point,sub.rest_center))) }
        hull := b2.ComputeHull(points[:])
        // Hull welding can collapse a thin ear below Box2D's collision tolerance.
        if hull.count < 3 { return false }
        polygon := b2.MakePolygon(hull,0)
        def := b2.DefaultShapeDef()
        def.density = 1
        _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
        s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id] += 1
        return true
    }
    physics_finish_mass :: proc(s: ^Scene,body: b2.BodyId,sub: Subdivision) {
        if s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id]==0 {
            // A microscopic attached subdivision is still one live logical entity.
            // Use a bounding fixture when the engine cannot resolve any of its ears.
            lo,hi:=Vec2{1e30,1e30},Vec2{-1e30,-1e30}
            for rest in sub.outline.points { p:=vsub(rest,sub.rest_center); lo={min(lo.x,p.x),min(lo.y,p.y)}; hi={max(hi.x,p.x),max(hi.y,p.y)} }
            polygon:=b2.MakeOffsetBox(max(f32(0.0025),(hi.x-lo.x)*0.5),max(f32(0.0025),(hi.y-lo.y)*0.5),to_b2(vmul(vadd(lo,hi),0.5)),b2.MakeRot(0))
            def:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); def.density=1
            _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
            s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id]=1
        }
        // Keep mass and the body origin tied to the exact logical polygon, including
        // when Box2D simplifies a fixture. This also makes rotational inheritance exact.
        inertia: f32
        for i in 0..<len(sub.outline.points) {
            a,b:=vsub(sub.outline.points[i],sub.rest_center),vsub(sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)],sub.rest_center)
            inertia+=vcross(a,b)*(vdot(a,a)+vdot(a,b)+vdot(b,b))/12
        }
        b2.Body_SetMassData(body,b2.MassData{mass=polygon_area(sub.outline),center={},rotationalInertia=math.abs(inertia)})
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,to_b2(sub.pose.velocity))
        b2.Body_SetAngularVelocity(body,sub.pose.angular_velocity)
    }
    // This runs only between World_Step calls. Existing handles survive ownership changes.
    physics_sync_structure :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        anchored:=make(map[u64]bool)
        defer delete(anchored)
        if s.physics.anchor_y>-1e30 {
            for sub in s.subdivisions {
                if !sub.live || anchored[sub.owner] { continue }
                for a,i in sub.outline.points {
                    b:=sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)]
                    if math.abs(a.y-s.physics.anchor_y)<0.00001 && math.abs(b.y-s.physics.anchor_y)<0.00001 && math.abs(a.x-b.x)>0.00001 { anchored[sub.owner]=true; break }
                }
            }
        }
        dead_joints: [dynamic]u64
        dead_bodies: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(dead_joints); defer delete(dead_bodies)
        for id,joint in s.physics.joints {
            row,ok := s.conn_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.connections[row].live || anchored[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[s.connections[row].a]].owner] { b2.DestroyJoint(joint); append(&dead_joints,id) }
        }
        for id in dead_joints { delete_key(&s.physics.joints,id) }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row,ok := s.sub_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.subdivisions[row].live { b2.DestroyBody(body); append(&dead_bodies,id) }
        }
        for id in dead_bodies { delete_key(&s.physics.bodies,id); delete_key(&s.physics.fixture_counts,id) }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            type:=b2.BodyType.dynamicBody
            if anchored[sub.owner] { type=.staticBody }
            if body,exists := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]; exists {
                if b2.Body_GetType(body)!=type {
                    b2.Body_SetType(body,type)
                    if type==.dynamicBody { physics_finish_mass(s,body,sub) }
                }
                continue
            }
            def := b2.DefaultBodyDef()
            // Refining a supported piece must not change its behaviour under gravity.
            // Once its connection to a support edge breaks, its bodies become dynamic.
            def.type = type
            def.position = to_b2(sub.pose.position)
            def.rotation = b2.MakeRot(sub.pose.angle)
            def.linearVelocity = to_b2(sub.pose.velocity)
            def.angularVelocity = sub.pose.angular_velocity
            body := b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
            s.physics.bodies[sub.id] = body
            if is_convex(sub.outline) && len(sub.outline.points) <= 8 {
                physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,sub.outline)
            } else {
                triangles := convex_decomposition(sub.outline)
                for triangle in triangles { physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,triangle); delete(triangle.points) }
                delete(triangles)
            }
            physics_finish_mass(s,body,sub)
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            if _,exists := s.physics.joints[c.id]; exists { continue }
            a := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]]
            b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            def := b2.DefaultWeldJointDef()
            def.bodyIdA = s.physics.bodies[c.a]
            def.bodyIdB = s.physics.bodies[c.b]
            // Their logical attachment still participates in blasts; two anchored
            // regions need no solver constraint between them.
            if b2.Body_GetType(def.bodyIdA)==.staticBody && b2.Body_GetType(def.bodyIdB)==.staticBody { continue }
            def.localAnchorA = to_b2(c.local_a)
            def.localAnchorB = to_b2(c.local_b)
            // All outlines share one undeformed frame. Its relative rest angle is zero.
            def.referenceAngle = 0
            flexibility := max(s.materials[a.material].flexibility,s.materials[b.material].flexibility)
            if flexibility > 0 {
                def.linearHertz = 1/max(flexibility,0.01)
                def.angularHertz = def.linearHertz
            }
            def.linearDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
            def.angularDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
            s.physics.joints[c.id] = b2.CreateWeldJoint(s.physics.world,def)
        }
    }
    apply_blast_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene, sub: ^Subdivision, direction: Vec2, load: f32) {
        delta_v := vmul(direction,load*BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE)
        if s.physics.active {
            body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
            impulse := vmul(delta_v,b2.Body_GetMass(body))
            b2.Body_ApplyLinearImpulseToCenter(body,to_b2(impulse),true)
            sub.pose.velocity = from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body))
        } else {
            sub.pose.velocity = vadd(sub.pose.velocity,delta_v)
        }
    }
    // Contact points and fixtures against the same other body form one interaction.
    // Joint reactions are already forces; totalNormalImpulse covers the full tick.
    // Box2D's tangent/rolling impulses cover the final substep in this binding version.
    calculate_physics_loads :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) -> Failures {
        assert(dt > 0)
        failures := Failures{}
        loads := make(map[u64]f32)
        defer delete(loads)
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
            capacity := int(b2.Body_GetContactCapacity(body))
            buffer := make([]b2.ContactData,capacity)
            contacts := b2.Body_GetContactData(body,buffer)
            interactions := make(map[b2.BodyId]Interaction)
            for contact in contacts {
                body_a,body_b := b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdA),b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdB)
                other := body_b
                sign := f32(-1)
                if body_b == body { other=body_a; sign=1 }
                normal := from_b2(contact.manifold.normal)
                tangent := Vec2{normal.y,-normal.x}
                interaction := interactions[other]
                for k in 0..<int(contact.manifold.pointCount) {
                    point := contact.manifold.points[k]
                    force := vadd(equivalent_force(vmul(normal,point.totalNormalImpulse*sign),dt),equivalent_force(vmul(tangent,point.tangentImpulse*sign),dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)))
                    interaction.force = vadd(interaction.force,force)
                    interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(from_b2(point.point),sub.pose.position),force)
                }
                interaction.torque += contact.manifold.rollingImpulse*sign/(dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS))
                interactions[other] = interaction
            }
            for _,interaction in interactions { loads[sub.id] = max(loads[sub.id],interaction_load(interaction)) }
            delete(interactions); delete(buffer)
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            joint,exists := s.physics.joints[c.id]
            if !exists { continue }
            interaction := Interaction{force=from_b2(b2.Joint_GetConstraintForce(joint)),torque=b2.Joint_GetConstraintTorque(joint)}
            load := interaction_load(interaction)
            a,b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            a_interaction,b_interaction := interaction,interaction
            a_interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(posed_point(a,c.rest_point),a.pose.position),interaction.force)
            b_interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(posed_point(b,c.rest_point),b.pose.position),interaction.force)
            loads[c.a] = max(loads[c.a],interaction_load(a_interaction))
            loads[c.b] = max(loads[c.b],interaction_load(b_interaction))
            material := s.materials[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].material]
            if fails(load,material.connection_strength) { append(&failures.connections,c.id) }
        }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if sub.live && fails(loads[sub.id],s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&failures.subdivisions,sub.id) }
        }
        return failures
    }
    Load_Calculator :: #type proc(s: ^Scene,dt: f32) -> Failures
    physics_tick :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32,calculate_loads: Load_Calculator = calculate_physics_loads) {
        assert(s.physics.active && dt > 0)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        b2.World_Step(s.physics.world,dt,PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)
        physics_read_motion(s)
        failures := calculate_loads(s,dt)
        apply_failures(s,failures)
        delete(failures.subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
        delete(failures.discard_subdivisions)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        fade_step(s,dt)
    }

    import rl "vendor:raylib"
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:fmt"
    
    // raylib 5.x automation event IDs (rcore.c); the Odin binding exposes the raw event.
    smoke_key :: proc(key: rl.KeyboardKey,down: bool) -> rl.AutomationEvent {
        type:=u32(1); if down { type=2 }
        return {type=type,params={i32(key),0,0,0}}
    }
    smoke_mouse :: proc(x,y: i32) -> rl.AutomationEvent {
        dpi:=rl.GetWindowScaleDPI()
        return {type=7,params={i32(f32(x)*dpi.x),i32(f32(y)*dpi.y),0,0}}
    }
    smoke_button :: proc(down: bool) -> rl.AutomationEvent {
        type:=u32(5); if down { type=6 }
        return {type=type,params={0,0,0,0}}
    }
    sandbox_smoke_frame :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,target: rl.RenderTexture2D,events: ..rl.AutomationEvent) {
        for event in events { rl.PlayAutomationEvent(event) }
        width,height:=f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight())
        view:=sandbox_view(width,height)
        mouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()
        over_ui:=sandbox_over_hud(mouse,width,height,game.inspection)
        raw:=sandbox_read_input()
        input:=sandbox_route_input(game,raw,over_ui)
        if !raw.menu_pressed && !raw.reset_pressed {
            if !sandbox_inspect_input(game,world_point(view,mouse),view,over_ui) && input.blast_pressed { sandbox_blast(game,world_point(view,mouse)) }
        }
        sandbox_advance(game,1.0/60.0,input)
        poses:=make(map[u64]Pose); defer delete(poses)
        rl.BeginDrawing()
        rl.BeginTextureMode(target)
        rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
        sandbox_draw_world(game,view,poses)
        if !game.panel_open && !over_ui { sandbox_draw_aim(game,view,mouse) }
        action:=sandbox_draw_hud(game,width,height)
        rl.EndTextureMode()
        rl.EndDrawing()
        sandbox_handle_ui(game,action)
    }
    sandbox_smoke_click :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,target: rl.RenderTexture2D,x,y: i32) {
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(x,y),smoke_button(true))
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(x,y),smoke_button(false))
    }
    sandbox_smoke_inputs :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        rl.SetTargetFPS(0)
        target:=rl.LoadRenderTexture(rl.GetScreenWidth(),rl.GetScreenHeight())
        defer rl.UnloadRenderTexture(target)
        for _ in 0..<60 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(30,40)) }
        assert(game.player.grounded,"Player did not land")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.D,true))
        for _ in 0..<45 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.D,false))
        assert(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).x>PLAYER_SPAWN.x+2,"D did not move the player")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.SPACE,true))
        assert(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(game.player.body).y>5,"Space did not jump")
        // Keep holding jump through landing: there must be no repeated jump.
        for _ in 0..<120 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        assert(game.player.grounded,"Holding Space repeated a jump")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.SPACE,false))
        revision:=game.scene.revision
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        assert(game.panel_open && game.scene.revision==revision,"Settings click leaked into the world")
        pose:=b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)
        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.D,true),smoke_key(.SPACE,true)) }
        assert(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)==pose,"Menu did not pause the player")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.D,false),smoke_key(.SPACE,false))
        // Begin a slider drag, close with Escape, release outside, then reopen by button.
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(820,294),smoke_button(true))
        assert(game.applied.blast_radius>5.1,"Radius slider did not update the preview value")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,true))
        assert(!game.panel_open && !rl.WindowShouldClose(),"Escape should resume without exiting")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,false),smoke_mouse(550,450),smoke_button(false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        assert(game.panel_open,"Closing a slider during drag left toolbar buttons captured")
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,785,368)
        assert(game.draft.pattern==2 && game.applied.pattern==0,"Breakup choice should be staged")
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,400,416)
        assert(!game.draft.generate_children && game.applied.generate_children)
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,780,622)
        assert(!game.panel_open && game.scene.materials[0].triangulate && game.scene.pieces[0].seed==0,"Apply & Reset did not apply the staged settings")
        assert(game.scene.materials[0].subdivision_strength==35 && game.scene.materials[0].connection_strength==20 && game.scene.materials[0].flexibility==0,"Pattern changed independent tuning")
        a,b,c:=counts_runtime(&game.scene)
        assert(a==10 && b==11 && c==2,"Apply click also blasted the yard")
        // Blast outside the tower, then inspect and reset the moving result.
        view:=sandbox_view(1280,800)
        aim:=screen_point(view,{1,1.3})
        revision=game.scene.revision
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,i32(aim.x),i32(aim.y))
        remaining,_,_:=counts_runtime(&game.scene)
        assert(game.scene.revision>revision && remaining<10,"The first fresh world click after Apply did not blast")
        for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.F3,true))
        assert(game.inspection)
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.F3,false))
        image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
        rl.ImageFlipVertical(&image)
        _ = rl.ExportImage(image,"sandbox-playthrough.png")
        rl.UnloadImage(image)
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.R,true))
        assert(b2.World_GetCounters(game.scene.physics.world).bodyCount==12 && len(game.scene.subdivisions)==10,"R did not restore a clean yard")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.R,false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        revision=game.scene.revision
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,785,230)
        assert(game.applied.blast_mode==.Falling_Bombs && game.scene.revision==revision,"Falling bombs toggle should apply without resetting the yard")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,true))
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,i32(aim.x),i32(aim.y))
        assert(game.scene.revision==revision,"World click still caused a manual blast in bomb mode")
        for _ in 0..<160 {
            sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target)
            if len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0 { break }
        }
        assert(len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0,"Bomb mode did not spawn a falling physics object")
        first_bomb:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].body
        for _ in 0..<180 {
            if game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed { break }
            sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target)
        }
        assert(game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].landed,"The falling bomb did not land")
        for _ in 0..<20 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        bomb_image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
        rl.ImageFlipVertical(&bomb_image)
        _ = rl.ExportImage(bomb_image,"sandbox-bombs-preview.png")
        rl.UnloadImage(bomb_image)
        for _ in 0..<45 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target) }
        assert(!b2.Body_IsValid(first_bomb),"The landed bomb did not explode and disappear")
        for _ in 0..<160 {
            if len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)>0 { break }
            sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target)
        }
        bomb_body:=game.bomb_rain.bombs[0].body
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,480,230)
        assert(game.applied.blast_mode==.Manual && len(game.bomb_rain.bombs)==0 && !b2.Body_IsValid(bomb_body),"Manual mode toggle did not remove pending bombs")
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,true))
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.ESCAPE,false))
        sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,i32(aim.x),i32(aim.y))
        assert(game.scene.revision>revision,"Switching back did not restore manual blasts")
        // Restore generation through the real panel, then excavate both ends of the
        // single floor root in each breakup pattern. Keep rendered results for review.
        sandbox_set_radius(game,DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS.blast_radius)
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.F3,true))
        sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_key(.F3,false))
        for pattern in 0..<3 {
            sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,1180,43)
            sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,468+i32(pattern)*168,368)
            if !game.draft.generate_children { sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,400,416) }
            sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,780,622)
            assert(!game.panel_open && game.applied.generate_children && game.applied.pattern==pattern)
            root:=game.scene.subdivisions[9].id
            for _ in 0..<30 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(30,40)) }
            positions:=[2]f32{6,-6}
            for x in positions {
                point:=screen_point(view,{x,0.2})
                sandbox_smoke_click(game,target,i32(point.x),i32(point.y))
                assert(!game.scene.subdivisions[game.scene.sub_rows[root]].live,"A distant floor hit did not generate local destruction")
                for _ in 0..<60 { sandbox_smoke_frame(game,target,smoke_mouse(30,40)) }
            }
            assert(b2.Body_IsValid(game.floor) && b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body).y>=YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM+PLAYER_HALF_HEIGHT-0.03,"Excavation opened the bottom of the screen")
            ground_image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
            rl.ImageFlipVertical(&ground_image)
            _ = rl.ExportImage(ground_image,rl.TextFormat("sandbox-ground-%d.png",pattern))
            rl.UnloadImage(ground_image)
        }
        fmt.println("Sandbox input smoke passed: movement, held jump, paused settings, slider drag, staged apply, blast, inspection, reset, both bomb-mode toggles, bomb landing and detonation, and destructible ground in all three patterns.")
    }

    package main
    
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    Sandbox_Settings :: struct {
        blast_radius: f32,
        blast_mode: Blast_Mode,
        pattern: int,
        fragment_strength, connection_strength, flexibility: f32,
        generate_children: bool,
        seed: u8,
    }
    DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS :: Sandbox_Settings{blast_radius=5.0,fragment_strength=35,connection_strength=20,flexibility=0,generate_children=true,seed=42}
    YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM :: f32(-3)
    YARD_BASE_DEPTH :: f32(0.25)
    sandbox_material :: proc(settings: Sandbox_Settings) -> Material {
        material:=material_preset(settings.pattern)
        material.subdivision_strength=settings.fragment_strength
        material.connection_strength=settings.connection_strength
        material.flexibility=settings.flexibility
        return material
    }
    Sandbox :: struct {
        scene: Scene,
        floor: b2.BodyId,
        player: Player,
        bomb_rain: Bomb_Rain,
        applied,draft: Sandbox_Settings,
        previous: map[u64]Pose,
        previous_player: Vec2,
        panel_open,inspection,tuning_open,surface,joints: bool,
        block_jump,block_blast,jump_queued: bool,
        selected: u64,
        accumulator: f32,
        status: string,
        status_time: f32,
    }
    sandbox_create :: proc(settings: Sandbox_Settings = DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS) -> Sandbox {
        game:=Sandbox{applied=settings,draft=settings,previous=make(map[u64]Pose),surface=true,joints=true}
        sandbox_reset(&game)
        return game
    }
    sandbox_destroy :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        scene_destroy(&game.scene)
        delete(game.bomb_rain.bombs); delete(game.bomb_rain.bursts)
        delete(game.previous)
        game^={}
    }
    sandbox_notice :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,text: string) { game.status=text; game.status_time=2.5 }
    sandbox_clear_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        game.accumulator=0
        game.jump_queued=false
        game.block_jump=true
        game.block_blast=true
        player_clear_input(&game.player)
        clear(&game.previous)
        game.previous_player=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
    }
    sandbox_reset :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        revision:=game.scene.revision+1
        scene_destroy(&game.scene)
        s:=&game.scene
        s^=new_scene(0.10)
        s.revision=revision
        material:=add_material(s,sandbox_material(game.applied))
        seed:=game.applied.seed
        if !game.applied.generate_children { seed=0 }
        owner:=add_piece(s,material,seed)
        // A stepped stack, with one common reference frame and real shared edges.
        for row in 0..<3 {
            for column in 0..<4-row {
                // Start on the floor: the former 5 mm drop overloaded stiff joints on landing.
                x,y:=f32(1.5)+f32(column)*0.85,f32(row)*0.85
                points:=[4]Vec2{{x,y},{x+0.85,y},{x+0.85,y+0.85},{x,y+0.85}}
                outline:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
                id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline)})
                // Stable block coordinates give neighboring roots distinct birth contexts.
                s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].seed=derive_seed(seed,u64(row*4+column+1))
                append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
            }
        }
        for a in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            for b in a+1..<len(s.subdivisions) { add_connection(s,s.subdivisions[a].id,s.subdivisions[b].id) }
        }
        for connection in s.connections { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].connections,connection.id) }
        // One large root, with future floor detail generated only near a blast.
        ground:=add_piece(s,material,derive_seed(seed,13))
        ground_points:=[4]Vec2{{-8,YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM},{9,YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM},{9,0},{-8,0}}
        ground_outline:=Polygon{points=ground_points[:]}
        id:=add_subdivision(s,ground,ground_outline,Pose{position=centroid(ground_outline)})
        append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[ground]].subdivisions,id)
        physics_init(s,{0,-9.8},YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM)
        def:=b2.DefaultBodyDef()
        def.position={0.5,YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM-YARD_BASE_DEPTH*0.5}
        game.floor=b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
        shape:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); shape.material.friction=0.65
        // Extend beyond the playable edges so excavation never opens the screen bottom.
        _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(game.floor,shape,b2.MakeBox(10,YARD_BASE_DEPTH*0.5))
        game.player=player_create(s.physics.world)
        bomb_rain_reset(&game.bomb_rain,game.applied.seed)
        game.selected=0
        sandbox_clear_input(game)
        sandbox_notice(game,"Yard reset")
    }
    sandbox_set_panel :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,open: bool) {
        game.panel_open=open
        if open { game.draft=game.applied }
        sandbox_clear_input(game)
    }
    sandbox_set_radius :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,radius: f32) {
        game.applied.blast_radius=clamp(radius,f32(0.5),f32(6))
        game.draft.blast_radius=game.applied.blast_radius
    }
    sandbox_apply_settings :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        game.applied=game.draft
        sandbox_reset(game)
        game.panel_open=false
        sandbox_notice(game,"Settings applied")
    }
    // Inclusive edges are solid too. Use the logical posed outline, not the cosmetic mesh.
    point_in_subdivision :: proc(sub: Subdivision,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        local:=vadd(sub.rest_center,vrotate(vsub(point,sub.pose.position),-sub.pose.angle))
        inside:=false
        for a,i in sub.outline.points {
            b:=sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)]
            edge:=vsub(b,a); relative:=vsub(local,a)
            if math.abs(vcross(edge,relative))<0.00001 && vdot(relative,edge)>=0 && vdot(relative,edge)<=vdot(edge,edge) { return true }
            if (a.y>local.y)!=(b.y>local.y) && local.x<(b.x-a.x)*(local.y-a.y)/(b.y-a.y)+a.x { inside=!inside }
        }
        return inside
    }
    sandbox_valid_aim :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live && point_in_subdivision(sub,point) { return false } }
        return true
    }
    sandbox_blast :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        if game.panel_open || game.applied.blast_mode!=.Manual { return false }
        if !sandbox_valid_aim(&game.scene,point) { sandbox_notice(game,"Aim outside the solid shape"); return false }
        sandbox_explode(game,point)
        return true
    }
    sandbox_explode :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2) {
        blast:=Blast{position=point,radius=game.applied.blast_radius}
        physics_read_motion(&game.scene)
        revision:=game.scene.revision
        refined:=sandbox_refine_ground(&game.scene,blast)
        blast_pass(&game.scene,blast)
        if refined && game.scene.revision==revision { game.scene.revision+=1 }
        clear(&game.previous)
    }
    
    // A huge floor cell can miss a local hit, including when its centre fails but
    // its first children miss. Resolve cells larger than the damage zone first;
    // smaller failed cells keep the existing generation rules and deletion shortcut.
    // Each step preserves the existing geometry, contexts and inherited attachments;
    // blast_pass then resolves actual damage before creating final physics bodies.
    sandbox_refine_ground :: proc(s: ^Scene,blast: Blast) -> bool {
        affected:=make(map[u64]bool)
        defer delete(affected)
        unrefinable:=make(map[u64]bool)
        defer delete(unrefinable)
        changed:=false
        for {
            failures:=Failures{}
            for sub in s.subdivisions {
                if !sub.live || sub.rest_center.y>=0 || sub.seed==0 || sub.width<=s.minimum_width || unrefinable[sub.id] { continue }
                strength:=s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength
                if fails(blast_load(vlen(vsub(sub.pose.position,blast.position)),blast.radius),strength) {
                    extent:=f32(0)
                    for point in sub.outline.points { extent=max(extent,vlen(vsub(point,sub.rest_center))) }
                    if extent<=blast.radius-strength/BLAST_LOAD_MULTIPLIER || blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,strength) { continue }
                }
                distance:=f32(1e30)
                if point_in_subdivision(sub,blast.position) { distance=0 }
                else {
                    for rest,i in sub.outline.points {
                        a,b:=posed_point(sub,rest),posed_point(sub,sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)])
                        edge:=vsub(b,a); squared:=vdot(edge,edge)
                        if squared<=0 { continue }
                        t:=clamp(vdot(vsub(blast.position,a),edge)/squared,f32(0),f32(1))
                        distance=min(distance,vlen(vsub(blast.position,vadd(a,vmul(edge,t)))))
                    }
                }
                if fails(blast_load(distance,blast.radius),strength) { append(&failures.subdivisions,sub.id) }
            }
            if len(failures.subdivisions)==0 { break }
            stage_failures(s,failures,&affected,true)
            for id in failures.subdivisions {
                if s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].live { unrefinable[id]=true }
                else { changed=true }
            }
            delete(failures.subdivisions)
        }
        if changed { rebuild_affected_pieces(s,affected) }
        return changed
    }
    
    // Input routing is independent of raylib, so menu consumption has a direct regression check.
    Sandbox_Input :: struct {
        move: f32,
        jump_pressed,jump_down,blast_pressed,blast_down: bool,
        menu_pressed,reset_pressed,inspection_pressed: bool,
        wheel: f32,
    }
    sandbox_route_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,raw: Sandbox_Input,over_ui: bool) -> Sandbox_Input {
        if raw.inspection_pressed { game.inspection=!game.inspection }
        if raw.menu_pressed {
            sandbox_set_panel(game,!game.panel_open)
            game.block_jump=raw.jump_down
            game.block_blast=raw.blast_down
            return {}
        }
        if !raw.jump_down { game.block_jump=false }
        if !raw.blast_down { game.block_blast=false }
        if game.panel_open { return {} }
        if raw.reset_pressed {
            sandbox_reset(game)
            game.block_jump=raw.jump_down
            game.block_blast=raw.blast_down
            return {}
        }
        result:=raw
        result.jump_pressed=raw.jump_pressed && !game.block_jump
        result.blast_pressed=raw.blast_pressed && !game.block_blast && !over_ui && game.applied.blast_mode==.Manual
        if over_ui { result.wheel=0 }
        if result.wheel!=0 { sandbox_set_radius(game,game.applied.blast_radius+result.wheel*0.2) }
        return result
    }
    sandbox_tick :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,move: f32,jump: bool,dt: f32 = 1.0/60.0) {
        clear(&game.previous)
        for sub in game.scene.subdivisions { if sub.live { game.previous[sub.id]=sub.pose } }
        game.previous_player=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
        bomb_rain_before_step(game,dt)
        player_before_step(&game.player,move,jump,dt)
        physics_tick(&game.scene,dt)
        bomb_rain_after_step(game,dt)
        if player_after_step(&game.player) {
            game.previous_player=PLAYER_SPAWN
            sandbox_notice(game,"Back at spawn")
        }
    }
    sandbox_advance :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,dt: f32,input: Sandbox_Input) {
        if game.panel_open { game.accumulator=0; game.jump_queued=false; return }
        if input.jump_pressed { game.jump_queued=true }
        game.status_time=max(f32(0),game.status_time-dt)
        game.accumulator+=clamp(dt,f32(0),f32(0.1))
        for game.accumulator>=1.0/60.0 {
            sandbox_tick(game,input.move,game.jump_queued)
            game.jump_queued=false
            game.accumulator-=1.0/60.0
        }
    }
    package main
    
    import rl "vendor:raylib"
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    
    YARD_INK :: rl.Color{229,239,241,255}
    YARD_MUTED :: rl.Color{144,165,178,255}
    YARD_ACCENT :: rl.Color{111,220,190,255}
    
    // Fit a fixed rectangle with letterboxing. Fragments never affect the camera.
    sandbox_view :: proc(width,height: f32) -> View {
        scale:=min((width-64)/16,(height-170)/8.4)
        return View{offset={width*0.5-0.5*scale,(height+30)*0.5+0.8*scale},scale=scale}
    }
    sandbox_settings_button :: proc(width: f32) -> rl.Rectangle { return {width-174,24,150,38} }
    sandbox_reset_button :: proc(width: f32) -> rl.Rectangle { return {width-284,24,98,38} }
    sandbox_over_hud :: proc(mouse: rl.Vector2,width,height: f32,inspection: bool) -> bool {
        if mouse.y<88 || mouse.y>height-56 { return true }
        return inspection && rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(mouse,{24,106,450,150})
    }
    sandbox_gui_style :: proc() {
        rl.GuiLoadStyleDefault()
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiDefaultProperty.TEXT_SIZE),18)
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BORDER_COLOR_NORMAL),transmute(i32)u32(0x435969ff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BASE_COLOR_NORMAL),transmute(i32)u32(0x233444ff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.TEXT_COLOR_NORMAL),transmute(i32)u32(0xe5eff1ff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BORDER_COLOR_FOCUSED),transmute(i32)u32(0x6fdcbeff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BASE_COLOR_FOCUSED),transmute(i32)u32(0x304e58ff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.TEXT_COLOR_FOCUSED),transmute(i32)u32(0xe5fff4ff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BORDER_COLOR_PRESSED),transmute(i32)u32(0x6fdcbeff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.BASE_COLOR_PRESSED),transmute(i32)u32(0x416d68ff))
        rl.GuiSetStyle(.DEFAULT,i32(rl.GuiControlProperty.TEXT_COLOR_PRESSED),transmute(i32)u32(0xffffffff))
    }
    sandbox_slider :: proc(x,y,width: f32,label: cstring,value: ^f32,low,high: f32,decimals: bool = false) {
        rl.DrawText(label,i32(x),i32(y),17,YARD_INK)
        text:=rl.TextFormat("%.0f",value^)
        if decimals { text=rl.TextFormat("%.2f",value^) }
        rl.DrawText(text,i32(x+width)-rl.MeasureText(text,17),i32(y),17,YARD_ACCENT)
        _ = rl.GuiSliderBar({x,y+25,width,16},nil,nil,value,low,high)
    }
    Sandbox_UI_Action :: enum { None, Open, Resume, Apply, Reset }
    sandbox_draw_panel :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,width,height: f32) -> Sandbox_UI_Action {
        rl.DrawRectangle(0,0,i32(width),i32(height),{8,14,23,205})
        panel_height:=f32(528)
        if game.tuning_open { panel_height=680 }
        x,y:=(width-560)*0.5,(height-panel_height)*0.5
        rl.DrawRectangleRounded({x,y,560,panel_height},0.025,8,{23,35,49,255})
        rl.DrawRectangleRoundedLinesEx({x,y,560,panel_height},0.025,8,1,{65,88,104,255})
        x+=28; y+=24
        rl.DrawText("SETTINGS",i32(x),i32(y),26,YARD_INK)
        rl.DrawText("Paused",i32(x+423),i32(y+7),16,YARD_ACCENT)
        y+=54
        mode:=i32(game.applied.blast_mode)
        _ = rl.GuiToggleGroup({x,y,248,32},"Manual blasts;Falling bombs",&mode)
        sandbox_set_blast_mode(game,Blast_Mode(mode))
        y+=48
        radius:=game.applied.blast_radius
        sandbox_slider(x,y,504,"Blast radius",&radius,0.5,6,true)
        sandbox_set_radius(game,radius)
        y+=63
        rl.DrawText("Breakup style",i32(x),i32(y),17,YARD_INK)
        y+=28
        active:=i32(game.draft.pattern)
        _ = rl.GuiToggleGroup({x,y,160,32},"Chunks;Strips;Shards",&active)
        game.draft.pattern=int(active)
        y+=54
        _ = rl.GuiCheckBox({x,y,22,22},"Generate children",&game.draft.generate_children)
        y+=40
        tuning_label:=cstring("+  Tuning")
        if game.tuning_open { tuning_label="-  Tuning" }
        if rl.GuiButton({x,y,504,30},tuning_label) { game.tuning_open=!game.tuning_open }
        y+=46
        if game.tuning_open {
            sandbox_slider(x,y,504,"Fragment strength",&game.draft.fragment_strength,5,100); y+=51
            sandbox_slider(x,y,504,"Connection strength",&game.draft.connection_strength,5,100); y+=51
            sandbox_slider(x,y,504,"Flexibility",&game.draft.flexibility,0,1,true); y+=50
        }
        rl.DrawText("A/D or arrows: move    Space: jump",i32(x),i32(y),16,YARD_MUTED); y+=22
        controls:=cstring("Click: blast    Wheel: radius / power    R: reset")
        if game.applied.blast_mode==.Falling_Bombs { controls="Bombs: 1 sec after landing    Wheel: power    R: reset" }
        rl.DrawText(controls,i32(x),i32(y),16,YARD_MUTED); y+=22
        rl.DrawText("Tab / Esc: settings    F3: inspection",i32(x),i32(y),16,YARD_MUTED); y+=28
        rl.DrawText("Mode and radius are live. Apply other edits to reset.",i32(x),i32(y),15,YARD_MUTED)
        button_y:=(height-panel_height)*0.5+panel_height-60
        if rl.GuiButton({x,button_y,180,36},"Resume") { return .Resume }
        if rl.GuiButton({x+196,button_y,308,36},"Apply & Reset") { return .Apply }
        return .None
    }
    sandbox_draw_bombs :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,view: View) {
        for burst in game.bomb_rain.bursts {
            progress:=burst.age/BOMB_BURST_TIME
            color:=rl.Color{255,200,112,u8(220*(1-progress))}
            rl.DrawCircleLinesV(screen_point(view,burst.position),burst.radius*view.scale*(0.2+0.8*progress),color)
        }
        for bomb in game.bomb_rain.bombs {
            position:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(bomb.body))
            if !game.panel_open { position=vadd(bomb.previous,vmul(vsub(position,bomb.previous),game.accumulator*60)) }
            center:=screen_point(view,position)
            radius:=BOMB_RADIUS*view.scale
            color:=rl.Color{245,206,133,255}
            if bomb.landed { color={255,132,112,255} }
            rl.DrawCircleV(center,radius,{39,42,50,255})
            rl.DrawCircleLinesV(center,radius,color)
            tip:=rl.Vector2{center.x+radius*0.5,center.y-radius*1.4}
            rl.DrawLineEx({center.x,center.y-radius*0.7},tip,2,color)
            rl.DrawCircleV(tip,2,color)
            if bomb.landed { rl.DrawRing(center,radius+3,radius+5,-90,-90+360*bomb.fuse/BOMB_FUSE,24,color) }
        }
    }
    sandbox_draw_world :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,view: View,poses: map[u64]Pose) {
        s:=&game.scene
        left,top:=screen_point(view,{-9.5,YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM}),screen_point(view,{10.5,YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM-YARD_BASE_DEPTH})
        rl.DrawRectangleRec({left.x,left.y,top.x-left.x,top.y-left.y},{42,58,68,255})
        rl.DrawLineEx(left,screen_point(view,{10.5,YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM}),3,{116,151,151,255})
        for i in -15..=16 {
            x:=f32(i)*0.5
            rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,{x,YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM-0.04}),screen_point(view,{x+0.12,YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM-0.20}),2,{66,86,91,255})
        }
        draw_scene(s,view,poses,game.selected,game.surface,game.inspection && game.joints,game.inspection)
        spawn:=screen_point(view,{PLAYER_SPAWN.x,0})
        rl.DrawLineEx({spawn.x-16,spawn.y+12},{spawn.x+16,spawn.y+12},3,YARD_ACCENT)
        rl.DrawText("SPAWN",i32(spawn.x)-24,i32(spawn.y)+27,12,YARD_MUTED)
        sandbox_draw_bombs(game,view)
        position:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
        if !game.panel_open { position=vadd(game.previous_player,vmul(vsub(position,game.previous_player),game.accumulator*60)) }
        center:=screen_point(view,position)
        radius:=PLAYER_RADIUS*view.scale
        segment:=PLAYER_SEGMENT*view.scale
        rl.DrawRectangleRec({center.x-radius,center.y-segment,2*radius,2*segment},YARD_ACCENT)
        rl.DrawCircleV({center.x,center.y-segment},radius,YARD_ACCENT)
        rl.DrawCircleV({center.x,center.y+segment},radius,YARD_ACCENT)
        rl.DrawLineEx({center.x-radius*0.45,center.y-segment},{center.x+radius*0.45,center.y-segment},3,{21,51,53,255})
    }
    sandbox_draw_aim :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,view: View,mouse: rl.Vector2) {
        if game.applied.blast_mode!=.Manual { return }
        point:=world_point(view,mouse)
        color:=rl.Color{245,206,133,210}
        valid:=sandbox_valid_aim(&game.scene,point)
        if !valid { color={244,132,131,230} }
        rl.DrawCircleLinesV(mouse,game.applied.blast_radius*view.scale,color)
        rl.DrawCircleV(mouse,3,color)
        if !valid {
            rl.DrawLineEx({mouse.x-7,mouse.y-7},{mouse.x+7,mouse.y+7},2,color)
            rl.DrawLineEx({mouse.x+7,mouse.y-7},{mouse.x-7,mouse.y+7},2,color)
            label:=cstring("Aim outside the solid shape")
            x:=clamp(mouse.x+18,f32(12),f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()-rl.MeasureText(label,16)-12))
            y:=clamp(mouse.y+18,f32(94),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight()-80))
            rl.DrawRectangle(i32(x)-7,i32(y)-5,rl.MeasureText(label,16)+14,26,{19,28,42,240})
            rl.DrawText(label,i32(x),i32(y),16,color)
        }
    }
    sandbox_draw_hud :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,width,height: f32) -> Sandbox_UI_Action {
        // raygui clears its private slider capture only when a slider sees mouse-up.
        // Keep that release path alive if Escape closed the panel during a drag.
        if !game.panel_open && !rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT) {
            dummy:=f32(0)
            _ = rl.GuiSliderBar({-100,-100,20,10},nil,nil,&dummy,0,1)
        }
        rl.DrawRectangle(0,0,i32(width),88,{19,28,42,250})
        rl.DrawText("BLAST YARD",24,24,26,YARD_INK)
        mode_label:=cstring("Manual blasts / Click to place")
        if game.applied.blast_mode==.Falling_Bombs { mode_label="Falling bombs / 1 sec fuse on landing" }
        rl.DrawText(mode_label,25,56,15,YARD_MUTED)
        if !game.panel_open {
            if rl.GuiButton(sandbox_reset_button(width),"R  Reset") { return .Reset }
            if rl.GuiButton(sandbox_settings_button(width),"Tab  Settings") { return .Open }
        }
        rl.DrawRectangle(0,i32(height)-56,i32(width),56,{19,28,42,250})
        controls:=cstring("A/D Move   /   Space Jump   /   Click Blast   /   R Reset")
        if game.applied.blast_mode==.Falling_Bombs { controls="A/D Move   /   Space Jump   /   Falling Bombs   /   R Reset" }
        rl.DrawText(controls,24,i32(height)-35,17,YARD_INK)
        rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("Radius %.1f  /  Wheel",game.applied.blast_radius),i32(width)-222,i32(height)-35,17,YARD_ACCENT)
        if game.status_time>0 {
            text:=rl.TextFormat("%s",game.status)
            x:=i32(width)/2-rl.MeasureText(text,17)/2
            rl.DrawRectangle(x-16,i32(height)-102,rl.MeasureText(text,17)+32,32,{23,40,51,240})
            rl.DrawText(text,x,i32(height)-94,17,YARD_ACCENT)
        }
        if game.inspection {
            rl.DrawRectangleRounded({24,106,450,150},0.07,8,{22,36,51,240})
            rl.DrawText("INSPECTION  /  F3",40,120,18,YARD_ACCENT)
            a,b,c:=counts_runtime(&game.scene)
            rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%d regions  /  %d links  /  %d pieces",a,b,c),40,150,17,YARD_INK)
            rl.DrawText("Right click: select   Delete / Ctrl+click: remove",40,180,16,YARD_MUTED)
            rl.DrawText("Shift+click / X: break link   J: links   V: surface",40,204,16,YARD_MUTED)
            rl.DrawText("S: save snapshot   D: move   Space: jump",40,228,16,YARD_MUTED)
        }
        if game.panel_open { return sandbox_draw_panel(game,width,height) }
        return .None
    }
    sandbox_inspect_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2,view: View,over_ui: bool) -> bool {
        if !game.inspection || game.panel_open { return false }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.J) { game.joints=!game.joints }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.V) { game.surface=!game.surface }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.S) {
            if save_snapshot(&game.scene,"snapshot.json") { sandbox_notice(game,"Saved snapshot.json") }
        }
        if over_ui { return false }
        hover:=pick_subdivision(&game.scene,point)
        if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.RIGHT) { game.selected=hover }
        remove:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.DELETE)
        link:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.X)
        consumed:=false
        if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) && !game.block_blast {
            if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_CONTROL) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT_CONTROL) { game.selected=hover; remove=true; consumed=true }
            if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_SHIFT) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT_SHIFT) { link=true; consumed=true }
        }
        failures:=Failures{}
        if remove && game.selected!=0 { append(&failures.discard_subdivisions,game.selected); game.selected=0 }
        if link {
            id:=pick_connection(&game.scene,point,24/view.scale)
            if id!=0 { append(&failures.connections,id) }
        }
        if len(failures.discard_subdivisions)+len(failures.connections)>0 {
            apply_failures(&game.scene,failures)
            physics_sync_structure(&game.scene)
            clear(&game.previous)
        }
        delete(failures.discard_subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
        return consumed
    }
    sandbox_read_input :: proc() -> Sandbox_Input {
        move:=f32(0)
        if rl.IsKeyDown(.A) || rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT) { move-=1 }
        if rl.IsKeyDown(.D) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT) { move+=1 }
        return Sandbox_Input{move=move,jump_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.SPACE),jump_down=rl.IsKeyDown(.SPACE),blast_pressed=rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT),blast_down=rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT),menu_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.TAB) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.ESCAPE),reset_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.R),inspection_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.F3),wheel=rl.GetMouseWheelMove()}
    }
    sandbox_handle_ui :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,action: Sandbox_UI_Action) {
        switch action {
        case .Open: sandbox_set_panel(game,true)
        case .Resume: sandbox_set_panel(game,false)
        case .Apply: sandbox_apply_settings(game)
        case .Reset: sandbox_reset(game)
        case .None:
        }
        if action!=.None {
            game.block_jump=rl.IsKeyDown(.SPACE)
            game.block_blast=rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT)
        }
    }
    run_sandbox :: proc(smoke: bool = false,smoke_panel: bool = false,smoke_input: bool = false) {
        rl.SetTraceLogLevel(.WARNING)
        flags:=rl.ConfigFlags{.MSAA_4X_HINT,.WINDOW_RESIZABLE,.WINDOW_HIGHDPI}
        if smoke { flags+={.WINDOW_HIDDEN} }
        rl.SetConfigFlags(flags)
        rl.InitWindow(1280,800,"Blast Yard | Odin + Box2D")
        defer rl.CloseWindow()
        rl.SetWindowMinSize(900,700)
        rl.SetExitKey(.KEY_NULL)
        rl.SetTargetFPS(60)
        sandbox_gui_style()
        game:=sandbox_create()
        defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        if smoke_input { sandbox_smoke_inputs(&game); return }
        if smoke_panel { sandbox_set_panel(&game,true); game.tuning_open=true }
        poses:=make(map[u64]Pose); defer delete(poses)
        target:=rl.RenderTexture2D{}
        if smoke { target=rl.LoadRenderTexture(rl.GetScreenWidth(),rl.GetScreenHeight()) }
        defer { if smoke { rl.UnloadRenderTexture(target) } }
        frames:=0
        for !rl.WindowShouldClose() {
            width,height:=f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight())
            view:=sandbox_view(width,height)
            mouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()
            over_ui:=sandbox_over_hud(mouse,width,height,game.inspection)
            raw:=sandbox_read_input()
            input:=sandbox_route_input(&game,raw,over_ui)
            point:=world_point(view,mouse)
            if !raw.menu_pressed && !raw.reset_pressed {
                if !sandbox_inspect_input(&game,point,view,over_ui) && input.blast_pressed { sandbox_blast(&game,point) }
            }
            sandbox_advance(&game,rl.GetFrameTime(),input)
            clear(&poses)
            for sub in game.scene.subdivisions {
                if !sub.live { continue }
                pose:=sub.pose
                if old,ok:=game.previous[sub.id]; ok && !game.panel_open { pose=interpolate_pose(old,pose,game.accumulator*60) }
                poses[sub.id]=pose
            }
            rl.BeginDrawing()
            if smoke { rl.BeginTextureMode(target) }
            rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
            sandbox_draw_world(&game,view,poses)
            if !game.panel_open && !over_ui { sandbox_draw_aim(&game,view,mouse) }
            action:=sandbox_draw_hud(&game,width,height)
            if smoke {
                rl.EndTextureMode()
                rl.DrawTextureRec(target.texture,{0,0,f32(target.texture.width),-f32(target.texture.height)},{0,0},rl.WHITE)
            }
            rl.EndDrawing()
            sandbox_handle_ui(&game,action)
            frames+=1
            if smoke && frames==2 {
                image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
                rl.ImageFlipVertical(&image)
                name:=cstring("sandbox-preview.png"); if smoke_panel { name="sandbox-settings-preview.png" }
                _ = rl.ExportImage(image,name)
                rl.UnloadImage(image)
                break
            }
        }
    }

    package main
    
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math/rand"
    
    Blast_Mode :: enum { Manual, Falling_Bombs }
    BOMB_RADIUS :: f32(0.18)
    BOMB_FUSE :: f32(1)
    BOMB_DROP_MIN :: f32(1)
    BOMB_DROP_MAX :: f32(2.5)
    BOMB_SKY_HEIGHT :: f32(7.3)
    BOMB_BURST_TIME :: f32(0.3)
    
    Bomb :: struct {
        body: b2.BodyId,
        previous: Vec2,
        landed: bool,
        fuse: f32,
    }
    Bomb_Burst :: struct { position: Vec2, radius, age: f32 }
    Bomb_Rain :: struct {
        bombs: [dynamic]Bomb,
        bursts: [dynamic]Bomb_Burst,
        random: rand.Default_Random_State,
        until_drop: f32,
    }
    bomb_drop_delay :: proc(rain: ^Bomb_Rain) -> f32 {
        return rand.float32_range(BOMB_DROP_MIN,BOMB_DROP_MAX,rand.default_random_generator(&rain.random))
    }
    bomb_rain_reset :: proc(rain: ^Bomb_Rain,seed: u8) {
        // The old physics world has already been destroyed. Keep the small list buffers.
        clear(&rain.bombs); clear(&rain.bursts)
        // A separate stream leaves procedural destruction seeds independent of drops.
        rain.random=rand.create(u64(seed)+0x626f6d62)
        rain.until_drop=bomb_drop_delay(rain)
    }
    bomb_rain_clear :: proc(rain: ^Bomb_Rain) {
        for bomb in rain.bombs { b2.DestroyBody(bomb.body) }
        clear(&rain.bombs); clear(&rain.bursts)
    }
    sandbox_set_blast_mode :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,mode: Blast_Mode) {
        if mode==game.applied.blast_mode { return }
        game.applied.blast_mode=mode
        game.draft.blast_mode=mode
        bomb_rain_clear(&game.bomb_rain)
        game.bomb_rain.until_drop=bomb_drop_delay(&game.bomb_rain)
        if mode==.Falling_Bombs { sandbox_notice(game,"Falling bombs: one-second fuse after landing") }
        else { sandbox_notice(game,"Manual blast placement") }
    }
    bomb_spawn :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,position: Vec2) {
        def:=b2.DefaultBodyDef()
        def.type=.dynamicBody
        def.position=to_b2(position)
        def.isBullet=true
        body:=b2.CreateBody(game.scene.physics.world,def)
        shape:=b2.DefaultShapeDef()
        shape.density=0.4
        shape.material.friction=0.7
        shape.material.restitution=0.05
        _ = b2.CreateCircleShape(body,shape,b2.Circle{radius=BOMB_RADIUS})
        append(&game.bomb_rain.bombs,Bomb{body=body,previous=position,fuse=BOMB_FUSE})
    }
    bomb_has_landed :: proc(bomb: Bomb) -> bool {
        position:=b2.Body_GetPosition(bomb.body)
        buffer:=make([]b2.ContactData,int(b2.Body_GetContactCapacity(bomb.body)))
        defer delete(buffer)
        for contact in b2.Body_GetContactData(bomb.body,buffer) {
            normal:=from_b2(contact.manifold.normal)
            if b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdA)==bomb.body { normal=vmul(normal,-1) }
            if normal.y<0.55 { continue }
            for i in 0..<int(contact.manifold.pointCount) {
                point:=contact.manifold.points[i]
                if point.separation<=0.025 && point.point.y<position.y { return true }
            }
        }
        return false
    }
    bomb_rain_before_step :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,dt: f32) {
        if game.applied.blast_mode!=.Falling_Bombs { return }
        rain:=&game.bomb_rain
        for &bomb in rain.bombs { bomb.previous=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(bomb.body)) }
        rain.until_drop-=dt
        if rain.until_drop<=0 {
            x:=rand.float32_range(-7,8,rand.default_random_generator(&rain.random))
            bomb_spawn(game,{x,BOMB_SKY_HEIGHT})
            rain.until_drop+=bomb_drop_delay(rain)
        }
    }
    bomb_rain_after_step :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,dt: f32) {
        rain:=&game.bomb_rain
        burst_count:=0
        for burst in rain.bursts {
            next:=burst; next.age+=dt
            if next.age<BOMB_BURST_TIME { rain.bursts[burst_count]=next; burst_count+=1 }
        }
        resize(&rain.bursts,burst_count)
        // Read landing contacts for all bombs before any blast changes the collision world.
        for &bomb in rain.bombs {
            if bomb.landed { bomb.fuse=max(f32(0),bomb.fuse-dt) }
            else if bomb_has_landed(bomb) { bomb.landed=true }
        }
        first_burst:=len(rain.bursts)
        bomb_count:=0
        for bomb in rain.bombs {
            position:=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(bomb.body))
            explode:=bomb.landed && bomb.fuse<=0.000001
            if explode { append(&rain.bursts,Bomb_Burst{position=position,radius=game.applied.blast_radius}) }
            if explode || position.y < -3 || position.x < -9 || position.x > 10 {
                b2.DestroyBody(bomb.body)
            } else { rain.bombs[bomb_count]=bomb; bomb_count+=1 }
        }
        resize(&rain.bombs,bomb_count)
        for burst in rain.bursts[first_burst:] { sandbox_explode(game,burst.position) }
    }

    sandbox_inspect_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2,view: View,over_ui: bool) -> bool {
        if !game.inspection || game.panel_open { return false }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.J) { game.joints=!game.joints }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.V) { game.surface=!game.surface }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.S) {
            if save_snapshot(&game.scene,"snapshot.json") { sandbox_notice(game,"Saved snapshot.json") }
        }
        if over_ui { return false }
        hover:=pick_subdivision(&game.scene,point)
        if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.RIGHT) { game.selected=hover }
        remove:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.DELETE)
        link:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.X)
        consumed:=false
        if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) && !game.block_blast {
            if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_CONTROL) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT_CONTROL) { game.selected=hover; remove=true; consumed=true }
            if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_SHIFT) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT_SHIFT) { link=true; consumed=true }
        }
        failures:=Failures{}
        if remove && game.selected!=0 { append(&failures.discard_subdivisions,game.selected); game.selected=0 }
        if link {
            id:=pick_connection(&game.scene,point,24/view.scale)
            if id!=0 { append(&failures.connections,id) }
        }
        if len(failures.discard_subdivisions)+len(failures.connections)>0 {
            apply_failures(&game.scene,failures)
            physics_sync_structure(&game.scene)
            clear(&game.previous)
        }
        delete(failures.discard_subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
        return consumed
    }
    sandbox_read_input :: proc() -> Sandbox_Input {
        move:=f32(0)
        if rl.IsKeyDown(.A) || rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT) { move-=1 }
        if rl.IsKeyDown(.D) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT) { move+=1 }
        return Sandbox_Input{move=move,jump_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.SPACE),jump_down=rl.IsKeyDown(.SPACE),blast_pressed=rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT),blast_down=rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT),menu_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.TAB) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.ESCAPE),reset_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.R),inspection_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.F3),wheel=rl.GetMouseWheelMove()}
    }
    sandbox_handle_ui :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,action: Sandbox_UI_Action) {
        switch action {
        case .Open: sandbox_set_panel(game,true)
        case .Resume: sandbox_set_panel(game,false)
        case .Apply: sandbox_apply_settings(game)
        case .Reset: sandbox_reset(game)
        case .None:
        }
        if action!=.None {
            game.block_jump=rl.IsKeyDown(.SPACE)
            game.block_blast=rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT)
        }
    }
    run_sandbox :: proc(smoke: bool = false,smoke_panel: bool = false,smoke_input: bool = false) {
        rl.SetTraceLogLevel(.WARNING)
        flags:=rl.ConfigFlags{.MSAA_4X_HINT,.WINDOW_RESIZABLE,.WINDOW_HIGHDPI}
        if smoke { flags+={.WINDOW_HIDDEN} }
        rl.SetConfigFlags(flags)
        rl.InitWindow(1280,800,"Blast Yard | Odin + Box2D")
        defer rl.CloseWindow()
        rl.SetWindowMinSize(900,700)
        rl.SetExitKey(.KEY_NULL)
        rl.SetTargetFPS(60)
        sandbox_gui_style()
        game:=sandbox_create()
        defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        if smoke_input { sandbox_smoke_inputs(&game); return }
        if smoke_panel { sandbox_set_panel(&game,true); game.tuning_open=true }
        poses:=make(map[u64]Pose); defer delete(poses)
        target:=rl.RenderTexture2D{}
        if smoke { target=rl.LoadRenderTexture(rl.GetScreenWidth(),rl.GetScreenHeight()) }
        defer { if smoke { rl.UnloadRenderTexture(target) } }
        frames:=0
        for !rl.WindowShouldClose() {
            width,height:=f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight())
            view:=sandbox_view(width,height)
            mouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()
            over_ui:=sandbox_over_hud(mouse,width,height,game.inspection)
            raw:=sandbox_read_input()
            input:=sandbox_route_input(&game,raw,over_ui)
            point:=world_point(view,mouse)
            if !raw.menu_pressed && !raw.reset_pressed {
                if !sandbox_inspect_input(&game,point,view,over_ui) && input.blast_pressed { sandbox_blast(&game,point) }
            }
            sandbox_advance(&game,rl.GetFrameTime(),input)
            clear(&poses)
            for sub in game.scene.subdivisions {
                if !sub.live { continue }
                pose:=sub.pose
                if old,ok:=game.previous[sub.id]; ok && !game.panel_open { pose=interpolate_pose(old,pose,game.accumulator*60) }
                poses[sub.id]=pose
            }
            rl.BeginDrawing()
            if smoke { rl.BeginTextureMode(target) }
            rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
            sandbox_draw_world(&game,view,poses)
            if !game.panel_open && !over_ui { sandbox_draw_aim(&game,view,mouse) }
            action:=sandbox_draw_hud(&game,width,height)
            if smoke {
                rl.EndTextureMode()
                rl.DrawTextureRec(target.texture,{0,0,f32(target.texture.width),-f32(target.texture.height)},{0,0},rl.WHITE)
            }
            rl.EndDrawing()
            sandbox_handle_ui(&game,action)
            frames+=1
            if smoke && frames==2 {
                image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
                rl.ImageFlipVertical(&image)
                name:=cstring("sandbox-preview.png"); if smoke_panel { name="sandbox-settings-preview.png" }
                _ = rl.ExportImage(image,name)
                rl.UnloadImage(image)
                break
            }
        }
    }

    Physics :: struct {
        world: b2.WorldId,
        bodies: map[u64]b2.BodyId,
        joints: map[u64]b2.JointId,
        fixture_counts: map[u64]int,
        anchor_y: f32,
        active: bool,
    }
    Interaction :: struct { force: Vec2, torque: f32 }
    REFERENCE_LENGTH :: f32(1)
    PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS :: 4
    GLOBAL_DAMPING :: f32(0.7)
    
    to_b2 :: proc(v: Vec2) -> b2.Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    from_b2 :: proc(v: b2.Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    interaction_load :: proc(i: Interaction) -> f32 {
        return max(vlen(i.force),math.abs(i.torque)/REFERENCE_LENGTH)
    }
    equivalent_force :: proc(impulse: Vec2, interval: f32) -> Vec2 {
        assert(interval > 0)
        return vmul(impulse,1/interval)
    }
    physics_init :: proc(s: ^Scene, gravity: Vec2 = {}, anchor_y: f32 = -1e30) {
        assert(!s.physics.active)
        def := b2.DefaultWorldDef()
        def.gravity = to_b2(gravity)
        s.physics = Physics{world=b2.CreateWorld(def),bodies=make(map[u64]b2.BodyId),joints=make(map[u64]b2.JointId),fixture_counts=make(map[u64]int),anchor_y=anchor_y,active=true}
        physics_sync_structure(s)
    }
    physics_destroy :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        b2.DestroyWorld(s.physics.world)
        delete(s.physics.bodies); delete(s.physics.joints); delete(s.physics.fixture_counts)
        s.physics = {}
    }
    physics_read_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row := s.sub_rows[id]
            rotation := b2.Body_GetRotation(body)
    add_projectile :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        material:=add_material(s,Material{name="projectile",subdivision_strength=math.inf_f32(1),connection_strength=math.inf_f32(1),generation_count=2,aspect_ratio=1})
        owner:=add_piece(s,material,0)
        points:=[4]Vec2{{-1.2,0.3},{-0.8,0.3},{-0.8,0.7},{-1.2,0.7}}
        outline:=make_polygon(points[:]); defer delete(outline.points)
        id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline),velocity={8,0}})
        append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)

    }
    draw_scene :: proc(s: ^Scene,view: View,poses: map[u64]Pose,selected: u64,surface,joints: bool,ids: bool = true) {
        for i in -20..=20 {
            tint:=rl.Color{31,44,62,255}
            if i==0 { tint={45,65,85,255} }
            rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,Vec2{f32(i),-20}),screen_point(view,Vec2{f32(i),20}),1,tint)
            rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,Vec2{-20,f32(i)}),screen_point(view,Vec2{20,f32(i)}),1,tint)
        }
        for remnant in s.remnants {
            sub:=s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[remnant.subdivision]]; sub.pose=remnant.pose
            outline:=posed_polygon(sub)
            draw_polygon(view,outline,rl.Color{140,152,170,u8(160*(1-remnant.age))},rl.Color{140,152,170,u8(160*(1-remnant.age))})
            delete(outline.points)
        }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            outline:=Polygon{points=make([]Vec2,len(sub.outline.points))}
            posed:=render_subdivision(s,sub,poses)
            for rest,i in sub.outline.points {
                point:=posed_point(posed,rest)
                if surface { point=cosmetic_point(s,sub,rest,poses) }
                outline.points[i]=point
            }
            stroke:=rl.Color{202,220,231,255}
            if sub.id==selected { stroke={255,255,255,255} }
            draw_polygon(view,outline,piece_color(sub.owner,210),stroke)
            delete(outline.points)
            center:=screen_point(view,posed.pose.position)
            if ids { rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%d",sub.id),i32(center.x)-5,i32(center.y)-23,16,rl.Color{16,29,40,255}) }
        }
        if joints {
            for c in s.connections {
                if !c.live { continue }
                a,b:=render_subdivision(s,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],poses),render_subdivision(s,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]],poses)
                anchor:=vmul(vadd(posed_point(a,c.rest_point),posed_point(b,c.rest_point)),0.5)
                color:=rl.Color{248,205,109,255}
                rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,a.pose.position),screen_point(view,b.pose.position),2,color)
                rl.DrawCircleV(screen_point(view,anchor),5,color)
                p:=screen_point(view,anchor)
                rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("c%d",c.id),i32(p.x)+7,i32(p.y)+7,14,color)
            }
        }
    }

    @(test)
    sandbox_menu_and_ui_consume_input_without_catchup :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
        sync.mutex_lock(&physics_test_mutex); defer sync.mutex_unlock(&physics_test_mutex)
        game:=sandbox_create(); defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{},false)
        game.jump_queued=true
        game.accumulator=0.01
        append(&game.scene.remnants,Remnant{subdivision=game.scene.subdivisions[0].id,age=0.2})
        pose:=b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)
        input:=sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true,jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true,move=1,wheel=1},false)
        sandbox_advance(&game,5,input)
        testing.expect(t,game.panel_open && !input.jump_pressed && !input.blast_pressed && input.move==0)
        testing.expect(t,game.accumulator==0 && !game.jump_queued && b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body)==pose && game.scene.remnants[0].age==0.2)
        testing.expect(t,!sandbox_blast(&game,{0,1}))
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true,jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,!game.panel_open && !input.jump_pressed && !input.blast_pressed)
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,!input.jump_pressed && !input.blast_pressed,"Held menu inputs must be released before they can act")
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{},false)
        radius:=game.applied.blast_radius
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true,wheel=2},true)
        testing.expect(t,!input.blast_pressed && input.wheel==0 && game.applied.blast_radius==radius)
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,input.jump_pressed && input.blast_pressed)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true},false)
        _ = sandbox_route_input(&game,{menu_pressed=true},false)
        input=sandbox_route_input(&game,{jump_pressed=true,jump_down=true,blast_pressed=true,blast_down=true},false)
        testing.expect(t,input.jump_pressed && input.blast_pressed,"A fresh press immediately after closing settings must work")
        sandbox_advance(&game,1.0/60.0,{})
        testing.expect(t,game.accumulator<0.001 && game.scene.remnants[0].age<0.22,"Resume must advance only the current frame")
    }
    
    @(test)
    sandbox_aim_uses_posed_outlines_and_suppresses_invalid_blast :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {

    new_id :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> u64 { s.next_id += 1; return s.next_id }
    new_scene :: proc(minimum_width: f32) -> Scene {
        return Scene{sub_rows=make(map[u64]int),conn_rows=make(map[u64]int),piece_rows=make(map[u64]int),minimum_width=minimum_width}
    }
    add_material :: proc(s: ^Scene, m: Material) -> int { append(&s.materials,m); return len(s.materials)-1 }
    add_piece :: proc(s: ^Scene, material: int, seed: u8) -> u64 {
        id := new_id(s)
        s.piece_rows[id] = len(s.pieces)
        append(&s.pieces,Piece{id=id,material=material,seed=seed,live=true})
        return id
    }
    add_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene, owner: u64, outline: Polygon, pose: Pose) -> u64 {
        id := new_id(s)
        piece := s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]]
        retain_subdivision(s,Subdivision{id=id,owner=owner,material=piece.material,seed=piece.seed,outline=outline,pose=pose,live=true})
        return id
    }
    // Outlines use ranges in one append-only undeformed vertex pool. The outline
    // slice is a derived read view, refreshed whenever appending can move the pool.
    // Callers may release their source polygon immediately after this call.
    retain_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene,source: Subdivision) {
        sub:=source
        points:=make_polygon(source.outline.points)
        defer delete(points.points)
        sub.rest_center=centroid(points)
        sub.width=outline_width(points.points)
        sub.outline_start=len(s.vertices); sub.outline_count=len(points.points)
        for point in points.points { append(&s.vertices,point) }
        for i in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            existing:=&s.subdivisions[i]
            existing.outline.points=s.vertices[existing.outline_start:existing.outline_start+existing.outline_count]
        }
        sub.outline.points=s.vertices[sub.outline_start:sub.outline_start+sub.outline_count]
        s.sub_rows[sub.id]=len(s.subdivisions)
        append(&s.subdivisions,sub)
    }
    add_connection :: proc(s: ^Scene, a, b: u64) -> u64 {
        if a == b { return 0 }
        for c in s.connections { if c.live && ((c.a == a && c.b == b) || (c.a == b && c.b == a)) { return c.id } }
        sa, sb := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[b]]
        length, point := shared_boundary(sa.outline,sb.outline)
        if length <= 0 { return 0 }
        id := new_id(s)
        s.conn_rows[id] = len(s.connections)
        append(&s.connections,Connection{id=id,a=a,b=b,rest_point=point,local_a=vsub(point,sa.rest_center),local_b=vsub(point,sb.rest_center),live=true})
        return id
    }
    connection_sample :: proc(s: ^Scene, c: Connection) -> Vec2 {
        a,b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
        return vmul(vadd(vadd(a.pose.position,vrotate(c.local_a,a.pose.angle)),vadd(b.pose.position,vrotate(c.local_b,b.pose.angle))),0.5)
    }
    subdivision_sample :: proc(sub: Subdivision) -> Vec2 { return sub.pose.position }
    contains_id :: proc(ids: []u64,id: u64) -> bool { for x in ids { if x == id { return true } }; return false }
    sort_ids :: proc(ids: []u64) {
        for i in 1..<len(ids) {
            j := i
            for j > 0 && ids[j] < ids[j-1] { ids[j],ids[j-1] = ids[j-1],ids[j]; j -= 1 }
        }
    }
    sorted_ids :: proc(ids: []u64) -> [dynamic]u64 {
        result: [dynamic]u64
        for id in ids { if !contains_id(result[:],id) { append(&result,id) } }
        sort_ids(result[:])
        return result

    counts_runtime :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> (int,int,int) {
        a,b,c:=0,0,0
        for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live { a+=1 } }
        for conn in s.connections { if conn.live { b+=1 } }
        for piece in s.pieces { if piece.live { c+=1 } }
        return a,b,c
    }
