    sandbox_inspect_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2,view: View,over_ui: bool) -> bool {
        if !game.inspection || game.panel_open { return false }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.J) { game.joints=!game.joints }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.V) { game.surface=!game.surface }
        if rl.IsKeyPressed(.S) {
            if save_snapshot(&game.scene,"snapshot.json") { sandbox_notice(game,"Saved snapshot.json") }
        }
        if over_ui { return false }
        hover:=pick_subdivision(&game.scene,point)
        if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.RIGHT) { game.selected=hover }
        remove:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.DELETE)
        link:=rl.IsKeyPressed(.X)
        consumed:=false
        if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) && !game.block_blast {
            if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_CONTROL) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT_CONTROL) { game.selected=hover; remove=true; consumed=true }
            if rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT_SHIFT) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT_SHIFT) { link=true; consumed=true }
        }
        failures:=Failures{}
        if remove && game.selected!=0 { append(&failures.discard_subdivisions,game.selected); game.selected=0 }
        if link {
            id:=pick_connection(&game.scene,point,24/view.scale)
            if id!=0 { append(&failures.connections,id) }
        }
        if len(failures.discard_subdivisions)+len(failures.connections)>0 {
            apply_failures(&game.scene,failures)
            physics_sync_structure(&game.scene)
            clear(&game.previous)
        }
        delete(failures.discard_subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
        return consumed
    }
    sandbox_read_input :: proc() -> Sandbox_Input {
        move:=f32(0)
        if rl.IsKeyDown(.A) || rl.IsKeyDown(.LEFT) { move-=1 }
        if rl.IsKeyDown(.D) || rl.IsKeyDown(.RIGHT) { move+=1 }
        return Sandbox_Input{move=move,jump_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.SPACE),jump_down=rl.IsKeyDown(.SPACE),blast_pressed=rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT),blast_down=rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT),menu_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.TAB) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.ESCAPE),reset_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.R),inspection_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.F3),edit_pressed=rl.IsKeyPressed(.ENTER),wheel=rl.GetMouseWheelMove()}
    }
    sandbox_handle_ui :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,action: Sandbox_UI_Action) {
        switch action {
        case .Open: sandbox_set_panel(game,true)
        case .Resume: sandbox_set_panel(game,false)
        case .Apply: sandbox_apply_settings(game)
        case .Reset: sandbox_reset(game)
        case .Toggle_Editor: sandbox_toggle_editor(game)
        case .None:
        }
        if action!=.None {
            game.block_jump=rl.IsKeyDown(.SPACE)
            game.block_blast=rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT)
        }
    }
    run_sandbox :: proc(smoke: bool = false,smoke_panel: bool = false,smoke_input: bool = false) {
        rl.SetTraceLogLevel(.WARNING)
        flags:=rl.ConfigFlags{.MSAA_4X_HINT,.WINDOW_RESIZABLE,.WINDOW_HIGHDPI}
        if smoke { flags+={.WINDOW_HIDDEN} }
        rl.SetConfigFlags(flags)
        rl.InitWindow(1280,800,"Blast Yard | Odin + Box2D")
        defer rl.CloseWindow()
        rl.SetWindowMinSize(900,700)
        rl.SetExitKey(.KEY_NULL)
        rl.SetTargetFPS(60)
        sandbox_gui_style()
        game:=sandbox_editor_create()
        defer sandbox_destroy(&game)
        if smoke_input { sandbox_smoke_inputs(&game); return }
        if smoke_panel { sandbox_set_panel(&game,true); game.tuning_open=true }
        poses:=make(map[u64]Pose); defer delete(poses)
        target:=rl.RenderTexture2D{}
        if smoke { target=rl.LoadRenderTexture(rl.GetScreenWidth(),rl.GetScreenHeight()) }
        defer { if smoke { rl.UnloadRenderTexture(target) } }
        frames:=0
        for !rl.WindowShouldClose() {
            width,height:=f32(rl.GetScreenWidth()),f32(rl.GetScreenHeight())
            view:=sandbox_view(width,height)
            mouse:=rl.GetMousePosition()
            over_ui:=sandbox_over_hud(mouse,width,height,game.inspection && !game.editor.editing)
            raw:=sandbox_read_input()
            input:=sandbox_route_input(&game,raw,over_ui)
            point:=world_point(view,mouse)
            if !raw.menu_pressed && !raw.reset_pressed {
                if game.editor.editing { sandbox_editor_input(&game,point,over_ui) }
                else if !sandbox_inspect_input(&game,point,view,over_ui) && input.blast_pressed { sandbox_blast(&game,point) }
            }
            sandbox_advance(&game,rl.GetFrameTime(),input)
            clear(&poses)
            for sub in game.scene.subdivisions {
                if !sub.live { continue }
                pose:=sub.pose
                if old,ok:=game.previous[sub.id]; ok && !game.panel_open { pose=interpolate_pose(old,pose,game.accumulator*60) }
                poses[sub.id]=pose
            }
            rl.BeginDrawing()
            if smoke { rl.BeginTextureMode(target) }
            rl.ClearBackground({19,28,42,255})
            sandbox_draw_world(&game,view,poses)
            if !game.panel_open && !over_ui { sandbox_draw_aim(&game,view,mouse) }
            action:=sandbox_draw_hud(&game,width,height)
            if smoke {
                rl.EndTextureMode()
                rl.DrawTextureRec(target.texture,{0,0,f32(target.texture.width),-f32(target.texture.height)},{0,0},rl.WHITE)
            }
            rl.EndDrawing()
            sandbox_handle_ui(&game,action)
            frames+=1
            if smoke && frames==2 {
                image:=rl.LoadImageFromTexture(target.texture)
                rl.ImageFlipVertical(&image)
                name:=cstring("sandbox-preview.png"); if smoke_panel { name="sandbox-settings-preview.png" }
                _ = rl.ExportImage(image,name)
                rl.UnloadImage(image)
                break
            }
        }
    }

    package main

    Palette :: enum { Wood, Glass, Rubber, Stone }
    RUBBER_CELL_SIZE :: f32(0.4)
    Authored_Rect :: struct { lo,hi: Vec2, material: Palette, identity: u64 }
    Material_Editor :: struct {
        enabled,editing,dragging: bool,
        palette: Palette,
        start,cursor: Vec2,
        next_identity: u64,
        objects: [dynamic]Authored_Rect,
    }
    // Gameplay presets use the ordinary material fields, not the diagnostic sliders.
    editor_material :: proc(choice: Palette) -> Material {
        m: Material
        switch choice {
        case .Wood:
            m=material_preset(1); m.name="wood"; m.subdivision_strength=28; m.connection_strength=22; m.flexibility=0
        case .Glass:
            m=material_preset(2); m.name="glass"; m.subdivision_strength=16; m.connection_strength=12; m.flexibility=0
        case .Rubber:
            m=material_preset(0); m.name="rubber"; m.subdivision_strength=45; m.connection_strength=90; m.flexibility=0.5
        case .Stone:
            m=material_preset(0); m.name="stone"; m.subdivision_strength=35; m.connection_strength=20; m.flexibility=0
        }
        return m
    }
    sandbox_editor_create :: proc() -> Sandbox {
        game:=Sandbox{applied=DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS,draft=DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS,previous=make(map[u64]Pose),surface=true,joints=true,outlines=true}
        game.editor.enabled=true; game.editor.editing=true
        sandbox_reset(&game)
        return game
    }
    editor_rectangle :: proc(a,b: Vec2,material: Palette) -> Authored_Rect {
        return Authored_Rect{lo={min(a.x,b.x),min(a.y,b.y)},hi={max(a.x,b.x),max(a.y,b.y)},material=material}
    }
    editor_overlaps :: proc(a,b: Authored_Rect) -> bool {
        return a.lo.x<b.hi.x && a.hi.x>b.lo.x && a.lo.y<b.hi.y && a.hi.y>b.lo.y
    }
    editor_valid_rectangle :: proc(editor: ^Material_Editor,r: Authored_Rect) -> bool {
        if !valid_vec(r.lo) || !valid_vec(r.hi) || r.hi.x-r.lo.x<0.2 || r.hi.y-r.lo.y<0.2 { return false }
        if r.lo.x< -7.5 || r.hi.x>8.5 || r.lo.y<0 || r.hi.y>4.8 { return false }
        // Reserve the initial player's footprint, too; no body starts inside a solid.
        spawn:=Authored_Rect{lo={PLAYER_SPAWN.x-PLAYER_RADIUS,0},hi={PLAYER_SPAWN.x+PLAYER_RADIUS,PLAYER_SPAWN.y+PLAYER_HALF_HEIGHT}}
        if editor_overlaps(r,spawn) { return false }
        for object in editor.objects { if editor_overlaps(r,object) { return false } }
        return true
    }
    editor_place :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,a,b: Vec2) -> bool {
        if !game.editor.editing || game.panel_open { return false }
        r:=editor_rectangle(a,b,game.editor.palette)
        if !editor_valid_rectangle(&game.editor,r) { sandbox_notice(game,"Place a rectangle above ground, clear of objects and spawn"); return false }
        game.editor.next_identity+=1; r.identity=game.editor.next_identity
        append(&game.editor.objects,r)
        return true
    }
    editor_remove :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        if !game.editor.editing || game.panel_open { return false }
        for object,i in game.editor.objects {
            if point.x>=object.lo.x && point.x<=object.hi.x && point.y>=object.lo.y && point.y<=object.hi.y {
                ordered_remove(&game.editor.objects,i); return true
            }
        }
        return false
    }
    sandbox_toggle_editor :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        if !game.editor.enabled || game.panel_open { return }
        game.editor.editing=!game.editor.editing
        game.editor.dragging=false
        sandbox_reset(game)
        if game.editor.editing { sandbox_notice(game,"Edit: undamaged layout restored") }
        else { sandbox_notice(game,"Test: R restores this layout and seed") }
    }
    editor_build_objects :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        s:=&game.scene
        materials: [4]int
        for choice in Palette { materials[int(choice)]=add_material(s,editor_material(choice)) }
        if game.editor.editing { return }
        for object in game.editor.objects {
            seed:=derive_seed(game.applied.seed,0x10000+object.identity)
            if object.material==.Rubber { seed=0 }
            owner:=add_piece(s,materials[int(object.material)],seed)
            nx,ny:=1,1
            if object.material==.Rubber {
                nx=int(math.ceil((object.hi.x-object.lo.x)/RUBBER_CELL_SIZE-0.00001))
                ny=int(math.ceil((object.hi.y-object.lo.y)/RUBBER_CELL_SIZE-0.00001))
            }
            // Uniform fitted cells: one target size, no tiny leftover edge strips.
            dx,dy:=(object.hi.x-object.lo.x)/f32(nx),(object.hi.y-object.lo.y)/f32(ny)
            ids:=make([]u64,nx*ny)
            for row in 0..<ny {
                for column in 0..<nx {
                    x0,x1:=object.lo.x+f32(column)*dx,object.lo.x+f32(column+1)*dx
                    y0,y1:=object.lo.y+f32(row)*dy,object.lo.y+f32(row+1)*dy
                    points:=[4]Vec2{{x0,y0},{x1,y0},{x1,y1},{x0,y1}}
                    outline:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
                    id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline)})
                    append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
                    index:=row*nx+column; ids[index]=id
                    if column>0 { connection:=add_connection(s,ids[index-1],id); assert(connection!=0); append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].connections,connection) }
                    if row>0 { connection:=add_connection(s,ids[index-nx],id); assert(connection!=0); append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].connections,connection) }
                }
            }
            delete(ids)
        }
    }

    // The playable application starts with sandbox_editor_create.
    sandbox_create :: proc(settings: Sandbox_Settings = DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS) -> Sandbox {
        game:=Sandbox{applied=settings,draft=settings,previous=make(map[u64]Pose),surface=true,joints=true,outlines=true}
        sandbox_reset(&game)
        return game
    }
    sandbox_destroy :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        scene_destroy(&game.scene)
        delete(game.bomb_rain.bombs); delete(game.bomb_rain.bursts)
        delete(game.previous); delete(game.editor.objects)
        game^={}
    }
    sandbox_notice :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,text: string) { game.status=text; game.status_time=2.5 }
    sandbox_clear_input :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {

        game.jump_queued=false

        game.block_blast=true
        player_clear_input(&game.player)
        clear(&game.previous)
        game.previous_player=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
    }
    sandbox_reset :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        revision:=game.scene.revision+1
        scene_destroy(&game.scene)
        s:=&game.scene
        s^=new_scene(0.10)
        s.revision=revision
        ground_material:=sandbox_material(game.applied)
        if game.editor.enabled { ground_material=editor_material(.Stone) }
        material:=add_material(s,ground_material)
        seed:=game.applied.seed
        if !game.editor.enabled && !game.applied.generate_children { seed=0 }
        if game.editor.enabled {
            editor_build_objects(game)
        } else {
            owner:=add_piece(s,material,seed)
            // A stepped stack, with one common reference frame and real shared edges.
            for row in 0..<3 {
                for column in 0..<4-row {
                    // Start on the floor: the former 5 mm drop overloaded stiff joints on landing.
                    x,y:=f32(1.5)+f32(column)*0.85,f32(row)*0.85
                    points:=[4]Vec2{{x,y},{x+0.85,y},{x+0.85,y+0.85},{x,y+0.85}}
                    outline:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
                    id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline)})
                    // Stable block coordinates give neighboring roots distinct birth contexts.
                    s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].seed=derive_seed(seed,u64(row*4+column+1))
                    append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
                }
            }
            for a in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
                for b in a+1..<len(s.subdivisions) { add_connection(s,s.subdivisions[a].id,s.subdivisions[b].id) }
            }
            for connection in s.connections { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].connections,connection.id) }
        }
        // One large root, with future floor detail generated only near a blast.
        ground:=add_piece(s,material,derive_seed(seed,13))
        ground_points:=[4]Vec2{{-8,YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM},{9,YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM},{9,0},{-8,0}}
        ground_outline:=Polygon{points=ground_points[:]}
        id:=add_subdivision(s,ground,ground_outline,Pose{position=centroid(ground_outline)})
        append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[ground]].subdivisions,id)
        physics_init(s,{0,-9.8},YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM)
        def:=b2.DefaultBodyDef()
        def.position={0.5,YARD_FLOOR_BOTTOM-YARD_BASE_DEPTH*0.5}
        game.floor=b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
        shape:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); shape.material.friction=0.65
        // Extend beyond the playable edges so excavation never opens the screen bottom.
        _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(game.floor,shape,b2.MakeBox(10,YARD_BASE_DEPTH*0.5))
        game.player=player_create(s.physics.world)
        bomb_rain_reset(&game.bomb_rain,game.applied.seed)
        game.selected=0
        game.editor.dragging=false
        sandbox_clear_input(game)
        sandbox_notice(game,"Yard reset")
    }
    sandbox_set_panel :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,open: bool) {

    // Inclusive edges are solid too. Use the logical posed outline, not the cosmetic mesh.
    point_in_subdivision :: proc(sub: Subdivision,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        local:=vadd(sub.rest_center,vrotate(vsub(point,sub.pose.position),-sub.pose.angle))
        inside:=false
        for a,i in sub.outline.points {
            b:=sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)]
            edge:=vsub(b,a); relative:=vsub(local,a)
            if math.abs(vcross(edge,relative))<0.00001 && vdot(relative,edge)>=0 && vdot(relative,edge)<=vdot(edge,edge) { return true }
            if (a.y>local.y)!=(b.y>local.y) && local.x<(b.x-a.x)*(local.y-a.y)/(b.y-a.y)+a.x { inside=!inside }
        }
        return inside
    }
    sandbox_valid_aim :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live && point_in_subdivision(sub,point) { return false } }

    }

    package main
    
    import rl "vendor:raylib"
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    View :: struct { offset: Vec2, scale: f32 }
    screen_point :: proc(view: View,point: Vec2) -> rl.Vector2 { return {view.offset.x+point.x*view.scale,view.offset.y-point.y*view.scale} }
    world_point :: proc(view: View,point: rl.Vector2) -> Vec2 { return {(point.x-view.offset.x)/view.scale,(view.offset.y-point.y)/view.scale} }
    piece_color :: proc(id: u64,alpha: u8 = 255) -> rl.Color {
        colors := [6]rl.Color{{64,173,165,255},{97,142,206,255},{194,134,204,255},{212,161,88,255},{139,178,113,255},{211,116,125,255}}
        c:=colors[id%6]; c.a=alpha; return c
    }
    render_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene,sub: Subdivision,poses: map[u64]Pose) -> Subdivision {
        result:=sub
        if pose,ok:=poses[sub.id]; ok { result.pose=pose }
        return result
    }
    point_on_boundary :: proc(point: Vec2,a,b: Polygon) -> bool {
        for i in 0..<len(a.points) {
            for j in 0..<len(b.points) {
                if segment,ok:=segment_overlap(Segment{a.points[i],a.points[(i+1)%len(a.points)]},Segment{b.points[j],b.points[(j+1)%len(b.points)]}); ok {
                    d:=vsub(segment.b,segment.a); length:=vlen(d)
                    projection:=vdot(vsub(point,segment.a),d)/(length*length)
                    if projection >= -0.0001 && projection <= 1.0001 && math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(point,segment.a))) < 0.0001*length { return true }
                }
            }
        }
        return false
    }
    // Only presentation vertices are blended. Stored outlines and fixtures stay exact.
    cosmetic_point :: proc(s: ^Scene,sub: Subdivision,rest: Vec2,poses: map[u64]Pose) -> Vec2 {
        self:=render_subdivision(s,sub,poses)
        point:=posed_point(self,rest)
        flex:=clamp(s.materials[sub.material].flexibility,f32(0),f32(1))
        if flex==0 { return point }
        weighted:=point
        count:=f32(1)
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            other_id:=u64(0)
            if c.a==sub.id { other_id=c.b } else if c.b==sub.id { other_id=c.a }
            if other_id==0 { continue }
            other:=render_subdivision(s,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[other_id]],poses)
            if point_on_boundary(rest,sub.outline,other.outline) { weighted=vadd(weighted,posed_point(other,rest)); count+=1 }
        }
        return vadd(point,vmul(vsub(vmul(weighted,1/count),point),flex))
    }
    draw_polygon :: proc(view: View,outline: Polygon,color: rl.Color,stroke: rl.Color,outlines: bool = true) {
        triangles:=triangulate_polygon(outline)
        for triangle in triangles {
            a,b,c:=screen_point(view,triangle.points[0]),screen_point(view,triangle.points[1]),screen_point(view,triangle.points[2])
            // Raylib's triangle winding uses the screen's downward Y axis.
            cross:=vcross(vsub(triangle.points[1],triangle.points[0]),vsub(triangle.points[2],triangle.points[0]))
            if cross > 0 { rl.DrawTriangle(a,b,c,color) } else { rl.DrawTriangle(c,b,a,color) }
            delete(triangle.points)
        }
        delete(triangles)
        if outlines {
            for i in 0..<len(outline.points) { rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,outline.points[i]),screen_point(view,outline.points[(i+1)%len(outline.points)]),2,stroke) }
        }
    }
    pick_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2) -> u64 {
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            points: [dynamic]rl.Vector2
            for rest in sub.outline.points { p:=posed_point(sub,rest); append(&points,rl.Vector2{p.x,p.y}) }
            hit:=rl.CheckCollisionPointPoly({point.x,point.y},raw_data(points),i32(len(points)))
            delete(points)
            if hit { return sub.id }
        }
        return 0
    }
    pick_connection :: proc(s: ^Scene,point: Vec2,max_distance: f32) -> u64 {
        best:=u64(0); distance:=max_distance
        for c in s.connections { if c.live { d:=vlen(vsub(point,connection_sample(s,c))); if d<distance { distance=d; best=c.id } } }
        return best
    }
    material_preset :: proc(index: int) -> Material {
        switch index {
        case 1: return Material{name="splinter",subdivision_strength=7,connection_strength=6,flexibility=0.6,generation_count=5,aspect_ratio=0.2}
        case 2: return Material{name="shatter",subdivision_strength=5,connection_strength=4,flexibility=0.05,generation_count=6,aspect_ratio=1,triangulate=true}
        }
        return Material{name="chunk",subdivision_strength=6,connection_strength=4,flexibility=0.25,generation_count=3,aspect_ratio=1}
    }
    reset_demo :: proc(s: ^Scene,preset: int,terminal: bool) {
        scene_destroy(s)
        seed:=u8(42); if terminal { seed=0 }
        s^=make_wall(seed,0.08)
        s.materials[0]=material_preset(preset)
        physics_init(s)
    }
    add_projectile :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        material:=add_material(s,Material{name="projectile",subdivision_strength=math.inf_f32(1),connection_strength=math.inf_f32(1),generation_count=2,aspect_ratio=1})
        owner:=add_piece(s,material,0)
        points:=[4]Vec2{{-1.2,0.3},{-0.8,0.3},{-0.8,0.7},{-1.2,0.7}}
        outline:=make_polygon(points[:]); defer delete(outline.points)
        id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline),velocity={8,0}})
        append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        b2.Body_SetBullet(s.physics.bodies[id],true)
        s.revision+=1
    }
    draw_scene :: proc(s: ^Scene,view: View,poses: map[u64]Pose,selected: u64,surface,joints: bool,ids: bool = true,material_colors: bool = false,outlines: bool = true) {
        for i in -20..=20 {
            tint:=rl.Color{31,44,62,255}
            if i==0 { tint={45,65,85,255} }
            rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,Vec2{f32(i),-20}),screen_point(view,Vec2{f32(i),20}),1,tint)
            rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,Vec2{-20,f32(i)}),screen_point(view,Vec2{20,f32(i)}),1,tint)
        }
        for remnant in s.remnants {
            sub:=s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[remnant.subdivision]]; sub.pose=remnant.pose
            outline:=posed_polygon(sub)
            draw_polygon(view,outline,rl.Color{140,152,170,u8(160*(1-remnant.age))},rl.Color{140,152,170,u8(160*(1-remnant.age))},outlines)
            delete(outline.points)
        }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            outline:=Polygon{points=make([]Vec2,len(sub.outline.points))}
            posed:=render_subdivision(s,sub,poses)
            for rest,i in sub.outline.points {
                point:=posed_point(posed,rest)
                if surface { point=cosmetic_point(s,sub,rest,poses) }
                outline.points[i]=point
            }
            stroke:=rl.Color{202,220,231,255}
            if sub.id==selected { stroke={255,255,255,255} }
            fill:=piece_color(sub.owner,210)
            if material_colors { fill=editor_color(s.materials[sub.material].name) }
            draw_polygon(view,outline,fill,stroke,outlines)
            delete(outline.points)
            center:=screen_point(view,posed.pose.position)
            if ids { rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("%d",sub.id),i32(center.x)-5,i32(center.y)-23,16,rl.Color{16,29,40,255}) }
        }
        if joints {
            for c in s.connections {
                if !c.live { continue }
                a,b:=render_subdivision(s,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],poses),render_subdivision(s,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]],poses)
                anchor:=vmul(vadd(posed_point(a,c.rest_point),posed_point(b,c.rest_point)),0.5)
                color:=rl.Color{248,205,109,255}
                rl.DrawLineEx(screen_point(view,a.pose.position),screen_point(view,b.pose.position),2,color)
                rl.DrawCircleV(screen_point(view,anchor),5,color)
                p:=screen_point(view,anchor)
                rl.DrawText(rl.TextFormat("c%d",c.id),i32(p.x)+7,i32(p.y)+7,14,color)
            }

    package main
    
    import "core:math"
    
    polygon_area :: proc(p: Polygon) -> f32 {
        a: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) { a += vcross(p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]) }
        return math.abs(a)*0.5
    }
    clip_polygon :: proc(p: Polygon, axis: int, cut: f32, keep_low: bool) -> Polygon {
        points: [dynamic]Vec2
        defer delete(points)
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            a,b := p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
            av,bv := a.x-cut,b.x-cut
            if axis == 1 { av = a.y-cut; bv = b.y-cut }
            if !keep_low { av = -av; bv = -bv }
            inside_a, inside_b := av <= 0,bv <= 0
            if inside_a { append(&points,a) }
            if inside_a != inside_b {
                t := av/(av-bv)
                append(&points,vadd(a,vmul(vsub(b,a),t)))
            }
        }
        return make_polygon(points[:])
    }
    is_convex :: proc(p: Polygon) -> bool {
        if len(p.points) < 3 { return false }
        sign: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            cross := vcross(vsub(p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)],p.points[i]),vsub(p.points[(i+2)%len(p.points)],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]))
            if math.abs(cross) < 0.00001 { continue }
            if sign == 0 { sign = cross } else if cross*sign < 0 { return false }
        }
        return true
    }
    point_in_triangle :: proc(p,a,b,c: Vec2, orientation: f32, tolerance: f32 = 0.00001) -> bool {
        return vcross(vsub(b,a),vsub(p,a))*orientation >= -tolerance &&
               vcross(vsub(c,b),vsub(p,b))*orientation >= -tolerance &&
               vcross(vsub(a,c),vsub(p,c))*orientation >= -tolerance
    }
    triangulate_polygon :: proc(p: Polygon) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
        result: [dynamic]Polygon
        indices: [dynamic]int
        defer delete(indices)
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) { append(&indices,i) }
        signed: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) { signed += vcross(p.points[i],p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]) }
        orientation := f32(1)
        if signed < 0 { orientation = -1 }
        for len(indices) > 3 {
            found := false
            // Keep the normal ear order; only retry exact predicates if its tolerance
            // rejects every ear of a small valid corner on a refined shared seam.
            tolerances:=[2]f32{0.00001,0}
            for tolerance in tolerances {
                for k in 0..<len(indices) {
                    i,j,l := indices[(k+len(indices)-1)%len(indices)],indices[k],indices[(k+1)%len(indices)]
                    a,b,c := p.points[i],p.points[j],p.points[l]
                    if vcross(vsub(b,a),vsub(c,b))*orientation <= tolerance { continue }
                    contains := false
                    for n in indices { if n != i && n != j && n != l && point_in_triangle(p.points[n],a,b,c,orientation,tolerance) { contains = true; break } }
                    if contains { continue }
                    append(&result,make_polygon([]Vec2{a,b,c}))
                    ordered_remove(&indices,k)
                    found = true
                    break
                }
                if found { break }
            }
            if !found { break }
        }
        if len(indices) == 3 { append(&result,make_polygon([]Vec2{p.points[indices[0]],p.points[indices[1]],p.points[indices[2]]})) }
        return result
    }
    // Straight shared cuts are constructed by clipping both sides at one value.

    generate_children :: proc(parent: Polygon, recipe: Material, seed: u8) -> [dynamic]Polygon {
        result: [dynamic]Polygon

            triangles: [dynamic]Polygon
            for polygon in result {
                parts:=triangulate_polygon(polygon)
                for part in parts { append(&triangles,part) }
                delete(parts); delete(polygon.points)
            }
            delete(result)
            result=triangles
        }
        // Incomplete triangulation or a no-progress recipe must remove the failed
        // outline, rather than retaining an equivalent child or a partial partition.
        area: f32
        genuine := len(result)>=2
        parent_area := polygon_area(parent)
        for child in result {
            child_area := polygon_area(child)
            genuine = genuine && child_area>0 && child_area<parent_area
            area += child_area
        }
        if !genuine || math.abs(area-parent_area)>max(f32(0.000002),parent_area*0.0002) {
            for child in result { delete(child.points) }
            delete(result)
            return nil
        }
        return result
    }
    
    apply_failures :: proc(s: ^Scene, failures: Failures) {
        if len(failures.subdivisions) == 0 && len(failures.connections) == 0 && len(failures.discard_subdivisions) == 0 { return }
        s.revision+=1
        affected := make(map[u64]bool)
        defer delete(affected)
        stage_failures(s,failures,&affected)
        rebuild_affected_pieces(s,affected)
    }
    // Reuse the existing one-wave graph update for physics and for each blast wave.
    // Ownership, size filtering and engine handles are committed only at the end.
    stage_failures :: proc(s: ^Scene, failures: Failures, affected: ^map[u64]bool, refine_only: bool = false) {
        replacements := make(map[u64][dynamic]u64)
        defer { for _,children in replacements { delete(children) }; delete(replacements) }
        failed_subs := sorted_ids(failures.subdivisions[:])
        for id in failures.discard_subdivisions { if !contains_id(failed_subs[:],id) { append(&failed_subs,id) } }
        sort_ids(failed_subs[:])
        failed_conns := sorted_ids(failures.connections[:])
        defer delete(failed_subs); defer delete(failed_conns)
        old_connection_count := len(s.connections)
        old_connections: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(old_connections)
        for i in 0..<old_connection_count { append(&old_connections,s.connections[i].id) }
        sort_ids(old_connections[:])
        for id in failed_subs {
            row, ok := s.sub_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.subdivisions[row].live { continue }
            parent := s.subdivisions[row]
            seed := parent.seed
            if parent.width<=s.minimum_width || contains_id(failures.discard_subdivisions[:],id) { seed=0 }
            children := generate_children(parent.outline,s.materials[parent.material],seed)
            // Spatial refinement is not yet a centre-sampled failure. If the recipe
            // cannot partition this outline, retain it for the actual blast decision.
            if refine_only && len(children)==0 { continue }
            affected[parent.owner] = true
            max_width: f32
            for outline,ordinal in children {
                center := centroid(outline)
                world_center := posed_point(parent,center)
                r := vsub(world_center,parent.pose.position)
                pose := Pose{position=world_center,angle=parent.pose.angle,velocity=vadd(parent.pose.velocity,Vec2{-parent.pose.angular_velocity*r.y,parent.pose.angular_velocity*r.x}),angular_velocity=parent.pose.angular_velocity}
                child := add_subdivision(s,parent.owner,outline,pose)
                child_row := s.sub_rows[child]
                // Parent context plus child ordinal is independent of other branches'
                // allocations. A deletion shortcut cannot perturb their future seeds.
                s.subdivisions[child_row].seed=derive_seed(parent.seed,u64(ordinal+1))
                max_width=max(max_width,s.subdivisions[child_row].width)
                delete(outline.points)
                child_ids := replacements[id]
                append(&child_ids,child)
                replacements[id] = child_ids
            }
            delete(children)
            if max_width<=s.minimum_width {
                child_ids := replacements[id]
                for child in child_ids { s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[child]].seed=0 }
            }
            s.subdivisions[row].live = false
        }
        for id in failed_conns {
            row, ok := s.conn_rows[id]
            if ok && s.connections[row].live {
                c := s.connections[row]
                affected[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].owner] = true
                affected[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].owner] = true
                s.connections[row].live = false
            }
        }
        for old_id in old_connections {
            i := s.conn_rows[old_id]
            c := s.connections[i]
            if !c.live { continue }
            a_dead := !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].live
            b_dead := !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].live
            if !a_dead && !b_dead { continue }
            s.connections[i].live = false
            left_default,right_default := [1]u64{c.a},[1]u64{c.b}
            left,right := left_default[:],right_default[:]
            if a_dead { left = replacements[c.a][:] }
            if b_dead { right = replacements[c.b][:] }
            old_a,old_b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            old_length,_ := shared_boundary(old_a.outline,old_b.outline)
            if old_length <= 0 { continue }
            for a in left {
                for b in right {
                    if inherits_old_boundary(s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[a]].outline,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[b]].outline,old_a.outline,old_b.outline) { add_connection(s,a,b) }
                }
            }
        }
        for id in failed_subs {
            children := replacements[id]
            for i in 0..<len(children) { for j in i+1..<len(children) { add_connection(s,children[i],children[j]) } }
        }
    }
    rebuild_affected_pieces :: proc(s: ^Scene, affected: map[u64]bool) {
        owners: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(owners)
        for owner in affected { append(&owners,owner) }
        sort_ids(owners[:])
        for owner in owners { rebuild_piece(s,owner) }
    }
    
    BLAST_LOAD_MULTIPLIER :: f32(10)
    BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE :: f32(0.2)
    blast_load :: proc(distance,radius: f32) -> f32 {
        if radius <= 0 || distance >= radius { return 0 }
        return BLAST_LOAD_MULTIPLIER*max(f32(0),radius-distance)
    }
    fails :: proc(load,strength: f32) -> bool { return load > 0 && load >= strength }
    evaluate_blast :: proc(s: ^Scene, blast: Blast, first_subdivision: int = 0, first_connection: int = 0) -> Failures {
        f := Failures{}
        for i in first_subdivision..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            sub := &s.subdivisions[i]
            if !sub.live { continue }
            offset := vsub(subdivision_sample(sub^),blast.position)
            distance := vlen(offset)
            load := blast_load(distance,blast.radius)
            if load <= 0 { continue }
            if fails(load,s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&f.subdivisions,sub.id) }
        }
        for i in first_connection..<len(s.connections) {
            c := s.connections[i]
            if !c.live { continue }
            a := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]]
            load := blast_load(vlen(vsub(connection_sample(s,c),blast.position)),blast.radius)
            if fails(load,s.materials[a.material].connection_strength) { append(&f.connections,c.id) }
        }
        return f
    }
    // Descendants partition the outline, inherit its material and keep its rigid
    // transform during this event. Their samples lie in the posed convex hull.
    // Outward rounding and a strict load margin avoid pruning borderline failures.
    blast_erases_descendants :: proc(sub: Subdivision, blast: Blast, strength: f32) -> bool {
        if !finite(strength) || !finite(blast.radius) || !valid_vec(blast.position) { return false }
        farthest: f32
        for point in sub.outline.points {
            distance := vlen(vsub(posed_point(sub,point),blast.position))
            if !finite(distance) { return false }
            farthest=max(farthest,distance)
        }
        farthest=math.nextafter(farthest,math.inf_f32(1))
        return blast_load(farthest,blast.radius)>strength+0.0001
    }
    blast_pass :: proc(s: ^Scene, blast: Blast, deletion_shortcut: bool = true) {
        physics_read_motion(s)
        affected := make(map[u64]bool)
        defer delete(affected)
        f := evaluate_blast(s,blast)
        changed := false
        for len(f.subdivisions)>0 || len(f.connections)>0 {
            changed=true
            if deletion_shortcut {
                for id in f.subdivisions {
                    sub := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]]
                    if sub.seed!=0 && sub.width>s.minimum_width && blast_erases_descendants(sub,blast,s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&f.discard_subdivisions,id) }
                }
            }
            first_subdivision,first_connection := len(s.subdivisions),len(s.connections)
            stage_failures(s,f,&affected)
            delete(f.subdivisions); delete(f.connections); delete(f.discard_subdivisions)
            // Earlier survivors have unchanged samples. Only children and new links
            // need this blast again; failed old links are already excluded from inheritance.
            f=evaluate_blast(s,blast,first_subdivision,first_connection)
        }
        delete(f.subdivisions); delete(f.connections); delete(f.discard_subdivisions)
        if changed { s.revision+=1; rebuild_affected_pieces(s,affected) }
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        for i in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            sub := &s.subdivisions[i]
            if !sub.live { continue }
            offset := vsub(subdivision_sample(sub^),blast.position)
            distance := vlen(offset)
            load := blast_load(distance,blast.radius)
            if load>0 && distance>0.00001 { apply_blast_motion(s,sub,vmul(offset,1/distance),load) }
        }
    }
    fade_step :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) {
        for i := len(s.remnants)-1; i >= 0; i -= 1 {
            s.remnants[i].age += dt
            if s.remnants[i].age >= 1 { ordered_remove(&s.remnants,i) }
        }
    }

    package main
    
    import b2 "vendor:box2d"
    import "core:math"
    
    Physics :: struct {
        world: b2.WorldId,
        bodies: map[u64]b2.BodyId,
        joints: map[u64]b2.JointId,
        fixture_counts: map[u64]int,
        anchor_y: f32,
        active: bool,
    }
    Interaction :: struct { force: Vec2, torque: f32 }
    REFERENCE_LENGTH :: f32(1)
    PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS :: 4
    GLOBAL_DAMPING :: f32(0.7)
    
    to_b2 :: proc(v: Vec2) -> b2.Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    from_b2 :: proc(v: b2.Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {v.x,v.y} }
    interaction_load :: proc(i: Interaction) -> f32 {
        return max(vlen(i.force),math.abs(i.torque)/REFERENCE_LENGTH)
    }
    equivalent_force :: proc(impulse: Vec2, interval: f32) -> Vec2 {
        assert(interval > 0)
        return vmul(impulse,1/interval)
    }
    physics_init :: proc(s: ^Scene, gravity: Vec2 = {}, anchor_y: f32 = -1e30) {
        assert(!s.physics.active)
        def := b2.DefaultWorldDef()
        def.gravity = to_b2(gravity)
        s.physics = Physics{world=b2.CreateWorld(def),bodies=make(map[u64]b2.BodyId),joints=make(map[u64]b2.JointId),fixture_counts=make(map[u64]int),anchor_y=anchor_y,active=true}
        physics_sync_structure(s)
    }
    physics_destroy :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        b2.DestroyWorld(s.physics.world)
        delete(s.physics.bodies); delete(s.physics.joints); delete(s.physics.fixture_counts)
        s.physics = {}
    }
    physics_read_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row := s.sub_rows[id]
            rotation := b2.Body_GetRotation(body)
            s.subdivisions[row].pose = Pose{
                position=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(body)),angle=math.atan2(rotation.s,rotation.c),
                velocity=from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body)),angular_velocity=b2.Body_GetAngularVelocity(body),
            }
        }
    }
    physics_create_fixture :: proc(s: ^Scene, body: b2.BodyId, sub: Subdivision, outline: Polygon) -> bool {
        points: [dynamic]b2.Vec2
        defer delete(points)
        for point in outline.points { append(&points,to_b2(vsub(point,sub.rest_center))) }
        hull := b2.ComputeHull(points[:])
        // Hull welding can collapse a thin ear below Box2D's collision tolerance.
        if hull.count < 3 { return false }
        polygon := b2.MakePolygon(hull,0)
        def := b2.DefaultShapeDef()
        def.density = 1
        _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
        s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id] += 1
        return true
    }
    physics_finish_mass :: proc(s: ^Scene,body: b2.BodyId,sub: Subdivision) {
        if s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id]==0 {
            // A microscopic attached subdivision is still one live logical entity.
            // Use a bounding fixture when the engine cannot resolve any of its ears.
            lo,hi:=Vec2{1e30,1e30},Vec2{-1e30,-1e30}
            for rest in sub.outline.points { p:=vsub(rest,sub.rest_center); lo={min(lo.x,p.x),min(lo.y,p.y)}; hi={max(hi.x,p.x),max(hi.y,p.y)} }
            polygon:=b2.MakeOffsetBox(max(f32(0.0025),(hi.x-lo.x)*0.5),max(f32(0.0025),(hi.y-lo.y)*0.5),to_b2(vmul(vadd(lo,hi),0.5)),b2.MakeRot(0))
            def:=b2.DefaultShapeDef(); def.density=1
            _ = b2.CreatePolygonShape(body,def,polygon)
            s.physics.fixture_counts[sub.id]=1
        }
        // Keep mass and the body origin tied to the exact logical polygon, including
        // when Box2D simplifies a fixture. This also makes rotational inheritance exact.
        inertia: f32
        for i in 0..<len(sub.outline.points) {
            a,b:=vsub(sub.outline.points[i],sub.rest_center),vsub(sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)],sub.rest_center)
            inertia+=vcross(a,b)*(vdot(a,a)+vdot(a,b)+vdot(b,b))/12
        }
        b2.Body_SetMassData(body,b2.MassData{mass=polygon_area(sub.outline),center={},rotationalInertia=math.abs(inertia)})
        b2.Body_SetLinearVelocity(body,to_b2(sub.pose.velocity))
        b2.Body_SetAngularVelocity(body,sub.pose.angular_velocity)
    }
    // This runs only between World_Step calls. Existing handles survive ownership changes.
    physics_sync_structure :: proc(s: ^Scene) {
        if !s.physics.active { return }
        anchored:=make(map[u64]bool)
        defer delete(anchored)
        if s.physics.anchor_y>-1e30 {
            for sub in s.subdivisions {
                if !sub.live || anchored[sub.owner] { continue }
                for a,i in sub.outline.points {
                    b:=sub.outline.points[(i+1)%len(sub.outline.points)]
                    if math.abs(a.y-s.physics.anchor_y)<0.00001 && math.abs(b.y-s.physics.anchor_y)<0.00001 && math.abs(a.x-b.x)>0.00001 { anchored[sub.owner]=true; break }
                }
            }
        }
        dead_joints: [dynamic]u64
        dead_bodies: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(dead_joints); defer delete(dead_bodies)
        for id,joint in s.physics.joints {
            row,ok := s.conn_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.connections[row].live || anchored[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[s.connections[row].a]].owner] { b2.DestroyJoint(joint); append(&dead_joints,id) }
        }
        for id in dead_joints { delete_key(&s.physics.joints,id) }
        for id,body in s.physics.bodies {
            row,ok := s.sub_rows[id]
            if !ok || !s.subdivisions[row].live { b2.DestroyBody(body); append(&dead_bodies,id) }
        }
        for id in dead_bodies { delete_key(&s.physics.bodies,id); delete_key(&s.physics.fixture_counts,id) }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            type:=b2.BodyType.dynamicBody
            if anchored[sub.owner] { type=.staticBody }
            if body,exists := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]; exists {
                if b2.Body_GetType(body)!=type {
                    b2.Body_SetType(body,type)
                    if type==.dynamicBody { physics_finish_mass(s,body,sub) }
                }
                continue
            }
            def := b2.DefaultBodyDef()
            // Refining a supported piece must not change its behaviour under gravity.
            // Once its connection to a support edge breaks, its bodies become dynamic.
            def.type = type
            def.position = to_b2(sub.pose.position)
            def.rotation = b2.MakeRot(sub.pose.angle)
            def.linearVelocity = to_b2(sub.pose.velocity)
            def.angularVelocity = sub.pose.angular_velocity
            body := b2.CreateBody(s.physics.world,def)
            s.physics.bodies[sub.id] = body
            if is_convex(sub.outline) && len(sub.outline.points) <= 8 {
                physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,sub.outline)
            } else {
                triangles := convex_decomposition(sub.outline)
                for triangle in triangles { physics_create_fixture(s,body,sub,triangle); delete(triangle.points) }
                delete(triangles)
            }
            physics_finish_mass(s,body,sub)
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            if _,exists := s.physics.joints[c.id]; exists { continue }
            a := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]]
            b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            def := b2.DefaultWeldJointDef()
            def.bodyIdA = s.physics.bodies[c.a]
            def.bodyIdB = s.physics.bodies[c.b]
            // Their logical attachment still participates in blasts; two anchored
            // regions need no solver constraint between them.
            if b2.Body_GetType(def.bodyIdA)==.staticBody && b2.Body_GetType(def.bodyIdB)==.staticBody { continue }
            def.localAnchorA = to_b2(c.local_a)
            def.localAnchorB = to_b2(c.local_b)
            // All outlines share one undeformed frame. Its relative rest angle is zero.
            def.referenceAngle = 0
            flexibility := max(s.materials[a.material].flexibility,s.materials[b.material].flexibility)
            if flexibility > 0 {
                def.linearHertz = 1/max(flexibility,0.01)
                def.angularHertz = def.linearHertz
            }
            def.linearDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
            def.angularDampingRatio = GLOBAL_DAMPING
            s.physics.joints[c.id] = b2.CreateWeldJoint(s.physics.world,def)
        }
    }
    apply_blast_motion :: proc(s: ^Scene, sub: ^Subdivision, direction: Vec2, load: f32) {
        delta_v := vmul(direction,load*BLAST_IMPULSE_SCALE)
        if s.physics.active {
            body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
            impulse := vmul(delta_v,b2.Body_GetMass(body))
            b2.Body_ApplyLinearImpulseToCenter(body,to_b2(impulse),true)
            sub.pose.velocity = from_b2(b2.Body_GetLinearVelocity(body))
        } else {
            sub.pose.velocity = vadd(sub.pose.velocity,delta_v)
        }
    }
    // Contact points and fixtures against the same other body form one interaction.
    // Joint reactions are already forces; totalNormalImpulse covers the full tick.
    // Box2D's tangent/rolling impulses cover the final substep in this binding version.
    calculate_physics_loads :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32) -> Failures {
        assert(dt > 0)
        failures := Failures{}
        loads := make(map[u64]f32)
        defer delete(loads)
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if !sub.live { continue }
            body := s.physics.bodies[sub.id]
            capacity := int(b2.Body_GetContactCapacity(body))
            buffer := make([]b2.ContactData,capacity)
            contacts := b2.Body_GetContactData(body,buffer)
            interactions := make(map[b2.BodyId]Interaction)
            for contact in contacts {
                body_a,body_b := b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdA),b2.Shape_GetBody(contact.shapeIdB)
                other := body_b
                sign := f32(-1)
                if body_b == body { other=body_a; sign=1 }
                normal := from_b2(contact.manifold.normal)
                tangent := Vec2{normal.y,-normal.x}
                interaction := interactions[other]
                for k in 0..<int(contact.manifold.pointCount) {
                    point := contact.manifold.points[k]
                    force := vadd(equivalent_force(vmul(normal,point.totalNormalImpulse*sign),dt),equivalent_force(vmul(tangent,point.tangentImpulse*sign),dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)))
                    interaction.force = vadd(interaction.force,force)
                    interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(from_b2(point.point),sub.pose.position),force)
                }
                interaction.torque += contact.manifold.rollingImpulse*sign/(dt/f32(PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS))
                interactions[other] = interaction
            }
            for _,interaction in interactions { loads[sub.id] = max(loads[sub.id],interaction_load(interaction)) }
            delete(interactions); delete(buffer)
        }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            joint,exists := s.physics.joints[c.id]
            if !exists { continue }
            interaction := Interaction{force=from_b2(b2.Joint_GetConstraintForce(joint)),torque=b2.Joint_GetConstraintTorque(joint)}
            load := interaction_load(interaction)
            a,b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            a_interaction,b_interaction := interaction,interaction
            a_interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(posed_point(a,c.rest_point),a.pose.position),interaction.force)
            b_interaction.torque += vcross(vsub(posed_point(b,c.rest_point),b.pose.position),interaction.force)
            loads[c.a] = max(loads[c.a],interaction_load(a_interaction))
            loads[c.b] = max(loads[c.b],interaction_load(b_interaction))
            material := s.materials[s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].material]
            if fails(load,material.connection_strength) { append(&failures.connections,c.id) }
        }
        for sub in s.subdivisions {
            if sub.live && fails(loads[sub.id],s.materials[sub.material].subdivision_strength) { append(&failures.subdivisions,sub.id) }
        }
        return failures
    }
    Load_Calculator :: #type proc(s: ^Scene,dt: f32) -> Failures
    physics_tick :: proc(s: ^Scene, dt: f32,calculate_loads: Load_Calculator = calculate_physics_loads) {
        assert(s.physics.active && dt > 0)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        b2.World_Step(s.physics.world,dt,PHYSICS_SUBSTEPS)
        physics_read_motion(s)
        failures := calculate_loads(s,dt)
        apply_failures(s,failures)
        delete(failures.subdivisions); delete(failures.connections)
        delete(failures.discard_subdivisions)
        physics_sync_structure(s)
        fade_step(s,dt)
    }

    package main
    
    import "core:math"
    
    Palette :: enum { Wood, Glass, Rubber, Stone }
    RUBBER_CELL_SIZE :: f32(0.4)
    Authored_Rect :: struct { lo,hi: Vec2, material: Palette, identity: u64 }
    Material_Editor :: struct {
        enabled,editing,dragging: bool,
        palette: Palette,
        start,cursor: Vec2,
        next_identity: u64,
        objects: [dynamic]Authored_Rect,
    }
    // Gameplay presets use the ordinary material fields, not the diagnostic sliders.
    editor_material :: proc(choice: Palette) -> Material {
        m: Material
        switch choice {
        case .Wood:
            m=material_preset(1); m.name="wood"; m.subdivision_strength=28; m.connection_strength=22; m.flexibility=0
        case .Glass:
            m=material_preset(2); m.name="glass"; m.subdivision_strength=16; m.connection_strength=12; m.flexibility=0
        case .Rubber:
            m=material_preset(0); m.name="rubber"; m.subdivision_strength=45; m.connection_strength=90; m.flexibility=0.5
        case .Stone:
            m=material_preset(0); m.name="stone"; m.subdivision_strength=35; m.connection_strength=20; m.flexibility=0
        }
        return m
    }
    sandbox_editor_create :: proc() -> Sandbox {
        game:=Sandbox{applied=DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS,draft=DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SETTINGS,previous=make(map[u64]Pose),surface=true,joints=true,outlines=true}
        game.editor.enabled=true; game.editor.editing=true
        sandbox_reset(&game)
        return game
    }
    editor_rectangle :: proc(a,b: Vec2,material: Palette) -> Authored_Rect {
        return Authored_Rect{lo={min(a.x,b.x),min(a.y,b.y)},hi={max(a.x,b.x),max(a.y,b.y)},material=material}
    }
    editor_overlaps :: proc(a,b: Authored_Rect) -> bool {
        return a.lo.x<b.hi.x && a.hi.x>b.lo.x && a.lo.y<b.hi.y && a.hi.y>b.lo.y
    }
    editor_valid_rectangle :: proc(editor: ^Material_Editor,r: Authored_Rect) -> bool {
        if !valid_vec(r.lo) || !valid_vec(r.hi) || r.hi.x-r.lo.x<0.2 || r.hi.y-r.lo.y<0.2 { return false }
        if r.lo.x< -7.5 || r.hi.x>8.5 || r.lo.y<0 || r.hi.y>4.8 { return false }
        // Reserve the initial player's footprint, too; no body starts inside a solid.
        spawn:=Authored_Rect{lo={PLAYER_SPAWN.x-PLAYER_RADIUS,0},hi={PLAYER_SPAWN.x+PLAYER_RADIUS,PLAYER_SPAWN.y+PLAYER_HALF_HEIGHT}}
        if editor_overlaps(r,spawn) { return false }
        for object in editor.objects { if editor_overlaps(r,object) { return false } }
        return true
    }
    editor_place :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,a,b: Vec2) -> bool {
        if !game.editor.editing || game.panel_open { return false }
        r:=editor_rectangle(a,b,game.editor.palette)
        if !editor_valid_rectangle(&game.editor,r) { sandbox_notice(game,"Place a rectangle above ground, clear of objects and spawn"); return false }
        game.editor.next_identity+=1; r.identity=game.editor.next_identity
        append(&game.editor.objects,r)
        return true
    }
    editor_remove :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,point: Vec2) -> bool {
        if !game.editor.editing || game.panel_open { return false }
        for object,i in game.editor.objects {
            if point.x>=object.lo.x && point.x<=object.hi.x && point.y>=object.lo.y && point.y<=object.hi.y {
                ordered_remove(&game.editor.objects,i); return true
            }
        }
        return false
    }
    sandbox_toggle_editor :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        if !game.editor.enabled || game.panel_open { return }
        game.editor.editing=!game.editor.editing
        game.editor.dragging=false
        sandbox_reset(game)
        if game.editor.editing { sandbox_notice(game,"Edit: undamaged layout restored") }
        else { sandbox_notice(game,"Test: R restores this layout and seed") }
    }
    editor_build_objects :: proc(game: ^Sandbox) {
        s:=&game.scene
        materials: [4]int
        for choice in Palette { materials[int(choice)]=add_material(s,editor_material(choice)) }
        if game.editor.editing { return }
        for object in game.editor.objects {
            seed:=derive_seed(game.applied.seed,0x10000+object.identity)
            if object.material==.Rubber { seed=0 }
            owner:=add_piece(s,materials[int(object.material)],seed)
            nx,ny:=1,1
            if object.material==.Rubber {
                nx=int(math.ceil((object.hi.x-object.lo.x)/RUBBER_CELL_SIZE-0.00001))
                ny=int(math.ceil((object.hi.y-object.lo.y)/RUBBER_CELL_SIZE-0.00001))
            }
            // Uniform fitted cells: one target size, no tiny leftover edge strips.
            dx,dy:=(object.hi.x-object.lo.x)/f32(nx),(object.hi.y-object.lo.y)/f32(ny)
            ids:=make([]u64,nx*ny)
            for row in 0..<ny {
                for column in 0..<nx {
                    x0,x1:=object.lo.x+f32(column)*dx,object.lo.x+f32(column+1)*dx
                    y0,y1:=object.lo.y+f32(row)*dy,object.lo.y+f32(row+1)*dy
                    points:=[4]Vec2{{x0,y0},{x1,y0},{x1,y1},{x0,y1}}
                    outline:=Polygon{points=points[:]}
                    id:=add_subdivision(s,owner,outline,Pose{position=centroid(outline)})
                    append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].subdivisions,id)
                    index:=row*nx+column; ids[index]=id
                    if column>0 { connection:=add_connection(s,ids[index-1],id); assert(connection!=0); append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].connections,connection) }
                    if row>0 { connection:=add_connection(s,ids[index-nx],id); assert(connection!=0); append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]].connections,connection) }
                }
            }
            delete(ids)
        }
    }

    package main
    
    import "core:math"
    
    Vec2 :: struct { x, y: f32 }
    Polygon :: struct { points: []Vec2 }
    Pose :: struct { position: Vec2, angle: f32, velocity: Vec2, angular_velocity: f32 }
    Material :: struct {
        name: string,
        subdivision_strength, connection_strength: f32,
        flexibility: f32,
        generation_count: int,
        aspect_ratio: f32,
        triangulate: bool,
    }
    Subdivision :: struct {
        id, owner: u64,
        material: int,
        seed: u8,
        outline: Polygon,
        outline_start,outline_count: int `json:"-"`,
        width: f32 `json:"-"`,
        rest_center: Vec2,
        pose: Pose,
        live: bool,
    }
    Connection :: struct {
        id, a, b: u64,
        rest_point, local_a, local_b: Vec2,
        live: bool,
    }
    Piece :: struct {
        id: u64,
        material: int,
        seed: u8,
        subdivisions, connections: [dynamic]u64,
        live: bool,
    }
    Remnant :: struct { subdivision: u64, pose: Pose, age: f32 }
    Scene :: struct {
        physics: Physics,
        materials: [dynamic]Material,
        owned_names: [dynamic]string,
        subdivisions: [dynamic]Subdivision,
        vertices: [dynamic]Vec2,
        connections: [dynamic]Connection,
        pieces: [dynamic]Piece,
        remnants: [dynamic]Remnant,
        sub_rows, conn_rows, piece_rows: map[u64]int,
        next_id: u64,
        revision: u64,
        minimum_width: f32,
    }
    Blast :: struct { position: Vec2, radius: f32 }
    Failures :: struct { subdivisions, connections, discard_subdivisions: [dynamic]u64 }
    
    vadd :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {a.x+b.x, a.y+b.y} }
    vsub :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> Vec2 { return {a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y} }
    vmul :: proc(a: Vec2, s: f32) -> Vec2 { return {a.x*s, a.y*s} }
    vdot :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> f32 { return a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y }
    vcross :: proc(a, b: Vec2) -> f32 { return a.x*b.y-a.y*b.x }
    vlen :: proc(a: Vec2) -> f32 { return math.sqrt(vdot(a,a)) }
    vrotate :: proc(a: Vec2, angle: f32) -> Vec2 {
        c, s := f32(math.cos(angle)), f32(math.sin(angle))
        return {a.x*c-a.y*s,a.x*s+a.y*c}
    }
    centroid :: proc(p: Polygon) -> Vec2 {
        area, x, y: f32
        for i in 0..<len(p.points) {
            a, b := p.points[i], p.points[(i+1)%len(p.points)]
            cross := vcross(a,b)
            area += cross
            x += (a.x+b.x)*cross
            y += (a.y+b.y)*cross
        }
        if math.abs(area) < 0.00001 {
            for point in p.points { x += point.x; y += point.y }
            return {x/f32(len(p.points)),y/f32(len(p.points))}
        }
        return {x/(3*area),y/(3*area)}
    }
    posed_point :: proc(sub: Subdivision, rest: Vec2) -> Vec2 {
        return vadd(sub.pose.position,vrotate(vsub(rest,sub.rest_center),sub.pose.angle))
    }
    posed_polygon :: proc(sub: Subdivision) -> Polygon {
        result := Polygon{points=make([]Vec2,len(sub.outline.points))}
        for point,i in sub.outline.points { result.points[i]=posed_point(sub,point) }
        return result
    }
    make_polygon :: proc(points: []Vec2) -> Polygon {
        result:=Polygon{points=make([]Vec2,len(points))}
        copy(result.points,points)
        return result
    }
    // Returns the common collinear edge length and its length-weighted midpoint.
    shared_boundary :: proc(a, b: Polygon) -> (f32, Vec2) {
        total: f32
        weighted := Vec2{}
        for i in 0..<len(a.points) {
            p, q := a.points[i], a.points[(i+1)%len(a.points)]
            d := vsub(q,p)
            length := vlen(d)
            if length < 0.00001 { continue }
            unit := vmul(d,1/length)
            for j in 0..<len(b.points) {
                r, s := b.points[j], b.points[(j+1)%len(b.points)]
                if math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(r,p))) > 0.0001*length || math.abs(vcross(d,vsub(s,p))) > 0.0001*length { continue }
                t0, t1 := vdot(vsub(r,p),unit), vdot(vsub(s,p),unit)
                lo := max(f32(0),min(t0,t1))
                hi := min(length,max(t0,t1))
                if hi-lo > 0.0001 {
                    span := hi-lo
                    total += span
                    weighted = vadd(weighted,vmul(vadd(p,vmul(unit,(lo+hi)*0.5)),span))
                }
            }
        }
        if total == 0 { return 0, {} }
        return total,vmul(weighted,1/total)
    }
    new_id :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> u64 { s.next_id += 1; return s.next_id }
    new_scene :: proc(minimum_width: f32) -> Scene {
        return Scene{sub_rows=make(map[u64]int),conn_rows=make(map[u64]int),piece_rows=make(map[u64]int),minimum_width=minimum_width}
    }
    add_material :: proc(s: ^Scene, m: Material) -> int { append(&s.materials,m); return len(s.materials)-1 }
    add_piece :: proc(s: ^Scene, material: int, seed: u8) -> u64 {
        id := new_id(s)
        s.piece_rows[id] = len(s.pieces)
        append(&s.pieces,Piece{id=id,material=material,seed=seed,live=true})
        return id
    }
    add_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene, owner: u64, outline: Polygon, pose: Pose) -> u64 {
        id := new_id(s)
        piece := s.pieces[s.piece_rows[owner]]
        retain_subdivision(s,Subdivision{id=id,owner=owner,material=piece.material,seed=piece.seed,outline=outline,pose=pose,live=true})
        return id
    }
    // Outlines use ranges in one append-only undeformed vertex pool. The outline
    // slice is a derived read view, refreshed whenever appending can move the pool.
    // Callers may release their source polygon immediately after this call.
    retain_subdivision :: proc(s: ^Scene,source: Subdivision) {
        sub:=source
        points:=make_polygon(source.outline.points)
        defer delete(points.points)
        sub.rest_center=centroid(points)
        sub.width=outline_width(points.points)
        sub.outline_start=len(s.vertices); sub.outline_count=len(points.points)
        for point in points.points { append(&s.vertices,point) }
        for i in 0..<len(s.subdivisions) {
            existing:=&s.subdivisions[i]
            existing.outline.points=s.vertices[existing.outline_start:existing.outline_start+existing.outline_count]
        }
        sub.outline.points=s.vertices[sub.outline_start:sub.outline_start+sub.outline_count]
        s.sub_rows[sub.id]=len(s.subdivisions)
        append(&s.subdivisions,sub)
    }
    add_connection :: proc(s: ^Scene, a, b: u64) -> u64 {
        if a == b { return 0 }
        for c in s.connections { if c.live && ((c.a == a && c.b == b) || (c.a == b && c.b == a)) { return c.id } }
        sa, sb := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[b]]
        length, point := shared_boundary(sa.outline,sb.outline)
        if length <= 0 { return 0 }
        id := new_id(s)
        s.conn_rows[id] = len(s.connections)
        append(&s.connections,Connection{id=id,a=a,b=b,rest_point=point,local_a=vsub(point,sa.rest_center),local_b=vsub(point,sb.rest_center),live=true})
        return id
    }
    connection_sample :: proc(s: ^Scene, c: Connection) -> Vec2 {
        a,b := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
        return vmul(vadd(vadd(a.pose.position,vrotate(c.local_a,a.pose.angle)),vadd(b.pose.position,vrotate(c.local_b,b.pose.angle))),0.5)
    }
    subdivision_sample :: proc(sub: Subdivision) -> Vec2 { return sub.pose.position }
    contains_id :: proc(ids: []u64,id: u64) -> bool { for x in ids { if x == id { return true } }; return false }
    sort_ids :: proc(ids: []u64) {
        for i in 1..<len(ids) {
            j := i
            for j > 0 && ids[j] < ids[j-1] { ids[j],ids[j-1] = ids[j-1],ids[j]; j -= 1 }
        }
    }
    sorted_ids :: proc(ids: []u64) -> [dynamic]u64 {
        result: [dynamic]u64
        for id in ids { if !contains_id(result[:],id) { append(&result,id) } }
        sort_ids(result[:])
        return result
    }
    derive_seed :: proc(seed: u8, identity: u64) -> u8 {
        if seed == 0 { return 0 }
        x := identity ~ (u64(seed)*0x9e3779b97f4a7c15)
        x ~= x >> 30; x *= 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9

    sandbox_tick :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,move: f32,jump: bool,dt: f32 = 1.0/60.0) {
        clear(&game.previous)
        for sub in game.scene.subdivisions { if sub.live { game.previous[sub.id]=sub.pose } }
        game.previous_player=from_b2(b2.Body_GetPosition(game.player.body))
        bomb_rain_before_step(game,dt)
        player_before_step(&game.player,move,jump,dt)
        physics_tick(&game.scene,dt)
        bomb_rain_after_step(game,dt)
        if player_after_step(&game.player) {
            game.previous_player=PLAYER_SPAWN
            sandbox_notice(game,"Back at spawn")
        }
    }
    sandbox_advance :: proc(game: ^Sandbox,dt: f32,input: Sandbox_Input) {
        if game.panel_open || game.editor.editing { game.accumulator=0; game.jump_queued=false; return }
        if input.jump_pressed { game.jump_queued=true }
        game.status_time=max(f32(0),game.status_time-dt)
        game.accumulator+=clamp(dt,f32(0),f32(0.1))
        for game.accumulator>=1.0/60.0 {
            sandbox_tick(game,input.move,game.jump_queued)
            game.jump_queued=false
            game.accumulator-=1.0/60.0
        }
    }

    .\README.md:51:Material limitations: this is not a continuous elastic or volume-preserving material model. Rubber bends/stretches at soft joints while its cells remain rigid; objects small enough for a single cell cannot bend internally; sufficiently strong hits can remove cells and split the grid. Its higher connection strength lets normal deformation survive, while finite cell strength permits destruction. Wood/glass/stone toughness still depends on shape, size, impacts and the existing centroid samples; large or elevated brittle objects can fracture from landing loads, and strong blasts can erase most of them. The mass/density, friction, damping and center-applied blast impulse policies are unchanged.

    .\README.md:125:Before a yard blast, a floor outline whose edge reaches failure load while its centre survives is refined using the existing generator and inherited connections. A failing cell is also refined when its extent exceeds the damage radius, preventing the huge floor root from turning into coarse children whose centres all miss the impact. Smaller failed cells retain ordinary generation and the conservative deletion shortcut. This lets local hits reach the huge floor root without generating its future detail at reset. An unsuccessful spatial split retains its original outline for the actual damage decision; a genuinely failed subdivision still follows the existing direct-removal rule. The ordinary centre-sampled blast then resolves damage; all refinement shares one structural revision and only final survivors receive physics bodies and impulses. The optional physics support plane anchors connected pieces with a reference edge at the base, so subdivision alone does not introduce gravity loads into intact terrain. When a piece loses its last anchored connection, its existing bodies become dynamic with their logical mass and inertia. Logical links between anchored regions remain available to blast evaluation without creating unnecessary static-to-static solver constraints.

    outline_width :: proc(points: []Vec2) -> f32 {
        hull:=convex_hull(points)
        defer delete(hull)
        if len(hull)<3 { return 0 }
        width := f32(1e30)
        for i in 0..<len(hull) {
            edge:=vsub(hull[(i+1)%len(hull)],hull[i]); length:=vlen(edge)
            if length<0.00001 { continue }
            normal:=Vec2{-edge.y/length,edge.x/length}
            lo,hi:=f32(1e30),f32(-1e30)
            for point in hull { projection:=vdot(point,normal); lo=min(lo,projection); hi=max(hi,projection) }
            width=min(width,hi-lo)
        }
        return width
    }
    rebuild_piece :: proc(s: ^Scene, old_id: u64) {
        old_row, ok := s.piece_rows[old_id]
        if !ok || !s.pieces[old_row].live { return }
        material := s.pieces[old_row].material
        groups: [dynamic][dynamic]u64
        visited := make(map[u64]bool)
        adjacency:=make(map[u64][dynamic]u64)
        defer delete(visited)
        defer { for _,neighbors in adjacency { delete(neighbors) }; delete(adjacency) }
        for c in s.connections {
            if !c.live { continue }
            a,b:=s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]],s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]]
            if !a.live || !b.live || a.owner!=old_id || b.owner!=old_id { continue }
            left,right:=adjacency[c.a],adjacency[c.b]
            append(&left,c.b); append(&right,c.a)
            adjacency[c.a]=left; adjacency[c.b]=right
        }
        defer {
            for group in groups { delete(group) }
            delete(groups)
        }
        // Find the lowest unvisited ID each time, independent of storage order.
        for {
            start := u64(0)
            for sub in s.subdivisions {
                if sub.live && sub.owner == old_id && !visited[sub.id] && (start == 0 || sub.id < start) { start = sub.id }
            }
            if start == 0 { break }
            group: [dynamic]u64
            queue := [dynamic]u64{start}
            visited[start] = true
            for head := 0; head < len(queue); head += 1 {
                id := queue[head]
                append(&group,id)
                neighbors:=adjacency[id]
                for other in neighbors {
                    if !visited[other] {
                        visited[other] = true; append(&queue,other)
                    }
                }
            }
            delete(queue)
            sort_ids(group[:])
            append(&groups,group)
        }
        s.pieces[old_row].live = false
        for group in groups {
            if piece_width(s,group[:]) < s.minimum_width {
                for id in group {
                    row := s.sub_rows[id]
                    append(&s.remnants,Remnant{subdivision=id,pose=s.subdivisions[row].pose})
                    s.subdivisions[row].live = false
                }
                continue
            }
            // Subdivision contexts belong to their geometry, never allocation-order
            // IDs or a later ownership change. Keep a representative piece context.
            seed: u8
            for id in group { if child_seed := s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].seed; child_seed != 0 { seed=child_seed; break } }
            new_owner := add_piece(s,material,seed)
            for id in group {
                s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]].owner = new_owner
                append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[new_owner]].subdivisions,id)
            }
            for c in s.connections {
                if c.live && contains_id(group[:],c.a) && contains_id(group[:],c.b) { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[new_owner]].connections,c.id) }
            }
            sort_ids(s.pieces[s.piece_rows[new_owner]].connections[:])
        }
        for i in 0..<len(s.connections) {
            c := &s.connections[i]
            if c.live && (!s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.a]].live || !s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[c.b]].live) { c.live = false }
        }
    }
    
    make_wall :: proc(seed: u8 = 0, minimum_width: f32 = 0) -> Scene {
        s := new_scene(minimum_width)
        m := add_material(&s,Material{name="brick",subdivision_strength=6,connection_strength=4,flexibility=0.25,generation_count=2,aspect_ratio=1.5})
        p := add_piece(&s,m,seed)
        ids: [3]u64
        for i in 0..<3 {
            x := f32(i)
            poly := make_polygon([]Vec2{{x,0},{x+1,0},{x+1,1},{x,1}})
            center := centroid(poly)
            ids[i] = add_subdivision(&s,p,poly,Pose{position=center})
            delete(poly.points)
        }
        add_connection(&s,ids[0],ids[1]); add_connection(&s,ids[1],ids[2])
        for id in ids { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[p]].subdivisions,id) }
        for c in s.connections { append(&s.pieces[s.piece_rows[p]].connections,c.id) }
        return s
    }
    
    scene_destroy :: proc(s: ^Scene) {

        delete(s.vertices)
        for p in s.pieces { delete(p.subdivisions); delete(p.connections) }
        delete(s.subdivisions); delete(s.connections); delete(s.pieces)
        delete(s.materials); delete(s.remnants)
        for name in s.owned_names { delete(name) }
        delete(s.owned_names)
        delete(s.sub_rows); delete(s.conn_rows); delete(s.piece_rows)
        s^ = {}
    }

    // A shallow read view. Geometry and memberships remain owned by the scene.
    read_state :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> Snapshot {
        out := Snapshot{version=2,next_id=s.next_id,revision=s.revision,minimum_width=s.minimum_width}
        for m in s.materials {
            wire := Wire_Material{name=m.name,subdivision_strength=m.subdivision_strength,connection_strength=m.connection_strength,flexibility=m.flexibility,generation_count=m.generation_count,aspect_ratio=m.aspect_ratio,triangulate=m.triangulate}
            if math.is_inf(m.subdivision_strength) { wire.subdivision_infinite=true; wire.subdivision_strength=0 }
            if math.is_inf(m.connection_strength) { wire.connection_infinite=true; wire.connection_strength=0 }
            append(&out.materials,wire)
        }
        ids: [dynamic]u64
        defer delete(ids)
        for sub in s.subdivisions { if sub.live { append(&ids,sub.id) } }
        sort_ids(ids[:])
        for id in ids { append(&out.subdivisions,s.subdivisions[s.sub_rows[id]]) }
        clear(&ids)
        for c in s.connections { if c.live { append(&ids,c.id) } }
        sort_ids(ids[:])
        for id in ids { c:=s.connections[s.conn_rows[id]]; append(&out.connections,Wire_Connection{c.id,c.a,c.b}) }
        clear(&ids)
        for p in s.pieces { if p.live { append(&ids,p.id) } }
        sort_ids(ids[:])
        for id in ids { append(&out.pieces,s.pieces[s.piece_rows[id]]) }
        return out
    }
    release_state_view :: proc(snapshot: ^Snapshot) {
        delete(snapshot.materials); delete(snapshot.subdivisions); delete(snapshot.connections); delete(snapshot.pieces)
        snapshot^ = {}
    }
    encode_snapshot :: proc(s: ^Scene) -> ([]byte,bool) {
        view := read_state(s)
        defer release_state_view(&view)
        data,err := json.marshal(view,{pretty=true})
        return data,err == nil
    }
    destroy_decoded_snapshot :: proc(snapshot: ^Snapshot) {
        for m in snapshot.materials { delete(m.name) }
        for sub in snapshot.subdivisions { delete(sub.outline.points) }
        for p in snapshot.pieces { delete(p.subdivisions); delete(p.connections) }
        release_state_view(snapshot)
    }
