    # Contact impulse verification
    
    The runtime C b2GetVersion call reports **3.1.1**. This default compiler target reports AVX2 false and links **box2d_windows_amd64_sse2.lib** (840310 bytes). The installed build script specifies 3.1.1. Compiler/bindings are Odin dev-2026-05 ea5175d.
    
    The [3.1.1 header](https://github.com/erincatto/box2d/blob/v3.1.1/include/box2d/collision.h) reveals stale binding names, with compatible binary layout: byte 28, called totalNormalImpulse by Odin, is C normalImpulse; byte 32 is tangentImpulse; byte 36, called maxNormalImpulse by Odin, is C totalNormalImpulse; byte 40 is normalVelocity. There is **no public maxNormalImpulse** in this library. Point/manifold sizes are 48/112 bytes, matching the declarations. Thus my earlier description of a positive peak with zero total was incorrect: it was positive actual total with zero final-substep normal impulse.
    
    [Contact update](https://github.com/erincatto/box2d/blob/v3.1.1/src/contact.c) clears total and velocity while rebuilding manifolds, preserving matched normal/tangent impulses for warm starting. [Solver preparation/storage](https://github.com/erincatto/box2d/blob/v3.1.1/src/contact_solver.c) initialize the counter, capture pre-solve relative velocity and store results after the substep loop. The [pipeline](https://github.com/erincatto/box2d/blob/v3.1.1/src/solver.c) runs biased solve and relaxation in each substep; both add nonnegative accumulated normal impulses to the total. Restitution adds its increment. This is not the signed sum of velocity-changing increments.
    
    ## Seeded Wood drop
    
    Same 2.4-square object, bounds (1.5,0)-(3.9,2.4), seed 42/context 178, settled 120 ticks, lifted 0.50 and tilted 0.15 radians. Speed qualification stays enabled. Player starts supported in all variants to isolate the block. Each run stops at root failure. Mass 5.76000023; dt=1/60 s; 4 substeps; h=1/240 s. The first actual impact is tick 17 in every run. Impulses below sum the root's contact points. Forces/torques are the code's calculated solver readouts, not independent net-force measurements.
    
    | Variant / observation | Tick | Closing speed | Final normal / actual total | Final tangent | Force (x,y) | Torque | Failure |
    |---|---:|---:|---|---:|---|---:|---|
    | Old fallback off: first impact | 17 | 2.61333 | 0 / 27.23360 | 0 | (0,0) | 0 | No |
    | Old fallback off: first failure | 26 | 2.61386 | 0.59107 / 15.46410 | -0.35464 | (-85.1139,35.4641) | -58.8553 | Load 92.2067 |
    | Old fallback on: impact/failure | 17 | 2.61333 | 0 / 27.23360 | 0 | (0,1634.0161) | -1674.7167 | Load 1674.7167 |
    | Correct total, no fallback | 17 | 2.61333 | 0 / 27.23360 | 0 | (0,1634.0161) | -1674.7167 | Load 1674.7167 |
    
    Tick 17's individual actual totals are 0 and 27.23360443; both final normal/tangent impulses are zero. At tick 26, the approaching point has final normal 0.59106886, tangent -0.35464132, actual total 14.43470192; another point contributes the remainder. The 1675 load is **torque divided by the one-unit reference length**, slightly exceeding the normal-force readout.
    
    ## Momentum sanity check
    
    At tick 17 the measured velocity changes from (0,-2.61333251) to (1.0795612,-0.56445009). Correcting for gravity gives:
    
    J_contacts = m*(v_after-v_before) - m*(0,-9.8)*dt = **(6.218273,12.742363)**.
    
    Gravity's vertical impulse is -0.940800. The root has no joints, damping or other applied forces; contact is with the static floor. This is a measured net-contact check subject to floating-point integration precision. The vertical equivalent average force is about **764.54**, not 1634.02. The public total includes impulses subsequently relaxed, so it exceeds signed net momentum transfer. Also, final tangent impulse is zero despite nonzero horizontal momentum change: a final-substep sample cannot recover earlier friction. Contact torque uses debug world points and a post-step center, so it approximates the moment over the entire step.
    
    Divide accumulated total by **dt**, not h; the latter would inflate the readout another fourfold. This is a consistent equivalent solver-load policy, not an exact physical net force, peak force or energy measure. This pass fixes interpretation without calibrating that policy.

    Removed the conditional peak fallback; added a local accessor for the actual total with compile-time size/offset guards. External vendor files are untouched. Correct totals exposed the player's artificial 0.09-unit startup fall as a real floor impact; spawn height is now half-height + 0.005 so entering Test stays harmless without weakening the 1-unit/s gate.

Strengths, recipes, blast behavior, B policy, flexibility and rendering are unchanged. Temporary probes and copied archive were removed. The corrected read preserves earlier impact detection and does not reduce the 1675 solver-load value; subsequent tuning must distinguish that value from net momentum.
